title: Team Lead
description:
Raymond West is looking for a dynamic Field Service Team Leader to join the Service Department. The Field Service Team Leader is responsible for assisting the DSM in directing and supporting the Field Service Technicians assigned to the Field Service Team Leader. Primary responsibility is to provide technical support at the field level. Correspond with company and/or Raymond factory technical support resources to resolve technical and troubleshooting issues that arise. Responsible for handling customer related issues in the assigned territory at the direction of the DSM. Responsible for coordinating all operational activities associated with a specific function within the assigned department. Assist DSM in achieving Service Department KPI standards with their assigned team and assists in the supervision of several employees as direct reports.

Raymond West is committed to providing our customers with end-to-end warehouse solutions. We bring you our industry-leading expertise in lift trucks, racking, conveyor, dock and door, rentals, parts, and service. Our customers trust us to provide the right supply chain solutions and services to keep their business up and running.

Duties and Responsibilities:

Primary duties and responsibilities will vary with the specific position. Typical responsibilities are listed below. This list is not inclusive.

  • Assign and supervise the operational activities within the Service Department.
  • Determine work procedures and expedite workflow
  • Issues instructions to staff
  • Troubleshoot and resolve problems
  • Arrange schedules and set priorities for staff
  • Communicate processes and procedures to internal and external constituents
  • Train and coach staff on process and procedures
  • Assist in the overall direction of the department; may serve as member of various committees.
  • Conduct performance evaluations for direct reports
  • Manage employee’s timecard utilizing the company’s Time and Attendance system
  • Assists direct reports to help achieve Service Department goals
  • Direct and prepare reports for Service Department Senior leadership
  • Participate in Company or Department projects
  • Ensure employees and team are following all Company Policies
  • Works closely with other departments and communicate with all levels of employees, customers, and Manufacturers both verbally and in writing
  • Demonstrates drive and initiative
  • Maintains a professional attitude in all matters
  • Must be able to manage time efficiently
  • Provide troubleshooting assistance for assigned technicians having difficulties with a particular job.
  • Resolve customer/technician related problems in conjunction with the DSM and the sales team.
  • Correspond with the DSM, factory and Technical Training on technical problems concerning equipment that the company sells and services.
  • Assist DSM with performance reviews for assigned technicians.
  • Maintain at least an 80% productivity level.
  • Assist DSM and dispatch team in achieving team SM completion goals.
  • Assist DSM in maintaining CFPM controls and cost reduction at assigned accounts
  • Perform 90-day inspections that are not on contract and are not assigned to a CCM as directed by the DSM.
  • Assist dispatch with tech assignments as needed.
  • Work with dispatchers to achieve 1st call completion and response time goals.
  • Assure that all team members adhere to all safety requirements and actively work to reduce work related accidents.
  • Assist DSM in establishing team goals. Review results monthly with DSM and Quarterly with the Director of Service Operations.
  • Assist DSM in maintaining team standards for WIP and timecards and GPS.
  • Work in conjunction with DSM, trainers, and SM auditor to assess tech skills and obtain necessary training.
  • Work with DSM to assess workload distribution and addition of technicians
  • Oversee Raymond projects within guidelines provided by Raymond as directed by DSM.
  • Fill in for DSM as assigned during DSM absences

Required Skills/Abilities:

  • Must be able to fulfill essential job function in a consistent state of alertness and safe manner.
  • Possess strong instructional skills. Be able to effectively demonstrate to technicians how to diagnose and troubleshoot specific technical problems.
  • Must be customer focused both internally and externally.
  • Exhibit strong leadership qualities and coach team members in daily activities and technical procedures.
  • Be able to communicate effectively with customer representatives and with all levels of RW management.
  • Possess excellent organizational and time management skills.
  • Must be flexible and able to adapt to varying workloads, work hours and environments.
  • Be willing to comply with employee handbook.
  • Possess working knowledge of personal computers including DOS and Windows applications.
  • Possess sound working knowledge of basic DC and AC electricity, SCR, wire guidance, transistor, microprocessor, internal combustion engines, hydraulic components, and systems.
  • Must have a valid California Driver License and maintain a Department of Motor Vehicles Report with no more than the acceptable number of points as determined by our vehicle insurance carrier

Education/Experience:

  • High School diploma or equivalent is required.
  • Possess a minimum of 5 years field breakdown experience or comparable service experience or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Level 2 Certification is preferred.
  • Must have completed the Raymond Technical Primer
  • Must have completed the RW Scheduled Maintenance Primer

Travel Requirement:

  • This position will be based in the field and require daily travel within assigned territories.
  • Lead Technicians will be provided a company vehicle and a company Fuel Card to pay for vehicle expenses.
  • Must be able to be insured by Raymond West.

Physical Requirements:

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • Position is non-Sedentary
  • Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.
  • The employee is regularly exposed to moving mechanical parts.
  • Position will be required to go onto job sites to perform duties where construction is underway.
  • The employee must frequently lift and/or move up to 50 pounds.
  • The position will require employees to use hands to finger, handle, or feel and reach with hands and arms.
  • The employee is occasionally required to smell.
  • Position requires the employee to climb/balance/stoop/kneel/crouch and crawl
  • The employee is frequently exposed to outside weather conditions and the risk of electrical shock.
  • The employee is occasionally exposed to wet and/or humid conditions; high, precarious places; fumes or airborne particles; toxic or caustic chemicals; extreme cold; extreme heat; and vibration.
  • The noise level in the work environment is sometimes loud.

Pay Range:

  • The hourly range for this position is $35.00 - $55.00. The specific pay offered to a candidate may be influenced by a variety of factors including but not limited to the candidate’s relevant experience, education, and work location.

Qualified candidates must be able to be insured by Raymond West and able to pass a pre-employment physical and drug screen.

Raymond West provides medical, dental, vision, 401k with company match, flexible spending accounts, disability insurance, life insurance, personal time off, holiday pay and a great team to work with!


Check us out at . Raymond West has a great group of loyal and hardworking employees who help us maintain our exemplary level of sales and service.

Apply on-line via the submit resume button provided. We are an equal opportunity employer and encourage all qualified persons to apply. We encourage qualified military veterans and persons with disabilities to submit their resume online. We will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in accordance with the FCO. We are a drug free company.

title: Sr. Program Manager
description:
Who We Are

We are an award-winning independent creative solutions company that aspires to be the most culturally-influential company in the world. We help ambitious brands harness the power of culture to solve their biggest challenges. As a unique mix of experts in culture, technology, and storytelling, we are united by a passion to grow brands in ways that advertising alone can never do.

We are an entrepreneurial business – not a traditional “ad agency.” That means we value resourcefulness and tenacity just as much as we value creativity and intelligence. We’re unapologetically ambitious!

We are looking for a Sr. Program Manager to join Translation!

This role is based in Brooklyn, New York with four days in-office and one day remote.


What You'll Do

  • Own the how. Develop scopes, timelines, budgets and delivery systems for programs ranging from complex to “simple.” Don’t assume one size fits all.
  • Coordinate internal and external meetings throughout the lifecycle of the program, and maintain close coordination with key stakeholders, including Business Leadership and Production.
  • Deliver strategic and creative deliverables directly to day to day clients. Own contact reports, internally and back to the client.
  • Manage talent allocations week over week. Work with the Group Engagement Director and Business Leadership to ensure programs are planned to achieve successful completion, including coming in on time and on budget.
  • Coordinate internal teams, ensure high quality delivery, and manage back to overarching strategy of the engagement.
  • Develop a strong understanding of client’s business and industry, key competitors, and audience demographics.
  • Help maintain integrated ways of working by reinforcing team processes and managing documentation and communications.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • A proactive, hands-on mentality. You take immense pride in your work. You’re results-driven and detail-oriented, but also passionate about people, culture, and creativity.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present ideas clearly, accurately, and succinctly.
  • Stellar time management and organizational skills, able to juggle multiple priorities under tight deadlines without sacrificing quality.
  • Thick-skinned, persistent, and diplomatic—you handle challenges with optimism and a solutions-oriented mindset.
  • Comfortable navigating across multiple internal disciplines (creative, production, strategy) and external partners to keep projects moving forward.
  • An understanding of when to escalate challenges and opportunities to the appropriate leads.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in a creative agency or similar communications environment, with a strong understanding of advertising, marketing, media, production, and agency finance.
  • Familiarity with the lifecycle of integrated campaigns across broadcast, digital, experiential and/or social.
  • Experience supporting or leading calls with cross-functional agency teams and interfacing directly with clients.
  • Fluent in Google Suite (especially Sheets and Slides); experience with resource management or workforce planning, as well as project planning tools.
  • Strong curiosity with a strong desire to learn and engage AI tools.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience directly managing timelines and deliverables for creative and production workstreams.
  • Exposure to or direct experience with production processes.
  • Acted as a producer or account executive in an agency environment with client facing
  • A passion for culture, innovation, and helping brands show up meaningfully in the world.

About UnitedMasters, Inc.

UnitedMasters Inc. represents the creative solutions company, Translation, and the leading software and services platform for independent creators, UnitedMasters. UnitedMasters enables ownership, exposure, and new paths for financial return for independent creators, while Translation helps brands leverage the power of contemporary culture to achieve transformational growth. Combined, UnitedMasters, Inc. is the world’s leading marketplace for cultural capital, connecting independent artists and brands to realize a future in which all creators own their future. Backed by Alphabet, Andreessen Horowitz, and Apple, UnitedMasters, Inc. is reimagining how brands and artists come together to tell their stories, build profitable growth, and push culture forward.

Salary Hiring Range: $95,000 - $115,000

Our salary ranges are based on paying competitively for our size and industry, and are one part of many compensation, benefits and other reward opportunities we provide (e.g. bonus, stock options, 401(k) match, etc.)

Individual pay rate decisions are based on a number of factors, including qualifications for the role, experience level, skillset, and balancing internal equity relative to peers at the company. We expect the majority of the candidates who are offered roles at our company to fall healthily throughout the range based on these factors.

The range above is for the expectations as laid out in the job description, however we are often open to a wide variety of profiles, and recognize that the person we hire may be less experienced (or more senior) than this job description as posted. If that ends up being the case, the updated salary range will be communicated with you as a candidate.

The salary range above is for the NY/CA. As a company, we have a location based strategy, which means the salary range could be lower or higher than this if the role is hired in another location.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Frontend
description:
Circle (NYSE: CRCL) is one of the world’s leading internet financial platform companies, building the foundation of a more open, global economy through digital assets, payment applications, and programmable blockchain infrastructure. Circle’s platform includes the world’s largest regulated stablecoin network anchored by USDC, Circle Payments Network for global money movement, and Arc, an enterprise-grade blockchain designed to become the Economic OS for the internet. Enterprises, financial institutions, and developers use Circle to power trusted, internet-scale financial innovation. Learn more at .

What you’ll be part of:

Circle is committed to visibility and stability in everything we do. As we grow as an organization, we're expanding into some of the world's strongest jurisdictions. Speed and efficiency are motivators for our success and our employees live by our company values: High Integrity, Future Forward, Multistakeholder, Mindful, and Driven by Excellence. We have built a flexible work environment where new ideas are encouraged and everyone is a stakeholder.

What you’ll be responsible for

You will build world-class Web3 consumer applications, web SDKs, and developer tools that make it easier for developers to integrate with Circle’s existing and future product offerings. You will also create internal tools that enable our Customer Success teams to deliver exceptional support. As a member of a dedicated engineering team, you will contribute to Circle’s broader frontend ecosystem by participating in code reviews, promoting consistent engineering practices, and maintaining a high standard for quality. You will collaborate closely with Product, Design, and Engineering partners to translate requirements into intuitive, reliable, and scalable experiences for developers and end users.

What you’ll work on

  • Build and maintain responsive Web3 applications using modern frontend technologies.

  • Develop web SDKs and tools that simplify integration with Circle products and services.

  • Design reusable, accessible, and scalable frontend components for shared use across products.

  • Partner with Product and Design to translate user needs into intuitive, high-quality features.

  • Build internal tools that help Customer Success teams resolve customer needs efficiently.

  • Participate in code and design reviews to improve quality, consistency, and maintainability.

  • Use automated testing, continuous delivery practices, and AI-assisted development tools to improve engineering velocity.

What you’ll bring to Circle

Core requirements

  • 4+ years of experience building user interfaces for complex web applications.

  • Strong proficiency in HTML, CSS, TypeScript, and JavaScript.

  • Experience building responsive, component-based applications with React.

  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as Claude, Codex, Cursor, or similar platforms.

  • Experience writing well-tested, maintainable code and contributing to strong coding standards.

  • Strong product judgment and the ability to identify opportunities to improve usability and quality.

  • Experience collaborating with product managers, designers, and distributed engineering teams.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly present technical concepts.

Preferred requirements

  • Experience with Node.js, developer platforms, SDKs, Web3 products, or blockchain technologies.

title: Partnerships Coordinator
description:
Partnerships Coordinator (Freelance)

Location: Remote (Colombia preferred) | Engagement: Independent contractor, ongoing | Hours: Overlap required with US Eastern business hours

We're a talent agency representing some of the most respected science and education creators on YouTube. We're looking for a freelance coordinator to keep our brand deals running smoothly from signed contract to published video.

About Us

We're an independent agency focused on factual and educational YouTube creators. Brand partnerships and sponsorship integrations are the core of what we do. Our creators are at the center of everything, and every decision starts with what's best for them.

What You'll Do
- Campaign coordination: Own timelines across brands, agencies, and creators. Send briefs, chase approvals, confirm go-live dates, and make sure every deliverable ships on time.
- Deal tracking: Keep our deal tracker and CRM current from signed deal to payment, so anyone on the team can see stage, deliverables, dates, and payment status at a glance.
- Brief and draft review: Check brand briefs and creator drafts against the signed contract (talking points, disclosures, links, restrictions) before anything goes live. Flag conflicts early.
- Contract admin: Prepare contract packets, track redlines and signatures, and log key terms like exclusivity windows, usage rights, and payment schedules.
- Creator support: Help keep creator profiles and rate cards up to date. Be a reliable, responsive point of contact on logistics.
- Reporting: Pull post-campaign performance into recaps that support renewals and new pitches.

What We're Looking For
- 1-2 years in a coordinator, project management, or operations role. Experience in talent management, influencer marketing, or brand partnerships is a plus.
Strong organizational skills. You can keep a dozen campaigns, contracts, and invoices straight without dropping details.
- Clear, professional written English. You'll be communicating with brands and creators daily.
- Comfort reading contracts and spotting the terms that matter: deliverables, usage, exclusivity, payment terms.
- Experience with CRM and project management tools (we use Pipedrive, Trello, Slack, Google Workspace).
- Good judgment about what to handle yourself and what to escalate.

Nice to Have
- Familiarity with YouTube: how creator content gets made, Shorts, analytics basics.
- Experience with sponsorship metrics (CPM, CTR, conversion tracking).
- Working knowledge of FTC/ASA disclosure rules for sponsored content.
- Genuine interest in science, history, or educational content.

Rate
$1,200 - $1,800 USD per month, depending on experience. Paid monthly.
As the engagement develops and your responsibilities grow, compensation will grow with it.

Why Work With Us
- Work alongside some of the most respected educational creators on YouTube. Names you'll be proud to have on your resume.
- A small, growing team where you work directly with the founders and your input matters from day one.
- Hands-on exposure to how brand deals, contracts, and creator business development actually work.
- Real room to grow. This role expands as the agency does.
- Fully remote and flexible.

To Apply
Please include your expected monthly rate in USD with your application. Applications without a rate will not be considered.

Location: Remote - GMT-07:00 to GMT-03:00

  • Customer relationship management (CRM)

  • Influencer marketing

title: Proposal Analyst - EMEA
description:
About the Role

We’re seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Proposal Analyst to support the end-to-end proposal development process in a fast-paced, high-growth startup environment. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in dynamic, evolving environments, enjoys solving problems, and is eager to take ownership of systems and processes that directly impact sales success.

You will play a key role in crafting compelling RFX responses, while also helping to manage content and tools—especially Arphie, our AI-powered proposal management platform. This role requires adaptability, initiative, and excellent cross-functional collaboration.

Ideal candidates should bring foundational experience in the travel industry and a deep commitment for mastering Navan’s product ecosystem, business model, and the broader corporate travel and expense landscape. This role requires excellent organizational skills, strong attention to detail, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment.

What You’ll Do:

Proposal Development

  • Manage and respond to RFPs, RFIs, and vendor questionnaires in collaboration with Sales, Product, Legal, and other subject matter experts.
  • Analyze requirements and tailor responses to align with client needs, ensuring compliance and brand consistency.
  • Ensure timely, high-quality proposal submissions under tight deadlines.

Content Management

  • Help maintain the proposal content library, ensuring all information is accurate, up to date, and properly categorized.
  • Help ensure content reflects the latest product capabilities, positioning, and compliance standards.

Collaboration & Communication

  • Work cross-functionally with product, marketing, legal, compliance, and technical teams to gather accurate input for proposals.
  • Coordinate internal review and approval workflows.
  • Communicate proposal timelines, responsibilities, and status updates clearly and consistently.

What We’re Looking For:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Journalism, English, or related field.
  • 2-4 years of experience in proposal coordination, RFP writing, or sales enablement—ideally within a B2B SaaS or tech company.
  • Familiarity with proposal automation platforms such as Responsive, Loopio, etc.; (direct experience with Arphie is a strong plus.)
  • Excellent writing, editing, and proofreading skills with a keen eye for detail.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills; able to manage multiple priorities under tight deadlines.
  • Technically savvy, with experience using CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce), collaboration tools (e.g., Slack), Google Suite and MS Office.
  • Ability to work independently in a fast-paced, ever-changing startup environment.
  • Comfort working cross-functionally with both technical and non-technical teams.

Preferred Skills

  • Hands-on experience applying large language models (LLMs) like ChatGPT to support proposal writing, content management, or sales enablement workflows.
  • Experience working with SaaS travel and expense management solutions.
  • Experience is the corporate travel and/or fintech space preferred.
  • Familiarity with industry compliance frameworks (SOC 2, GDPR, ISO 27001, etc.).
  • Experience scaling proposal operations in a startup or growth-stage company.

title: Lead Software Engineer
description:
Why Faculty?


We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here.

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.

Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.

About the Team

Bringing medicine to patients is complex, expensive and high-risk. Faculty’s Life Science’s team is concentrated on building AI solutions which optimise the research and commercialisation of life-changing therapies.

We partner with major pharma firms, academic research centres and MedTech start-ups to design and deliver solutions which address critical healthcare challenges, and help to democratise health for all.

About the role

Join us as a Lead Software Engineer to spearhead the technical direction and delivery of complex, innovative AI and software projects. You will act as a technical expert, applying your skills across various projects from solution architecture to client-side deployments, while ensuring engineering decisions are sound and reliable.

This role demands deep technical expertise and a genuine curiosity for solving hard engineering problems, focusing on driving innovation and building reusable solutions across the organisation. If you're ready to get hands-on with practical, innovative outcomes, this is your chance to shape our future.

What you'll be doing

  • Setting the technical direction for complex ML and software projects, balancing trade-offs, and guiding team priorities

  • Architecting, implementing, and maintaining reliable, scalable ML/software systems, and justifying key architectural decisions.

  • Defining project problems, developing roadmaps, and overseeing delivery across multiple workstreams in often ill-defined, high-risk environments.

  • Driving the development of shared resources and libraries across the organisation and guiding other engineers in contributing to them.

  • Leading hiring processes, making informed selection decisions, and mentoring multiple individuals to foster team growth.

  • Proactively developing and executing recommendations for adopting new technologies, tools and changing our ways of working to stay ahead of the competition.

  • Acting as a technical expert and coach for customers, accurately estimating large work-streams and defending rationale to stakeholders.

Who we're looking for

  • You are a technical expert among your peers, capable of going deep on particular topics and demonstrating breadth of knowledge to solve almost any problem.

  • You possess strong software engineering skills in Python and at least one compiled or strongly-typed language (e.g. Go, Java, Rust, or TypeScript), and know how to build robust, production-grade systems.

  • You are an expert in at least one major Cloud Solution Provider (e.g., Azure, GCP, AWS) and have led teams to build full-stack web applications.

  • You have hands-on experience with containerisation tools like Docker and orchestration via Kubernetes.

  • You can successfully guide and support a team of engineers, helping them deliver great work for clients.

  • You find novel, clever solutions for project delivery and take ownership for successful project outcomes.

  • You're an excellent communicator who can proactively help customers achieve their goals and guide both technical teams and non-technical stakeholders.

Our Interview Process

  1. Talent Team Screen (30 minutes)

  2. Introduction to the role (45 minutes)

  3. Pair Programming Interview (90 minutes)

  4. System Design Interview (90 minutes)

  5. Commercial & Leadership Interview (60 minutes)

Our Recruitment Ethos

We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. title: Backend Software Engineer - Distribution
description:
About Rune

Rune Technologies builds mission-critical software for military logistics and sustainment. Our flagship product is TyrOS, an AI-enabled logistics command and control platform that gives commanders a single, real-time operating picture of their sustainment fight, from inventory and distribution to medical and operational planning, even in degraded and contested environments.

We're not a traditional defense contractor. We're a small, fast-moving team that combines deep operational experience in and with the DoD with the software discipline of the best product companies, and we apply that combination to a customer set that desperately needs it. We stay close to our users by embedding directly with military units during exercises and rotations, and we ship constantly based on what we learn.

The U.S. military and its allies face a real logistics modernization problem. We're building the software to solve it.

About Rune

Rune Technologies is here to revolutionize the status quo of military logistics and sustainment through the deployment of AI-enabled solutions. Combining elite Silicon Valley software expertise with deep operational experience working in and with the Department of Defense, Rune builds cutting-edge software to solve the most critical logistics challenges faced by the U.S. military and its allies.

Rune’s flagship product is TyrOS, an advanced software platform designed to enhance logistics at tactical and operational echelons, providing unified, comprehensive management of inventory, personnel, equipment, and distribution. TyrOS integrates critical information for holistic, data-driven logistics decisions, leveraging AI for decision support, predictive analytics, and optimization at machine speed.

Rune’s mission is to support and enable the military logistics and sustainment communities with software built to meet the needs of the next fight.

About the Role

The Distribution team at Rune is building the software that determines how supplies, equipment, and other critical resources move through complex logistics networks — from requirements and inventory availability through planning, allocation, routing, dispatch, tracking, and delivery.

Military distribution is a dynamic systems problem. Routes change. Transportation assets become unavailable. Priorities shift. Inventory moves. Communications degrade. Threat conditions evolve. The software supporting these decisions has to continuously reconcile changing information and turn it into reliable, executable actions.

As a Backend Software Engineer focused on Distribution, you will design and build the production systems at the center of these workflows. You’ll own services that model logistics networks, coordinate movement across nodes and transportation modes, manage state across distributed systems, and enable users to rapidly plan and replan as operational conditions change.

This is not a generic backend role. We are particularly interested in engineers who have built software where system decisions directly affect real-world operations — logistics, transportation, fulfillment, routing, dispatch, warehousing, marketplace operations, supply chain, or similar domains.

You will work closely with product engineers, optimization engineers, military domain experts, and platform teams to translate complicated operational workflows into resilient, scalable software. The result is a distribution capability that can operate from enterprise environments to the tactical edge and give military users a dramatically better way to understand, plan, and execute logistics movements.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the architecture and development of backend services supporting Rune’s distribution capabilities across TyrOS.

  • Design systems that support end-to-end logistics workflows including:

    • Transportation and movement planning

    • Routing and dispatch

    • Shipment creation and execution

    • Asset and capacity allocation

    • Multi-modal transportation

    • Scheduling and time-window management

    • Tracking and status reconciliation

    • Dynamic replanning when conditions change

  • Translate real-world logistics workflows into durable domain models, APIs, services, and event-driven systems.

  • Build systems that reconcile inventory, demand, transportation capacity, location, time, priority, and other operational constraints across distributed networks.

  • Develop performant, production-grade services in Go and integrate them directly into TyrOS and the broader Rune platform.

  • Integrate optimization and planning capabilities into operational software, turning algorithmic recommendations into reliable, understandable, and executable workflows.

  • Design systems capable of handling partial, delayed, conflicting, or changing information while maintaining a reliable representation of operational state.

  • Build APIs, messaging patterns, data pipelines, and backend infrastructure that allow distribution services to communicate effectively across Rune’s product ecosystem.

  • Design for environments where bandwidth, connectivity, compute, latency, and system availability may all be constrained.

  • Partner directly with military users and domain experts to understand how distribution actually operates, identify the highest-leverage problems, and convert ambiguous requirements into scalable software.

  • Make architectural decisions that balance speed of development with long-term reliability, maintainability, and extensibility.

  • Establish strong engineering practices around testing, observability, performance, failure recovery, and operational resilience.

  • Provide technical leadership to other engineers through system design, code review, mentorship, and ownership of complex cross-functional initiatives.

Qualifications

  • 7+ years of backend, platform, or distributed systems engineering experience, including substantial ownership of production-grade software.

  • Demonstrated experience building production systems in logistics, transportation, fulfillment, routing, dispatch, shipment management, warehousing, marketplace operations, supply chain, travel, operations planning, or another similarly complex operational domain.

  • Experience building software that supports real-world planning or operational decision-making, rather than exclusively transactional or CRUD-oriented backend applications.

  • Strong programming skills in one or more performant languages such as Go, C++, Java, or Rust.

  • Strong understanding of distributed systems concepts including service architecture, asynchronous processing, messaging, state management, failure handling, consistency, and system reliability.

  • Experience designing complex domain models and translating evolving business or operational requirements into maintainable software architecture.

  • Strong experience designing and consuming APIs and integrating services through messaging layers, event-driven architectures, and cloud infrastructure.

  • Experience working with large or complex structured datasets and building systems that continuously reconcile changing state.

  • Strong engineering fundamentals including profiling, testing, observability, code review, performance tuning, version control, and production debugging.

  • Demonstrated ability to independently lead complex technical projects from ambiguous problem definition through architecture, implementation, deployment, and production operation.

  • Ability to collaborate effectively with product managers, domain experts, operations researchers, and engineers across multiple parts of a software platform.

Desired Qualifications

  • Experience building software for transportation management, fleet management, freight, supply chain planning, warehouse management, order fulfillment, travel, logistics marketplaces, or network planning.

  • Experience with production optimization or planning systems involving routing, scheduling, allocation, matching, capacity planning, or other constrained decision-making problems.

  • Familiarity with optimization approaches such as MIP, LP, CP, graph algorithms, heuristics, or vehicle-routing techniques.

  • Familiarity with optimization libraries or tools such as OR-Tools, Gurobi, or other commercial solvers.

  • Experience with geospatial, temporal, transportation, or logistics datasets.

  • Experience designing systems that must continuously replan or respond to changes in demand, capacity, availability, priority, or external conditions.

  • Experience with event-driven systems and architectures where information arrives asynchronously from multiple sources.

  • Experience with systems deployed in constrained environments, including edge compute, unreliable networks, or latency-sensitive applications.

  • Experience with military logistics, defense software, contested logistics, or Department of Defense users and systems.

  • Background working alongside operations research, applied mathematics, optimization, or data science teams.

Benefits

Rune offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees to include a full suite of insurance options at no cost for employees and low-cost to spouses and dependents. Highly competitive equity grants are also included in the majority of full time offers and are considered part of Rune's total compensation package. Benefits include:

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans; premiums 100% covered by Rune for all employees; exceptionally low premiums for spouses and dependents

  • Basic life insurance and disability 100% covered for all employees by Rune; option to purchase additional life insurance available

  • ‘Take the time off that you need, when you need it’ paid time off, not accrual based

  • Generous company holiday calendar including a holiday shutdown in December

  • Supportive leave of absence program including time off for military service, medical events, and parental leave

  • Full 401(k) retirement plan for all full-time eligible employees

  • Company-funded commuter benefits

  • Free access to on-site gym at office

title: Lead RF PCB Layout Engineer
description:
Array Labs builds advanced radar systems to help humanity understand and respond to changes across the physical world.
We’re launching a coordinated fleet of radar satellites to create a high-resolution 3D map of the Earth – updated in real time – enabling faster, smarter decision-making for government and commercial organizations supporting disaster response, infrastructure resilience, and mission-critical geopolitical intelligence.
We design and build our satellites end-to-end, producing the world’s most advanced earth observation satellites. Our fleet will deliver unprecedented levels of accuracy, coverage, and responsiveness to power critical insights precisely where they’re needed most.
About the job
As a Lead RF PCB Layout Engineer, you will own the physical implementation of Array’s RF and microwave electronics in Altium, translating schematics and performance requirements into layouts that work on the first spin. Your work will include component placement, controlled-impedance routing, stack-up definition, grounding and shielding strategy, connector and launch design, and isolation of sensitive RF and mixed-signal domains.
You will partner closely with RF design, electrical, antenna, mixed-signal, mechanical, and test engineers to drive layout constraints, reviews, and manufacturing releases. The boards you ship will directly determine RF performance, stability, spurious behavior, and overall sensor reliability in the lab and on orbit.
Responsibilities:
  • Own RF PCB layout from initial placement through manufacturing release in Altium Designer
  • Define and implement stack-ups, controlled-impedance routing, and RF grounding, shielding, and isolation strategies
  • Translate schematic intent into layouts that meet RF performance requirements, including connector launches, transitions, filtering, and protection circuitry placement
  • Partner with RF design, electrical, antenna, mixed-signal, mechanical, and test engineers to develop layout constraints, run reviews, and de-risk first-pass success
  • Drive DFM/DFT considerations with fabrication and assembly partners, including documentation and release artifacts
Basic Qualifications:
  • B.S. in Electrical Engineering, or a related field with 8+ years of relevant experience
  • Experience in PCB layout, fabrication, and release of RF and/or high-performance electronics
  • Excellent teamwork and communication skills
  • Learns new concepts rapidly, completely, and in a self-directed manner
  • High levels of self-motivation and personal accountability
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment under significant time constraints
Preferred Skills and Experience:
  • Experience designing RF and microwave PCB layouts including controlled-impedance routing, launches and transitions, grounding, shielding, and isolation
  • Comfort with Altium Designer for constraint-driven layout and clean manufacturing outputs; experience with Allegro and/or OrCAD is a plus
  • Experience developing PCB stack-ups and layout constraints for high-frequency, high-performance electronics
  • A strong intuition for layout-driven RF behavior, including coupling, return paths, leakage, spurious paths, and stability risks
  • Experience working closely with RF design engineers to translate schematic intent into layouts that work on the first spin
  • Experience with manufacturing release, DFM/DFT considerations, and collaborating with fabrication and assembly partners
  • Experience supporting lab bring-up and RF characterization alongside design and test engineers (e.g., helping troubleshoot issues seen on VNAs, spectrum analyzers, and in system testing)
  • Experience with EM and RF analysis workflows for layout validation (e.g., HFSS, CST, ADS Momentum) is a plus
  • Experience taking RF hardware from prototype through qualification and environmental testing
ITAR Requirements:
  • To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) you must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State
Equal Opportunity Employer:
  • Array Labs is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made on the basis of merit, competence, and job qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by gender, color, race, ethnicity, national origin, sexual orientation, religion, age, gender identity, veteran status, disability status, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status
Interview Process
We will conduct interviews via Google Meet; the typical process takes around 2-4 weeks to complete from start to finish.
Hiring and Compensation Strategy
Our hiring and compensation strategy is simple:
1) find uncommonly good people
2) pay them uncommonly well
You can anticipate competitive pay, with high flexibility between salary and equity-based compensation.
Why Join Array Labs?
Array Labs is launching a constellation of satellites to create the first high-resolution, real-time, three-dimensional model of Earth. Our next-generation satellite technology will offer image quality 60x greater than traditional techniques, profoundly expanding humanity’s ability to understand and respond to events on a global scale.
In forging an affordable, accessible, accurate representation of Earth, our work has the potential to transform the face of dozens of fields, including autonomy, telecommunications, disaster relief, gaming, climate science, defense and construction.

title: Spacecraft Propulsion Systems Engineer II
description:
ABOUT ROCKET LAB

Rocket Lab is the end-to-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity’s reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We move fast, build real hardware for meaningful missions, and make the impossible routine. Come shape the future with us.

SPACE SYSTEMS

At Rocket Lab, we’re not just launching rockets — we're building the future of space. Our Space Systems team builds everything from complete spacecraft, precision payloads to the components and subsystems that allow them to thrive in space, like solar panels, flight software, star trackers, optical systems, separation systems, radios, and more.

Our Space Systems team has enabled more than 1,700 missions, ranging from interplanetary exploration, in-space manufacturing to national security and defense initiatives. The team has built spacecraft, payloads, and components for missions to the Moon and Mars, working with partners including NASA, the Space Development Agency, and the U.S. Space Force. Whether it’s a single high-performance spacecraft, constellation, or the vertically integrated components that help them get to space — our world class Space Systems team is empowering some of the boldest and most ambitious space missions.

SPACECRAFT PROPULSION SYSTEMS ENGINEER II

We're currently seeking a Spacecraft Propulsion Systems Engineer II for our propulsion engineering team based out of Long Beach, CA. As a Propulsion Systems Engineer, you're responsible for system-level and component-level ownership of space systems propulsion and fluidic development. This team supports our Space Systems division, and leads cutting-edge programs for civil, commercial, and defense customers.

WHAT YOU’LL GET TO DO:

  • Own development of new or existing products or systems, acting as technical lead to guide team through end-to-end development process.
  • Conceptual and detailed performance calculations, systems modelling, analysis, and system designs.
  • Requirements gathering, definition, and management. Systems engineering activities and leadership within the team.
  • Test planning, setup, instrumentation, execution, and data analysis.
  • Communicate with project stakeholders internal and external to the team.
  • Technical risk-based decision making to the right/best solution when faced with an engineering challenge.
  • Project management including schedule building and maintenance, identifying top priority items, tasking of other engineers and technicians, and communication of status to leadership and other teams.
  • Mentorship and coaching of people within the team on technical and professional development.
  • Defining and maintaining standard of excellence for their team through documentation, training, coaching, and review of others’ work.
  • Contributing to engineering process development and documentation at Rocket Lab related to areas of experience.

YOU’LL BRING THESE QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor’s degree in an engineering discipline.
  • 2+ years of experience in propulsion system development or other high-performance field.
  • US citizenship is required, due to program requirements.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a security clearance.

THESE QUALIFICATIONS WOULD BE NICE TO HAVE:

  • A genuine passion for engineering, curious mindset, and willingness to learn.
  • Demonstrated hands-on engineering skills, inside or outside the workplace.
  • Comfortable working with high levels of ambiguity. Makes decisions using basic engineering principles, available literature and standards, technical risk assessments, test data, and physics-based models.
  • Expertise in propulsion system modelling, static and transient analysis, and model validation using test data using software such as Amesim, EcosimPro, Simulink, Simscape, or similar.
  • Experience working on propulsion systems utilizing different storable propellants, such as electrical and chemical.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to work well within a team environment.
  • Practice in identifying the necessary steps to achieve high level technical goals, scheduling them in a plan, and managing delivery against that plan.
  • Experience with end-to-end development process including gathering requirements, detailed design, qualification, production, and acceptance testing.
  • Strong grasp of all steps in the Systems Engineering V and risk-based decision making.
  • Experience with Jama.
  • Capabilities using Python for data manipulation and post-processing.
  • Detailed mechanical design experience using NX (preferred) or equivalent industry standard CAD software.
  • Experience with GD&T and engineering drawings.
  • Experience using Product Lifecycle Management software such as Teamcenter (preferred), Windchill, or similar.
  • Experience using National Instruments data acquisition systems.
  • Experience with testing and troubleshooting flight hardware.
  • Master's or PhD in engineering.

This position may require prolonged periods of sitting, standing, walking, computer work, and occasional exposure to moderate levels of noise, dust, and fumes in production areas.

Anticipated annual equity grant value is designed around function, level, experience, and other factors; realized value depends on vesting and stock-price performance.

Join one of the world's fastest-growing space companies and own a piece of it. In addition to competitive base pay, you'll receive company stock as part of your total compensation package, giving you a direct stake in our success. As we expand to new launch sites, groundbreaking missions, and global markets, your ownership has the opportunity to grow alongside the company.

Our comprehensive benefits package includes our industry-leading Employee Stock Purchase Program (with a 15% discount on company stock), top-tier medical plans (HMO, PPO, and a zero cost HDHP option with a significant HSA company contribution), dental and vision coverage, paid vacation and sick time, 11 paid holidays, flexible spending and dependent care accounts, paid parental leave, disability and life insurance, and a 401(k) retirement plan with company match.

$111,000—$168,000 USD
Base Salary
$100,000—$150,000 USD

WHAT TO EXPECT

We’re on a mission to unlock the potential of space to improve life on Earth, but that’s not an easy task. It takes hard work, determination, relentless innovation, teamwork, grit, and an unwavering commitment to achieving what others often deem impossible. Our people out-think, out-work, and out-pace. We pride ourselves on having each other’s backs, checking our egos at the door, and rolling up our sleeves on all tasks big and small. We thrive under pressure, work to tight deadlines, and our focus is always on how we can deliver, rather than dwelling on the challenges that stand in the way.

The Research Assistant will play a key role in participant recruitment and study operations. Primary responsibilities include engaging active-duty service members in the primary clinic waiting area, explaining the study, and inviting eligible individuals to complete an online screening questionnaire. The Research Assistant will also assist with participant consent, answer questions about the study, support protocol amendments and regulatory requirements, and help ensure compliance with study procedures. This position requires an on-site presence at Womack Army Medical Center, primarily during morning sick call hours to support recruitment activities. The study will recruit up to nine (9) service members from units at Fort Bragg for enrollment. The project is currently in Phase I, which focuses on participant recruitment and enrollment. Phase II will involve facilitating and supporting focus groups to gather participant feedback and inform future program refinement.

$17.00 PER HOUR. Salaries are determined based on several factors including external market data, internal equity, and the candidate’s related knowledge, skills, and abilities for the position.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience required
  • 1 year experience in research preferred
  • Non-profit, research, or healthcare experience desired
  • Demonstrate competence in oral and written communication
  • Must be organized, attentive to detail, and possess a positive, friendly and professional demeanor
  • Must be flexible with changing priorities and able to communicate in a diplomatic and professional manner
  • Computer skills including at least intermediate level experience with Excel and other Microsoft Office Software
  • Familiarity with medical terminology, medications, laboratory tests, and abbreviations commonly used in patient medical charts

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Adheres to Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA), Good Clinical Practices (GCP), Good Laboratory Practices (GLP), infection control procedures and rules and regulations pertaining to the research site
  • Assist with self-reporting baseline assessment measures

  • Executes, maintains research study to include data collection

  • Manages study documentation to include accurate and timely filing
  • Prepares progress reports
  • Complies with all the rules and regulations as applicable to assigned duty station
  • Documents all correspondence and communication pertinent to the research
  • Interacts and communicates effectively with study and site personnel, research participants, The Geneva Foundation and the study sponsor
  • Promotes safety and confidentiality of research participants at all times

title: Counselor (4532)
description:
Job Summary:

Provides behavioral health assessment, counseling, treatment planning, education, case management, and recovery support services to individuals receiving behavioral health treatment. Assists consumers in identifying treatment needs, achieving recovery goals, accessing community resources, and improving overall functioning and quality of life. Provides individual, group, and family counseling services while ensuring compliance with applicable licensing, certification, documentation, regulatory, and professional practice standards.

Essential Functions:

  • Completes behavioral health assessments and participates in the development of individualized treatment plans.
  • Assists consumers in identifying treatment needs, strengths, goals, and barriers to recovery.
  • Provides individual, group, and family counseling services.
  • Implements evidence-based and recovery-oriented treatment interventions.
  • Monitors consumer progress toward treatment goals and modifies interventions as clinically appropriate.
  • Assists in coordinating treatment planning, discharge planning, and continuity of care services.
  • Provides psychoeducation regarding mental health conditions, coping skills, wellness, recovery principles, and available community resources.
  • Provides crisis intervention services and risk assessment activities as assigned.
  • Participates in interdisciplinary treatment team meetings and service planning activities.
  • Coordinates referrals and access to behavioral healthcare, medical, educational, vocational, housing, and social services.
  • Collaborates with community providers, families, support systems, and referral sources to ensure continuity of care.
  • Maintains client confidentiality and compliance with HIPAA and applicable privacy requirements.
  • Completes all required documentation accurately and within established timeframes.
  • Maintains agency productivity standards and performance expectations.
  • Maintains current knowledge of behavioral health treatment best practices and regulatory requirements.
  • Performs related duties as assigned.

Required Knowledge & Skills:

  • Knowledge of behavioral health disorders, treatment approaches, recovery principles, and evidence-based practices.
  • Knowledge of serious mental illness, emotional and behavioral disorders, co-occurring conditions, and treatment interventions.
  • Knowledge of consumer rights and applicable agency, state, and federal regulations.
  • Knowledge of community resources, healthcare systems, educational services, housing services, and social service programs.
  • Knowledge of clinical documentation requirements, treatment planning, and case management principles.
  • Knowledge of crisis intervention techniques and risk assessment practices.
  • Knowledge of individual, family, and group counseling techniques.
  • Knowledge of family dynamics and support systems.
  • Ability to observe, document, and report consumer functioning and progress.
  • Ability to interpret assessments, evaluations, and treatment recommendations.
  • Ability to develop and implement treatment plans and clinical interventions.
  • Ability to identify community resources and coordinate needed services.
  • Ability to establish effective working relationships with internal staff and external organizations.
  • Ability to interact effectively with consumers and families from diverse backgrounds.
  • Ability to communicate effectively both verbally and in writing.
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality and professional boundaries.
  • Ability to work independently under general supervision.
  • Ability to demonstrate strong interpersonal, counseling, and active listening skills.
  • Ability to establish priorities and manage multiple responsibilities.
  • Ability to coordinate care and facilitate collaboration among treatment providers and support systems.

Primary Responsibilities, but not limited to:

  • Provides behavioral health assessments and counseling services.
  • Develops and monitors individualized treatment plans.
  • Facilitates individual, family, and group counseling sessions.
  • Coordinates referrals and support services.
  • Provides crisis intervention and case management services.
  • Maintains required documentation and clinical records.
  • Participates in interdisciplinary treatment planning.
  • Supports consumer recovery, wellness, resilience, and community integration.
  • Provides education and resource coordination services.
  • Promotes person-centered and recovery-oriented care.

title: Full-Stack Software Engineer, People Intelligence
description:
Applied Intuition, Inc. is powering the future of physical AI. Founded in 2017 and now valued at $15 billion, the Silicon Valley company is creating the digital infrastructure needed to bring intelligence to every moving machine on the planet. Applied Intuition services the automotive, defense, trucking, construction, mining and agriculture industries in three core areas: tools and infrastructure, operating systems, and autonomy. Eighteen of the top 20 global automakers, as well as the United States military and its allies, trust the company’s solutions to deliver physical intelligence. Applied Intuition is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, with offices in Washington, D.C.; San Diego; Ft. Walton Beach, Florida; Ann Arbor, Michigan; London; Stuttgart; Munich; Stockholm; Bangalore; Seoul; and Tokyo. Learn more at .

We are an in-office company, and our expectation is that full-time employees primarily work from their Applied Intuition office 5 days a week. However, we also recognize the importance of flexibility and trust our employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work, starting the day with morning meetings from home before heading to the office, or leaving earlier when needed to accommodate family commitments. This in-office expectation does not apply to contractor positions

About the role

The People Intelligence team builds the internal software Applied Intuition's leaders use to run the company as it grows and scales to many thousands of employees: tools for performance management, team planning, headcount and budget, organizational insight, and the everyday experience of working here. Building a great company is as much a people problem as a technical one, so we work side by side with leaders and internal teams to understand the problem before we build. Much of that understanding comes from data: turning people, financial, and operational data into measures and analysis leaders can trust.

You'll join a small team where every engineer owns products end to end: working directly with company leaders as customers, turning operational bottlenecks into durable systems, and shipping to production continuously. Few roles offer this combination of company-wide impact, executive visibility, and real ownership.

At Applied Intuition, you will:

  • Own products end to end, from an ambiguous problem to shipped, reliable software: Go services (Gin, sqlc) and React/TypeScript frontends (Vite) on Postgres

  • Build with AI coding agents (e.g., Claude Code) and LLM APIs every day, while keeping a high bar for quality: tests, code review, safe migrations, and careful deploys

  • Build data pipelines and integrations with company systems of record (Workday, Slack, Jira), with versioned schema migrations (Alembic)

  • Deploy and run what you ship on GCP and AWS (ECS, RDS, Terraform), with CI/CD in GitHub Actions and your own monitoring and alerting

  • Retire legacy Python/Flask systems by migrating their data and APIs onto the modern service platform without disrupting the people who depend on them

  • Turn people, financial, and operational data into metrics, analyses, and visualizations that leaders use to make decisions, using SQL and Python

  • Keep sensitive people and financial data correct and access-controlled: identity-aware access, authorization enforced in code, and tests that catch regressions before deploy

  • Work directly with company leaders and partner teams (People, Finance, IT, and others) to decide what gets built

We're looking for someone who has:

  • BS in Computer Science or a related field

  • 5+ years of experience building software products with a large user base

  • Experience with a major cloud provider (GCP and/or AWS) and relational databases

  • Comfort building with AI coding tools

  • Strong SQL and experience analyzing data: defining metrics, separating signal from noise, and explaining findings to non-technical audiences

  • As much interest in business and operational problems as in technical challenges, and the communication skills to work directly with senior stakeholders

  • A track record of owning products end to end, from ambiguous problem to shipped solution

Nice to have:

  • Experience with Go, React/TypeScript, and Postgres

  • A background in data science or statistics (e.g., survey analysis, forecasting, or experimentation)

  • Experience with HR, finance, or other enterprise data systems

  • Experience at product companies in the HR-tech or fintech space

  • A history of using software to solve logistical and operational problems, such as internal tooling or process automation

  • A combined business and engineering background

    • Xây dựng bộ chỉ số đo lường chất lượng (Test Coverage, Defect Density, Defect Leakage, tỷ lệ Pass/Fail, thời gian xử lý lỗi…) và dùng số liệu để ra quyết định.
  • Quản lý & Phát triển đội ngũ Test
    • Trực tiếp quản lý team Tester (Manual & Automation): ước lượng khối lượng công việc (Test Estimation), phân công nhiệm vụ, theo dõi tiến độ và xử lý vướng mắc.
    • Review chất lượng test case, kết quả kiểm thử và báo cáo lỗi của thành viên; đảm bảo đầu ra đồng đều và đúng chuẩn.
    • Đào tạo, kèm cặp (Coaching/Mentoring), đánh giá hiệu suất và xây dựng lộ trình phát triển năng lực cho từng thành viên.
    • Xây dựng kho tri thức dùng chung của team: template, checklist, bộ test case mẫu, tài liệu hướng dẫn.
  • Phối hợp trong team dự án
    • Tham gia review yêu cầu (User Story, Acceptance Criteria, tài liệu đặc tả) cùng BA/PO ngay từ đầu để phát hiện sớm điểm mơ hồ, thiếu sót.
    • Phối hợp chặt chẽ với Dev, DevOps, Data/AI Engineer để thống nhất phạm vi kiểm thử, môi trường, dữ liệu và kế hoạch phát hành.
    • Đại diện QA trong các buổi Sprint Planning, Daily, Review, Retrospective; báo cáo tình trạng chất lượng cho PM/Ban lãnh đạo và đưa ra khuyến nghị Go/No-go trước mỗi lần phát hành.
  • Tổ chức thực thi kiểm thử
    • Chỉ đạo thiết kế test scenario/test case cho kiểm thử chức năng và phi chức năng: API, tích hợp hệ thống, dữ liệu, hiệu năng, bảo mật, tương thích đa nền tảng (Web/Mobile).
    • Chuẩn bị và quản lý môi trường kiểm thử (Test Environment) và dữ liệu kiểm thử (Test Data), đảm bảo tuân thủ quy định bảo mật dữ liệu.
    • Quản lý vòng đời lỗi trên Jira: phân loại Severity/Priority, điều phối Bug Triage, phân tích nguyên nhân gốc (Root Cause Analysis) và theo dõi đến khi đóng lỗi.
    • Định hướng và thúc đẩy kiểm thử tự động (API, UI, Regression), từng bước nâng tỷ lệ tự động hóa và rút ngắn thời gian kiểm thử hồi quy.
  • Ứng dụng AI vào hoạt động kiểm thử (AI for Testing)
    • Sử dụng các công cụ AI tạo sinh/LLM (ChatGPT, Claude, GitHub Copilot…) để sinh test scenario, test case từ User Story và tài liệu yêu cầu; tạo dữ liệu kiểm thử giả lập (Synthetic Test Data); hỗ trợ viết và bảo trì script automation.
    • Ứng dụng AI để phân tích log và báo cáo lỗi: gom nhóm lỗi trùng lặp, gợi ý nguyên nhân gốc, dự đoán khu vực rủi ro cao để ưu tiên kiểm thử.
    • Nghiên cứu, thử nghiệm và đưa vào sử dụng các công cụ kiểm thử có tích hợp AI (Self-healing Test, Visual Testing, AI Test Generation…); đo lường hiệu quả (thời gian tiết kiệm, độ bao phủ, số lỗi phát hiện) và nhân rộng trong team.
    • Xây dựng hướng dẫn sử dụng AI an toàn và có trách nhiệm trong team: không đưa dữ liệu nhạy cảm vào công cụ bên ngoài, bắt buộc review kết quả do AI sinh ra trước khi sử dụng.
  • Kiểm thử sản phẩm AI (Testing AI Products)
    • Xây dựng phương pháp kiểm thử đặc thù cho các sản phẩm AI của Viettel AI (Sàn Dữ liệu, Trung gian dữ liệu, DMP, Trợ lý ảo…), kết hợp kiểm thử chức năng truyền thống với đánh giá chất lượng mô hình.
    • Kiểm thử các ứng dụng dùng LLM: độ chính xác và nhất quán của câu trả lời, hiện tượng “ảo giác”, Prompt Injection, nội dung không phù hợp; kiểm thử hồi quy khi thay đổi mô hình hoặc prompt.
    • Đánh giá hiệu năng, độ ổn định và tính công bằng (Bias/Fairness) của hệ thống AI trong điều kiện thực tế: tải đồng thời, thời gian phản hồi, dữ liệu đầu vào nhiễu hoặc bất thường.
  • Nghiệm thu & Hỗ trợ triển khai
    • Tổ chức nghiệm thu nội bộ (Internal UAT) và hỗ trợ khách hàng trong quá trình UAT; chuẩn bị tài liệu hướng dẫn sử dụng và tài liệu bàn giao.
    • Đánh giá mức độ sẵn sàng phát hành (Release Readiness), thực hiện Smoke Test sau Go-live và hỗ trợ xử lý sự cố trên môi trường Production.
    • Tổng kết bài học kinh nghiệm (Lessons Learned) sau mỗi dự án/release để cải tiến quy trình kiểm thử.

Your Skills and Experience

Yêu cầu chung

  • Tốt nghiệp Đại học Chính quy loại Khá trở lên, chuyên ngành Công nghệ thông tin, hoặc các chuyên ngành liên quan.
  • Tiếng Anh tối thiểu TOEIC 650/990 (Chưa yêu cầu có bằng khi tuyển dụng đầu vào).

Why You'll Love Working Here

description:

This is a piece‑rate role compensated based on completed vehicle inventory and audits rather than hourly work. While the work schedule is flexible, candidates must have sufficient availability during standard daytime, weekday business hours to complete assigned vehicle inventory and audit work. title: Principal Software Engineer
description:

Job Description Summary:

It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing!

Rocket Software is seeking an accomplished Principal Software Engineer – Change Data Capture & Data Integration to help drive the evolution of our Enterprise Data Integration portfolio.
This is a deeply technical, hands-on role focused on the design, implementation, and optimization of Change Data Capture (CDC) technologies across mainframe and distributed environments. The successful candidate will develop software that captures and processes transactional changes from enterprise databases, requiring expertise in database internals, transaction-log processing, systems programming, and high-volume data processing.
The ideal candidate thrives in complex environments, rapidly understands mature legacy systems, reverse engineers undocumented formats and behaviors, and develops highly reliable software that operates at enterprise scale. This role combines technical leadership with a strong sense of ownership and accountability for customer success.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Architect, design, and implement Change Data Capture and data integration technologies.
  • Develop software that reads, interprets, and processes database transaction logs.
  • Analyze database internals, transaction structures, encodings, and storage formats.
  • Reverse engineer undocumented or partially documented software, interfaces, and data structures.
  • Build, compile, debug, and test software across both mainframe and distributed environments.
  • Diagnose complex performance, reliability, compatibility, and data-integrity issues.
  • Drive technical direction for CDC-related capabilities and engineering standards.
  • Mentor engineers and share expertise in systems programming, database technologies, and software architecture.
  • Collaborate with Product Management, Support, and Customer Success teams to solve complex customer challenges.
  • Participate in the investigation and resolution of critical customer escalations involving business-critical production environments.
  • Demonstrate flexibility to work outside normal business hours when required to support critical customer issues, production incidents, releases, or operational events.
  • Champion innovation and adoption of modern engineering and AI-assisted development practices.

Required Qualifications:

  • 10+ years of software engineering experience.
  • Strong proficiency in C, C++, or comparable systems programming languages.
  • Experience developing enterprise-scale software involving database internals, data replication, CDC, transaction processing, or similar technologies.
  • Proven ability to understand and work within large, mature legacy codebases.
  • Experience reverse engineering software behavior, transaction logs, binary formats, encodings, or proprietary interfaces.
  • Hands-on experience building, compiling, debugging, and testing software across mainframe and distributed platforms.
  • Strong understanding of performance optimization, concurrency, reliability, and data integrity.
  • Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Expertise in one or more of the following: Db2 for z/OS, Db2 LUW, Datacom, Adabas, or IDMS.
  • Experience with CDC, replication, recovery, log-reading, or database utility technologies.
  • Familiarity with z/OS, JCL, EBCDIC, packed decimal, and related mainframe technologies.
  • Experience modernizing mature enterprise software systems.
  • Experience with cloud-based or distributed architectures.


Education:

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, IS, or related technical discipline.

<5%minimal travel

title: MTS Module Engineer - Advanced Packaging Program (2.5D and 3D Heterogeneous Integration)
description:
About GF

GlobalFoundries (GF) is a leading manufacturer of essential semiconductors, enabling AI at scale from the cloud to the physical world. Through deep partnerships with customers, GF delivers differentiated, power efficient and high-performance solutions for high growth markets. With global manufacturing operations across the U.S., Europe and Asia, GF is a trusted and holistic technology partner for customers around the world. GF’s talented, global team remains focused every day on security, longevity, and sustainability. For more information, visit .

Introduction:

Globalfoundries Singapore is seeking highly skilled and motivated Experienced Member of Technical Staff (MTS)/Principal Process Engineer, to become part of our starting 300mm Advance Packaging Center, Singapore.

The primary responsibilities of this position are to develop and/or optimize unit processes to set up Advance Packaging related process (bond & Debond, pre-bond - Plasma / UV / cleaning process, Die re-constitution, annealing & TSV) on multi-stack bond wafer / Die-to-Wafer process (on wafer level or frame Form Carrier level), do troubleshooting for process and tool issues. Additionally, the candidate will be expected to assist in tooling start-up, installing the processes into manufacturing, and owning the processes and the tools in manufacturing.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Designing, executing, and analyzing experiments to develop advanced packaging etch processes to meet technology (e.g. performance, yield, and reliability) and manufacturing (e.g. process stability, cost of ownership) targets.

  • Startup and qualify new process and new equipment within scheduled timeline. Work closely with Equipment Engineer on new equipment acceptance and tool matching. Understand the concept of repeatability and reproducibility (R&R) run.

  • Improve process robustness for high volume manufacturing using statistical tools, DOE techniques, data driven decision making and systematic problem-solving skills. Use lean manufacturing and six sigma processes.

  • To work closely with equipment team to improve equipment productivity indices

title: Senior Robotics Software Engineer, Perception
description:
Parallel Systems is pioneering autonomous battery-electric rail vehicles designed to transform freight transportation by shifting portions of the $900 billion U.S. trucking industry onto rail. Our innovative technology offers cleaner, safer, and more efficient logistics solutions. Join our dynamic team and help shape a smarter, greener future for global freight.

Parallel Systems is seeking a Senior Robotics Software Engineer to develop the perception and sensor fusion algorithms that let our fully autonomous, battery-electric rail vehicles understand the world around them in real time. In this role, you'll design and implement geometry-based computer vision and robotics algorithms alongside ML/learned-based methods, fuse high-throughput data from lidar, camera, IMU, and GPS sensors, and validate that the resulting system runs reliably around the clock in the field. You'll work closely with ML, firmware, embedded platform, and systems engineers to take sensor selection, calibration, and real-time fusion from first principles through production deployment. If you like working close to the math, the sensors, and the real world all at once, we'd love to work with you.

Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain real-time robotics software that ingests and fuses high-throughput, multi-modal sensor data from lidar, camera, IMU, GPS, and other sensors.
  • Implement, validate, and test real-time sensor fusion code across simulation and real-world deployments, catching regressions before they reach the field.
  • Perform sensor calibration (intrinsic, extrinsic, temporal) and apply a strong foundation in linear algebra, 3D geometry, and optimization (e.g., Kalman/particle filters, non-linear optimization) to state estimation problems.
  • Design and implement geometry-based computer vision and robotics algorithms (multi-view geometry, filtering, tracking) for real-time perception; experience with ML-based approaches is a bonus.
  • Evaluate sensor selection and system-level tradeoffs, and define test and validation plans that prove the system can run reliably 24/7 in production.
  • Contribute to sensor system hardware design, including IP-rated, ruggedized enclosures and mounts built to hold up in real-world field conditions.
  • Build and maintain sensor pipelines for real-time sensor and video data streaming and processing.
  • Collaborate with ML, firmware, embedded platform, and systems engineering teams to integrate perception algorithms into the full autonomy stack.

What Success Looks Like:

  • After 30 Days: You've developed a solid understanding of our current perception architecture, sensor suite (lidar, camera, IMU, GPS), and calibration and fusion pipeline. You've reviewed the state estimation and tracking algorithms end-to-end and identified concrete opportunities to improve accuracy, robustness, or performance.
  • After 60 Days: You've designed and landed improvements to a sensor fusion, state estimation, or tracking algorithm, and contributed to sensor calibration procedures. You've built a proof of concept demonstrating measurable gains in accuracy or robustness.
  • After 90 Days: You own a perception or sensor fusion subsystem end-to-end, with an algorithm delivering measurable, validated improvements in accuracy, robustness, or real-time performance. You've contributed to sensor selection or system-level tradeoffs with clear impact on overall perception capability.

Basic Requirements:

  • Bachelor's or higher degree in Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline; equivalent experience considered.
  • 4+ years of hands-on experience developing and deploying robotics or perception software in real-world systems.
  • Strong background designing and implementing geometry-based computer vision and robotics algorithms (multi-view geometry, filtering, optimization); ML-based experience is a bonus.
  • Proficiency in Rust and C/C++.
  • Experience with real-time systems handling high-throughput, multi-modal sensor data and fusion across lidar, camera, IMU, and GPS.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience implementing and testing real-time sensor fusion code, including validation methodology.
  • Experience with sensor calibration and/or a strong foundation in math and optimization algorithms (Kalman/particle filters, non-linear optimization, 3D geometry).
  • Ability to evaluate sensor selection and system-level tradeoffs, and to define test and validation plans that prove robust, round-the-clock production operations.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with experience working on interdisciplinary teams.
  • Experience with sensor fusion, localization/SLAM, and/or online calibration.
  • Experience with GStreamer for real-time pipeline development.
  • Publications in top-tier robotics conferences (e.g., ICRA, IROS, RSS, CoRL) or related journals.
  • Hardware experience building IP-rated, ruggedized robotic systems and designing real-world robotic platforms.
  • Experience with ROS2 or similar robotics middleware.
  • Background in autonomous vehicles, field robotics, or other safety-critical domains.
