title: Senior Spacecraft Propulsion Systems Engineer II - Secret Clearance
description:
ABOUT ROCKET LAB

Rocket Lab is the end-to-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity’s reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We move fast, build real hardware for meaningful missions, and make the impossible routine. Come shape the future with us.

SPACE SYSTEMS

At Rocket Lab, we’re not just launching rockets — we're building the future of space. Our Space Systems team builds everything from complete spacecraft, precision payloads to the components and subsystems that allow them to thrive in space, like solar panels, flight software, star trackers, optical systems, separation systems, radios, and more.

Our Space Systems team has enabled more than 1,700 missions, ranging from interplanetary exploration, in-space manufacturing to national security and defense initiatives. The team has built spacecraft, payloads, and components for missions to the Moon and Mars, working with partners including NASA, the Space Development Agency, and the U.S. Space Force. Whether it’s a single high-performance spacecraft, constellation, or the vertically integrated components that help them get to space — our world class Space Systems team is empowering some of the boldest and most ambitious space missions.

SENIOR SPACECRAFT PROPULSION SYSTEMS ENGINEER II - SECRET CLEARANCE

We're seeking a Senior Spacecraft Propulsion Systems Engineer II for our propulsion engineering team based out of Long Beach, CA. As a Senior Propulsion Systems Engineer, you are responsible for system-level and component-level ownership of space systems propulsion and fluidic development. These teams support our Space Systems division, and lead cutting-edge programs for civil, commercial, and defense customers.

WHAT YOU’LL GET TO DO:

  • Owning development of new or existing products or systems, acting as technical lead to guide team through end-to-end development process
  • Conceptual and detailed performance calculations, systems modelling, analysis, and system designs
  • Requirements gathering, definition, and management
  • Systems engineering activities and leadership within the team
  • Test planning, setup, instrumentation, execution, and data analysis
  • Communicating with project stakeholders internal and external to the team
  • Technical risk-based decision making to the right/best solution when faced with an engineering challenge
  • Project management including schedule building and maintenance, identifying top priority items, tasking of other engineers and technicians, and communication of status to leadership and other teams
  • Mentorship and coaching of people within the team on technical and professional development
  • Defining and maintaining standard of excellence for their team through documentation, training, coaching, and review of others’ work
  • Contributing to engineering process development and documentation at Rocket Lab related to areas of experience

YOU’LL BRING THESE QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering (aerospace, mechanical, mechatronics, or other technical discipline)
  • 8+ years of experience in propulsion system development, or other high-performance field
  • Active Secret clearance with TS/SCI eligibility
  • US citizenship is required, due to program requirements
  • Expertise in propulsion system modelling, static and transient analysis, and model validation using test data software such as Amesim, EcosimPro, Simulink, or Simscape
  • Experience with end-to-end development process, including gathering requirements, detailed design, qualification, production, and acceptance testing
  • Experience with all steps in the Systems Engineering V and risk-based decision making
  • Experience working on propulsion systems utilizing different storable propellants, such as electrical and chemical

THESE QUALIFICATIONS WOULD BE NICE TO HAVE:

  • A genuine passion for engineering, curious mindset, and willingness to learn
  • Demonstrated hands-on engineering skills, inside or outside the workplace
  • Comfortable working with high levels of ambiguity
  • Ability to make decisions using basic engineering principles, available literature and standards, technical risk assessments, test data, and physics-based models
  • Practice in identifying the necessary steps to achieve high level technical goals, scheduling them in a plan, and managing delivery against that plan
  • Experience with Jama
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to work well within a team environment
  • Capabilities using Python for data manipulation and post-processing
  • Detailed mechanical design experience using NX (preferred) or equivalent industry standard CAD software
  • Experience with GD&T and engineering drawings
  • Experience using Product Lifecycle Management software such as Teamcenter (preferred), Windchill, or similar
  • Experience using National Instruments data acquisition systems
  • Experience with testing and troubleshooting flight hardware
  • Master's or PhD

This position may require prolonged periods of sitting, standing, walking, computer work, and occasional exposure to moderate levels of noise, dust, and fumes in production areas.

Anticipated annual equity grant value is designed around function, level, experience, and other factors; realized value depends on vesting and stock-price performance.

Join one of the world's fastest-growing space companies and own a piece of it. In addition to competitive base pay, you'll receive company stock as part of your total compensation package, giving you a direct stake in our success. As we expand to new launch sites, groundbreaking missions, and global markets, your ownership has the opportunity to grow alongside the company.

Our comprehensive benefits package includes our industry-leading Employee Stock Purchase Program (with a 15% discount on company stock), top-tier medical plans (HMO, PPO, and a zero cost HDHP option with a significant HSA company contribution), dental and vision coverage, paid vacation and sick time, 11 paid holidays, flexible spending and dependent care accounts, paid parental leave, disability and life insurance, and a 401(k) retirement plan with company match.

Additional perks include subsidized EV charging, onsite fitness centers (where available), discounted gym memberships, complimentary snacks and beverages, 50% employee discount on our popular merch store, and a variety of other employee discounts.

$165,000—$277,000 USD
Base Salary
$132,000—$220,000 USD

WHAT TO EXPECT

We’re on a mission to unlock the potential of space to improve life on Earth, but that’s not an easy task. It takes hard work, determination, relentless innovation, teamwork, grit, and an unwavering commitment to achieving what others often deem impossible. Our people out-think, out-work, and out-pace. We pride ourselves on having each other’s backs, checking our egos at the door, and rolling up our sleeves on all tasks big and small. We thrive under pressure, work to tight deadlines, and our focus is always on how we can deliver, rather than dwelling on the challenges that stand in the way.

title: Information Security System Officer (ISSO)
description:
Applied Intuition, Inc. is powering the future of physical AI. Founded in 2017 and now valued at $15 billion, the Silicon Valley company is creating the digital infrastructure needed to bring intelligence to every moving machine on the planet. Applied Intuition services the automotive, defense, trucking, construction, mining and agriculture industries in three core areas: tools and infrastructure, operating systems, and autonomy. Eighteen of the top 20 global automakers, as well as the United States military and its allies, trust the company’s solutions to deliver physical intelligence. Applied Intuition is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, with offices in Washington, D.C.; San Diego; Ft. Walton Beach, Florida; Ann Arbor, Michigan; London; Stuttgart; Munich; Stockholm; Bangalore; Seoul; and Tokyo. Learn more at .

We are an in-office company, and our expectation is that full-time employees primarily work from their Applied Intuition office 5 days a week. However, we also recognize the importance of flexibility and trust our employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work, starting the day with morning meetings from home before heading to the office, or leaving earlier when needed to accommodate family commitments. This in-office expectation does not apply to contractor positions

About EpiSci

EpiSci, an Applied Intuition company, develops next-generation tactical autonomy solutions for national security problems. EpiSci's autonomy software is technology agnostic, operationally informed, and tactically relevant, and has piloted swarms of uncrewed aerial systems and tactical fighter aircraft. Additional applications include crewed-uncrewed teaming for air dominance, cognitive sensors, networks for advanced communications systems, and battle management command and control for informed decision-making. EpiSci delivers speed, cost-efficiency, and scalability as the preferred partner for defense agencies and industry teams seeking mission-critical autonomy solutions.

About the Role

This ISSO owns the day-to-day security posture of EpiSci's classified information systems, collateral and Special Access Program, across our Irvine and Poway facilities.

You will build and maintain authorization packages under the Risk Management Framework, with implementation guidance drawn from JSIG, DAAPM, ICD-503, CMMC, and the NIST 800 series. You will work directly with the ISSM to attain and maintain assessment and authorization from government authorizing officials, from initial requirements through operational deployment and continuous monitoring.

This is a hands-on seat. The work includes configuring, scanning, remediating, and standing up enclaves alongside the documentation. You can expect regular interaction with government security offices and authorizing officials, DCSA, and program security teams, and a continuous review cadence on eMASS and program packages.

Program access: This position requires Special Access Program access. Prior SAP experience is strongly preferred. Candidates with collateral-only experience and a strong track record under RMF will be considered and read on after hire.

What You Will Do

  • Maintain accredited classified systems in an authorized operating state while meeting program delivery timelines

  • Author, update, and defend RMF artifacts: System Security Plans (SSP), Security Assessment Reports (SAR), POA&Ms, Risk Assessment Reports, Configuration Management Plans, Incident Response Plans, Continuous Monitoring Plans, and hardware and software baselines

  • Execute continuous monitoring: ACAS and Nessus vulnerability scanning, SCAP and STIG compliance checking, audit log review, and remediation tracking against CAT I, II, and III findings

  • Support the design, development, and implementation of procedures and systems for secure facilities, and ensure facility compliance with requirements for classified information system processing

  • Conduct risk and vulnerability assessments of planned and installed systems to identify vulnerabilities, threats, and protection needs, and recommend mitigations

  • Lead periodic self-inspections and support DoD Cybersecurity On-Site Inspections, DCSA assessments, and customer security reviews across both sites

  • Serve as first-line response for classified security incidents and spillage: detect, contain, preserve evidence, document, and escalate through the ISSM and program security chain

  • Administer and harden classified computing and network infrastructure, including standing up and configuring new enclaves

  • Manage user account provisioning, privileged access review, media control, and trusted download and data transfer procedures

  • Deliver security awareness and system-specific training to cleared users and system administrators

  • Maintain working knowledge of evolving policy, regulation, and compliance guidance affecting classified computing assets

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant field, or a minimum of 5 years of ISSO, ISSE, or cybersecurity policy and engineering experience in a classified environment

  • DoD 8570/8140 IAM Level I/IAT Level 2 (Security +) as a condition of employment

  • Demonstrated proficiency applying RMF and writing authorization packages, with working knowledge of ICD-503, JSIG, and the NIST 800 series (800-53, 800-37, 800-171)

  • Hands-on experience with security tooling: NESSUS and ACAS, DISA STIGs, STIG Viewer, SCAP Compliance Checker, and HBSS or ESS

  • Experience designing, building, and maintaining information system enclaves, including the underlying computing hardware and network architecture

  • Working knowledge of incident response, disaster recovery, forensic principles, continuous monitoring, and cybersecurity hygiene

  • Active DoD security clearance (SECRET minimum) and U.S. citizenship

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior SAP experience as an ISSO, ISSE, or system administrator under JSIG, with current or recent program briefings

  • TS/SCI with the ability to obtain program access

  • eMASS, Xacta, or equivalent package management experience as a package author

  • Experience with DCSA DAAPM and NISPOM-governed facilities, including Co-Use or multi-program environments

  • Prior ISSM designation, or readiness to be designated ISSM for a smaller program

  • Hands-on Linux (RHEL, Rocky, Ubuntu) and Windows Server administration in air-gapped and cross-domain environments

  • Familiarity with cross-domain solutions, COMSEC and TACLANE operations, or trusted download procedures

  • CMMC assessment or preparation experience on the CUI side

  • Experience supporting a rapid-prototyping or startup defense environment

What Success Looks Like in the First Year

  • 90 days: Fully briefed and read on. Baseline established, with a complete inventory of accredited systems across Irvine and Poway, current POA&M status understood, and scan and audit cadence running on schedule.

  • 6 months: Self-inspection program running cleanly at both sites, package gaps closed, and established as the point of contact for the ISSM, program security, and government assessors.

  • 12 months: New program systems accredited on the timeline the program requires.

Travel Requirements

Willing to travel for company business between Irvine, CA and Poway, CA, as well as to customer and government sites (approximately 15-20%).

Security Requirements

  • Must be a U.S. Citizen

  • Must hold an active DoD security clearance

  • Must be eligible for and willing to accept Special Access Program briefings

  • Position is 100% on-site. Classified work cannot be performed remotely.

For more information about U.S. security clearances:

title: Community Lead, Developer Relations
description:
About OpenRouter

OpenRouter is the open AI routing and infrastructure layer that enterprises use to access, manage, and optimize the best large language models across providers, without lock-in, capacity constraints, or unnecessary cost. We power some of the most advanced AI teams in the world by giving them the flexibility to move fast, scale confidently, and stay future-proof as models evolve.

As enterprise adoption of AI accelerates, OpenRouter sits at the center of how organizations operationalize LLMs across research, product, and production workloads.

The Role

We're looking for a Community Lead to become the heartbeat of OpenRouter's developer community. You will be the person our community knows by name and recognizes in person, the one who is always around, always listening, and always making the community a better place to be.

OpenRouter's Discord is already one of the largest AI communities anywhere. Over 50,000 members, hundreds of threads, and thousands of chats every week. It is THE place where people talk about models, harnesses, new techniques, and projects. Not just OpenRouter, but AI in general.

You are a community person first and a developer at heart. You've built with LLMs, you understand what AI builders care about, and you're fluent in the culture of the spaces where they gather. You will own this Discord and grow our presence across Twitter/X, Reddit, and other community channels, turning an already thriving community into the best place on the internet to be an AI builder.

This is a hands-on, founding community role. In the first 3 months, you will be the primary steward of the community, with the opportunity to shape how the function scales over time. You'll work closely with our DevRel and marketing teams as a complementary, community-focused counterpart.

Everything you do in this role should be 1:n. Instead of hosting one meetup, you create the event kit that lets a community member in any city run their own. Instead of answering the same question ten times, you build the automation that surfaces it once. Instead of personally moderating every channel, you recruit and equip a mod team that scales without you.

The focus is digital first, roughly an 80/20 split between online community work and in-person community events to start.

This role is not about selling or broadcasting. It is about presence, trust, and making OpenRouter's community a place developers genuinely want to be.

What You'll Do

  • Discord Stewardship: Own and run OpenRouter's Discord end to end. Design and run Discord-specific events, giveaways, and challenges that keep the community engaged and growing.

  • Community Programs: Own and scale our recognition programs for contributors and helpers, such as special Discord roles for members who help us find bugs or support other members, and design new programs as the community grows.

  • Moderation & Mod Team: Recruit, onboard, and support a team of community moderators. Design non-monetary recognition and benefits that make moderating OpenRouter's community rewarding.

  • Community Pulse: Be the full-time ears of the company. Actively listen to how the community feels about OpenRouter, about models, and about the AI space overall, and report that pulse back to the team continuously.

  • Community Automations: Build and maintain automations that surface community sentiment, trends, and signals at scale, extending the tooling we've already started.

  • In-Person Community Events: Partner with our events team to make community events a flywheel over time. Instead of running events one by one, build the playbooks, resources, and support that let community members in different locales launch their own OpenRouter events.

  • Social Presence: Extend community energy to Twitter/X and other socials, engaging with developers where they are and amplifying community moments.

  • Product Feedback Loop: Own the loop from community to product. Synthesize community feedback, bug reports, and sentiment into actionable insights for engineering, product, and design, and close the loop back to the community when their input ships.

  • Collaboration: Partner with marketing and DevRel on community-facing campaigns, launches, and content as a complementary community voice.

What Success Looks Like (First 6 Months)

  • OpenRouter's Discord is widely seen as one of the best AI builder communities, with a regular cadence of events, challenges, and giveaways.

  • A healthy, active moderator team is in place with clear roles, recognition, and benefits.

  • Community members are consistently recognized for their contributions through structured role and reward programs.

title: Associate Learning Experience Designer (part-time)
description:
Company
BrainStorm is a B2B SaaS company that drives digital adoption and organizational change for outstanding companies around the world, including PepsiCo, Agilent Technologies, Mattel, IDEXX, Johnsonville, VF Corp, and more.
BrainStorm thrives on a dynamic and fun-loving atmosphere, paired with a steadfast commitment to excellence. Our high-performing team is composed of self-starters who play a pivotal role in driving our success. Once we walk through the door, it’s definitely ‘Go Time’.

Opportunity

Join BrainStorm’s award-winning Learning Experience (LX) team in a part-time role where you will use AI and the latest digital tools to create learning experiences for millions of users at thousands of leading companies.

As part of a dynamic, agile team, you will collaborate across Learning Experience and the broader business, building the context and judgment to turn complex technology into clear, compelling learning experiences.

This is more than a content-production role. You will use AI, modern tools, and evolving production processes alongside data, strategy, research, and experimentation—drawing on the science and craft of behavior change and adult learning—to decide what to build, how to build it, and how to make new technology stick. You will help create and maintain videos, experience guides, prompt guides, use-case resources, and email-based learning across topics such as Microsoft 365 Copilot, AI agents, and security awareness.

What you would do

What we’re looking for

  • AI-native mindset: You are comfortable directing AI agents and modern tools to learn, solve problems, and increase your effectiveness.

Additional Details

  • Hours: This is a part-time position with an expected commitment of 20–29 hours per week.

title: Integrated Campaigns Director
description:
About Us:

The way people buy software is changing. We’re creating what comes next.

Consensus is the world’s most trusted demo platform for B2B sales and marketing teams, rated #1 in Demo Automation on G2. We’re rethinking the demo experience from the first interaction to the live conversation.

Consensus connects every demo experience, from interactive product tours and videos to AI demo agents and live demos with real-time data, into one continuous buying experience. Every interaction creates demo intelligence that helps teams understand what buyers explored, what they cared about, and what they need next. The result? More context, less friction, faster sales cycles, higher conversions, and more capacity for sales and presales teams.

At Consensus, we’re not just another SaaS company. We’re a dynamic team on a mission to change how buyers buy. Your unique perspective isn’t just welcomed; it’s essential. We want people who bring curiosity, challenge the status quo, and are excited to have a real hand in shaping what comes next.

Our values aren’t just words on a wall. They show up in how we work, how we collaborate, and how we make decisions. We want you to show up ready to contribute and grow. Perfection isn’t the goal. It’s about putting your name on a version one, learning from it, and making it better.

If you’re ready to roll up your sleeves and help shape the future of B2B buying, we want you on our team.

Want to see Consensus in action for yourself? Check out our demo (in the Consensus platform—meta, right?)


The Team:

Our marketing team brings together sharp strategists, creative thinkers, and strong storytellers who care deeply about the work we put into the world. We’re thoughtful about our craft, serious about making an impact, and always looking for a smarter way to solve a problem. We work hard, challenge each other, and have fun along the way. If you’re curious, clever, and want to do work you’re proud to put your name on, you’ll fit right in.


About the Role:


Consensus is entering its most important chapter: moving beyond demo automation to redefine our category. We have the story. We need someone to put it in market at scale.


We're looking for a Director of Integrated Campaigns to own the campaign engine, from the always-on programs to the big, themed campaigns that turn our category narrative into demand across every channel. Reporting to the VP of Growth, you'll own the plan, the calendar, the channel mix, the budget behind it, and the number it produces.


This is a builder's role. Today campaigns are run channel by channel; you'll run them as integrated programs with a clear thesis, a defined audience, and a measurement model agreed before anything launches. You'll work in signal and account engagement rather than lead counts, and you'll be the person who can say what's working, what isn't, and what we're doing about it.


What You'll Do:


  • Own the integrated campaign strategy and calendar: a small number of well-resourced, themed campaigns tied to the category narrative and the product roadmap, executed across email, paid, web, content, social, and partner channels.
  • Build campaigns against buyer signal, not lead volume. Design programs around account engagement, product experience data, and intent — and lead the shift away from an MQL-first model.
  • Own channel mix and budget allocation across paid search and social, answer-engine and AI-search channels, syndication, newsletters, and sponsorships, with a defensible read on efficiency by channel.
  • Run the always-on engine, including awareness and consideration nurtures and persona-based journeys for the pre-sales, revenue, and marketing leaders we sell to.
  • Put our own product at the center of our campaigns. Every program should give a buyer a real product experience, not a form and a follow-up.
  • Partner across Marketing so there is one plan: Product Marketing on launches, Brand and Content on assets and narrative, Field Marketing on regional and event programs, ABM on target accounts, Lifecycle on the installed base.
  • Instrument everything. Define what a campaign is accountable for before it goes live, read it honestly afterward, and retire what doesn't work quickly.
  • Test deliberately — new channels, formats, and AI-search visibility — with real hypotheses and a bar for what graduates to always-on.
  • Work with Sales and SDR leadership so every campaign lands with a next step a rep can act on the same day.
  • Manage agency and vendor relationships, and hold them to the same bar.
  • Lead, coach, and develop the campaigns team.


What You'll Be Measured On


  • Pipeline sourced and influenced by campaign programs, against a target you help set
  • Qualified account creation and hand-raisers — engaged accounts and buying groups, not raw lead counts
  • Efficiency by channel — cost per opportunity, blended CAC, and payback on the spend you allocate
  • Campaign contribution to launches and expansion, in partnership with Product Marketing and Lifecycle
  • Speed and throughput — concept to in-market, and the share of the calendar that ships on time


What We're Looking For:


  • 8+ years in B2B demand generation or integrated campaigns, with 3+ years leading campaign teams and owning a pipeline number.
  • Proven multi-channel range — you've built programs that work across paid, email, web, content, and events, and you know which lever to pull when.
  • Fluency with the modern stack — marketing automation (HubSpot preferred), CRM, intent and signal tools — and the judgment to know what actually moves the number.
  • Domain fit strongly preferred: experience marketing to pre-sales, revenue, or marketing leaders in GTM, sales tech, or revenue tech.
  • AI-forward — you use AI fluently to build (research, creative, copy, analysis, and operations) and raise the whole team's leverage doing it.
  • Evidence over assertion: you set targets, measure honestly, and can always answer "here"s how we"ll know."
  • A strong writer with real creative instincts, and the taste to tell the difference between bold and noisy.
  • Comfortable in ambiguity and speed — you can set direction, sequence the work, and hold a plan against louder voices.
  • A strong partner and collaborator who's trusted cross-functionally — and who likes to have fun (a good sense of humor is a must).



Join Consensus and enjoy a robust benefits package designed with your well-being in mind:

  • Health & Wellness: Benefit from a generous employer contribution towards health insurance, with a variety of plans that include dental and vision coverage. Enjoy employer contributions to your HSA, and take advantage of HSA/FSA programs to maximize your tax savings.
  • Retirement Ready: Secure your future with our 401(k) plan featuring company-matching contributions.
  • Family First: We offer paid parental leave, so you can prioritize what matters most—your family.
  • Work-Life Balance: Enjoy unlimited PTO and 12 company holidays to recharge and refresh. Celebrate your birthday with a day off, and enjoy Flex Fridays, where every third Friday of the month is yours to unwind.
  • Flexible Work Options: Work in a flexible, remote environment that suits your lifestyle, with a top-tier WFH setup provided when you join.
  • Grow with Us: Participate in our professional development program to expand your skills and advance your career.
  • Give Back: Make a difference in your community with two paid volunteer days each year at a charity of your choice.

title: Experience Researcher - Ecommerce (All Genders)
description:
About the Role

At zooplus, the Experience Intelligence team helps turn customer signals into confident decisions. We connect research, customer feedback, analytics, experimentation, and journey insights to enable teams to make more customer-centric and business-informed decisions.

We are looking for a User Experience Researcher to help us better understand pet owners, uncover opportunities for improvement, and translate customer insights into actionable recommendations for product, business, and experience teams.

Support Customer-Centric Decision Making

  • Contribute to opportunity identification and prioritization activities.

Contribute to the Journey Atlas

  • Help connect qualitative insights with other data sources.
  • Collaborate Across Teams

  • Participate in workshops, discovery activities, and insight-sharing sessions.

Required:

  • Strong synthesis, communication, and storytelling skills.

Headquartered in Munich, with offices across Madrid, Krakow, Wroclaw, London and Vienna, we collaborate because we genuinely love working together - so you’ll be at the heart of an incredible, multinational team. title: ELEVATOR OPERATOR

title: QA Manager
description:
About Harver

Harver delivers a suite of automated solutions that optimize talent decisions for some of the world's leading organizations. Rooted in over 40 years of science and rich data insights backed by industrial-organizational and cognitive science, we enable organizations to engage, hire, and grow the right talent in a fast and fundamentally unbiased way.


Our Employee Value Proposition

Putting the right person in the right role is life-changing — for the individual and for the organization. That's not a tagline. It's the reason we come to work. We've applied 35 years of assessment science to one of the hardest problems in business, helping thousands of organizations hire with more confidence and less guesswork. Now we're entering our most exciting chapter yet — new products, a sharpened focus, and a market that genuinely needs what we've built.


The people here are something else. Smart, authentic, genuinely invested in the work and in each other. This isn't a place where you coast — you'll be pushed and expected to deliver. But you'll do it alongside people who care, led by a vision that's worth working hard for.


If that sounds like your kind of place, we'd love to meet you.

Job Overview:


Everything Harver builds exists to help our customers achieve a greater Return on Talent Investment — putting the right person in the right role through science-backed, skills-based hiring. That promise only holds if the platforms behind it are dependable, and that's the quality bar you'll own. As our QA Manager, you'll be the most senior quality voice at Harver, accountable for the quality of every platform we support and for the QA Engineers who protect each one.


This is a builder's role, not a gatekeeper's. You'll set the quality strategy across our platforms, shape how quality is designed into products from discovery onward, and lead a team of platform-focused QA Engineers — coaching them, setting direction, and raising the ceiling on what good looks like. You'll be as comfortable authoring acceptance criteria and reviewing test architecture as you are running a 1:1 or making the call on an escalation. You know automation deeply (Playwright, Node.js, TypeScript, MongoDB, Postgres) and are fluent with AI-assisted engineering — Claude Code, agents, and skills — and you use that fluency to build systems and standards that scale, not to become the bottleneck.


If you're passionate about working in a dynamic, fast-growing company — with cutting edge technology, smart colleagues, and opportunities for development — come grow with us!


Responsibilities and Qualifications

In this role you get to:

• Own quality across every platform Harver supports — set the strategy, define what "healthy" looks like for each platform, and hold a continuously current view of quality and a standing plan for how to improve it.

• Lead and grow the QA function — manage the QA Engineers responsible for each platform, coach and develop them, set clear direction, and build a high-performing, high-trust team.

• Shift quality left — bring QA into discovery by default, so quality risks, edge cases, and acceptance expectations are shaped before engineering takes ownership rather than discovered late.

• Own acceptance criteria and test contracts as the backbone of quality — ensure stories reach engineering with testable criteria, risk tiers, and non-functional requirements defined up front, so engineers build against a clear contract.

• Own and evolve the test automation architecture and tooling — engineers write the tests; you own the frameworks, pattern libraries, and standards they build against, and you keep them fit for a growing platform.

• Drive production health across platforms — review production signals on a regular cadence, monitor NFR compliance, track bugs and escalations by platform and severity, and make feature health scores available and trustworthy for every new feature.

• Lead incident response from a quality lens — you hold independent authority to declare an escalation without waiting for approval, drive root-cause analysis, and close the loop by updating contracts so the same gap doesn't reappear.

• Configure and maintain AI-assisted quality pipelines across the delivery lifecycle — from solution-document and AC review through test generation, PR risk scoring, and production signal analysis.


We're looking for people who have:

• Proven experience managing QA Engineers — you've led a quality team, developed people, and set direction, not just delivered your own work.

• Command of our technology stack — you're comfortable and hands-on with Playwright, Node.js, TypeScript, MongoDB, and Postgres.

• Fluency with AI-assisted engineering — you know your way around Claude Code and can set up agents and skills to compress manual effort and raise coverage.

• Deep, senior-level automation expertise — you're hands-on and credible in writing automation tests against the stack above.

• A track record of owning test architecture and contracts — acceptance criteria, risk tiers, NFRs, and the frameworks engineers build against.

• Strong production-health instincts — comfort with monitoring, signal review, incident response, and turning production patterns into better coverage.

• The judgment to know when to escalate and the confidence to make that call independently.

• A builder's mindset — you scale quality through systems, standards, and people rather than personal throughput.

• Preferred: exposure to AI-assisted quality tooling, mutation testing, and observability stacks (e.g., Datadog, Grafana, OpenTelemetry), and experience owning quality across multiple products or platforms at once.


Pssst… you don't have to check all the boxes to apply!


The benefits of working at Harver:

As a global company, our benefits vary by location. Ask your recruiter to provide information about localized benefits. Harverians enjoy:

• A competitive base salary and great incentive program

• Paid time off — when you need it, take it

• Benefit plan options that give you the flexibility to select the right health care coverage for you and eligible family members

• Bonus opportunities and employee referral rewards

title: Biophysicist
description:
Biophysicist

Job Description

This position is on-site in Budapest and requires EU residency and EU work visa.

General Info

We are building a computational imaging platform that recovers the physical optical properties of a scene — the illumination, the camera’s own response, and how real materials reflect and scatter light — from images captured with ordinary consumer cameras. We are building the whole stack: capture, models, and the applications that run on them.

This role owns the biology behind what we capture: what a layered, scattering biological material is made of, which of its constituents interact with light and how, and what that means for what our measurements can and cannot tell us. You will work closely with our imaging and AI scientists and engineers, who own the capture and calibration, the models, and the training data. They understand light and computation; you bring the biology and the laboratory discipline, and you will learn the tissue-optics side of the problem from them and from the literature as you go. While this is not a software engineering role, you will play a key part in turning scientific insights into concrete, testable requirements that help engineers bring innovative ideas to life.

Tasks

In your first year you will build and document our biological reference base: the tissues we study, the components that interact with light, and the reference measurements used to validate our models.

Biological & Biophysical Science

  • Act as the team’s reference on the biochemistry, structure, and physiology of layered biological tissue and its optically active constituents and keep that knowledge current with the literature across biophysics, biomedical optics, and analysis and modeling of biological materials.
  • Build and maintain the internal reference base of chromophore absorption characteristics, tissue layer composition, and the physiological ranges and variation across the human population relevant to our measurements.
  • Design, calibrate, and run quantitative analytical and spectrophotometric methods for characterizing biological samples and reference materials, and document them to a standard that others can reproduce.
  • Evaluate, specify, and validate the reference materials and tissue phantoms used to check the platform’s measurements against independent physical ground truth.
  • Work with the leads to design human-subject capture studies: protocol design, subject diversity across the full range of human variation relevant to the measurements, informed consent, ethics approval, and data governance.
  • Help the engineers build a computational model of layered biological tissue: supply the structure, composition, and physiological parameter ranges the model needs, and check its behavior against biological reality.
  • Translate biological knowledge into measurable, testable requirements and priors for the imaging and ML teams, and flag where a proposed measurement is biologically implausible or where a result is not supported by the underlying biology.
  • Analyze experimental and measurement data, including uncertainty, and report what the data supports as distinct from what it merely suggests.
  • Contribute to internal technical briefs, patent filings, and the scientific record behind the platform.

Requirements

The Education & Experience list is the shortlisting bar: we do not progress candidates who cannot evidence every item on it. The Strongly Preferred list separates shortlisted candidates from one another — nobody is expected to have all of it, and its absence alone will not cost you the role.

Education & Experience

  • Master’s degree or PhD required, in biophysics, computational biology, biochemical engineering, biotechnology, biomedical science, or a closely related field. A dermatological focus is an advantage.
  • Strong background in studying the structure, dynamics, and function of biological systems using experimental and computational approaches.
  • Hands-on research experience in the biophysical characterization of biological samples, including quantitative absorption spectroscopy (spectrophotometry) and related optical measurement techniques.
  • Experience developing and calibrating a quantitative analytical method from first principles.
  • Working knowledge of the biochemistry and physiology of human tissue, including the constituents that absorb and scatter light, or a demonstrated ability to acquire it rapidly from the primary literature.
  • Designing experiments and interpreting data with appropriate consideration of uncertainty.
  • Practical Python and Linux skills for scientific computing and data analysis.

Skills & Competencies

  • Laboratory rigor - attention to method, documentation, and independent validation of results.
  • Ability to explain biological concepts clearly to physicists, engineers, and ML researchers and ensure conclusions remain grounded in biology
  • Comfort learning an adjacent discipline — biomedical optics and spectral imaging — quickly and on the job, alongside specialists in it.
  • The judgment to distinguish what the data supports from what it merely suggests.
  • Comfort operating in a confidential, research-driven, fast-moving environment where requirements evolve quickly.
  • High ownership, sharp attention to detail, and genuine curiosity about the problem.
  • Comfortable communicating and working in English. Candidates must be eligible to work in Hungary, or hold qualifications that allow the Company to sponsor a Hungarian work permit (e.g. Hungarian Card or EU Blue Card) for them.

Strongly Preferred — Differentiators Between Shortlisted Candidates

  • Coursework or research exposure to the interaction of radiation or light with biological systems.
  • Familiarity with tissue optics, biomedical optics, or spectral imaging of biological materials, at any depth.
  • Experience in dermatology or dermatological research — clinical, laboratory, or cosmetic-science — including familiarity with skin typing, pigmentation, and vascular variation across the population.
  • Experience with oxidative, pigment, or hemoprotein biochemistry, or with the biochemistry of ocular or dermal tissue.
  • Experience with bioprocess or biochemical modeling and optimization.
  • Experience fabricating or validating reference materials or tissue phantoms.
  • Research presentations or publications in applied biotechnology, biophysics, or a related field.
  • Experience designing studies involving human subjects or human-derived samples, including ethics approval and GDPR handling of health-adjacent data.
  • Additional languages beyond English.

Compensation

  • Salary range: HUF 1,000,000 – HUF 1,500,000 gross per month, depending on experience and demonstrated depth.
  • Discretionary performance bonus, with details discussed with shortlisted candidates.

Compensation decisions are made on the basis of objective, gender-neutral criteria, including relevant experience, technical skills, scope of responsibility, and demonstrated performance. The Company does not request salary history during the recruitment process.

title: Medical Doctor with SNOMED Coding Experience (UK)
description:

You will have the right to work in your country of residence.

title: Billing Clerk (4527)
description:
Job Summary:

Under general supervision, performs billing, claims processing, collections, reimbursement, account reconciliation, and customer service functions in support of the organization's revenue cycle operations. Responsible for preparing and submitting claims, resolving billing discrepancies, maintaining financial records, processing payments, monitoring accounts receivable activity, and ensuring compliance with payer, regulatory, and organizational requirements.   • Obtains and verifies patient demographic, insurance, financial, and eligibility information.

  • Knowledge of accounts receivable processes and claims management practices.

  • Knowledge of billing record maintenance, reporting, and reconciliation procedures.

  • Ability to interpret reimbursement guidelines, insurance requirements, and agency procedures.
  • Ability to identify, research, and resolve billing and claims discrepancies.

  • Ability to prepare reports and maintain detailed documentation.
  • Ability to communicate professionally and effectively with consumers, staff, and external agencies.
  • Ability to organize and prioritize work assignments.
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality and exercise sound judgment.
  • Ability to perform accurate data entry and maintain accurate financial records.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, billing systems, electronic health records, and related software.

  • Payment posting and account reconciliation.
  • Collections and reimbursement follow-up.
  • Insurance verification and eligibility determination.
  • Billing discrepancy research and resolution.
  • Patient account maintenance.
  • Revenue cycle reporting and documentation.
  • Customer service and financial communication.
  • Revenue cycle process improvement support.

title: Site Reliability Engineer
description:
ADP is hiring a Site Reliability Engineer

  • Are you a proven SAP Basis and S/4HANA engineer with deep platform expertise?
  • Do you thrive solving complex infrastructure and performance challenges at enterprise scale?
  • Ready to lead technical strategy for mission-critical global systems?

Well, this may be the role for you. Ready to make your mark?

In this role, you will operate, optimize, and continuously evolve ADP's SAP platform that supports our GlobalView Business serving multinational payroll and HR clients globally. You will be a Subject Matter Expert (SME) driving system performance, availability, and scalability across enterprise systems while mentoring teams and shaping infrastructure decisions that impact thousands of businesses relying on ADP's services.

No two days are the same. You'll balance strategic initiatives with hands-on technical problem-solving—architecting capacity expansions one day, diagnosing critical production incidents the next. Your days include performance tuning sessions, code reviews of basis configurations, mentoring junior administrators through complex migrations, designing disaster recovery strategies, and collaborating with business stakeholders to align infrastructure with evolving requirements. From proactive system monitoring to reactive incident leadership, you'll operate with both depth and breadth, always focused on platform stability and innovation.

To thrive in this SAP platform Site Reliability engineer role, you'll need extensive expertise in SAP Basis and HANA architecture, J2EE platforms, and enterprise database administration (Oracle, SQL Server, HANA, or equivalent). You'll also need strong experience with SAP Basis administration, system performance tuning, security hardening, and integration technologies (SAP BTP). Our best platform engineers are strategic thinkers who balance operational excellence with innovation—they stay current with SAP technology roadmaps, mentor others, and advocate for continuous improvement. They're comfortable owning both legacy optimization and next-gen cloud migrations, and they excel at translating technical complexity into clear communication for business leaders.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

Here's what you can expect on a typical day in the life of a Site Reliability Engineer at ADP.

  • System Administration: Maintain & Support existing SAP workloads on prem and new S/4 HANA systems on RISE.
  • Support SAP RISE migration: Support migration to SAP ECS/RISE.
  • Portal Administration & SSO: Configure and maintain Portal infrastructure SSO integration (including Single Sign-On technologies and security configurations). Support Web Dispatchers and supplemental technologies (Apache, firewalls, certificate management).
  • Performance & Optimization: Proactively monitor system health using SAP tools (Solution Manager, Performance Analyzer, ST04, ST03), identify bottlenecks, and drive tuning initiatives. Create capacity planning reports and recommendations to meet short and long-term performance goals. Analyze Portal runtime exceptions and troubleshoot connectivity and web service issues.
  • Incident Leadership & Troubleshooting: Lead response to critical production incidents across all complexity levels (simple to highly complex), perform root-cause analysis, and implement permanent solutions.
  • Disaster Recovery & High Availability: Design, test, and maintain backup and recovery strategies, failover configurations, and business continuity plans. Conduct disaster recovery drills and optimize RTO/RPO metrics.
  • Security & Compliance: Harden SAP systems against vulnerabilities, manage user access controls, audit system security, and ensure compliance with enterprise and regulatory standards.
  • Integration & Middleware: Oversee SAP integration points (SAP BTP), API management, and middleware infrastructure supporting GlobalView's multi-tenant architecture.
  • Team Leadership & Mentoring: Collaborate with global teams and external vendors, maintain runbooks and technical documentation, define team best practices and mentor engineers to strengthen operational excellence.

TO SUCCEED IN THIS ROLE:

Required Qualifications & Competencies

Deep SAP Platform Expertise:

8+ years of hands-on SAP Basis administration with extensive experience on ECC and/or S/4HANA systems.

Architecture & Design:

Proven ability to design and implement complex SAP Basis and HANA landscapes including multi-instance systems, high-availability setups, and disaster recovery configurations.

Technical Depth: Expert-level knowledge of:

  • SAP Basis and HANA architecture (ABAP, Java, or dual-stack)
  • Oracle, SQL Server, or similar enterprise database administration with advanced recovery/restore capabilities
  • Strong background in Linux administration (SUSE / Red Hat), virtualization (VMware), networking (routing, firewalls, load balancing), and storage for SAP environments.
  • Network and security concepts including Single Sign-On (SSO), firewalls, SSL/TLS, and user provisioning

Preferred Qualifications

  • SAP Basis and HANA or Basis certification (SAP Certified Technology Associate or Consultant level); HANA 2.0 certification is a strong plus
  • Experience with 2+ full-cycle SAP implementations, major upgrade projects, or S/4HANA conversions
  • Cloud experience (SAP Cloud Platform, SAP S/4HANA Cloud, AWS, or similar)
  • SAP HANA database administration and optimization experience
  • DevOps and infrastructure automation (Kubernetes, Ansible, Jenkins, Docker, or equivalent)
  • Scripting/automation experience (shell, Python, or equivalent) for infrastructure-as-code
  • Advanced security topics including SSO technologies, high availability, and disaster recovery
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related technical discipline

title: Senior HCM Analyst, Workday
description:
About Us

At Cast & Crew, we’ve empowered creativity and supported the global entertainment industry for decades. Together with our family of brands - Backstage, CAPS, Checks & Balances, Final Draft, Media Services, Sargent-Disc, and The TEAM Companies – we operate as a combined entertainment technology and services provider offering industry standard screenwriting accounting software, digital payroll products, data & reporting, and a host of creative tools. The industry continues to move faster than ever, and the need for our expertise, our technology, and our people has never been greater. We are a production’s best ally every step of the way. #OneCastOneCrew

The Senior HCM Analyst, Workday, serves as a functional and technical subject matter expert responsible for the administration, maintenance, optimization, and continued evolution of our Workday HCM.

The role will own core Workday system support and ongoing process improvement, while partnering with People Systems leadership, HR Business Partners, HR Operations, and other cross-functional stakeholders on business enablement, strategic initiatives, integrations, and system enhancements. The role requires strong Workday configuration expertise, including business processes, integrations, reporting, and security, as well as experience working in a global or multi-entity environment with country-specific requirements.

Success requires both reliable ownership of the system’s day-to-day functional needs and a continuous-improvement mindset: resolving immediate issues while strengthening the processes, configuration, and technical foundation behind them.

Core Responsibilities

Core System Support & Administration

  • Serve as a primary Workday HCM subject matter expert, independently troubleshooting and resolving complex system, configuration, data, and process issues.

  • Own ongoing Workday administration and maintenance across Workday foundational structures and functionality, such as business processes, positions, job profiles, supervisory organizations, security, reporting, organizational changes, integrations, and file feeds.

  • Build Workday capability across the People team by providing guidance, training, and support for routine system tasks, data maintenance, and reporting, while serving as the escalation point for issues.

  • Diagnose and correct business process errors, configuration issues, data discrepancies, and downstream impacts to maintain system stability, accuracy, and an effective end-user experience.

  • Maintain system integrity and data quality through proactive monitoring, audits, testing, documentation, and issue resolution.

  • Monitor and support integrations, scheduled processes, file feeds, and related interfaces; investigate failures and coordinate resolution with internal technical teams and external partners as needed.

  • Create and maintain system documentation, configuration references, process workflows, testing materials, and user guidance to support sustainable system administration.

Process Improvement & Automation

  • Maintain a continuous pipeline of Workday enhancements and process improvements that reduce manual work, strengthen controls, and improve the employee and manager experience.

  • Evaluate existing workflows and configure sustainable solutions using Workday functionality, including notifications, approvals, routing, validations, eligibility rules, calculated fields, and related automation.

  • Design, test, implement, and document enhancements to support evolving HR processes and business requirements, including global or country-specific needs.

  • Proactively identify opportunities to simplify processes, eliminate redundant steps, improve data quality, and increase appropriate employee and manager self-service.

  • Develop and maintain system documentation, configuration records, process workflows, testing materials, and user guidance to support sustainable operations and knowledge transfer.

Business Enablement & Reporting

  • Partner with People & Culture, cross-functional teams, and business stakeholders to translate business requirements into effective Workday solutions.

  • Develop and enhance reports, dashboards, business processes and other configurations in partnership with process owners, balancing business needs with system governance and controls.

  • Partner with process owners to prioritize enhancements and assess requests for technical feasibility, dependencies, security considerations, downstream impacts, and scalability.

  • Provide technical guidance and enable adoption for stakeholders, communicating and documenting complex Workday concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Strategic, Technical & Cyclical Initiatives

  • Partner with People leadership and cross-functional teams on strategic Workday initiatives including integrations, job architecture, large-scale automation, and new or expanded functionality.

  • Design, test, and deploy practical enhancements supporting evolving business and geographic needs, including new processes or requirements in international locations.

  • Support the design, testing, implementation, monitoring, and troubleshooting of Workday integrations and downstream system connections in partnership with IT, vendors, and business owners.

  • Provide Workday configuration, reporting, testing, and issue-resolution support for time-sensitive cyclical programs such as open enrollment, merit and bonus cycles, payroll activities, audits, and other annual or periodic processes.

  • Serve as a knowledgeable internal partner during larger initiatives, helping reduce reliance on external AMS/vendor support by building internal capability and independently resolving work that can be effectively supported in-house.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Information Technology, Finance, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.

  • Minimum 5 years of hands-on Workday HCM experience, preferably within an HR function or consulting capacity.

  • Strong functional and technical knowledge of business process configuration, integrations, EIBs/file feeds, custom reporting, audit reporting, and security permissions.

  • Expert understanding of HR processes and the ability to translate business requirements into scalable system solutions.

  • Experience building or maintaining Workday reports and calculated fields; experience with dashboards, eligibility rules, custom objects, and advanced configuration.

  • Demonstrated experience independently troubleshooting complex Workday issues and evaluating downstream impacts across processes, data, security, reporting, or integrations.

  • Ability to manage competing priorities and balance day-to-day system support with enhancement and project work.

  • Demonstrated ability to manage competing priorities, work independently, and partner effectively across HR and cross-functional teams.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders and collaborate across functions.

title: Staff Software Engineer - Tools & Infrastructure / DevOps
description:
Cerebras Systems builds the world's largest AI chip, 56 times larger than GPUs. This architecture allows Cerebras to deliver industry-leading training and inference speeds; over 10 times faster than GPU-based hyperscale cloud inference services.

This order of magnitude increase in speed is transforming the user experience of AI applications, unlocking real-time iteration and increasing intelligence via additional agentic computation.

Cerebras works with the leading model labs, global enterprises, and cutting-edge AI-native startups. OpenAI recently announced a multi-year partnership with Cerebras, to deploy 750 megawatts of scale, transforming key workloads with ultra high-speed inference.

  • Strong understanding of Linux/Unix systems, networking fundamentals, and scripting or programming for automation.

title: Undersköterska till Saltsjöbadens sjukhus
description:
Nu söker vi på Saltsjöbadens sjukhus i Nacka kommun en undersköterska till teamet. Vi erbjuder utbildning och flera förmåner.

Det här får du hos oss:

  • Utbildning som gör ditt arbete enklare, till exempel vårdhygien, bemötande vid demenssjukdom och ergonomi.

  • Förmånsportal med rabatter och erbjudanden. Till exempel kan du köpa biobiljetter och resor med kollektivtrafik till bra pris.

  • En coachande och stöttande chef som jobbar tillsammans med dig i vardagen.

  • Tydliga arbetssätt och rutiner som förenklar ditt jobb.

  • Karriär- och utvecklingsmöjligheter. Till exempel kan du bli gruppchef med personalansvar eller få ett specifikt ämnesansvar som demensansvarig eller hygienombud.

Om Saltsjöbadens sjukhus

Saltsjöbadens äldreboende finns i en vacker och anrik miljö vid Baggensfjärden strax intill Stockholms skärgård med havet som granne. Här arbetar ett kompetent team som trivs på jobbet - vi välkomnar nu ytterligare en kollega till vår trevliga arbetsplats.

På Saltsjöbadens sjukhus finns 92 lägenheter och vi erbjuder både permanent boende (avdelningar för personer med demenssjukdom och somatiska avdelningar) samt korttidsboende.

Här finns en god arbetsmiljö som du aktivt kan påverka. Vi är en dynamisk arbetsplats med korta beslutsvägar, tydliga mål och där kvalitet och service prioriteras.

Det är cirka 10 minuters promenadväg till Saltsjöbanans station Saltsjöbaden. Fri parkering finns i anslutning till boendet.

  • Vi är ett demenscertifierat boende, vilket betyder att alla vi som arbetar här är utbildade i demens och bemötande via Vardagas Demensakademi.

  • Vi tillämpar behovsbaserat önskeschema. Det innebär att du som medarbetare har möjlighet att påverka din egen arbetstid, utifrån behov och önskemål. Vi lägger schema för 10 veckor i taget.

  • Vi har ett samarbete med företaget Ung Omsorg. Det innebär att ett team av ungdomar i åldrarna 14–18 år besöker oss på helger och lov. Ung Omsorg gör olika aktiviteter för att sätta guldkant på tillvaron för våra boende.

  • Du har en gruppchef som större delen av sin tid arbetar nära dig i verksamheten. Att bli gruppchef kan även vara en karriärmöjlighet för dig som undersköterska.

Som undersköterska är du oerhört viktig!

Din uppgift är att ge livskvalitet. Med hjälp av dig kan våra boende behålla sitt levnadssätt och sina vanor. Du ser varje person och tolkar vad de behöver. Samtidigt lär du dig mycket om omvårdnad, åldrande och hur man bemöter människor.

Du står närmast den boende och har därmed en nyckelroll i teamet med sjuksköterska, arbetsterapeut och fysioterapeut. Du medverkar också vid vårdplanering och skriver social dokumentation.

Med hjärtat på rätta stället

Hos oss får du arbeta i en stark kultur där vi drivs av vår vision: Vi gör världen lite bättre, en människa i taget. Det är oerhört viktigt att du delar vår vision och våra fyra värderingar:

Respekt: Hos oss har alla rätt till ett värdigt liv med såväl fysiskt, psykiskt som socialt välbefinnande.

Ansvar: Hos oss har vi medarbetare som vågar och vill och chefer som lyssnar och leder.

Enkelhet: Hos oss är det enkelt att påverka och att vara medarbetare eller kund.

Kunskap: Hos oss reflekterar vi, lär av varandra och tar tillvara allas kompetens

Tillsammans jobbar vi kontinuerligt med att säkra att värdegrunden genomsyrar vårt bemötande, både till varandra och alla som bor hos oss.

Din erfarenhet och kunskap

Vi ser att du är utbildad undersköterska och har arbetat några år inom äldreomsorgen. God datorvana, erfarenhet av dokumentation samt goda kunskaper i det svenska språket i tal och skrift är också ett krav. Du är van att arbeta självständigt och är ansvarstagande med en god förmåga att hantera föränderliga situationer med lugn och fokus. Samtidigt arbetar du strukturerat och metodiskt, även i ett högt tempo. För oss är kunden i fokus, vi lägger därför stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet.

Om du delar våra värderingar och har rätt egenskaper, ger vi dig stöd och möjlighet att växa.

Vi tror att du:

- lockas av ett varierat arbete och tycker om att möta människor i olika situationer.

- är en kreativ person som vågar tänka själv och ta ansvar.

- trivs med att jobba i team och stötta dina kollegor.

Övrigt

Lön: Vi tillämpar individuell lönesättning
Tillträdesdatum: Enligt överenskommelse
Sista ansökningsdag: 29 november 2026
Registerkontroll: Utdrag ur belastningsregister skall uppvisas vid en eventuell anställning
Har du frågor? Kontakta gärna gruppchef Marcia Villagran. Observera att det inte går att ansöka via E-post.
Om du vill veta mer om hur det är att jobba på Vardaga så läs gärna mer och träffa några av våra medarbetare här.

Facklig kontakt: Kommunal, kommunal.se

Ansökan

Välkommen att ansöka via knappen ”Skicka ansökan” nedan. Vänta inte med att ansöka då vi gör urval löpande.

Om du blir kallad till en intervju behöver du kunna styrka att du har rätt att arbeta i Sverige, genom att uppvisa att du har medborgarskap inom EU/EES eller ett giltigt arbetstillstånd.

På Vardagas drygt 100 boenden runt om i Sverige erbjuder vi en äldreomsorg där varje dag är lika viktig. Hos oss möter du expertis och trygghet på varje äldreboende, korttidsboende, i hemtjänst och dagverksamhet. Vi ska vara kvalitetsledande i allt vi gör och vår vision är att göra världen lite bättre, en människa i taget. Våra medarbetare arbetar med varje individs livskvalitet och trygghet i fokus. Vardaga ingår i företagsgruppen Ambea. www.vardaga.se

title: Director, Platform Engineering
description:
Director, Platform Engineering – Accelerate the SaaS transformation behind one of the world’s leading media platforms

Do you thrive at the intersection of organizational leadership, platform engineering, and SaaS transformation? Are you motivated by building teams and shared capabilities that enable other engineers to move faster, operate with greater autonomy, and deliver at scale?

At Stibo DX, we are looking for an experienced Director of Platform Engineering to lead a strategically important engineering domain and drive our transition toward SaaS.

The role

As Director of Platform Engineering, you will lead three global teams responsible for Cloud Platform, Print Platform, and Content Delivery. Together, these teams provide shared platform foundations, deployment capabilities, gateway infrastructure, APIs, and supporting services used across the Cue media enterprise platform.

Your primary mission is to accelerate the SaaS transformation. You will develop the domain into a coherent platform-engineering organization that provides standardized, reusable, and self-service capabilities, enabling application teams to deploy and operate their services without the Platform Engineering organization becoming a central delivery bottleneck.

A central part of the role is to establish clear organizational boundaries between Platform Engineering, application teams, SRE, and Operations. You will help shape a model in which Platform Engineering provides the shared foundation and developer enablement, while application teams remain accountable for the behavior, reliability, and operational outcomes of the services they build.

You will also lead the organization through this transition. Stibo DX is building toward a SaaS-first future while continuing to support self-hosted and hybrid customers. The role therefore requires someone who can balance the target state with pragmatic migration paths, preserving customer value while steadily reducing complexity and fragmentation.

Reporting directly to the CTO and serving both as a member of the Development Leadership Team and the company-wide Senior Leadership Team, you will lead a domain of 14 people and contribute to the continued development of both your domain and the wider engineering organization. The role can be based at any of our Stibo DX offices in Aarhus, Copenhagen, Hamburg, Oslo, or Málaga.

Key responsibilities

You will lead and develop a distributed engineering organization while creating the structure, capabilities, and momentum required to scale Stibo DX’s SaaS transformation. The role combines organizational leadership, platform strategy, developer enablement, and operational discipline, and requires close collaboration with Product Management, Architecture, SRE, Operations, and other engineering leaders.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Lead and develop the distributed Cloud Platform, Print Platform, and Content Delivery teams.
  • Build a coherent platform-engineering organization with a shared mission, clear ownership, and strong execution.
  • Accelerate the SaaS transformation by translating strategic direction into platform capabilities, adoption paths, and measurable outcomes.
  • Provide standardized, reusable, and self-service capabilities that enable application teams to deploy and operate services independently.
  • Treat the platform as a product, with clear internal users, priorities, adoption measures, and feedback loops.
  • Establish clear boundaries between Platform Engineering, application teams, SRE, Operations, and Architecture.
  • Drive platform adoption with the other Development leaders while keeping application migration and operational ownership within the application domains.
  • Balance development of the target SaaS platform with pragmatic transition paths for self-hosted and hybrid customers.
  • Build a culture of trust, accountability, constructive challenge, continuous improvement, and company-first leadership.

The ideal candidate

You are first and foremost an experienced engineering leader. You know how to create clarity, build effective teams, and translate strategic direction into coordinated execution across a complex engineering domain. You have successfully led distributed engineering teams in an international environment and bring experience from a customer-facing SaaS company or an organization transitioning toward SaaS delivery models.

You understand that developer enablement is how platform engineering scales. You know where a central platform team should build reusable capabilities, where it should provide standards and guardrails, and where application teams must retain ownership. You measure success through adoption and autonomy, not through the amount of work centralized in the platform organization.

You bring sufficient technical depth in platform engineering and SaaS to engage credibly with senior engineers and architects, understand trade-offs, ask incisive questions, guide the overall direction, and recognize whether teams are progressing toward a coherent and scalable platform. You are not expected to be hands-on or to act as the chief platform architect. Your role is to create the conditions for strong technical decisions and hold the organization accountable for sustained progress.

You are a strong people leader known for building trust, developing talent, and creating an environment where accountability, ownership, and continuous learning thrive. You communicate clearly, collaborate naturally across organizational boundaries, and contribute to the success of the wider company rather than focusing only on your own area.

Relevant experience

  • Proven leadership experience from platform engineering, cloud-native engineering, developer platforms, or a closely related area.
  • Experience leading multiple distributed engineering teams through organizational and technological change.
  • Experience with customer-facing SaaS products and the organizational changes required to support SaaS-first delivery models.
  • Broad understanding of platform engineering, internal developer platforms, self-service, AWS, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, APIs and gateways, observability, security, reliability, and cloud economics.
  • Experience modernizing an established software platform while continuing to support legacy, self-hosted, or hybrid customer environments.
  • A demonstrated ability to strengthen adoption of shared platforms and improve autonomy for application teams.
  • Strong stakeholder-management and communication skills, with the ability to align across engineering, product, architecture, and operations.
  • Fluency in English, spoken and written.

Interested?

Please apply through LinkedIn. We review applications as they are received and encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Shortlisted candidates will be invited to an interview. The position will remain open until we have found the right candidate.

If you have questions about the position, you are welcome to contact Chief Technology Officer Jesper Broni Andersen by email at jba@stibodx.com. We look forward to hearing from you.

Help us empower storytellers across the globe

Stibo DX is the global leader in digital transformation for media enterprises. Our platform and services help automate complex content production and enable omnichannel delivery for some of the world's most ambitious and successful media organizations.

We are a global and dynamic team of over 200 employees based in Aarhus, Copenhagen, Atlanta, Hamburg, Oslo, and Málaga, combining creativity and innovation with the stability of a long-standing organization.

Stibo DX is part of the Stibo Software Group, the second-largest Danish-owned software group. Our roots trace back to the Stibo Foundation, which has a 228-year history and a rich legacy that supports our continued growth.

Read the Stibo DX story and about working at Stibo DX.

title: Presales Solution Engineer – Commercial
description:
About Boomi and What Makes Us Special

Are you ready to work at a fast-growing company where you can make a difference? Boomi, the data activation company for AI, powers the agentic enterprise by bringing data to life across the business. The Role

Our commercial sales professionals of Account Executives and Account Managers rely on proactive technical support during the sales process, and our expert Presales Solution Engineering team is there to assist. Our Boomi SEs follow a prescriptive technical sales cycle and engagement model, focused on effectiveness and efficiency. The SE team is viewed as far more than a technical resource; our SEs are valued partners throughout the sales journey and help build trust with our stakeholders and prospects.

As a Presales Solution Engineer, you will provide pre-sales technical support to our field sales teams throughout the sales process. This includes account and prospect research, collaborative discovery and needs analysis, formulating a technical strategy and win-team, executing on that strategy, and ultimately securing the technical win.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead technical discovery and consultative pre-sales engagements with prospective customers.
  • Design solution strategies across Boomi’s portfolio of integration, data management, API management and AI.
  • Qualify opportunities by understanding customer technical requirements, decision-making processes and underlying demand drivers.
  • Deliver tailored product demonstrations and technical presentations to both technical and business audiences.
  • Partner with Account Executives and Solution Architects to craft compelling proposals that highlight business value and ROI.
  • Support RFIs / RFPs and Proof-of-Concept activities, and provide technical guidance that ensures a smooth transition from presales to implementation.
  • Understand the competitive landscape and position Boomi’s solutions effectively against alternatives.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor throughout the sales cycle, and support trade shows, webinars and workshops.
  • Work with Boomi’s Partners to help them position the Boomi platform to their customers.
  • Coach and mentor fellow team members, sharing knowledge across the wider SE team.
  • Stay current on AI trends, LLM-based tooling, competitive offerings, Boomi platform innovations, and general customer and industry trends.

Required Skills and Experience

Essential

  • Strong business acumen, with the ability to relate technical features to business impact and value.
  • Technical aptitude and a problem-solving mindset, ideally with exposure to integration, data management, API management and AI platforms.
  • Exceptional presentation and communication skills in English; comfortable engaging executives, developers and non-technical stakeholders alike.
  • A natural curiosity and a passion for creative problem-solving – a genuine interest in understanding how things work.
  • A self-starter who thrives in collaborative, cross-functional teams and dynamic environments, and is comfortable switching between independent and collaborative work.
  • A commitment to continuous learning, alongside a willingness to coach and mentor others.

Preferred

  • Above all, a deep, hands-on grounding in integration or iPaaS technology. That might come from a presales or sales engineering role, but it’s just as likely to come from professional services, implementation, solution architecture or partner and SI delivery. If you know the technology, we can teach you the craft of presales.
  • 5–15 years of relevant experience, ideally gained in SaaS or iPaaS domains.
  • A Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Applied Science or a related scientific field.
  • Familiarity with several of the following: integration patterns, messaging queues and middleware concepts; APIs and API Management, including Federated API Management; data pipeline and orchestration tools; Managed File Transfer (MFT) protocols and use cases; AI and LLM-based applications such as prompt engineering, RAG, vector search or agent-based automation.
  • A track record of successful projects in enterprise accounts.
  • Experience in value-based selling methodologies, and in carrying quota and supporting sales planning such as forecasting, account planning and go-to-market strategy.
  • Integration experience with enterprise applications such as SAP, Oracle EBS, Fusion, NetSuite, MS Dynamics, ServiceNow, Salesforce or IFS.
  • Exposure to basic scripting or programming languages (e.g. Python, JavaScript or Groovy).

Location

  • Must be located in Singapore.
  • A valid Singapore work visa is required, if applicable.

Why Now?

At Boomi, you won’t just showcase technology – you’ll help customers accelerate AI adoption, unlock data value and build resilient digital ecosystems. It’s an exciting time to be part of a company driving innovation at scale.

If you’re passionate about technology, thrive in a customer-facing role, and are excited by what’s next in integration, data and AI, we’d love to hear from you.

Be Bold. Be You. Be Boomi. We take pride in our culture and core values and are committed to being a place where everyone can be their true, authentic self.
