title: Regional Deployment Engineer
description:
Regional Deployment Engineer
Who we are
We see the world of cybersecurity from a unique perspective here at Varonis. We’re fighting the battle on a different front than conventional cybersecurity companies, relentlessly focused on securing data. Data assets are the most valuable – and vulnerable – components of the global economy. Along with employees, data is at the heart of almost every organization, yet conventional cybersecurity solutions, by themselves, have failed to protect it.
What we do
We give companies vision into who is doing what, where and when in their environment. We can show them where their sensitive data is stored, who has access to it and who shouldn’t have access to it. We can alert on unwanted activity within minutes and stop the bad guys in their tracks. We are the secret weapon companies need to have in their arsenal.
Regional Deployment Engineer
Summary:
The Deployment Engineer executes the end-to-end implementation of the Varonis platform for SMB to enterprise customers. They manage multiple deployments concurrently, in pre-sales and post-sales phases, ensuring each stage—from readiness validation to configuration and go-live—is completed successfully. The role includes confirming technical prerequisites, configuring environments, troubleshooting issues, and collaborating with internal and customer teams to ensure a seamless and efficient deployment experience.

Responsibilities
  • Work with sales teams on new business opportunities and upsell activity.
  • Understand customer requirements and implement the Varonis platform to address business needs.
  • Present technical information about the Varonis platform and services to customers.
  • Manage simultaneous projects through the various phases of the evaluation lifecycle.
  • Address customer concerns and foster a relationship to ensure a positive evaluation experience.
  • Identify and bridge gaps in product documentation and configuration to improve the deployment experience.
Requirements
  • The ability to discuss highly technical concepts with all audiences ranging from non-technical people to executive level technical decision-makers.
  • Proficiency in Active Directory, Windows, NAS, and Microsoft 365 environments.
  • Proficiency with configuration and troubleshooting in a Windows Domain environment.
  • Ability to manage many different tasks and proactively drive initiatives & opportunities to completion.
  • Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines, while maintaining a pleasant and professional attitude towards customers and colleagues.
  • BS in a Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or Information Technology with additional education in Information Security.
  • Preferred – Experience with and/or understanding in Cloud based platforms such as Salesforce, Azure Blob, Snowflake, or AWS.
  • Preferred – Experience with NTFS permissions, least privilege model, data access governance, and data lifecycle management.

Competencies

To perform this job successfully, an individual should demonstrate the following competencies:

  • Analytical: Collects and researches data; designs workflows and procedures; identifies data relationships and dependencies; synthesizes complex or diverse information; uses intuition and experience to complement data.
  • Technical Skills: Honest assessment of current skills, strives for continuous improvement, actively shares knowledge to build team confidence.
  • Sense of Urgency: Displays a matter of utmost urgency; understands the importance of making critical business decisions in a timely manner with strong attention to detail; realization that efficiency and prioritization is critical to success.
  • Customer Service: Manages difficult or emotional customer situations; meets commitments; responds promptly to customer needs; solicits customer feedback to improve service.
  • Problem Solving: Demonstrate strong problem-solving skills by assisting in identifying causes of complex issues and escalating them to the appropriate technical resources when necessary.
  • Written & Oral Communications: Edits work for spelling and grammar; presents numerical data effectively; varies writing style to meet needs; writes clearly and informatively. Demonstrates group presentation skills; listens and gets clarification; responds well to questions; speaks clearly and persuasively.
  • Adaptability: Adapts to changes in the work environment; manages competing demands; changes approach or method to best fit the situation; able to deal with frequent change, delays, or unexpected events.
  • Planning/Organizing: Prioritizes and plans work activities; uses time efficiently; multi-tasking; plans for additional resources; sets goals and objectives; develops realistic action plans.

We invite you to check out our Instagram Page to gain further insight into the Varonis culture!

title: Program Assistant
description:
At Wayfinder Family Services, we understand the unique challenges facing some of our state’s most vulnerable children, youth and adults. Those with disabilities, those without a home of their own, those who have been abused and many, many more. We answer the call for them. We believe in the amazing potential in, and for, each and every one of them. And, together, we find a way to turn that potential into reality.

Program and Role Summary

Wayfinder’s Kinship Support Services Program (KSSP) provides kinship navigation service for grandparents, extended family members or close family friends who step up to raise children so they avoid the trauma of separation from their birth family. The program also assists kinship families that form voluntarily, without the assistance of a child welfare agency. Our program offers counseling, assistance with basic needs, support groups and workshops, respite resources and more. Kinship families are more stable, and children maintain their family connections, which produces better long-term outcomes.

The primary focus on the Program Assistant is to provide administrative support to the program and be responsible for record management services focusing primarily on data entry and maintenance, preparing data for reports, and creating and updating relative contact logs and family builds. This position provides various administrative, and staff support services at the program level.

The hourly wage range for this role is $21.00 - $23.00.

This position is part-time and budgeted for 20 hours/week, with a varied schedule.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Greets visitors, takes telephone calls, and refers visitors and callers to appropriate staff or offices.
  • Provides general information concerning the organization's rules, procedures, policies, and philosophy.
  • Support the office administrative team with tasks as needed to ensure the smooth operation of the office, including but not limited to ordering supplies, operating a variety of standard office machinery, and maintaining inventory of office supplies, books, food, and beverages.
  • Updates and maintains client information in the required database(s).
  • Accounts for various documents for tracking purposes, telephone inquiries, training events, purchasing/returns, and generates reports as necessary.
  • Takes initial phone inquiries from clients, referral sources, or program partners.
  • Assists in coordinating, organizing, and logistical support of ongoing groups and program activities, such as arranging meeting space, confirming attendance, and providing additional support.
  • Supports program with collection/distribution of data, communications, coordination of meetings and materials, sorts and files all correspondence, reports, records, documents, or other materials, and searches files to retrieve information as requested.
  • Performs other duties as may become necessary or as directed.

title: QC Inspector (Piping) – Commissioning
description:
Orbit International Survey Services (Orbit ISS) is an industrial asset integrity engineering management firm based in United Arab Emirates, since 2006. We are an ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015 & ISO 45001:2018 accredited company and have provided asset integrity solutions to high-profile clients throughout the Middle East, North America, and Asia. Founded on the principles of safety, quality, and environmental stewardship, Orbit ISS is committed to providing world-class services and technology that help our clients address complex challenges in the oil, gas, marine and renewable energy sectors.

Visit our website at to learn more..

Role Overview:

Orbit ISS is seeking an experienced QC Inspector (Piping) for commissioning activities in Oil & Gas and Energy projects. The role includes reviewing P&IDs and test packages, inspecting pipe installation, supports, valves, welds, and flanges, and performing hydrostatic/pneumatic testing. The candidate will ensure all piping works comply with project specifications, industry standards, and client requirements.


Key Responsibilities:
  • Review and verify P&IDs, isometrics, and test packages against installed piping.
  • Mechanical completion of piping system and equipments.
  • Check pipe routing, size, material grade, orientation, and correct installation.
  • Inspect supports, hangers, guides, spring supports, and confirm compliance with drawings.
  • Verify installation of valves, fittings, gaskets, bolts, reducers, strainers, etc.
  • Ensure lines are mechanically complete and ready for hydrotest or reinstatement.
  • Inspect flange connections for correct facing, gasket selection, bolt material, and orientation.
  • Verify flange assembly using correct torque/tension procedures and tightening sequence.
  • Ensure bolt lubrication, alignment, and gap acceptance meet project tolerances.
  • Perform hydrostatic/pneumatic testing inspections, including test package review, leak testing, pressure holding, and line walk-downs.



Requirements

  • Diploma in Mechanical Engineering or a related field.
  • 5 years of QC piping experience in Oil & Gas projects.
  • Strong knowledge of piping materials, isometrics, and welding processes.
  • Familiarity with ASME, API, and ISO codes.
  • Certifications such as CSWIP, ASNT, or API are preferred.
  • Excellent attention to detail, reporting, and documentation skills.
  • Strong communication and coordination skills.

title: Vehicle Software Engineer – Rust Controls
description:
At Stoke, we believe a thriving space economy will enable a vibrant, sustainable, and equitable future here on Earth. That is why we’re building Nova, our fully and rapidly reusable launch vehicle. Designed for daily flight, Nova tackles the core challenges of space transportation by reducing cost, increasing availability, and improving reliability. By radically lowering launch costs and increasing flight cadence, we’re helping create a truly scalable space industry.

Our team is mission-driven, collaborative, and empowered to take ownership of their work. If you want to work alongside some of the most dedicated and talented people on Earth, we’d love to have you join us.

Description

Automation links the Vehicle Software ecosystem to hardware intent. As a Rust Controls Engineer, your primary focus will be building an automation framework that lets end users compose vehicle behavior from building blocks you own. These building blocks will be used daily across the company to perform benchtop checkouts, engine hotfires, and flight objectives. You will define the right boundaries and guardrails to enable users to navigate a control language that is operationally flexible yet appropriately restrictive. You will also own pieces of automation, dogfooding your building blocks as your software commands the physical world around it.

You must be ready to stay focused, move fast, self-direct, and learn on the fly.

Responsibilities

  • Design useful abstractions for hardware control behavior in a distributed system
  • Create user-facing guardrails for an autonomy ecosystem
  • Develop ground and vehicle automation
  • Build software tests
  • Support hardware test

Qualifications

  • Experience with Rust and Python
  • Strong systems-thinking approach with the ability to navigate complex, distributed software-hardware interactions
  • Strong math background
  • 2+ years of professional experience in software development, controls, or systems engineering
  • Ability to prioritize, self-direct, and ask for help

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with control theory and laws
  • Software language or compiler background

Benefits

  • Equity – We know that our employees are the reason we succeed. To give everyone a stake in our future, we are pleased to offer equity in the form of stock options to all regular, full-time employees.
  • Comprehensive benefits program including subsidized medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • Company-paid life and disability insurance

Compensation

Our job posts are intentionally written to attract a wide variety of experience levels, and we make decisions about the right fit on a per-candidate basis.

Your actual level and base salary will be decided based on your specific experience and skill level.

ITAR Requirements

To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR), you must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S. (i.e., current Green Card holder), or protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3).

It is committed to compliance with all equal opportunity laws, including the Immigration and Nationality Act (INA) and Title VII. It does not discriminate on the basis of nationality, race, citizenship, immigration status, or any other protected class when it comes to employment practices, including hiring.

See Yourself at Telix

title: Sr Mobile Infrastructure Engineer II
description:
GROW WITH US:
Tandem Diabetes Care creates new possibilities for people living with diabetes, their loved ones, and their healthcare providers through a positively different experience. We’d love for you to team up with us to “innovate every day,” put “people first,” and take the “no-shortcuts” approach that has propelled us to become a leader in the diabetes technology industry.


STAY AWESOME:
Tandem Diabetes Care is proud to manufacture and sell the Tandem Mobi system and t:slim X2 insulin pump with Control-IQ+ technology — an advanced predictive algorithm that automates insulin delivery. But we’re so much more than that. Our company’s human-centered approach to design, development, and support delivers innovative products and services for people who use insulin. Because many of our own team members live with diabetes, or have a loved one impacted by diabetes, the work is personal, and we are committed to the cause. Learn more at

A DAY IN THE LIFE:

The Mobile Infrastructure team at Tandem Diabetes Care exists to keep our mobile engineering teams moving fast and shipping with confidence. We own the CI/CD systems, build automation, macOS runner fleet, and shared tooling that iOS and Android engineers rely on every day to build life-critical medical device software.

We are looking for a Senior Mobile Infrastructure Engineer II to help own our macOS and Linux runner infrastructure and mobile pipelines. This role is central to how we scale CI capacity, maintain runner health, and ship reliable builds for our iOS and Android applications. Working across provisioning automation, cloud-hosted VM platforms, GitHub Actions workflow design, and the Apple toolchain, this role partners closely with mobile engineers to reduce friction throughout the development lifecycle.

The CI systems this role owns directly support the reliability, quality, and delivery of FDA-regulated medical device software used daily by people with diabetes.

A Sr. Mobile Infrastructure Engineer II at Tandem also:

  • Manages and evolves the cloud-hosted macOS VM fleet, including provisioning automation, capacity planning, health monitoring, and recovery; ensures runners are reliable, up-to-date, and consistently configured across environments.

  • Designs, maintains, and improves build, test, signing, and release workflows for iOS and Android applications; drives improvements in build time, queue time, and flake rates through systematic measurement and iteration.

  • Builds reusable workflows, composite actions, and shared tooling consumed across iOS, Android, and infrastructure repositories; establishes consistent, maintainable patterns for CI authoring in GitHub Actions.

  • Writes reliable, well-tested Python and shell scripts for build orchestration, runner management, artifact handling, and secret lifecycle management.

  • Instruments runner health, build durations, and failure patterns; owns alerting for outages and degraded pipeline states.

  • Maintains toolchain version consistency across developer machines and CI environments; documents systems and authors runbooks.

  • Maintains distribution certificates, provisioning profiles, and export configurations for Apple code signing; automates expiry monitoring and rotation across all build variants and environments.

  • Contributes to Android build and signing workflows, including multi-flavor, multi-variant build pipelines and Firebase App Distribution delivery.

WHEN & WHERE YOU’LL WORK:

Remote: This position is fully remote and open to candidates within the United States. Equipment for the role will be provided and training will occur virtually.

WHAT YOU’LL NEED:

  • 8+ years of experience in software engineering, CI/CD, or build/release engineering with meaningful ownership of production systems.

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering or computer sciences or related field or equivalent combination of education and applicable job experience.

  • Proficiency in Python, shell scripting, YAML, and Git.

  • Production experience with GitHub Actions, including reusable workflows, matrix strategies, concurrency controls, and composite actions.

  • Strong iOS CI expertise including deep familiarity with Xcode build configuration, Apple code signing (certificates, provisioning profiles, entitlements), simulator management, and automated TestFlight or App Store delivery.

  • Experience with cloud-hosted or local macOS VM platforms such as Orka/MacStadium, Tart, or equivalent.

  • Experience with Apple Developer account management including certificates, provisioning profiles, and App Store Connect API.

EXTRA AWESOME

  • Experience with Firebase App Distribution for internal mobile build delivery.

  • Experience with Android build systems and signing pipelines.

  • Experience integrating mobile testing frameworks — unit, instrumented, snapshot, contract, and end-to-end — into CI pipelines.

  • Background in iOS or Android mobile development.

  • Experience in a regulated industry such as medical devices with traceability and compliance requirements.

  • Experience running multi-flavor/multi-variant Android builds with regional distribution targets.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS:

The starting base pay range for this position is $165,000 to $185,000 annually. Base pay will vary based on job-related knowledge, skills, experience and may also fluctuate depending on candidate’s location and the overall job market. In addition to base pay, Tandem offers a competitive compensation package that includes bonus and a robust benefits package.

Tandem offers health care benefits such as medical, dental, vision available your first day, as well as health savings accounts and flexible saving accounts. You’ll also receive 11 paid holidays per year, a minimum of 20 days of paid time off (with accrual starting on day 1) and you will have access to a 401k plan with company match as well as an Employee Stock Purchase plan. Learn more about Tandem’s benefits here!

YOU SHOULD KNOW:

Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with applicable state and local Fair Chance laws and regulations. A conditional offer of employment from Tandem is contingent upon successful completion of a pre-employment screening process comprised of a drug test (excluding marijuana) and background check, which includes a review of criminal history information.

Tandem has good cause to conduct a review of criminal history information of candidates for this position, as this role may involve access to proprietary, sensitive and/or confidential information, including customer protected health information. This review is required to ensure that individuals in such roles uphold high standards of trust and integrity so as to protect the interests of our customers, employees, and stakeholders.

SPONSORSHIP: Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.

WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE:
At Tandem, we believe joy fuels excellence. That's why we've built a workplace that celebrates your achievements and supports your well-being. Our team thrives on pushing boundaries and fostering growth, all while maintaining a spirit of fun and camaraderie. This is just one of the ways we stay awesome! Explore the benefits and reasons to love Tandem at .

BE YOU, WITH US!

We embrace the value that every single one of us brings to the table. But sometimes we forget that when we don’t meet 100% of a job description’s criteria – maybe you’re feeling that way right now? We encourage you to apply anyway. Because we want you to be you, with us.

Tandem is firmly committed to being an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of age, disability, sex, race, religion or belief, gender identity or expression, marriage/civil partnership, pregnancy/maternity, or sexual orientation. We are an inclusive organization, and we welcome applications from a wide range of candidates. Selection for roles will be based on individual merit alone.

REFERRALS:
We love a good referral! If you know someone who would be a great fit for this position, please share!

APPLICATION DEADLINE:
The position will be posted until a final candidate is selected for the requisition or the requisition has a sufficient number of applications.

Make a move that matters. Join Tandem Diabetes Care, where we're turning challenges into triumphs every day and where your talents will help shape a healthier, happier tomorrow.

title: Strategy & Operations Lead
description:
Who We Are

Revyse exists to help multifamily operators discover the best vendor partners, manage contracts and compliance, and reduce financial risk. Our AI-powered platform helps the industry turn vendor and supplier data into a strategic advantage. We are a fast-moving, early-stage tech company with a big vision. Founded by industry experts and financially supported by industry veterans - we're overhauling the relationship between operators and suppliers.

In 2026, Revyse was acquired by Get Covered LLC, pairing our vendor and compliance platform with Get Covered's reach across the multifamily industry. The team, mission, and roadmap continue under the Revyse name, now backed by a larger platform.


About the role

We're hiring a Strategy and Operations Lead to own the company's highest-priority cross-functional problems, specifically the ones that don't have an obvious owner. You will diagnose the issue, build the solution, drive it through implementation, and establish durable ownership before moving on. This role is in-person, on-site in Bend, Oregon, but may be remote within the US for the perfect candidate.

The scope is deliberately unbounded. In a given quarter it might be a product decision stalled between engineering and sales, a partnership that has gone quiet, a pricing structure that needs rebuilding, or the operational plumbing nobody has touched in six months. What stays constant is the standard: once a problem lands with you, the founders stop carrying it.

What you'll do

  • Diagnose Before You Build: Find the actual constraint rather than the symptom that was handed to you. Talk to the people closest to the work, look at the data, and be willing to come back and tell us the problem we described is not the problem worth solving.
  • Build the Solution: Produce the artifacts that make the fix real: the spec, the model, the process, the pricing structure, the partner agreement. You are not writing recommendations for somebody else to execute.
  • Drive It Through Implementation: Carry the work across engineering, sales, CX, and finance until it is live and functioning. These problems are cross-functional precisely because they stall in the handoffs. Owning the handoffs is the job.
  • Establish Durable Ownership: Nothing is done until a named person owns it, with a documented process and a way to tell whether it is still working. Then you move to the next problem. Success is measured by what holds up six months after you left it.
  • Work Across the Full Range: Some quarters that means pricing architecture or a marketplace launch. Some weeks it is managing the PO Box, a benefits question, or a vendor account nobody has logged into since January. Both count, and we will not pretend otherwise in the interview.
  • Bring Answers, Not Status: “Still working on it” is not an update. Tell us what you found, what you decided, and what you need from us.
  • Use AI Aggressively: We use AI a lot. Research, diagnosis, drafting, analysis, and workflow automation should let one person cover the ground of three. If you are not already working this way, you will be within a month.
  • Represent the Company Well: You will sit in front of customers, partners, and vendors on the Company’s behalf. How you show up is how Revyse shows up.

Qualifications

  • We believe in giving people opportunities, so if you don't check all of the boxes below, don't let that hold you back.
  • Evidence of ownership from start to finish: You can name specific problems you inherited, describe how you diagnosed them, and point to what is still standing after you moved on. This is what we screen hardest for. Somewhere around 3 to 5+ years of experience is a reasonable benchmark, but we have left the band wide on purpose and will weigh evidence over tenure.
  • Product background: You have shipped software. You have written specs, sat in engineering standups, argued about scope, and made tradeoffs on incomplete information. Even on problems that are not product problems, that instinct: define it, cut it down, ship it: is the one we are hiring for.
  • Structured thinking under ambiguity: There is no 100-page spec. Often there is no spec at all. You should be able to impose structure on a vague problem without waiting to be handed one.
  • Range without ego: You can move from a pricing architecture debate in the morning to a benefits administration question in the afternoon and treat both as real work.
  • Strong writing: Clear, short, and decisive. Much of this role is written communication with customers, partners, and the team.
  • Commercial instincts: You can tell the difference between work that moves revenue and work that only feels productive, and you sequence accordingly.
  • Multifamily or proptech exposure: A plus, not a requirement. We can teach you about the industry. We cannot teach hunger.

Why Join Us

  • Opportunity to play a key role in shaping the growth and success of a fast-growing startup, and career advancement as we scale.
  • Collaborative work environment with a SUPER passionate and talented team. We love working hard on interesting projects.
  • You'll be sitting at the crossroads of vendors and operators. Being able to bring the industry together and amplifying the good happening all around us is some seriously rewarding work.
  • Because trust falls are part of our DNA. We don't think it's weird or awkward to care about our well-being at work - we value each other as individuals and are energized by the idea of understanding our colleagues on a deeper level.
  • We believe that 100% of the organization should understand and be accountable to the vision and strategy. If we all know where it is we're trying to go, it's far easier to row the boat in unison.

Salary

  • $135,000 to $150,000

title: Distribution Coordinator -Shipping - Logistics

description:

  • Own the target cloud services architecture on AWS and the roadmap to get there, including simplifying a large estate of Lambda services and reducing dependence on legacy partner systems.

title: Head of Capital Formation & Corporate Development
description:
Uniphore is one of the largest B2B AI-native companies—decades-proven, built-for-scale and designed for the enterprise. The company drives business outcomes, across multiple industry verticals, and enables the largest global deployments.

Uniphore infuses AI into every part of the enterprise that impacts the customer. We deliver the only multimodal architecture centered on customers that combines Generative AI, Knowledge AI, Emotion AI, workflow automation and a co-pilot to guide you. We understand better than anyone how to capture voice, video and text and how to analyze all types of data.

As AI becomes more powerful, every part of the enterprise that impacts the customer will be disrupted. We believe the future will run on the connective tissue between people, machines and data: all in the service of creating the most human processes and experiences for customers and employees.

Job Description:

Uniphore is looking for a rare hybrid operator to lead the next phase of its private capital strategy and inorganic growth agenda. This is a CEO-adjacent, board-facing seat at a fast-growing, AI-native company — someone who will help determine how Uniphore funds its future, and what it builds versus what it buys to get there.

Most organizations split this mandate across two people: one who raises capital, and one who runs M&A. We're looking for one person who can credibly do both. You don't need to be equally deep on each side — but you need a genuine track record on at least one, and real, hands-on fluency on the other. This is not a generalist finance role, and it is not an entry point into private capital markets or M&A — we're looking for someone who has already done this work and knows the players.

Location: Palo Alto, CA

Key Responsibilities

Capital Formation & Private Fundraising

  • Build and lead Uniphore's private fundraising strategy, targeting late-stage venture capital, growth-equity, and private equity investors, family offices, and high-net-worth individuals — including investors focused on companies approaching public-market readiness.
  • Own the debt-financing strategy and lender relationships, working across bulge-bracket and specialty/boutique banking partners to structure and negotiate debt facilities.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for private investors: end-to-end relationship management, tailored investor presentations, financial models, and fundraising materials.
  • Oversee investor due diligence, ensuring accuracy, transparency, and alignment with Uniphore's growth strategy.

Corporate Development & M&A

  • Partner with the Office of the CEO and the Chief Technology & Product Officer to drive Uniphore's inorganic growth strategy, including full-lifecycle M&A: sourcing, evaluation, negotiation, and integration.
  • Lead build-versus-buy analysis on emerging technology and product capabilities — bringing fluency in the startup and AI research-lab landscape to identify and evaluate acquisition targets.
  • Determine the right capital structure for each transaction — whether it's funded from existing balance sheet capacity or requires a dedicated capital raise (debt or equity) — and lead that raise when needed.
  • Negotiate directly with target companies and their investors/cap tables through to close.

Executive & Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Act as a true financial and strategic business partner to the CFO.
  • Work in close daily partnership with the CEO; prepare board-ready materials and help secure board-level approvals for fundraising and M&A decisions.
  • Align fundraising and corporate development initiatives across Product, Marketing, People, Legal, and Finance.
  • Serve as an internal expert on AI and SaaS market trends to guide strategic decision-making.

What We're Looking For

  • A background at the Associate through Director/Partner level within an investment bank (bulge-bracket or specialty/boutique), or equivalent principal-side experience leading fundraising and/or corporate development at a high-growth technology company.
  • A demonstrated, closeable track record on at least one of the two core mandates: leading and closing private fundraising rounds with VC, growth-equity, or PE investors, or running M&A transactions full-cycle — sourcing through integration — as a principal, not solely as an advisor or banker.
  • Working knowledge of whichever side isn't your primary strength — we will invest in developing you further on that side, but you need to already speak the language.
  • Banking, investment banking, or venture capital experience is core to this profile. Candidates who have also spent time in-house at a public company — ideally in AI or data platforms — are especially well-positioned, bringing both the deal-side discipline and the operator's view of running these functions from inside a growth-stage business.
  • AI or SaaS industry experience is non-negotiable. You should be able to speak credibly, internally and externally, to where the AI market is headed, who the emerging players and research labs are, and how that shapes build-versus-buy decisions.
  • Deep fluency in private capital markets specifically — VC/PE deal mechanics, terms, and investor psychology. This is distinct from public-markets investor relations experience.
  • Strong financial modeling and strategic/analytical skills, with the ability to evaluate complex M&A and fundraising decisions and their attendant risks.
  • Executive presence: proven ability to build trust and credibility directly with a CEO, executive team, and board.
  • A proactive, high-autonomy operator who is comfortable managing multiple live workstreams in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment.
  • Master's degree in Business, Accounting, Finance, Economics, or a related field; equivalent experience will be considered.

Why Join Uniphore

This is an opportunity to build and own the capital strategy and M&A agenda for a high-growth, AI-native company at a pivotal stage — with direct, regular access to the CEO and the Office of the CEO on the decisions that shape the company's next chapter. It comes with a meaningful equity opportunity at a company with a strong valuation trajectory.



Hiring Pay Range:

$200,000 - $350,000


Benefits:


In addition to competitive base pay, this position also includes an annual incentive opportunity based on target achievement, pre-IPO stock options, benefits including medical, dental, vision, 401(k) with a match, and more, plus generous paid time off, paid holidays, paid day off for your birthday and other paid leave policies to support employees through all phases of life.


Location preference:

USA - CA - Palo Alto

Uniphore is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity in the workplace. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, disability, veteran status, and other protected characteristics.

For more information on how Uniphore uses AI to unify—and humanize—every enterprise experience, please visit www.uniphore.com.

title: Principal Software Engineer
description:

  • Take ownership of the long-term health and evolution of key architectural components and platform foundations
  • Mentor Staff and Senior Staff engineers into broader-scope technical leaders capable of owning major domains independently

Required Qualifications

  • Master-level technical expertise in one or more major software engineering domains (e.g., distributed systems, data-intensive applications, real-time systems, complex UI architectures) with strong breadth across adjacent areas

  • Extensive experience leading the technical direction of large, complex software systems from initial concept through multi-year operation and evolution
  • Strong background in evaluating and adopting new technologies, frameworks, and architectural approaches at organizational scale—including build vs. buy and platform investment decisions
  • Proven ability to translate business and mission requirements into durable technical decisions, engineering principles, and architectural standards
  • Track record of successfully mentoring and developing Staff and Senior Staff engineers into broader technical leaders
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills: ability to present technical strategy clearly to engineering leadership, program management, and non-technical executive stakeholders
  • Experience designing systems that meet strict reliability, security, and compliance requirements in production environments

Preferred Qualifications

  • History of defining company-wide engineering standards, reference architectures, or platform strategies that persist across product generations and leadership transitions
  • Experience leading technology evaluations, major architectural transitions, or build-vs-buy decisions at enterprise scale

Required Experience and Education:

  • Colorado Springs is our HQ with an established office — 3–4 days on-site per week.
  • DC, Dallas, and Salt Lake City-based roles will be remote until offices are established there, and then will require 3–4 days on-site.

You use modern AI tools with judgment: integrating them into workflows where they're impactful, reviewing their outputs, and handling proprietary or sensitive data responsibly.

$165,000—$230,000 USD

At Bluestaq, we build secure data platforms that matter for space missions, national defense, healthcare systems, and commercial innovation. Founded in 2018, we've become a leader in enterprise software and secure data management by staying focused on what counts: modern architecture, operational excellence, and mission impact.

Location: This is a remote-based role that requires flexibility and willingness to travel within a specified region and for company-related purposes as needed.

The Opportunity

Praxis Precision Medicines is entering a pivotal moment as we prepare for commercialization, and how we build and scale capability across the organization will directly impact our success. We are seeking a driven and customer-focused Account Specialist to execute in the field and drive commercial performance across a defined territory. This individual will be responsible for engaging healthcare providers, building strong customer relationships, and delivering on commercial objectives.

Working closely with cross-functional partners, you will play a critical role in supporting product launches, driving adoption, and ensuring patients gain access to innovative therapies.

What You’ll Do

  • Execute territory business plans to achieve and exceed sales goals.
  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with healthcare providers and key stakeholders.
  • Drive product adoption through effective customer engagement and education.
  • Navigate complex patient pathways and support access to therapy.
  • Partner with Market Access, Strategic Accounts, Patient Services, and Medical teams to optimize customer and patient outcomes.
  • Support launch execution, including pre-launch planning and post-launch adoption strategies.
  • Leverage insights from the field to inform strategy and improve execution.
  • Maintain a high level of product, disease state, and market knowledge.
  • Ensure compliance with all regulatory and company policies.

How You Work

  • You think in terms of systems, not silos.
  • You balance rigor with speed, knowing when each matters most.
  • You hold a high bar for performance, quality, and accountability.
  • You collaborate deeply but act with ownership and urgency.
  • You are passionate about building strong customer relationships and driving impact for patients.

What You Bring

  • 5+ years of direct sales experience in CNS or specialty pharmaceuticals.
  • Deep understanding of complex patient pathways and specialist prescriber dynamics.
  • Participation in a recent product launch highly preferred, including familiarity with pre-launch planning and early market execution.
  • Experience with formulary access strategies and early market penetration tactics.
  • Experience selling into hospital systems, IDNs, and institutional accounts is a strong plus.
  • Understanding of specialty pharmacy and hub services models.
  • Demonstrated track record of strong, consistent performance against quota and territory goals.
  • Evidence of execution against target metrics with year-over-year improvement.
  • The physical and mental requirements of our roles include but are not limited to regular use of a computer, devices or other office equipment, clear communication, and occasional movement. You'll need comfort with screen work, basic hand coordination, and focus. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these functions.

To round out our world-class total rewards package, we provide annualized base salary in the range listed below. This range reflects the base salary the Company reasonably expects to pay for the position at the time of posting. Placement within the range will be based on job-related factors, including experience, qualifications, scope of responsibilities, and demonstrated track record of delivering results in similar roles.

Annualized Base Salary
$160,000—$192,000 USD

Compensation & Benefits

At Praxis, we believe that taking care of our people (and their people) is important, so we provide a world class benefits package to help you thrive. This includes 99% of the premium paid for medical, dental and vision plans. We also provide company-paid life insurance, AD&D, disability benefits, and voluntary plans to personalize your coverage. Thinking about the future? We match dollar-for-dollar up to 6% on eligible 401(k) contributions and sweeten the deal with long-term stock incentives and ESPP. We provide a discretionary quarterly bonus, an extremely flexible wellness benefit, generous PTO, paid holidays and company-wide shutdowns. Not to mention, you'll also be joining a phenomenal crew of colleagues who are smart, engaged and inspiring. We aim high, collaborate hard, and produce results. Let’s achieve the impossible together!

Company Overview

Praxis Precision Medicines is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company translating genetic insights into the development of therapies for central nervous system disorders characterized by neuronal imbalance. At Praxis we share a common vision of reshaping the human condition into a more freeing and fulfilled existence by developing high impact medicines for patients and families affected by and living with complex brain disorders. Our core Values of Trust, Ownership, Curiosity and Results are foundational to every aspect of our business and are exemplified by each and every one of our team members.

Diversity, Equity & Inclusion
Guided by our core values, at Praxis Precision Medicines, Inc. we continue to DARE FOR MORE® to advance, promote, and champion diversity, equity, and inclusion by encouraging individuals to bring their authentic selves and perspectives to work each day. We are an equal opportunity employer and committed to providing opportunities to all qualified applicants without regard to race, religious creed, color, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, sexual orientation, disability, genetics, military service and veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

Attention: Job Scam Alert
Praxis has recently become aware of fraudulent job recruitment postings from individuals claiming to represent Praxis. These postings seek financial information in connection with fraudulent opportunities for employment. If you suspect any fraudulent activity or misrepresentation in connection with a Praxis job opportunity, please report it to careers@praxismedicines.com.

Praxis does not accept unsolicited submissions from recruitment agencies for open positions. We ask all recruitment agencies to refrain from contacting any Praxis employee regarding any position. All unsolicited resumes submitted by recruitment agencies to any Praxis employee in any form or method will be deemed to be the property of Praxis, and Praxis explicitly reserves the right to hire those candidate(s) without any financial obligation to the recruitment agency.

title: Lead Software Engineer
description:
Role: Lead Software Engineer

Location: Cape Town City Centre

"Looking for a strong Team Lead with good Java experience and the ability to thrive in rapidly growing, fast-paced international technology startup"

We are assisting our client, an international and cutting-edge engineering and design business, source for a Cape Town-basedSenior Software Team Lead.

About the role:

The Senior Software Team Lead will run a small team building high-volume, low-latency systems on a modern Java / Spring Boot stack. This is a hands-on lead role: you'll write and review code, but your bigger job is organising the team's work, unblocking people, and making sure what our client ships is solid.

You'll own delivery for your team's slice of the platform: planning, work allocation, code quality, technical direction, and stakeholder communication. You'll report into engineering leadership and have a real say in architecture and hiring.

What you'll actually do:

Lead the team (about 30% of your time)

  • Break down projects into work, allocate to engineers based on strengths and growth goals, and track delivery.
  • Run sprint planning, standups, and retros. Keep the team's backlog healthy and prioritised with the product side.
  • Do 1:1s with each engineer. Coach, give feedback, flag performance issues early.
  • Own code review standards on the team. Make sure reviews happen quickly and raise the bar over time.
  • Be the point of contact for other teams, product, and ops when something on your patch needs a decision.
  • Contribute to hiring: screen CVs, run technical interviews, help shape the team you want.

Stay hands-on (about 70% of your time)

  • Design and build services on our Java 17+ / Spring Boot stack. You should still be writing production code every week.
  • Drive technical design for non-trivial work. Write design docs, run design reviews, make the calls on trade-offs.
  • Lead the team's response to production issues. Triage, root-cause, and follow through on fixes.
  • Keep the architecture honest: push back on shortcuts that will hurt us in six months, agree to ones that won't.

What we need from you:

Experience

  • 8+ years building production Java systems, with at least 2 years leading a team of engineers (formal or informal lead).
  • Strong Spring Boot and modern Java (17+). You can build a service from scratch and explain every choice.
  • Real microservices experience: service boundaries, async messaging, API design, versioning, observability. Not just "we had multiple services."\
  • Solid with PostgreSQL or similar (schema design, query tuning, migrations). MySQL is fine too.
  • AWS in production: ECS or EKS, S3, IAM, plus infrastructure-as-code (Terraform preferred).
  • Docker in your sleep. CI/CD pipelines you've built or meaningfully improved.
  • Comfortable with Linux and standard web server / reverse proxy setups (Nginx, Apache).
  • Git workflow fluency (branching strategies, code review, GitHub or GitLab).
  • You've worked in Agile / Scrum and have opinions on what works and what's theatre.

AI tooling: fluent but not dependent:

Our client uses Claude (and similar tools) heavily across the engineering team. They want a lead who uses them well, not someone who's either skeptical or over-reliant.

  • You actively use Claude (Claude Code or the chat interface) day to day for coding, debugging, design exploration, and writing.
  • Comfortable with vibe coding for prototypes, spikes, and throwaway tooling. You know when it's the right tool and when it isn't.
  • You can read AI-generated code critically. You catch the subtle bugs, you push back on bad suggestions, and you don't ship code you don't understand.
  • You can teach junior engineers how to use AI tools without becoming dependent on them. Fundamentals first, AI as a multiplier.
  • Red flag: engineers who can't debug or design without an AI assistant, or who paste in AI output without reading it.

How you work:

  • You explain your thinking clearly, in writing and out loud, to both engineers and non-engineers.
  • You're decisive. You'd rather make a reversible call now than wait a week for perfect information.
  • You give feedback directly and kindly. You take it the same way.
  • You finish things. "Almost done" doesn't count.

Qualifications:

  • BSc / Diploma in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Oracle Certified Professional (Java) is a plus, not a requirement.

Nice to have:

  • Experience with event-driven architectures (Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQS).
  • Performance tuning experience on low-latency systems (JVM tuning, profiling, caching strategies).
  • Exposure to Kotlin, Go, or other JVM / backend languages.

title: Business Analyst, Data & Business Intelligence
company: GIRO Inc. / Le Groupe en informatique et recherche opérationnelle
description:
GIRO IS YOUR WAY FORWARD

At GIRO, our mission is clear: Improving quality of life around the world through software and services that increase the efficiency of public transport and postal delivery.

Joining us means contributing to projects and initiatives that makes a real difference to millions of people. Every line of code, every idea, every action, advances our impact around the world. Join us and let’s lead the way forward, together.

Why choose GIRO?

• Join a Quebec software company that is an international leader

• Advance your career in a collaborative work environment where expertise and commitment are the driving force behind every project

• Stability based on long-lasting client relationships and our long-term vision

AN ENVIRONMENT FOR GROWTH

Here, we focus on an inclusive and positive environment.

We offer a range of benefits, including

• Flexible working hours, including remote work for a balanced life.

• Team activities and annual traditions that we take pride in

• Everyday support: Employee assistance program, telemedicine and mental health support.

• Training and professional development opportunities to grow, learn and discover your way forward.

YOUR MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES

As part of the Corporate Effectiveness team, you will act as a Business Analyst in a context focused on data value creation, the evolution of business intelligence, and the deployment of artificial intelligence.

You will contribute to structuring and advancing practices related to the use of data, metrics, and business intelligence at GIRO. You will support teams in defining their needs while contributing to corporate data governance, the enhancement of BI practices, and the evolution of our data ecosystem.

Business Analysis and Stakeholder Support

  • Understand, analyze, and clarify business needs related to data, performance indicators, and business intelligence.
  • Conduct process analyses, create process maps, and identify improvement opportunities to optimize data utilization.
  • Assess available data, identify gaps, and translate business needs into requirements for the development of analytics and business intelligence solutions.

Data Governance and Business Intelligence

  • Participate in the implementation and continuous evolution of data governance practices.
  • Assess current practices and recommend the mechanisms, standards, and tools required to operationalize data governance.
  • Define, document, and promote best practices related to the use and governance of business intelligence solutions.
  • Support the definition and evolution of organizational performance indicators.
  • Evaluate and recommend improvements to the management, accessibility, and use of the corporate dashboard portfolio.

Transformation and Practice Evolution

  • Collaborate with various teams to anticipate the impact of transformation initiatives on data, metrics, and organizational performance.
  • Influence and support stakeholders in adopting new data and business intelligence practices.
  • Contribute to the evolution of BI practices and to strategic thinking around the use of data and artificial intelligence at GIRO.

THE SKILLS THAT WILL MAKE YOU A KEY MEMBER OF OUR TEAM

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • Approximately 8 to 15 years of experience, primarily in business analysis and/or business intelligence.
  • Significant experience with initiatives related to data, business intelligence, analytics, or data governance.
  • Experience in requirements analysis, stakeholder management, and the delivery of strategic recommendations.
  • Strong understanding of concepts related to data platforms, data lakes, and modern BI environments.
  • Experience with Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, or similar technologies is a strong asset.
  • Experience working on digital transformation initiatives or enterprise solution implementations.
  • CBAP certification is an asset.
  • Excellent ability to clarify mandates in collaboration with initiative sponsors, analyze complex issues, and align stakeholders around practical solutions.
  • Strong influencing leadership, autonomy, proactivity, and a highly collaborative mindset.
  • Ability to communicate effectively in both French and English (to interact with English-speaking internal and/or external clients).

WHAT WILL MAKE ALL THE DIFFERENCE

We are looking for someone who combines the rigor of a business analyst with the curiosity of a data expert. Someone who can understand the challenges behind a request, question assumptions, propose innovative approaches, and support GIRO in its transition toward a more data-driven and AI-enabled organization.

You will join a team of three business analysts who value knowledge sharing, collaboration, and mutual support. This environment enables everyone to contribute to a variety of initiatives and make an impact beyond their primary area of responsibility.

READY TO HELP SHAPE THE FUTURE WITH US?

Apply today and connect with our Talent Acquisition team. We look forward to meeting you!


In accordance with the standards and regulatory requirements to which GIRO adheres, all positions—whether permanent, fixed-term, or internship—are subject to a criminal background check. Positions that involve access to financial data are also subject to a credit check. All verifications are conducted in accordance with GIRO’s established procedures.

Employment Conditions

Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the selected country at the time an offer of employment is made. It is the sole responsibility of candidates to obtain any required work permits, visas, or other authorizations prior to their start date.

title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
description:
Senior Site Reliability Engineer

As a Senior Site Reliability Engineer to Sr. Director – Platform Operations, you'll play a critical role in ensuring the availability, reliability, and operational excellence of Nasdaq's cloud-based platforms. Based in Manila and working within a globally distributed team, you'll support mission-critical services and drive continuous improvement across our FinTech Platform Operations organization.

You'll thrive in this position if you're hands-on, solutions-oriented, and passionate about building resilient systems in a fast-paced, high-impact environment.

What You’ll Do

  • Manage incidents and problems through resolution, including technical diagnosis, recovery coordination, and follow-up actions with relevant teams.

  • Test, plan, and deploy changes to cloud systems to strengthen reliability, operational excellence, and customer outcomes.

  • Drive observability, automation, patching, vulnerability management, and capacity practices across cloud platforms.

  • Facilitate disaster recovery tests, business continuity activities, change events, and operational readiness exercises.

  • Coordinate cross-functional operational initiatives with global engineering, security, product support, and customer delivery teams.

  • Provide clear, structured communication during incidents and changes, including impact, recovery status, risks, and next steps.

What You’ll Bring

  • 8+ years of experience supporting 24x7x365 mission-critical production environments in financial services, cloud operations, or managed services.

  • Strong hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP, or OCI), Linux, Kubernetes, and infrastructure automation tools such as Terraform and Ansible.

  • Solid experience with containerization technologies including Docker and Kubernetes.

  • Proficiency in monitoring and observability tools such as Datadog or AWS CloudWatch.

  • Strong understanding of networking fundamentals including TCP/IP, DNS, firewalls, VPNs, and routing.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to articulate technical issues and recovery plans to both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Flexibility to work on a 4-day work week schedule (Mon - Tue - Fri - Sat) covering morning to afternoon hours.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Professional-level certification in AWS, Azure, or OCI.

  • ITIL certification or equivalent service management experience.

  • Experience in financial services environments or knowledge of relational database platforms (Oracle, PostgreSQL).

Work Schedule & Location

This is a permanent, full-time role based in Bonifacio Global City, Philippines, operating on a hybrid work model with at least two days per week in the office.

This role follows a 4-day work week (Monday, Tuesday, Friday, and Saturday), covering the Australian time zone (8:00 AM – 7:00 PM AEST / 10 hours per day including a 1-hour break).

Benefits & Rewards

We offer a competitive, well-rounded rewards package designed to support the financial, physical, and emotional well-being of our employees and their families (where applicable).

In return, you can expect HMO coverage for you and your dependents, employee stock purchase plan, equity grant, retirement plan, annual bonus, free counseling sessions, subscription to e-learning platforms, fitness, wellness, and more.

We utilize a structured job architecture and career framework to ensure growth opportunities are transparent, fair, and accessible to all employees.

For more information, visit Nasdaq Benefits & Rewards Career Page.

Come as You Are

Nasdaq is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds and identities.

We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where diverse perspectives, experiences, and identities are valued and celebrated.

We ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided with reasonable accommodation throughout the hiring process.

title: Design System Lead - Product & Engineering
description:
Shift4 (NYSE: FOUR) is boldly redefining commerce by simplifying complex payments ecosystems across the world. As the leader in commerce-enabling technology, Shift4 powers billions of transactions annually for hundreds of thousands of businesses in virtually every industry. For more information, visit www.shift4.com.



Design System Lead - Product & Engineering

Summary

Our Product Design team works across multiple product lines, from web and SaaS to Android and POS hardware, as we move toward a shared foundation. We are looking for a Design System Lead to lead the next evolution of that foundation. You will own the design system end-to-end, from token architecture and component governance to AI-assisted tooling that closes the gap between Figma and production. You will define what should be standardized across platforms and what should remain platform-specific, creating a cohesive product experience without forcing a single technical implementation. title: Business English Coach, Executive Learners | Contract, Remote, JST Hours
description:
Business English Coach, Executive Learners | Contract, Remote, JST Hours

The Role

IMMERSE is a language learning company that helps adults build real-world fluency through live instruction and immersive technology.

We are hiring experienced instructors to deliver 1:1 business English coaching to senior professionals at a global enterprise client. Learners are working executives based in Japan. They are advanced speakers who need their English to hold up under pressure in the situations their roles actually demand: running meetings, presenting to leadership, negotiating, and communicating with US-based counterparts across cultures.

Sessions are 50 minutes, one to one, delivered over Zoom. You work with a small ongoing caseload rather than a rotating queue, so you build a real relationship with each learner over time and see their progress.

You will work from an IMMERSE content library developed around the client organization's leadership framework and the communication demands of their roles. For each learner you select and sequence from that library based on their role and goals, and you create additional material where their needs go beyond it. This is not scripted delivery, and it is not building a program from nothing. Expect to spend real time shaping each learner's path and adjusting it as they go.

The role suits an instructor who works well independently with advanced learners, who can read what a senior professional actually needs and adjust in the moment, and who writes feedback a busy executive will act on.

Compensation

This role pays $45 to $70 per session, based on coaching experience and credentials. The session rate covers the 50-minute session, pre-session review of the learner's history and goals, personalization of the session plan within our framework, and written post-session feedback. Onboarding and calibration are paid separately at $20 per hour. If a learner cancels with less than 8 hours notice or does not attend, you are paid 100% of the session rate. Coaches invoice monthly and are paid within 30 days in USD. This is an independent contractor engagement. You are responsible for your own taxes and for holding valid freelance status in your country of residence.

Schedule Availability

Learners are based in Japan and book during JST business hours. Coaches set their own availability within that window. We are currently prioritizing coaches who anticipate consistent availability for multiple sessions per week during JST business hours. Session volume will vary based on learner demand and coach availability.

Why Coaches Like Working With IMMERSE

  • Preparation and written feedback are paid
  • Work directly with senior, motivated learners in leadership roles
  • A content library to build from, with real latitude to personalize
  • An ongoing relationship with a small caseload rather than a rotating queue
  • Paid onboarding, and full pay when a learner cancels late or does not attend
  • Fully remote, with availability you set within our learners' booking window

What You’ll Do

  • Deliver 1:1 business English coaching sessions with executive learners over Zoom
  • Select and sequence content from our library for each learner, and build supplementary material where their goals require it
  • Work through real professional scenarios relevant to their role, such as meetings, negotiations, presentations, and cross-cultural communication
  • Coach pronunciation, grammar, fluency, and professional writing
  • Write post-session feedback each learner can act on
  • Track progress and adjust each learner's path accordingly
  • Communicate proactively with the instructional team


Required Qualifications

  • Two or more years providing 1:1 business or executive English coaching to working professionals, including building individualized programs for corporate or executive clients
  • Master's degree in TESOL, Applied Linguistics, Education, or Business Communication, or equivalent depth of professional experience. We will seriously consider candidates without a master's who meet the experience bar above
  • Strong command of English pronunciation and of professional writing conventions in business contexts, including experience with formal pronunciation assessment
  • Learners are preparing for communication with US-based counterparts, so this role requires the ability to model General American English pronunciation and idiomatic business usage
  • Available to offer regular session times within JST business hours
  • Comfortable using Zoom and learning new platforms
  • Organized, reliable, and professional


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with Japanese professional learners
  • Prior experience working in a corporate environment
  • Comfort using AI tools for lesson development and personalization

AI Use Disclosure

How we review applications: Members of our team personally review your application and conduct your interview before any decision is made. We use AI tools to help summarize notes and surface details worth a closer look, supporting consistent evaluation across candidates. AI does not score, rank, reject, or make hiring decisions.

Apply

If you're an experienced English instructor who enjoys building personalized coaching programs for executive learners, we'd love to hear from you.

High school diploma or equivalent and at least 4 years of relevant experience in document control, records management, or a regulated quality environment.

Working knowledge of applicable quality-system requirements and government regulations relevant to the site, including FDA and USDA requirements, as applicable.

  • 8+ years of experience in propulsion system development, or other high-performance field
  • US citizenship is required, due to program requirements
  • Expertise in propulsion system modelling, static and transient analysis, and model validation using test data software such as Amesim, EcosimPro, Simulink, or Simscape
  • Experience with end-to-end development process, including gathering requirements, detailed design, qualification, production, and acceptance testing
  • Experience with all steps in the Systems Engineering V and risk-based decision making

THESE QUALIFICATIONS WOULD BE NICE TO HAVE:

  • A genuine passion for engineering, curious mindset, and willingness to learn

This position may require prolonged periods of sitting, standing, walking, computer work, and occasional exposure to moderate levels of noise, dust, and fumes in production areas.

title: LEAD SYSTEM INTEGRATION ENGINEER
description:
We are seeking a Lead System Integration engineer to contribute to the system integration and testing activities for the next generation vehicle controller and software platform. This new architecture will integrate new and advanced software functions for cloud connectivity and edge processing, thus enabling highly automated driving and advanced connectivity features. The individual should be an experienced engineer in system integration and testing, with strong skills in system-level issue root-causing and having a strong technical background in systems engineering and vehicle architecture development.

The primary focus will be to integrate the system of ECUs on a system bench and ensure that the software running on all ECUs function without issues or vulnerabilities. The process starts with flashing the software of the involved ECUs, and then running a suite of tests that verifies the communication (Ethernet, CAN, and LIN) among multiple ECUs, assess the stability of the software under stress, and run tests that involve verifying diagnostics functions and cybersecurity features. The responsibilities may include setting up and maintenance of system benches to ensure a workable test environment that is also remotely accessible. These activities involve a cycle of testing, analyzing results, and implementing remediation to improve overall security posture.

The job also entails reviewing relevant requirements, developing test cases using Python and CAPL scripting (among others), automating the execution of the test cases on CI pipelines, and analyzing the results. The role demands close alignment and interaction with SW design and architecture teams, in addition to cybersecurity experts.

We are looking for a highly motivated integration engineer who will work side by side with development engineers from the early design phase until system validation. This starts at day one by not only integrating early implementations and requirement models, but challenging design and logical architecture in the earliest phase and with a focus to always strive for a great end-to-end system experience.

We are seeking someone with good expertise at the following levels of the electrical system architecture and its various vehicle network functions and features: design verification, architecture verification, code/script development, system integration, and product validation.

title: Quality Assurance Technician
description:
At Zimmer Biomet, we believe in pushing the boundaries of innovation and driving our mission forward. As a global medical technology leader for nearly 100 years, a patient’s mobility is enhanced by a Zimmer Biomet product or technology every 8 seconds.

As a Zimmer Biomet team member, you will share in our commitment to providing mobility and renewed life to people around the world. To support our talented team, we focus on development opportunities, robust employee resource groups (ERGs), a flexible working environment, location specific competitive total rewards, wellness incentives and a culture of recognition and performance awards. We are committed to creating an environment where every team member feels inspired, invested, cared for, valued, and have a strong sense of belonging.


What You Can Expect

With direction from the QA Inspection Supervisor(s) and Quality Management perform dimensional inspections on machined and molded components manufactured from internal and external sources per engineering drawings and applicable external standards. Maintains inspection equipment including Vertex and Vectors. Also maintains control of products on hold.

This is an onsite position.

How You'll Create Impact

  • Perform moderate first article, on-line and final dimensional inspections, working from engineering drawings, procedures and external standards, using typical inspection equipment such as micrometers, thread gauges, calipers, optical comparator, concentricity gauge, and height & depth gages.
  • Perform receiving inspections of raw materials and component parts using, typical inspection equipment.
  • Perform component testing utilizing various inspection equipment such as tensile testers, force gages and custom equipment including programmable inspection machines.
  • Complete and maintain all QA paperwork in accordance with established procedures and manufacturing practices including the generation of first article reports, discrepant material reports, QA history log sheets and document change requests (DCR’s) as required.
  • Support the qualification/validation of new products/process projects; perform specialized inspections to help engineering develop new products, gages and inspection methods.
  • Follow written procedures and engineering specifications utilized for inspection and ensure they are kept current and adequate for the inspections performed. Provide feedback to QA Management on documents requiring updates or error correction.
  • Interact with personnel from departments outside of the Quality Inspection department, i.e. Manufacturing, Materials, Engineering, etc, to improve on overall Quality of product entering into the QA Inspection department, reducing rejections found and reported in QA.
  • Generate Non-conformance Reports for submitted product found out of specification. Coordinates movement/control/disposition of products that are under investigation for non- conformance. Coordinate shipment of Finished Goods scrap for destruction.
  • Generate Quality Hold documents and coordinate containment of affected product.
  • Publish various daily quality related reports
  • Perform additional duties as assigned by supervisor.
  • Using typical MS Office software (Word, Excel, and Outlook) create and perform simple data entry tasks and procedure changes as requested by QA Management.

This is not an exhaustive list of duties or functions and might not necessarily comprise all of the essential functions for purposes of the Americans with Disabilities Act.

What Makes You Stand Out

  • Ability to use typical measuring devices (micrometer, caliper, comparator, thread gages, go/nogo gages and custom gages) and test instruments (pull and torque testers).
  • Experience operating or programming programmable inspection machines (vision systems, CMM, etc) a plus.
  • Working knowledge of sampling techniques (e.g., ANSI Z1.4.), Good Manufacturing Practices and other regulatory standards required.
  • Ability to read standard operating procedures engineering drawings; solid understanding of engineering drawings utilizing Geometric Dimension and Tolerancing (GD&T) required.

Your Background

  • High School Diploma or Equivalent with specialized training and/or certification and 2 years of relevant experience
  • Work experience in an ISO and/or regulated industry environment preferred.

Travel Expectations

Up to 5%

Expected Compensation Range

$22 - $27.40/hour USD

title: Product Manager
description:
About GlobalFoundries:

GlobalFoundries is a leading full-service semiconductor foundry providing a unique combination of design, development, and fabrication services to some of the world’s most inspired technology companies. With a global manufacturing footprint spanning three continents, GlobalFoundries makes possible the technologies and systems that transform industries and give customers the power to shape their markets.
