Summary of Role:

MIPS is building a modern ecommerce platform to make it easier for customers, partners, and developers to discover, evaluate, purchase, and manage MIPS products and services. The platform will support both digital goods, including software, licenses, documentation, training, and support offerings, as well as physical goods that require fulfillment, inventory coordination, logistics, tax handling, and import/export compliance. This role will help define the requirements and operating model for a trusted commerce experience that connects product discovery, ordering, fulfillment, entitlement, support, and lifecycle management.

As the Product Manager / Product Owner, you will own the ecommerce roadmap, requirements, and backlog. You will translate business goals, customer workflows, operational constraints, and compliance needs into clear, prioritized deliverables for engineering and implementation partners. You will work across product management, engineering, finance, tax, legal, sales operations, supply chain, customer support, IT, security, and external commerce, payment, logistics, and fulfillment partners to launch and scale a platform that is reliable, compliant, measurable, and easy to use.

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Own the Ecommerce Product Backlog: Define, prioritize, and continuously refine epics, features, user stories, and acceptance criteria across product catalog, pricing, cart, checkout, payments, tax, fulfillment, entitlement, support, and account management.
  • Shape the Roadmap: Build and maintain a rolling 12 to 18 month ecommerce roadmap aligned with MIPS commercial priorities, product launches, customer needs, channel strategy, and operational readiness.
  • Represent the Buyer and Internal Operator: Develop a deep understanding of customer purchasing journeys, partner workflows, sales operations, support needs, and internal fulfillment processes; convert those insights into requirements that improve conversion, compliance, efficiency, and customer satisfaction.
  • Deliver Commerce Capabilities: Run agile planning and delivery with cross-functional teams to ship high-value capabilities such as product configuration, quote-to-order workflows, license delivery, payment processing, order tracking, returns or replacements, and customer self-service.
  • Enable Digital and Physical Goods: Define requirements for digital delivery, software licensing, entitlement management, documentation access, training content, and support offerings, while also supporting physical goods that require inventory visibility, shipping options, logistics coordination, and post-purchase service.
  • Drive Tax, Trade, and Compliance Requirements: Work with finance, tax, legal, security, and compliance teams to capture requirements for sales tax, VAT, invoicing, export controls, import restrictions, restricted-party screening, product classification, data privacy, and auditability.
  • Support Customer and Partner Programs: Coordinate beta programs, pilot launches, and partner integrations with commerce platform vendors, payment providers, tax engines, fulfillment providers, logistics partners, and systems integrators.
  • Prepare for Launch and Scale: Collaborate with product marketing, sales, customer support, finance, and operations on launch readiness, enablement, communications, reporting, support processes, and ongoing platform adoption.
  • Measure and Optimize: Define success metrics for conversion, activation, order accuracy, fulfillment cycle time, entitlement delivery, payment success, support volume, compliance exceptions, and revenue influence; use data to improve the platform continuously.
  • Collaborate Across Functions: Build strong working relationships with engineering, IT, security, finance, tax, legal, supply chain, sales operations, customer support, product marketing, and external partners.

Other Responsibilities:

  • Perform all activities in a safe and responsible manner and support all Environmental, Health, Safety & Security requirements and programs.

Required Qualifications:

• 8+ years in product management, product ownership, ecommerce, digital platforms, enterprise software, marketplace platforms, or commerce operations, with experience translating complex business and operational requirements into delivered product capabilities.

• Experience with ecommerce platform capabilities such as product catalogs, pricing, cart and checkout, payments, subscriptions or renewals, tax calculation, invoicing, customer accounts, order management, and analytics.

• Working knowledge of supply chain and fulfillment processes for physical goods, including inventory coordination, shipping methods, carrier integration, returns, replacements, and post-purchase support.

• Familiarity with sales tax, VAT, import/export restrictions, export controls, restricted-party screening, product classification, invoicing, and audit requirements for global commerce.

• Strong fluency with modern software delivery practices, agile product ownership, systems integration, API-based platforms, identity and access management, security, data privacy, and usage analytics.

• Experience working with external vendors or partners such as ecommerce platform providers, payment processors, tax engines, ERP or CRM systems, logistics partners, fulfillment providers, or systems integrators.

• Exceptional communication skills and stakeholder management across engineering, internal central functions, business leaders, customer-facing teams, and external partners. Key Performance Indicators


Preferred Qualifications:

Key Performance Indicators (first 12 months)

• Launch Readiness: Approved requirements, operating model, partner responsibilities, compliance workflows, and release plan for the initial ecommerce launch. GF Confidential – Need to know

• Commerce Conversion: Visitor-to-account, account-to-cart, cart-to-order, payment success, and abandoned checkout improvement across priority product families.

• Operational Accuracy: Order accuracy, entitlement delivery accuracy, tax calculation accuracy, fulfillment cycle time, and reduction in manual intervention.

• Compliance Performance: Successful handling of tax, trade, data privacy, security, and audit requirements with clear escalation paths and low exception rates.

• Business Impact: Revenue influenced through ecommerce, reduction in order cycle time, increased self-service adoption, and improved customer satisfaction.


Why Join MIPS, a GlobalFoundries company MIPS is expanding how customers and partners engage with our products, services, and ecosystem.

This role is an opportunity to define the commerce foundation that supports digital delivery, physical fulfillment, secure customer access, global compliance, and scalable commercial operations.

If you enjoy building platforms that connect product, engineering, operations, finance, legal, partners, and customers into a simple end-to-end experience, this role is for you.

Here is what you can expect from us: At MIPS, you will join a fast-growing team of technologists developing high-performance, real-time RISC-V processors that are functionally safe.

Our small, agile teams operate in a flat structure, giving you the opportunity to see and influence the bigger picture.

We offer substantial autonomy, with support from some of the most experienced hardware and software engineers in the industry. MIPS offers a competitive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, retirement savings, and paid leave to support both you and your family.


More about us: MIPS is a pioneer in microprocessor technology, having led the RISC-based computing movement that enabled faster, more power-efficient semiconductors across a wide range of markets from consumer electronics to networking and communications. More than 40 years after the original MIPS RISC architecture debuted, our processors have shipped in billions of consumer and enterprise products. We are driving innovation in compute platform that enable Physical AI across autonomous automotive and industrial solutions.

Thanks to our RISC heritage, deep engineering expertise, and proven technologies, MIPS is accelerating the development and deployment of next-generation RISC-V based solutions.

The team has built spacecraft, payloads, and components for missions to the Moon and Mars, working with partners including NASA, the Space Development Agency, and the U.S. Space Force. Whether it’s a single high-performance spacecraft, constellation, or the vertically integrated components that help them get to space — our world class Space Systems team is empowering some of the boldest and most ambitious space missions.

SENIOR SPACECRAFT PROPULSION COMPONENTS ENGINEER I

We are currently seeking a Senior Spacecraft Propulsion Components Engineer I for our propulsion engineering team based out of Long Beach, CA. As a Propulsion Components Engineer, you are responsible for system-level and component-level ownership of space systems propulsion and fluidic development. These teams support our Space Systems division, and lead cutting-edge programs for civil, commercial, and defense customers.

WHAT YOU’LL GET TO DO:

  • Owning development of new or existing products or systems, acting as technical lead to guide team through end-to-end development process.
  • Conceptual and detailed designs in CAD for propulsion system components as well as performance calculations, and analysis.
  • Review and approval of others’ drawings, 3D PMI, reports, and specifications.
  • Test planning, setup, instrumentation, execution, and data analysis.
  • Communicating with project stakeholders internal and external to the team.
  • Technical risk-based decision making to the right/best solution when faced with an engineering challenge.
  • Project management including schedule building and maintenance, identifying top priority items, tasking of other engineers and technicians, and communication of status to leadership and other teams.
  • Mentorship and coaching of people within the team on technical and professional development.
  • Defining and maintaining standard of excellence for their team through documentation, training, coaching, and review of others’ work.
  • Contributing to engineering process development and documentation at Rocket Lab related to areas of experience.

YOU’LL BRING THESE QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 5+ years of experience in propulsion system development, or equivalent high-performance field
  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, (aerospace, mechanical, mechatronics, or other technical engineering discipline)
  • Detailed mechanical design experience using NX (preferred) or equivalent industry standard CAD software and Product Lifecycle Management software such as Teamcenter (preferred), Windchill, or similar
  • Track record of design reviews and approving release of flight parts, qual reports and decisions for flight hardware
  • Experience with end-to-end development process including gathering requirements, detailed design, qualification, production, and acceptance testing
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to work well within a team environment
  • Hands-on integration and testing experience (ideally using NI equipment and software)
  • Experience working on propulsion systems utilizing different storable propellants, such as electrical and chemical
  • US citizenship and willingness to obtain a security clearance required, due to program requirements

THESE QUALIFICATIONS WOULD BE NICE TO HAVE:

  • A genuine passion for engineering, curious mindset, and willingness to learn
  • Comfortable working with high levels of ambiguity. Makes decisions using basic engineering principles, available literature and standards, technical risk assessments, test data, and physics-based models
  • Practice in identifying the necessary steps to achieve high level technical goals, scheduling them in a plan, and managing delivery against that plan
  • Experience developing requirement and verification sets, as well as writing test plans, performing testing, and writing test reports
  • Capabilities using Python for data manipulation and post-processing
  • Demonstrated hands on engineering skills, inside or outside the workplace
  • Detailed mechanical design experience using NX (preferred) or equivalent industry standard CAD software
  • Experience with GD&T and engineering drawings
  • Experience using Product Lifecycle Management software such as Teamcenter (preferred), Windchill, or similar
  • Experience using National Instruments data acquisition systems
  • Experience with testing and troubleshooting flight hardware
  • Master's or PhD

This position may require prolonged periods of sitting, standing, walking, computer work, and occasional exposure to moderate levels of noise, dust, and fumes in production areas.

Anticipated annual equity grant value is designed around function, level, experience, and other factors; realized value depends on vesting and stock-price performance.

Join one of the world's fastest-growing space companies and own a piece of it. In addition to competitive base pay, you'll receive company stock as part of your total compensation package, giving you a direct stake in our success. As we expand to new launch sites, groundbreaking missions, and global markets, your ownership has the opportunity to grow alongside the company.

Our comprehensive benefits package includes our industry-leading Employee Stock Purchase Program (with a 15% discount on company stock), top-tier medical plans (HMO, PPO, and a zero cost HDHP option with a significant HSA company contribution), dental and vision coverage, paid vacation and sick time, 11 paid holidays, flexible spending and dependent care accounts, paid parental leave, disability and life insurance, and a 401(k) retirement plan with company match.

Additional perks include subsidized EV charging, onsite fitness centers (where available), discounted gym memberships, complimentary snacks and beverages, 50% employee discount on our popular merch store, and a variety of other employee discounts.

Level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

$135,000—$208,000 USD

WHAT TO EXPECT

We’re on a mission to unlock the potential of space to improve life on Earth, but that’s not an easy task. It takes hard work, determination, relentless innovation, teamwork, grit, and an unwavering commitment to achieving what others often deem impossible. Our people out-think, out-work, and out-pace. We pride ourselves on having each other’s backs, checking our egos at the door, and rolling up our sleeves on all tasks big and small. We thrive under pressure, work to tight deadlines, and our focus is always on how we can deliver, rather than dwelling on the challenges that stand in the way.

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
About UpHill

At UpHill, our mission is to increase clinical capacity so healthcare professionals can focus on what matters most - the patients. Healthcare teams are either stretched thin by work that can be automated or weighed down by waste that can be avoided. UpHill's intelligent automated platform uses hospital data and patient conversations to turn chaos into useful and efficient interactions.


We build conversational AI agents, intelligent clinical pathways, and care orchestration tools that empower clinicians to work at their full potential - deployed across leading hospitals in Europe, with 100K+ lives impacted and over 1 million clinical interactions mediated. UpHill Route is a certified Class IIa Medical Device.


We're a team of curious and creative people who believe technology should enhance - not replace - the work of healthcare professionals. If you're excited about making a real impact in one of the most meaningful industries in the world, you just might be an Uphiller.


Today we're looking for a Senior Product Designer to own design at UpHill end to end - shaping the products clinicians and patients use every day, from the first sketch to what ships in production.


About the role

Our design team is one person short and that person is you. This is a full-ownership role: you'll be the only designer at UpHill, responsible for everything from early product ideation to the pixels that ship. We're looking for someone senior enough to run with that scope on their own, comfortable moving fast, making decisions independently, and being deeply proactive about what the product needs, not waiting to be told.


You'll take features from a rough idea to a validated, polished, shipped experience, and you'll do it largely on your own, which means you'll lean hard on prototyping (leveraging AI tools) to explore ideas quickly and get to conviction faster than a traditional design process allows. You'll also single-handedly own and evolve our design system, and you'll need to be comfortable jumping into production to make quick UI/UX changes yourself rather than routing everything through a queue for the Engineering team.


This is a rare opportunity to define how design works at a healthcare AI company from the ground up, with direct influence over the products used by clinicians and patients across Europe.


Responsibilities

  • Own the product design process end to end - from ideation and discovery through prototyping, validation, and launch - across UpHill's AI agents, clinical pathways and care orchestration solutions.
  • Prototype heavily and quickly, leveraging AI-assisted design and coding tools to explore directions and de-risk decisions before they reach engineering.
  • Build, maintain and evolve UpHill's design system single-handedly, keeping it consistent and scalable as the product grows.
  • Make fast, hands-on production UI/UX changes, working directly in the codebase or shoulder-to-shoulder with engineers when something needs to ship now.
  • Partner closely with Head of Product, founders, product managers, engineers, and clinical stakeholders to turn ambiguous problems into clear, well-designed solutions.
  • Talk to clinicians, hospital staff, and patients to validate design decisions and uncover real workflow pain points.
  • Set and uphold the bar for design quality, usability, and accessibility across every product surface.
  • Ensure design decisions account for the realities of a regulated, Class IIa medical device environment.


Main requirements

  • 6+ years of product design experience, with a portfolio that shows real end-to-end ownership - from concept to shipped, live product.
  • Experience building or independently owning a design system.
  • Strong prototyping skills, with hands-on experience using AI tools (e.g. Figma AI, v0, Lovable, Cursor, Framer, or similar) to move from idea to testable prototype fast.
  • Comfortable making UI/UX changes directly in production.
  • Highly proactive and self-directed - you don't need a spec handed to you, and you're comfortable being the sole designer driving decisions.
  • Sharp visual and interaction design fundamentals.
  • Strong communication skills, able to explain the "why" behind design decisions to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Fluent in English.


Strong plus

  • Experience designing for healthcare, clinical workflows, or other complex, regulated domains.
  • Experience designing AI-driven interfaces.
  • Front-end coding skills (HTML/CSS/React) to ship changes directly, no handoff required.
  • Experience as the sole or founding designer at an early-stage or scale-up startup.
  • Background designing complex B2B or enterprise software.
  • Familiarity with accessibility standards and medical device design/regulatory considerations (e.g. IEC 62366).


What you'll get

  • Be part of a dynamic, mission-driven team shaping the future of healthcare
  • Competitive salary
  • Comprehensive health insurance
  • Top-tier equipment — new MacBook + budget for peripherals
  • Flexible schedule and hybrid work model
  • Direct impact on patient outcomes — the AI you build handles real clinical conversations
  • No-BS culture: small, senior team where your voice shapes product and architecture decisions


Ready to shape the future of healthcare with us? Apply now and become an Uphiller!

title: Sr. Engineer- Perimeter Security | On-Site, Bangalore
description:
This position will be on-site reporting to our Bangalore office, M-F

This team provides 24/7 support. This role requires shift flexibility, including the ability to rotate between days, mids, and nights.

The Perimeter Security Engineer is responsible for designing, implementing, administering, monitoring, and supporting enterprise perimeter security controls across on-premises, cloud, and remote-access environments. The role provides deep operational expertise in next-generation firewalls and secure web proxy technologies, partners with infrastructure and application teams to resolve connectivity and policy issues, and strengthens security through disciplined change, compliance, lifecycle, and incident-management practices.

How you’ll make an impact

  • Administer enterprise firewalls, including security policies, NAT, routing, VPN, application control, URL filtering, threat prevention, software upgrades, high availability, monitoring, auditing, and rule-base hygiene.
  • Configure, operate, and troubleshoot secure web proxy and cloud-delivered security services, including explicit and transparent proxy, PAC files, authentication, SSL/TLS inspection, URL categorization, malware controls, and policy enforcement.
  • Plan, design, implement, and validate improvements, migrations, replacements, and standardization of perimeter security components.
  • Perform in-depth troubleshooting using firewall and proxy logs, packet captures, flow analysis, threat logs, and monitoring tools to determine root cause and restore services.
  • Investigate security events and indicators involving internet ingress and egress, remote access, web traffic, command-and-control activity, malicious downloads, and policy violations.
  • Assess and implement firewall and proxy requests with appropriate business justification, least-privilege access, application awareness, risk review, testing, and rollback planning.
  • Monitor platform availability, capacity, performance, license health, certificate validity, and high-availability status; support uptime and service-level commitments.
  • Maintain technical standards, ruleset documentation, object inventories, network diagrams, runbooks, software-release plans, hardware lifecycle records, and operational procedures.
  • Support security compliance and audit activities by producing evidence, reviewing access, remediating findings, and reporting adherence to approved policies and standards.
  • Collaborate with network, cloud, endpoint, SOC, IAM, application, and vendor teams; provide technical guidance and mentor junior engineers during incidents and changes.

Technical Expertise

  • Next-Generation Firewalls: (Fortinet or Palo Alto Networks) NGFW and Panorama; Prisma Access; App-ID, User-ID, Content-ID; GlobalProtect; security profiles; NAT; IPsec and SSL VPN; routing; HA; decryption; log analysis.
  • Secure Web Proxy / SSE: Zscaler Internet Access, Broadcom Symantec ProxySG, Netskope, Forcepoint, or equivalent; proxy policy, PAC files, authentication, SSL inspection, URL filtering, sandboxing, DLP integration, and troubleshooting
  • Cloud Security: AWS and Microsoft Azure networking and security controls; cloud firewalls, security groups, route tables, load balancers, private connectivity, and hybrid traffic flows. GCP exposure is advantageous.
  • Network & Security Foundations: TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, HTTP/S, TLS, BGP, OSPF, VLANs, routing and switching, load balancers, certificates/PKI, packet capture, and network traffic analysis.
  • Operations & Tooling: ITSM and change management; SIEM and monitoring tools; configuration backup; vulnerability and compliance review; scripting or automation with Python, PowerShell, APIs, or infrastructure-as-code is desirable.

What we're looking for

  • Minimum 5 years of relevant hands-on experience in perimeter security, with strong operational expertise in enterprise firewall and secure web proxy technologies.
  • Proven experience implementing and supporting Palo Alto Networks firewalls and Panorama in enterprise environments; Prisma Access experience is strongly preferred.
  • Hands-on experience with at least one enterprise secure web proxy or Security Service Edge platform such as Zscaler, Symantec ProxySG, Netskope, or Forcepoint.
  • Professional experience in information security, network security, consulting, managed services, or an enterprise security operations role.
  • Demonstrated ability to handle complex incidents, analyze traffic, communicate root cause, and define corrective and preventive actions.
  • Experience working within formal incident, problems, change, vulnerability, and configuration-management processes.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical risks and solutions to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
  • This role demands the availability of 24/5.
  • This role is Work from Office.

Certifications

  • Palo Alto Networks Certified Network Security Engineer (PCNSE)/ Fortinet Certified Professional NSE4 & NSE5 or current equivalent.
  • Zscaler, Netskope, Broadcom/Symantec, Forcepoint, or other proxy/SSE platform certification.
  • CCNP Security, CISSP, or a relevant cloud security certification from Microsoft Azure or AWS.

title: Learning Experience Designer
description:
Applied Intuition, Inc. is powering the future of physical AI. Founded in 2017 and now valued at $15 billion, the Silicon Valley company is creating the digital infrastructure needed to bring intelligence to every moving machine on the planet. Applied Intuition services the automotive, defense, trucking, construction, mining and agriculture industries in three core areas: tools and infrastructure, operating systems, and autonomy. Walton Beach, Florida; Ann Arbor, Michigan; London; Stuttgart; Munich; Stockholm; Bangalore; Seoul; and Tokyo. Learn more at .

We are an in-office company, and our expectation is that full-time employees primarily work from their Applied Intuition office 5 days a week. However, we also recognize the importance of flexibility and trust our employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work, starting the day with morning meetings from home before heading to the office, or leaving earlier when needed to accommodate family commitments. This in-office expectation does not apply to contractor positions

About the role

We are seeking a Learning Experience Designer to join our Vehicle Operations team to design and scale learning experiences that build the skills, knowledge, and operational readiness required to safely and effectively operate, test, maintain, and support our vehicle fleet and associated operations. This role is critical in ensuring our operators and operations staff are prepared, safe, and aligned with best practices. You'll manage training content, drive onboarding, track compliance, and work cross-functionally to improve team knowledge and performance.

This is a highly hands-on role at the intersection of Learning & Development, Vehicle Operations, Engineering, and Technology. You will work closely with Vehicle Operations leaders, subject matter experts, engineers, and other cross-functional partners to translate complex operational processes and technical requirements into practical, engaging, and measurable learning experiences.

You will own the design of learning experiences across the employee lifecycle—from onboarding and foundational skills through advanced technical training, certification, qualification, and ongoing proficiency. You will also leverage AI and emerging learning technologies to make learning more scalable, personalized, experiential, and closely connected to the flow of work.

The ideal candidate is a strong learning designer who enjoys working in complex technical environments, can quickly learn unfamiliar operational domains, and approaches learning as a capability and performance problem—not simply a content-development exercise.

At Applied Intuition, you will:

  • Design Vehicle Operations learning programs that build role-specific skills, knowledge, and operational readiness—from onboarding and foundational training through advanced technical skills, qualification, certification, and ongoing proficiency.

  • Partner with Vehicle Operations leaders, engineers, SMEs, and cross-functional teams to identify capability gaps, define proficiency requirements, and translate complex operational, technical, and safety requirements into practical learning experiences.

  • Design engaging, hands-on learning experiences using a blend of instructor-led training, vehicle-based practice, simulations, scenarios, assessments, job aids, and performance support to prepare employees for real-world operational environments.

  • Apply learning science and performance-based design to determine the right solution for each business need—not defaulting to training—and create learning journeys that drive measurable behavior, skill, and performance outcomes.

  • Leverage AI and emerging learning technologies to accelerate content development, personalize learning, enable on-demand knowledge and coaching, and create scalable simulations, practice, and performance-support experiences.

  • Build and maintain high-quality learning content and curricula, including learning paths, facilitator and learner materials, assessments, job aids, and digital experiences, ensuring technical accuracy and alignment with evolving vehicle technologies and operational procedures.

  • Measure and continuously improve learning effectiveness using learner feedback, proficiency data, operational performance, and business outcomes, with a focus on safety, quality, readiness, and time to proficiency.

  • 4+ years of experience in learning experience design, instructional design, technical training, or learning program management.

  • Strong foundation in adult learning, instructional design, needs analysis, and learning assessment.

  • Experience with Articulate Storyline/Rise or similar learning-authoring tools.

  • Proven ability to translate complex business, technical, and operational requirements into structured, practical learning solutions.

  • Experience developing training across multiple formats, including in-LMS, e-learning, documentation, presentations, video, and instructor-led/ hands-on learning.

  • Strong project management and execution skills, with a proactive, self-directed approach to driving deliverables from concept to completion.

  • Excellent communication, facilitation, stakeholder management, and SME partnership skills; comfortable working with operators, engineers, and product teams.

  • Strong curiosity and ability to quickly learn complex technical and operational domains, with exceptional attention to detail.

  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment and continuously improve learning experiences based on learner and business needs.

  • Bachelor's degree in Instructional Design, Learning Sciences, Education, Organizational Development, Human Factors, or a related field

Nice to have:

  • Familiarity with vehicle safety standards and operator onboarding

  • Experience using tools like Confluence, Google Workspace, and LMS/LXP platforms and learning technology ecosystems (Ethena, Cornerstone, etc.)

  • Experience designing learning for vehicle operations, automotive, autonomous vehicles, ADAS, robotics, manufacturing, logistics, field operations, or other safety-critical environments.

  • Experience developing technical certification, qualification, or proficiency programs.

  • Experience designing hands-on training, simulations, labs, or scenario-based learning.

  • Experience using generative AI to improve learning design and development.

  • Experience working closely with Engineering, Operations, Product, Safety, or Technical teams.

  • Familiarity with operational metrics and performance-based learning measurement.Compensation at Applied Intuition for eligible roles includes base salary, equity, and benefits. Base salary is a single component of the total compensation package, which may also include equity in the form of options and/or restricted stock units, comprehensive health, dental, vision, life and disability insurance coverage, 401k retirement benefits with employer match, learning and wellness stipends, and paid time off. Note that benefits are subject to change and may vary based on jurisdiction of employment.

title: Software Engineer, Robot Autonomy (Multi Agent Orchestration), Intern
description:
Our Mission

At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. Advances in AI, cloud computing, and hardware are reshaping what autonomous systems can do. Our mission is to build the intelligent software that powers physical security in the real world - enabling robots and sensors to handle dangerous and critical tasks that humans shouldn't have to. By engineering the orchestration layer for intelligent security, we aim to create a world that is safer, more secure, and more resilient.

We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today!

The Role

As a Software Engineering Intern in Multi-Agent Orchestration, you'll work on developing the orchestration layer that enables our autonomous agents to coordinate, collaborate, and make intelligent decisions to achieve efficient and scalable surveillance. Your primary focus will be on Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL), exploring how agents can learn optimal coordination strategies in dynamic environments. You'll also have the opportunity to explore alternative approaches, including task allocation algorithms, decentralized planning, and optimization techniques, to build robust and adaptive multi-agent systems.

This role is highly practical as we expect the developed methodologies not only to work I. simulation, but be deployed in real world scenarios.

What You'll Work On

  • Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning: Design, train, and evaluate MARL algorithms for cooperative multi-robot surveillance and persistent patrolling.

  • Multi-Robot Coordination: Develop strategies for decentralized decision-making, task allocation, and efficient collaboration between autonomous robots.

  • Simulation: Improve our simulations to train the policies that can be later transferred to the real world.

  • Real-World Deployment: Build and test algorithms in simulation environments, with opportunities to deploy them on real quadruped robots.

  • Algorithm Research & Optimization: Explore and compare learning-based approaches with classical optimization, planning, and heuristic methods.

  • Performance Evaluation: Develop benchmarks to assess surveillance coverage, patrol efficiency, scalability, and robustness in dynamic environments.

Who We're Looking For

We're looking for a motivated robotics or machine learning student excited to apply academic training in a fast-moving startup. You'll be surrounded by a team that values learning, experimentation, and building things that actually work in the real world.

Your Background

  • Currently in the final stages of a Master's degree or pursuing a PhD in Computer Science, Robotics, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field.

  • Demonstrated hands-on experience with Reinforcement Learning, backed by academic, personal, or research projects.

  • Experience with robotics simulators such as Isaac Sim, MuJoCo, or Gazebo or custom built simulators.

  • Solid understanding of reinforcement learning algorithms and concepts.

  • Ability to independently research, implement, and evaluate algorithms.

  • Good coding skills in Python, with PyTorch (or JAX).

Nice to Have

  • Experience deploying learned policies on physical robots, ideally legged.

  • C++ and ROS 2 experience.

  • Publications at top robotics or ML venues (CoRL, RSS, ICRA, NeurIPS).

What We Offer

  • Ownership: you are able to ship products and deliver project end-to-end.

  • Mission: autonomous security that keeps people and critical sites safe, including in defence.

  • Career path: a ground-floor seat with real runway. Prove your value and you will not have barriers to grow.

  • Team: work directly with PhD-level co-founders in AI, Robotics, and Physics, alongside a strong (and fun) founding team.

  • Compensation: Competitive equity/salary package

  • Culture: International founding team that is serious about building but does not take itself too seriously.

title: Senior Data Engineer - Sponsored Content & Products (all genders)
description:
The Sponsored Content & Products team is a key growth driver. Its mission is to build highly scalable self-serve cost-per-click (CPC) bidding marketplaces that empower brands to efficiently boost their visibility in real time right at the digital point of sale.

While operating within an existing ecosystem, the architectural transition from a single monolith into four specialized product teams provides a highly autonomous, greenfield-like environment where your design decisions will directly shape our future state and enable us to multiply our Retail Media revenue.

  • Bridge Platform & Application Layers: Design, build and maintain high-throughput Reverse ETL replication pipelines that bridge the gap between central core platform systems and client-facing reporting tools
  • Evaluate Storage & Data Modeling: Actively evaluate whether data is structured correctly for their downstream use cases. Command strategic technical decisions on whether workloads belong in relational engines (MySQL aggregates), fast search indexing layouts (OpenSearch), cloud warehouses (BigQuery), or columnar storage (ClickHouse)
  • Pipeline Modernization: Take lead in the migration of our current custom data processing pipelines into a modern, scalable data architecture through a secure transition path
  • Cross-Functional Information Architecture: Partner closely with Backend Engineers and Analytics Engineers to map out highly performant, scalable data structures, taking ownership over physical and logical modeling boundaries
  • Drive Operational Excellence: Promote operational excellence across our data infrastructure by prioritizing proactive monitoring, system reliability, and overall application health just as much as building new pipelines

  • Batch Workflow Orchestration: Expert experience building automated, event-driven batch architectures.. Skilled in configuring state tracking, asset sensors, and task dependency graphs for complex pipeline schedules
  • Database Architecture: Advanced understanding of relational and analytical database engines. Expert knowledge of when to leverage transactional relational setups (MySQL transaction isolation levels, query performance tuning) versus highly optimized columnar/document architectures (ClickHouse, OpenSearch, BigQuery)
  • Observability & Telemetry: Experience tracking system resources, logging pipeline runtimes, and setting up centralized data alerts within monitoring platforms like Datadog
  • Pragmatic & Solution-Oriented Mindset: A practical problem solver who values executing secure, stable transition steps over premature optimization or over-engineering

title: Equipment Engineer
description:
About GenScript

Founded in 2002 in New Jersey, GenScript Biotech Corporation accelerates innovation in biotech and healthcare by providing researchers and companies with the building blocks needed to develop groundbreaking treatments and products. Guided by its mission to Make People and Nature Healthier Through Biotechnology, and its role as a well-recognized biotechnology company, GenScript has a team of approximately 6,165 employees and has served more than 200,000 customers across over 100 countries and regions.

Job Title: Equipment Engineer

Location: Piscataway, NJ (Fully Onsite)

Reports to: Manager II, Engineering

Compensation: The estimated salary range is $65,000 - $75,000, dependent upon experience level.

Job Overview:

The Equipment Engineer reports to the Manager II, Engineering and supports laboratory and production equipment at our Piscataway, NJ facilities. This hands-on role maintains and repairs assigned equipment, improves reliability, and keeps complete records of equipment work.

The engineer performs appropriate preventive maintenance, troubleshooting, repairs, and calibration activities internally. OEM and third-party providers are used when specialist tools, qualifications, warranty terms, or capacity require outside service.

Job Responsibilities:

Hands-On Maintenance and Repair:

  • Perform scheduled preventive maintenance and appropriate calibration activities on assigned laboratory and production equipment, following approved procedures and documenting results.
  • Diagnose equipment failures, perform hands-on repairs within training and authorization, verify performance, and coordinate return to service with equipment users and Quality as applicable.
  • Support a range of instruments, which may include liquid handlers, automated systems, HPLC systems, centrifuges, thermal cyclers, analyzers, and general laboratory equipment.

Vendor and Service Management:

  • Determine when work should be outsourced to an OEM or qualified service provider and define the service needed.
  • Schedule and coordinate vendor visits for repairs, preventive maintenance, and calibration; prepare equipment and access, oversee work on site, and communicate timing to users.
  • Review vendor service reports and calibration certificates, confirm the work is complete, and follow up on unresolved issues before closing the work order.

Asset and Work Order Management:

  • Create and maintain CMMS work orders for failures, repairs, preventive maintenance, and calibration. Record symptoms, troubleshooting, work performed, parts used, results, attachments, and equipment status.
  • Maintain accurate asset histories, maintenance schedules, calibration due dates, and equipment inventory records; identify critical spares and support inventory planning.
  • Develop and improve clear technical procedures and maintenance instructions for assigned equipment.

Reliability, Quality, and Compliance:

  • Review work order history for repeat failures, downtime, and recurring costs; investigate causes and recommend improvements to maintenance plans, spares, or vendor support.
  • Perform and document equipment work in accordance with applicable site procedures and Quality requirements.
  • Support equipment-related deviations, root cause investigations, and corrective actions in collaboration with Quality and equipment users.

Communication and Collaboration:

  • Communicate equipment status, risks, and expected recovery times to laboratory and production users, management, and the Equipment team.
  • Coordinate work with users to minimize disruption and share troubleshooting knowledge with other team members

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related technical or scientific field, or equivalent relevant technical experience.
  • Three or more years of relevant equipment engineering, maintenance, field service, or calibration experience is preferred.
  • Hands-on experience maintaining and repairing laboratory equipment is preferred; experience with laboratory equipment troubleshooting and calibration is also preferred.
  • Ability to use a computerized maintenance management system (CMMS) or similar work order system to document work and track scheduled maintenance.
  • Experience coordinating OEM or third-party service providers and reviewing completed service work is preferred.
  • Familiarity with applicable GMP, ISO, or other regulated quality practices is helpful; ability to follow site procedures and maintain accurate records is required.
  • Strong problem-solving, organization, and communication skills, with the ability to prioritize equipment needs and work effectively with laboratory, production, and Quality teams.

title: Senior Security Risk Analyst, GRC
description:
About the Team

DoorDash’s Global Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC) team helps the business scale securely through practical risk-based decisions, reliable controls and clear accountability. Our third-party risk program protects the systems and data behind our marketplace across DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo.

About the Role

We're hiring a Security Risk Specialist, who will help run and shape our risk management program and treatment plans, enabling risk and control owners and security teams to keep risk at an acceptable level as the business grows. You will work cross-functionally to achieve business goals by running risk assessments and reporting, supporting exception requests when a policy can't be met, and helping automate the tooling and processes that keep our risk register accurate and trustworthy. You'll also help us build a more proactive risk function — going into specific areas of the business to deep-dive their controls, surface where things have gone wrong, and get ahead of issues before they surface.

You will report into the Senior Security Risk Manager on our GRC team in our Security organization.

You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…

  • Lead our global risk management process (assessing risk, negotiating treatment plans with owners, turning regulatory and framework changes into real, working controls)
  • Get into the detail of how controls operate day-to-day, factoring in threat intelligence to make sure we stay ahead of new threat actors and attack vectors
  • Manage policy exceptions by building compensatory controls or a case for risk acceptance instead
  • Own risk reporting for key areas like security or engineering, becoming the go-to risk contact for at least one and helping reduce risk there in a measurable way
  • Collaborate and report widely within our GRC and security teams and across the business
  • Help shape our team’s strategy and tooling as we grow by building your own automations rather than waiting on an engineer to build them for you

We’re excited about you because…

  • You have 4+ years of experience in security risk, GRC, or a related field.
  • You have a Bachelor's degree in a technology-related field, or an additional 4 years of work experience in a technology-related field.
  • You're fluent in risk management frameworks, including the National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) Cybersecurity Framework (CSF).
  • You know how to translate technical risk into language both technical and non-technical audiences can act on.
  • You have strong written and verbal communication skills, and can turn complex control requirements into clear, actionable guidance.
  • You're comfortable owning risk metrics and reporting, and can show — not just assert — that a program is working.
  • You have experience automating workflows, or an interest in agentic AI workflows.

Nice to have:

  • You have experience implementing or using GRC tooling.
  • You have experience with AI-related risk.
  • You have experience in controls assurance and effectiveness testing.

We expect this position to be filled by 12/16/2026

Base salary is localized according to an employee’s work location. Ranges are market-dependent and may be modified in the future.

In addition to base salary, the compensation for this role includes opportunities for equity grants. Talk to your recruiter for more information.

That’s why we offer a comprehensive benefits package to all regular employees, which includes a 401(k) plan with employer matching, 16 weeks of paid parental leave, wellness benefits, commuter benefits match, paid time off and paid sick leave in compliance with applicable laws (e.g. Colorado Healthy Families and Workplaces Act). DoorDash also offers medical, dental, and vision benefits, 11 paid holidays, disability and basic life insurance, family-forming assistance, and a mental health program, among others.

title: Fabric Data Engineer
description:
You're an experienced data engineer who gets excited about landing the rapidly evolving Fabric stack at data-driven enterprises the right way. You don't just build pipelines you think about how to do it right. You care about defining best practices, bringing software engineering discipline to the data platform world, and making things work at scale. You're pragmatic, opinionated where it matters, and always looking to raise the bar.

The Xebia Data Division

Xebia Data is one of Xebia's divisions, renowned for its expertise in building strong Data and AI practices that deliver value to our clients. In the past, our team has predicted daily bread demand for millions of loaves, built advanced energy-saving algorithms at a national scale, and established data innovation labs at large multinational companies!

You’ll work with the sharpest data professionals in Europe, people who are not only technically brilliant but also generous with their knowledge. We enjoy the benefits of being part of a large organization while maintaining the energetic atmosphere of a scale- up. Our commitment to our community is strong; we are deeply rooted in the local landscape.

What You’ll Be Doing To Make Organizations Data-Driven

Microsoft Fabric is becoming the go-to data platform for many organizations, and teams are eager to unlock its full potential. That's where you come in. You'll help clients adopt Fabric the right way: with proper engineering practices, reproducible deployments, testable code, and architectures that don't fall apart at scale.

Your day-to-day will include designing lakehouses and data pipelines in Fabric, but also tackling the harder questions: How do you set up CI/CD for Fabric? How do you manage environments and promotion? How do you structure a workspace for a team of ten? You'll define the patterns others follow.

Fabric is your main focus, but you stay curious. You keep an eye on the broader ecosystem, whether that's Azure, AWS, GCP, or open-source tools like Spark, Terraform, and dbt. You understand that good engineering principles transfer across platforms, and you bring that perspective to every engagement.

You use your communication skills as much as your technical skills. You explain your design choices, align stakeholders, and help client teams make confident and informed decisions about their data platform. You will be surrounded by experts from diverse fields and learn from different environments and industries. It’s not always easy, but it is always rewarding.

You will work on projects of varying lengths. Some are three weeks, some are one year, most are in between. Every project is different, as is every client. You'll work in mixed teams of Xebians and client engineers, building the foundations that power data products

When on-site with clients, you may encounter something very difficult to solve. At Xebia we work as a team and we've got your back. Everyone is just a message away and ready to help! We say People First, and we mean it.

What are we looking for

The Data Engineer role is a senior position integral to our teams, so we ask for at least 3 years of relevant Data Engineering work, with at least 1.5 years of that working with (or helping to transfer to) Fabric. That said, we’re always open to talent that stands out! If you have unique achievements, like contributing to open-source projects or founding your own startup, we encourage you to apply, no matter your experience level.

This is your dream job if….

  • You have hands-on experience with Microsoft Fabric and want to push it further by defining best practices, not just following tutorials.
  • You care about software engineering fundamentals like version control, testing, CI/CD, and code review, and you want to bring these to the Fabric ecosystem.
  • You think about scale. You've dealt with (or are eager to tackle) the challenges that come when data volumes, team sizes, and complexity grow.
  • You're curious beyond Fabric. You have experience with or interest in other clouds (Azure, AWS, GCP) and tools like Spark, Terraform, dbt, or Airflow.
  • You like working for different clients and enjoy learning in new environments and meeting new people on a regular basis in various locations.

This is not your dream job if….

  • You prefer clicking through UIs over writing code. We believe in engineering our data platforms, not just configuring them.
  • You're not interested in how things work under the hood. We want people who dig deeper.
  • You prefer to work alone and get drained from having to explain why you made certain technical choices.
  • You don't enjoy sharing knowledge. We write, speak, and teach because it's part of who we are.
  • If you do not live in North Brabant, Limburg, or Gelderland.

The Xebia Way

We believe in building a respectful and collaborative atmosphere where everyone can shine. Picture this: a team of curious minds, always eager to learn and share ideas. We are especially proud of our generous educational budget and our “Hack-What-You-Want” Fridays, where you can dive into projects that excite you. We champion our consultants to grow into advisors and thought leaders, whether that’s publishing blogs, speaking at events, or shaping conversations about Data & AI.

Xebia is a Great Place to Work certified organization driven by technology evangelists in Data and AI. Our global presence has a proven record of success across industries.

Our Commitment to You

  • Enjoy free healthy lunches and not-so-healthy drinks/snacks at our offices.
  • Get a lease car or mobility budget
  • Pick whatever laptop or MacBook you like!
  • You can work on that innovative idea of yours next to other colleagues during our monthly Xebia Data Fridays.
  • You can build/test/experiment with anything you want in our sandbox environments in GCP, AWS, and Azure
  • Pension plan.
  • Fun events and activities like ski trips, BBQs, cooking workshops and more!
  • 5k educational budget. And please, do spend every bit of it!
  • Career strategy support to help you scale your skills and leadership
  • Unlimited book budget

Our core values are people first, quality without compromise, knowledge sharing, and customer intimacy. At Xebia Data, you will find like-minded colleagues who are at the forefront of their field and have the courage to go off the beaten track; they are the people who make organizations move.

Banding: Band 6
Location: London Bridge Hospital, London
Start Date: ASAP
Salary: £24–£30 per hour
Working Hours: Part-time or full-time
Contract Duration: 3 months

Job Overview

We are currently seeking an experienced and motivated Band 6 Speech and Language Therapist (SALT) to join the team at London Bridge Hospital on a locum basis for an initial period of three months.

This role is suited to a confident and experienced clinician with a background in critical care who can work independently in the assessment and management of patients with complex communication and swallowing needs, particularly those requiring tracheostomy management.

The successful candidate will predominantly be based at the main London Bridge Hospital site, although they may also be required to review patients at the Guy’s site. This is an excellent opportunity for a skilled Speech and Language Therapist to contribute to high-quality patient care within a specialist hospital environment.

Key Responsibilities

In this role, you will:

  • Assess and manage patients with complex speech, language, communication and swallowing difficulties within a critical care setting.
  • Independently assess and manage patients with tracheostomies, ensuring safe and effective clinical practice.
  • Develop and implement individualised treatment plans based on patients’ clinical needs.
  • Work collaboratively with the wider multidisciplinary team to support patient recovery and rehabilitation.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date clinical documentation in line with professional and organisational standards.
  • Provide clinical recommendations to support safe and effective patient management.
  • Predominantly work at London Bridge Hospital, with occasional reviews required at the Guy’s site.
  • Where suitably qualified and experienced, undertake Fibreoptic Endoscopic Evaluation of Swallowing (FEES) and Videofluoroscopic Swallowing Assessments (VFSS).

Qualifications and Experience

To be considered for this role, you must have:

  • A recognised degree in Speech and Language Therapy (or equivalent).
  • Current Health and Care Professions Council (HCPC) registration.
  • Proven clinical experience working within a critical care environment.
  • Demonstrable experience and confidence in the independent management of patients with tracheostomies.
  • Strong clinical reasoning, assessment and decision-making skills.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • The ability to work independently and collaboratively within a multidisciplinary team.

Desirable experience:

  • Experience in conducting FEES assessments.
  • Experience in conducting videofluoroscopic (VFSS) assessments.
  • Previous experience working within an acute hospital setting.

If you are an experienced Band 6 Speech and Language Therapist with a background in critical care and independent tracheostomy management, we would love to hear from you.

This is an excellent opportunity to secure a locum position at London Bridge Hospital, with an immediate start available and flexible part-time or full-time working options.

Please apply using the link below or contact our specialist team to find out more about this opportunity.

As a global leader in life sciences research support, STEMCELL Technologies is looking for an Electronics Engineer to join our Instrumentation UK engineering team. In this role, you will play a key role in supporting the continued manufacture, performance and evolution of our innovative cell sorting instruments, while also contributing to the development of our next generation of instrumentation.

As an Electronics Engineer, your initial priority will be sustaining engineering for our existing cell sorting platform, investigating technical and manufacturing issues, implementing design improvements, and supporting the product throughout its lifecycle. Alongside this, you will contribute to the design, development and transfer to manufacture of next-generation instrumentation as our product portfolio evolves.

Job Description

Duties and Responsibilities

  • Support ongoing product improvement and lead or support electronics-related quality investigations through problem investigation, root-cause analysis, design change, verification, and implementation into manufacture

  • Own and deliver sustaining engineering activities including management of component obsolescence, substitutions, supplier support, product lifetime improvements and cost reductions

  • Contribute to new product design, development and transfer to manufacture, including prototype builds, design verification, engineering documentation and design transfer

  • Bachelor's degree in Electronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering or a related discipline, with 2–6 years of relevant engineering experience (or an equivalent combination of education and experience)

  • Practical experience designing, simulating, and troubleshooting analogue and digital electronic systems incorporating power supplies, ADCs, motor/fan controllers, sensors, and interfaces (I2C, SPI, SMBus, Ethernet, USB)

  • Proficiency in schematic capture and multi-layer mixed-signal PCB layout, with circuit simulation experience being desirable

  • Hands-on experience using laboratory equipment (oscilloscopes, logic analysers, multimeters, VNAs) for bench testing, fault finding and board bring-up

  • Proven ability to perform root-cause analysis and deliver product lifecycle support in a manufacturing environment

  • Experience with FPGA firmware design (VHDL/Verilog including IP blocks, synthesis and place and route) is desirable

title: Senior Systems Engineer
description:
Parallel Systems is pioneering autonomous battery-electric rail vehicles designed to transform freight transportation by shifting portions of the $900 billion U.S. trucking industry onto rail. Our innovative technology offers cleaner, safer, and more efficient logistics solutions. Join our dynamic team and help shape a smarter, greener future for global freight.

Senior Systems Engineer

Parallel Systems is building autonomous, battery-electric rail vehicles to modernize freight transportation. We are looking for a hands-on Senior Systems Engineer to interface with customers and end users to define the product. You’ll architect the system and use best Systems Engineering practices to define requirements, lead design reviews, and execute validation campaigns.

This position straddles the vehicle hardware and the end user command and control software. You will have a critical role in integrating to existing train control systems, and will participate in crafting the next generation of advanced autonomous rail operations.

Responsibilities

  • Define high level needs, goals, and objectives based on business and customer desires
  • Develop product plans and roadmaps and guide team execution to those plans
  • Lead trade studies to determine best implementation of product
  • Develop system architecture, concepts of operation, and requirements
  • Decompose system level requirements to subsystems requirements with all engineering disciples (mechanical, electrical, system/software)
  • Manage and maintain requirements traceability from system requirements through validation evidence using a structured requirements database
  • Develop interface control documents (ICD)
  • Develop compliance matrix, verification and validation plan, integration plan and design verification test (DVT) plan/procedure
  • Lead and perform Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA)
  • Provide feedback across the design lifecycle to improve testability, reliability, and system robustness
  • Provide technical guidance for engineering best practices

Success in This Role

  • After 30 Days: Understand the vehicle architecture, command and control software, railroad operating environment, subsystem interfaces, and existing requirements. Identify the highest-priority gaps in requirements, traceability, integration, and validation.
  • After 60 Days: Own key system and subsystem requirements and interfaces. Lead cross-functional design reviews, improve requirements traceability, and begin driving trade studies and integration issue
  • After 90 Days: Independently lead systems engineering for a major vehicle or operational capability. Establish clear requirements, interfaces, risks, and verification plans, and drive integration and validation to produce structured, audit-ready evidence.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, Controls, Aerospace, Computer Science, or related field
  • 5+ years of experience working on complex hardware systems
  • Direct experience testing electromechanical systems that integrate hardware, firmware, and software interfaces
  • Strong foundation in electromechanical fundamentals and system integration
  • Experience with system and subsystem validation such as acceptance testing, environmental validation, integration testing, and deployment testing
  • Experience with existing railroad operations and train control software
  • Demonstrated ability to create structured, audit-ready documentation for safety and compliance purposes

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with classical systems engineering practices including requirements management, functional architecture, and DFMEA
  • Experience managing or administering a requirements database and maintaining verification traceability
  • Experience integrating hardware and software systems in a regulated or safety-critical environment
  • Track record of implementing process improvements across engineering or manufacturing systems
  • Experience with Python or similar programming languages
  • Familiarity with CAD tools such as SolidWorks

Final compensation may vary and will be determined during the interview process. The target hiring range for this position is listed below.

title: Senior AI Engineer
description:
About Centific

Centific is a frontier AI data foundry that curates diverse, high-quality data, using our purpose-built technology platforms to empower the Magnificent Seven and our enterprise clients with safe, scalable AI deployment. Our team includes more than 150 PhDs and data scientists, along with more than 4,000 AI practitioners and engineers. We harness the power of an integrated solution ecosystem—comprising industry-leading partnerships and 1.8 million vertical domain experts in more than 230 markets—to create contextual, multilingual, pre-trained datasets; fine-tuned, industry-specific LLMs; and RAG pipelines supported by vector databases. Our zero-distance innovation™ solutions for GenAI can reduce GenAI costs by up to 80% and bring solutions to market 50% faster.

Our mission is to bridge the gap between AI creators and industry leaders by bringing best practices in GenAI to unicorn innovators and enterprise customers. We aim to help these organizations unlock significant business value by deploying GenAI at scale, helping to ensure they stay at the forefront of technological advancement and maintain a competitive edge in their respective markets.

About Job

AI Engineer – Vision AI, Agentic Systems & Physical AI

Location: Seattle / Palo Alto / Remote

Job Description

Centific’s Physical AI team is building next-generation AI systems at the intersection of Vision AI, multimodal foundation models, agentic AI, simulation, and real-world robotics. We work on practical and frontier problems spanning video understanding, autonomous systems, embodied intelligence, data pipelines, evaluation, and deployment.

We are looking for an AI Engineer who can bridge research and production: someone who can build, fine-tune, evaluate, and deploy AI systems across vision, language, video, simulation, and agentic workflows. You will work closely with research, data science, and platform engineering teams to turn advanced AI ideas into scalable, customer-ready systems.

This role is ideal for an engineer with strong hands-on experience in modern AI/ML systems, a solid grasp of multimodal and agentic architectures, and an interest in Physical AI challenges such as perception, dexterity, navigation, simulation, and autonomous decision-making.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and deploy AI/ML systems across Vision AI, multimodal AI, agentic AI, and Physical AI use cases.

  • Develop and integrate models for video understanding, image perception, tracking, multimodal reasoning, autonomous workflows, and robotics-related tasks.

  • Work with research and engineering teams to productionize models using platforms such as NVIDIA NeMo, Riva, RAPIDS, Triton, Isaac stack, AWS Bedrock, GCP Vertex AI, and related SDKs.

  • Build pipelines for large-scale structured and unstructured data, including video, audio, sensor, and text data.

  • Implement and optimize model inference, evaluation, monitoring, drift detection, and governance workflows in production environments.

  • Support experimentation with LLMs, VLMs, world models, agent frameworks, tool-using agents, and memory-enabled agentic systems.

  • Contribute to AI systems for simulation, digital twins, robotics perception, dexterous manipulation, long-horizon task execution, autonomous driving, and edge-case evaluation.

  • Perform data analysis, error analysis, benchmarking, and model improvement for robustness, safety, and generalization.

  • Collaborate directly with customers and internal teams to identify relevant datasets, define success metrics, and translate business needs into AI system design.

  • Help build reusable internal frameworks, accelerators, and data products for multimodal and agentic AI deployments.

Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 5+ years of experience building and deploying large scale AI/ML systems in production.

  • Strong programming skills in Python and solid experience with modern ML frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or JAX.

  • Hands-on experience with Vision AI, including one or more of: image/video models, object detection, tracking, segmentation, grounding, video analytics, 3D vision, or multimodal perception.

  • Experience with Generative AI, including LLMs, VLMs, multimodal pipelines, RAG, agents, or agent orchestration frameworks.

  • Familiarity with agentic AI concepts such as tool use, planning, workflow orchestration, and memory; experience with agentic memory or knowledge-graph-backed agents is a plus.

  • Experience working with NVIDIA AI ecosystem tools such as NeMo, RAPIDS, Riva, Triton, and ideally exposure to Isaac Sim / Omniverse or related simulation environments.

  • Experience building scalable inference or training pipelines on GPU infrastructure, with familiarity in performance optimization, distributed systems, or high-performance networking.

  • Ability to design experiments, evaluate hypotheses, and implement optimization workflows for real-world AI systems.

  • Strong communication skills and ability to work directly with customers, researchers, and cross-functional engineering teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with robotics, autonomous driving, simulation, digital twins, or embodied AI systems.

  • Familiarity with Ray, Kubernetes, Docker, FastAPI, TensorRT, MLflow/W&B, or related MLOps and distributed AI tooling.

  • Exposure to sensor fusion, audio/video analytics, multimodal data pipelines, or robotics data formats.

  • Experience with model governance, observability, safety evaluation, or production model monitoring.

  • Comfort working across both applied engineering and research-driven prototyping.

Why Join Us

  • Work on frontier problems in Vision AI, agentic AI, and Physical AI.

  • Build systems that connect research-grade models to real deployments.

  • Collaborate with a strong cross-functional team spanning engineering, data science, simulation, and robotics.

  • Help shape the next generation of AI systems for real-world action.

Salary: $160,000-$220,000 + OTB

Centific is an equal-opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, age, mental or physical disability, medical condition, sex (including pregnancy), gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, marital status, familial status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

Critical Facilities Technician - Chandler, AZ
