title: Superintendent, Electrical
description:
At Moss Utilities, we specialize in underground utility installations across the DFW Metroplex. Our project experience includes commercial, single-family residential, multi-family residential, and public works infrastructure.

Founded in 2016, Moss Utilities carries forward a family legacy in Dallas-Fort Worth utility construction dating back to the early 1900s. As an employee-owned company (ESOP), every team member has a stake in our shared success and the future we’re building together.

Position Overview

The Superintendent, Electrical plays a key role in executing Moss Utilities projects with excellence. This role is responsible for overseeing field construction activities for underground electrical infrastructure projects, including duct banks and underground conduit systems. The Superintendent ensures crews work safely, schedules stay on track, materials and equipment are available, and work meets project specifications and quality standards. This role combines field leadership with strong planning and coordination. Travel, including out-of-town assignments, may be required.

Responsibilities

Project Planning and Coordination

• Prepare and submit a three-week look-ahead schedule by end of day Thursday each week.

• Attend weekly scheduling meetings with updated and accurate project information.

• Develop and maintain project schedules with the Project Manager, communicating deviations promptly.

• Coordinate crews, subcontractors, and material deliveries to maintain project progress.

• Schedule equipment, fuel, and tools with a minimum of 72 hours’ notice.

• Coordinate with the Concrete Division to confirm duct bank readiness and concrete placement.

Field Execution and Quality

• Oversee excavation, conduit placement, duct bank installation, concrete encasement, and backfill.

• Review electrical and civil plans with Foremen to verify installation details, material needs, and

subcontractor coordination.

• Verify conduit placement, spacing, elevations, and concrete encasement meet project specifications.

• Coordinate required inspections before concrete placement and backfill.

• Monitor production, work quality, and material usage while identifying potential schedule conflicts.

• Partner with the Project Manager to manage project costs and address field changes.

Safety and Crew Leadership

• Ensure compliance with OSHA requirements, Moss safety policies, and applicable regulations.

• Review safety documentation and exercise Stop Work Authority when necessary.

• Hold Foremen accountable for crew performance, quality, and safety.

• Verify equipment inspection reports through report reviews and physical equipment checks.

• Participate in recruiting, interviewing, and hiring crew members as needed.

• Approve all employee time entries by 5:00 PM each Monday.

Communication and Reporting

• Maintain clear communication with Project Managers, General Superintendents, Foremen, subcontractors,

inspectors, and utility providers.

• Build strong relationships with General Contractors and project partners through consistent daily

communication.

• Communicate field issues, schedule changes, and resource needs promptly.

• Keep BaseCamp updated according to the requirements provided by the VP of Field Operations.

• Respond promptly to calls and acknowledge receipt by text when unavailable.

Required Qualifications

• Proven experience supervising commercial construction projects involving underground electrical

infrastructure, including duct banks and conduit systems.

• Strong understanding of construction methods, scheduling, crew coordination, and cost control.

• Knowledge of safety standards, electrical utility installation processes, and municipal regulations.

• Ability to read and interpret electrical and civil plans, specifications, and engineering documents.

• Strong communication, problem-solving, and leadership skills.

• Ability to work collaboratively with field and office teams in a fast-paced environment.

• Proficiency with project coordination tools, Microsoft Office Suite, and Google Workspace.

• Willingness and ability to travel, including out-of-town assignments, as needed.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience supervising underground electrical infrastructure for data center projects.

What You Get from Working at Moss

• An incredible culture built on our core values.

• Competitive pay and strong benefits.

• Onsite amenities include fitness center, basketball and pickleball courts, and personal training.

• Opportunities for professional growth and long-term career development.

• Employee ownership, where your hard work directly contributes to the value you build.

Benefits Offered

• Medical, dental, and vision coverage.

• Life insurance, short-term disability, accident, and critical illness plans.

• Multiple health plan options.

• 401(k) with company match.

• Paid time off and paid holidays.

• Employee ownership through our ESOP program.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to maintaining a Drug-Free Workplace. We participate in E-Verify, and all applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States.

title: Insider Risk Analyst
description:
As an Insider Risk Analyst at Lam Research, you will play a critical role in helping manage insider risk investigations and helping to build out our insider risk capabilities. Your responsibilities will include analyzing and investigating anomalous user activities, indicators, and providing support to active incidents alongside our most valuable stakeholders. You may be asked to support cross-functional opportunities across Lam Research to help identify security trends and metrics, develop innovative use cases designed to detect anomalous events, and support education and awareness campaigns for insider risks and threats. You will use sophisticated technology and robust partnerships to enhance our insider risk posture against nation-state actors, negligent and malicious employee activity, and support high-risk populations from potential compromise. You will play a vital role in taking the Lam Research Insider Risk program to the next level by being both an analytical and technical expert on our team.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Drive triage, investigation, and support management of insider risk cases.

  • Identify, collect, and analyze technical and non-technical indicators from a variety of sources.

  • Coordinate investigation and mitigation strategies with Insider Risk team’s management and colleagues, as well as additional internal stakeholders.

  • Leverage your analytical and technical skills to identify patterns and trends and make recommendations to enhance detective and preventive controls.

  • Perform log analysis and coordinate/perform event queries across enterprise systems.

  • Operationalize and maintain the processes and playbooks required for insider risk analysis and support the development and execution of any new processes and playbooks.

  • Leverage subject matter expertise to educate stakeholders on the importance of data and information sharing to protect and enable the business.

  • Ensure investigative findings are documented, as needed.

  • Support process improvement initiatives and provide project related support for the Insider Risk program.

  • Respond to requests for ad-hoc support, reporting, and research topics from management and stakeholders, as required.

  • Must be able to maintain confidentiality and always use sound discretion and judgment.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or Advanced Degree in Cybersecurity, Information Security, Counterintelligence, or related discipline.

  • 4+ years of experience in an Insider Risk role.

  • Korean fluency required (additional language abilities preferred).

  • Experience working Insider Risk investigations directly and/or providing analysis to Insider Risk investigations beyond alert triage.

  • Ability to read, interpret, and identify anomalies within system, network, and application logs.

  • Proficiency in querying, analyzing, and parsing unstructured log data to identify complex behavioral patterns.

  • Experience monitoring and responding to alerts and investigations.

  • Basic knowledge of malicious insider risk indicators, such as those associated with theft of intellectual property, sabotage, and/or espionage.

  • Proficiency utilizing security-related tools, to include UEBA, UAM, and DLP experience.

  • Working knowledge of investigation processes and techniques, leveraging technical and non-technical indicators and ability to prescribe best practices with our stakeholders.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate professionally with team members, stakeholders, and senior leadership, as needed.

  • Strong aptitude for identifying and learning new technologies.

  • Ability to adapt to a fast-paced and evolving environment.

  • A self-motivated person that can use their creative and experience-driven analytical skills to solve problems.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Formal education and training in insider risk and/or counterintelligence.

  • Possession of investigative interviewing skills to gather context from employees, managers, and witnesses during internal investigations.

  • Proficiency in identifying insider threats using a multitude of sources.

  • Ability to break down and understand complex problems and the ability to develop a plan and innovative ways to address them.

  • Strong people and team/relationship building skills in cross-functional global team settings.

  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate with wider security, counterintelligence, and insider risk professional communities.

title: Principal Spacecraft Operations Engineer - Secret Clearance Required
description:
ABOUT ROCKET LAB

Rocket Lab is the end-to-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity’s reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We move fast, build real hardware for meaningful missions, and make the impossible routine. Come shape the future with us.

SPACE SYSTEMS

At Rocket Lab, we’re not just launching rockets — we're building the future of space. Our Space Systems team builds everything from complete spacecraft, precision payloads to the components and subsystems that allow them to thrive in space, like solar panels, flight software, star trackers, optical systems, separation systems, radios, and more.

Our Space Systems team has enabled more than 1,700 missions, ranging from interplanetary exploration, in-space manufacturing to national security and defense initiatives. The team has built spacecraft, payloads, and components for missions to the Moon and Mars, working with partners including NASA, the Space Development Agency, and the U.S. Space Force. Whether it’s a single high-performance spacecraft, constellation, or the vertically integrated components that help them get to space — our world class Space Systems team is empowering some of the boldest and most ambitious space missions

PRINCIPAL SPACECRAFT OPERATIONS ENGINEER I- SECRET CLEARANCE

Based on site at Rocket Lab's headquarters in Long Beach, CA the Principal Spacecraft Operations Engineer is responsible for ensuring the health, safety, and optimal performance of a growing fleet of satellites while meeting mission objectives and SLAs for both commercial and government customers. This includes supporting diverse missions such as LEO constellations, interplanetary exploration, LEO rendezvous, and SDA-related deployments.

Your expertise would be critical during commissioning, orbit raising, routine operations, and potentially re-entry phases, ensuring the health and safety of Rocket Lab’s expanding fleet. The Spacecraft Operations team works closely with related teams, such as spacecraft design, AIT, flight software, propulsion, GNC, flight dynamics and ground software development to help improve both the ground and satellite-based capabilities over time.

The space operations experience at Rocket Lab is unique because you will cover a multitude of roles/positions and responsibilities, with the large majority of the technical products being supplied through the vertical integration/in-house.

WHAT YOU’LL GET TO DO:

  • Serve as the program's mission operations technical lead: set the technical direction and strategy for operations, plan and prioritize the work of the mission operations staff, and act as the primary operations point of contact for program-level design decisions and trades
  • Advocate for operability across the program: influence spacecraft and ground architecture upstream so vehicles are designed to be operated safely, efficiently, and autonomously, and push for changes to program design and execution when operational needs demand it
  • Own mission operations requirements and lead requirements validation and verification for spacecraft missions and system-level capability and function
  • Define the automation strategy and lead the development of robust, software-driven methods for mission operations, testing, and data analysis to ensure efficient, repeatable, and reliable spacecraft operation
  • Design, develop, and test flight software sequences and FDIR/telemetry configurations to ensure spacecraft health and fault management through software-driven processes
  • Architect, develop, and test ground software for long-duration operations, including scripting and automation frameworks that make operations robust, hands-off, and scalable across a growing fleet
  • Establish and steward the integration, testing, and maintenance of mission operations tooling and codebases, including CI, version control, and release discipline. Ensure the on-call or shift schedules of operations
  • Author and own interface specifications, CONOPS, contingency procedures, and other operational design documents
  • Lead validation of flight products and procedures against spacecraft simulation tools, including flatsat, HITL, SIL, and digital twins
  • Support AIT teams across multiple spacecraft integrated tests (TVAC, propulsion stack, DITL
  • Provide program and product support to team leads and program managers, and serve as a key technical interface between the NZ and USA engineering teams
  • Represent mission operations in program milestone reviews, design reviews, and readiness gates, and drive continuous improvement through post-mission lessons learned

YOU'LL BRING THESE QUALIFICATIONS AS A PRINCIPALSPACECRAFT OPERATIONS ENGINEER:

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering (software, computer, electrical, aerospace, mechanical, or other technical engineering discipline)
  • 12+ years of direct experience in any of the following: space mission design, satellite subsystems, ground systems, spacecraft command control, or spacecraft operations
  • 5+ years of experience leading teams of engineers through spacecraft missions or related aerospace projects
  • Previous experience in roles such as Mission Lead, Mission Director, Flight Director, or Senior Spacecraft Operations Engineer
  • Previous experience supporting mission operations activities in an on-console or operator-in-the-loop capacity
  • Thorough understanding of key spacecraft subsystems and associated components, including attitude determination and control systems (ADCS), electrical power systems (EPS), space-to-ground communications, command and data handling (C&DH), thermal control systems (TCS), spacecraft propulsion systems, and fault detection, isolation, and recovery (FDIR)
  • Understanding of the space environment, orbital mechanics, and rigid body dynamics
  • 5+ years of direct software development experience (Python/Ruby/C/C++/other high-level languages), covering items such as spacecraft onboard flight scripts, ground scripting and automation, and data manipulation and analysis
  • US citizenship is required due to program requirements
  • Active U.S. Government Secret Security Clearance

THESE QUALIFICATIONS WOULD BE NICE TO HAVE:

  • Master’s or PhD engineering in engineering (software, computer, electrical, aerospace, mechanical, or other technical engineering discipline)
  • Prior experience in spacecraft operations
  • Prior experience in satellite system design
  • Prior experience in satellite ground systems
  • Exposure to modern development practices – GIT, CI/CD, cloud infrastructure
  • Proficiency with Agile issue-tracking tools, specifically Jira, for mission task management, status tracking, and bug reporting
  • Software-in-the-Loop (SIL) Testing: Exposure to testing frameworks that simulate software behavior in operational environments. ·
  • Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) Testing: Familiarity with testing frameworks that integrate software and hardware systems.
  • Active TS/SCI U.S. Government Security Clearance

This position may require prolonged periods of sitting, standing, walking, computer work, and occasional exposure to moderate levels of noise, dust, and fumes in production areas

Anticipated annual equity grant value is designed around function, level, experience, and other factors; realized value depends on vesting and stock-price performance.

Join one of the world's fastest-growing space companies and own a piece of it. In addition to competitive base pay, you'll receive company stock as part of your total compensation package, giving you a direct stake in our success. As we expand to new launch sites, groundbreaking missions, and global markets, your ownership has the opportunity to grow alongside the company.

description:

We are seeking a driven and customer-focused Account Specialist to execute in the field and drive commercial performance across a defined territory. This individual will be responsible for engaging healthcare providers, building strong customer relationships, and delivering on commercial objectives.

Working closely with cross-functional partners, you will play a critical role in supporting product launches, driving adoption, and ensuring patients gain access to innovative therapies.

What You’ll Do

title: Senior Director, Assessment Solutions and Technical Strategy
company: LE0010 Curriculum Associates India Private Limited
description:
At Curriculum Associates, we believe in the potential of every child and are changing the face of education technology with award-winning learning programs like i-Ready that serve a third of the nation’s K–8 students. For more than 50 years, our commitment to making classrooms better places, serving educators, and supporting accessible learning experiences for all students has driven the continuous improvement of our innovative programs. Our team of more than 2,500 employees is composed of lifelong learners who stand behind this mission, working tirelessly to serve the educational community with world-class programs and support every day.

At Curriculum Associates, our goal is to make classrooms better places for students and teachers. By providing high-quality, research-based, engaging, and culturally sustaining content to the schools we serve, along with assessment tools for setting high expectations, we believe that we can help schools create a learning environment where every student succeeds.

This role is part of the Assessment Solutions team and reports to the Associate Vice President of Assessment Solutions. The Assessment Solutions team is one of the Assessment and Psychometrics team within Assessment Programs group. This position sits at the intersection of psychometric expertise and strategic communication, bringing deep technical knowledge of educational measurement to bear on the documentation, proposal, and knowledge-translation work that enables Curriculum Associates’ assessment products to succeed in competitive state and district markets. In this role, working closely with leaders across the Assessment Programs team, you will work closely with a team of people across departments that include Bids and Proposals, Sales, and Marketing teams, and others. You’ll work with a dynamic and diverse team of associate vice presidents, directors, project managers, writers, researchers, marketing personnel, and assessment designers all focused on making classrooms better places for students and teachers.

Responsible AI use is a core expectation of this role. The Senior Director is expected to model effective AI adoption and build AI fluency - using AI tools to accelerate analysis, sharpen writing and communication, and manage technical projects.

Essential duties/responsibilities:

  • Lead proposal response strategy on behalf of the Assessment and Psychometrics teams to best position our Curriculum Associates assessment products to meet state and district needs while balancing the needs of our product roadmaps.

  • Drive the development of and lead ongoing management of the proposal response process for the Assessment and Psychometrics teams to create proposal responses which will showcase Curriculum Associate’s principled approach to assessment, coherence with instruction, deep psychometric expertise, and best in class assessment solutions.

  • Translate high-quality technical documentation into proposal text, assessment boilerplate, and technical reference materials that are accurate, psychometrically grounded, and accessible to the target audience, leveraging AI-tools as appropriate. Apply expertise in educational measurement to ensure documentation reflects the technical rigor expected by sophisticated state and district evaluators.

  • Manage assessment boilerplate text, technical documentation libraries, and versioning of materials as new assessment products, psychometric analyses, and research findings are generated. Maintain consistency and technical accuracy across all documentation as the assessment product portfolio evolves.

  • Use AI-assisted tools to accelerate proposal drafting, boilerplate development, and technical documentation workflows, ensuring all AI-assisted output undergoes expert review for psychometric accuracy and technical rigor before use.

  • Work closely with the Assessment, Psychometrics, and Marketing teams to develop an in-depth and continuously current understanding of Curriculum Associates’ assessment products, the psychometric and research foundations behind them, and how they are implemented in districts and classrooms across the country. Serve as a primary translator between technical psychometric and measurement expertise and the documentation, proposal, and strategic communication needs of the broader team.

  • Serve as a psychometric and assessment subject matter expert to diagnose gaps in proposals, conceptualize and develop technically rigorous solutions, and provide input when custom product expertise and implementation guidance are required to address state or large district purchasing or review requirements. Report to the larger Assessment team the market needs and assessment capability gaps demonstrated in these proposals and drive strategic decisions on how to fill them.

  • Review requests for proposals, information, and qualifications with a critical psychometric and assessment design lens. Identify technical and strategic challenges, propose and develop solutions that draw on deep measurement expertise, and communicate findings and recommendations clearly to the broader team.

  • Provide guidance on communicating relevant assessment, research, and implementation topics for the cross-departmental team that works on bids and proposals.

  • Contribute to and lead the preparation of third party-reviewed publications, technical reports, and presentations for academic and professional conferences in educational measurement and assessment. Use AI tools to produce high-quality, well-structured, and technically-sound publications.

  • Represent Curriculum Associates as a thought leader at conferences such as NCME, CCSSO, and AERA, advancing both the organization’s external reputation and the field’s understanding of applied psychometrics in K–12 assessment.

Required job skills:

  • Strong analytical/critical and creative thinking skills, including an ability to analyze data to inform both relevant response/market needs and existing capabilities relative to those needs

  • Ability to work in a self-directed and action-oriented way, anticipating and synthesizing needs, and developing a plan of action to meet deadlines with high-quality deliverables

  • Curiosity and initiative to learn new information, technologies, and skills, and to procure information using available resources

  • Excellent written and verbal communication

  • Experience leveraging AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot) to support proposal development, technical writing, and documentation management.

  • Deep expertise in psychometrics and educational measurement, including applied experience with item response theory, test development, validity, reliability, and standard setting. Demonstrated ability to analyze, synthesize, and translate sophisticated psychometric technical materials into clear, compelling language for district, state, and policy audiences.

  • Demonstrated expertise in K–12 assessment design and technical content, with the credibility and communication skills to engage productively with psychometricians, researchers, product teams, and external assessment experts on strategy and solutions

  • Ability to manage multiple tasks/projects concurrently, anticipate and solve problems, and develop creative solutions

  • Proven ability to work collaboratively and effectively across departments and business units with competing needs

Minimum qualifications:

  • Doctorate (Ph.D. or Ed.D.) in Educational Measurement, Psychometrics, or a closely related field required; or Masters level qualification plus relevant experience in K-12 assessment instead.

  • Knowledge of psychometric methodology that includes Classical Test Theory, Item Response Theory, Computer Adaptive Testing, Standard Setting, Field Testing, Scaling and Equating, Reliability, Validity, Classification Accuracy, and bias and DIF analyses.

  • A minimum of 5 years of technical writing experience with assessments

  • Demonstrated experience communicating about K-12 digital assessment and learning, specifically with district or state level audiences

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience in educational publishing proposal writing, particularly for state or large district RFPs in assessment or educational measurement

  • Record of peer-reviewed publication or professional conference presentations in educational measurement, psychometrics, or K–12 assessment

  • Experience applying psychometric methods in an operational K–12 assessment context, such as test development, standard setting, or technical manual preparation

  • Detailed knowledge of key state and national policies and trends on educational assessment

Benefits and Pay Range:
Pay Range – This role’s range is $164,250. - $196,500. The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that Curriculum Associates considers in making compensation decisions based on our Compensation Philosophy. Actual base pay within that range will vary based upon several factors including, but not limited to, prior experience and relevant skill sets. At Curriculum Associates, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances for each case. This role is also eligible to participate in the company bonus plan. The Company recognizes that minimum wage varies by location and will ensure all compensation decisions comply with applicable state and local laws.


Benefits – Benefit eligible employees (and their families) are covered by medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance. Employees can enroll in our company’s 401k plan and receive an employer match. Employees have access to a flexible vacation and sick policy in addition to twelve paid holidays and a winter office closure between Christmas and New Year's, as well as a number of additional perks and benefits.

title: Installation Lead
description:
Taking network infrastructure from plan to performance nationwide.

Installation Lead

Remote in US (based near one of these airport hubs: Atlanta, Houston, Dallas, Washington D.C, Charlotte or Chicago). Will require extensive travel.

About the role

Are you an experienced installation professional who thrives in fast-paced environments and enjoys leading complex network infrastructure deployments from start to finish? The Installation Lead plays a critical role in coordinating onsite installation activities, ensuring quality standards are met, and serving as the primary field representative throughout project execution.

You'll lead installation teams, manage onsite logistics, oversee testing and troubleshooting efforts, and ensure deployments are completed accurately, safely, and efficiently. Your work will directly impact project success, customer satisfaction, and the performance of mission-critical network infrastructure

What you’ll be doing

As a member of the Deployment & Implementation team, you'll be responsible for coordinating field installations, ensuring infrastructure quality, and supporting successful project delivery across customer environments. Your responsibilities will include:

Installation Leadership & Project Coordination

  • Coordinate onsite implementation activities to ensure installations align with approved designs and project requirements.
  • Lead installation crews and serve as the primary onsite representative for Boldyn throughout project execution.
  • Coordinate activities between escorts, Field Service Representatives, contractors, vendors, and internal implementation teams.
  • Track installation progress and provide regular status updates to project managers and stakeholders.
  • Manage onsite inventory, equipment logistics, and installation resources to support project timelines.
  • Ensure all equipment is properly scanned, tracked, and installed in the correct locations.

Network Installation, Testing & Troubleshooting

  • Oversee installation of fiber, copper, and networking infrastructure.
  • Perform testing and validation of network infrastructure to ensure quality and performance standards are achieved.
  • Conduct signal strength and speed coverage verification to confirm alignment with deployment plans.
  • Troubleshoot network issues in partnership with Engineering, NOC, Circuit, and Vendor teams.
  • Repair and resolve fiber and copper connectivity issues identified during testing and commissioning activities.
  • Support the successful activation and optimization of deployed network solutions.

Quality Assurance & Documentation

  • Conduct quality control inspections of installed equipment and infrastructure.
  • Verify installations meet project specifications, company standards, and customer requirements.
  • Complete closeout documentation, including network records and wireless design as-builts.
  • Maintain accurate daily records, installation reports, and project documentation.
  • Capture and organize closeout photographs of installed equipment and completed work.
  • Support inventory reconciliation, return shipments, and project closeout activities.

Collaboration & Customer Engagement

  • Serve as the primary onsite point of contact for customers, partners, and internal stakeholders.
  • Communicate effectively with project teams, field personnel, and customers throughout deployment activities.
  • Foster a collaborative work environment focused on safety, quality, and operational excellence.
  • Support incident resolution, work order completion, and escalated field-related issues.
  • Contribute to a culture of teamwork, accountability, and continuous improvement.

What you’ll bring

Think you could make a difference here? We're looking for someone who brings strong technical installation expertise, leadership capabilities, and a commitment to delivering high-quality infrastructure solutions. You will also bring some of the following:

  • Minimum of 3+ years of experience in cabling installation, networking infrastructure, or related electronic systems.
  • Experience leading or coordinating field installation projects and onsite crews.
  • Technical school certification preferred but not required.
  • Knowledge of fiber optic and copper infrastructure installation, testing, and troubleshooting.
  • Familiarity with IP networking, Ethernet, routers, firewalls, and CAT5/CAT6 technologies.
  • Ability to read and interpret construction drawings, installation specifications, and wiring diagrams.
  • Working knowledge of BICSI, INSTF, or related cabling standards and best practices preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently while managing multiple priorities in dynamic field environments.
  • Strong organizational skills with experience managing equipment, inventory, and project documentation.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to work effectively with customers, contractors, and internal teams.
  • Mechanical aptitude and proficiency using hand tools, power tools, and installation equipment.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to follow established installation, testing, and troubleshooting procedures.
  • High level of accountability, integrity, adaptability, and attention to detail.
  • Ability and willingness to travel extensively. Candidates should be located near a major airport.

About us

At Boldyn Networks, we're reimagining the future of interconnectivity. Our network solutions are solving some of tomorrow’s greatest challenges. We are one team across the globe—always listening, learning, and challenging each other to be our best. Here, you can change lives today and create a better tomorrow.

Why work with us?

We’re large enough to deliver and maintain large-scale operations, yet agile enough to empower your growth. You’ll work on meaningful projects, collaborate with talented colleagues, and develop new skills along the way.

We also offer:

  • Hourly rate: $21 - $25
  • Annual bonus
  • Learning Development Opportunities
  • Flexible working opportunities
  • Competitive benefit packages
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Vacation starting at 15 days and increasing with length of service
  • 10 days paid sick leave
  • 4 days off each year to volunteer

Ready to apply?

Are you ready to create an impact that will last for generations? Join us at Boldyn Networks today. Hit apply and follow the instructions to get started.

Diversity & Inclusion

We celebrate diversity in all its forms. Our backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences make us stronger. We welcome applications from all individuals regardless of race, age, gender, background, or religion. Together, we’ll solve customer challenges in the smartest ways possible.

title: Exerp India- QA Engineer II
company: Career opportunities at Clubessential | Xplor Technologies
description:
Xplor Technologies powers the experiences at the heart of everyday life. Through modern vertical software, embedded payments, and AI-powered capabilities, we help businesses in fitness, recreation, golf and club, field services, laundry, education, and other membership-based and service-based industries simplify operations, uncover insights, and elevate customer and member experiences.

We unite popular brands such as Clubessential, foreUP, myFitApp, Vermont Systems, Momence, Exerp, and many more.

Join Exerp as QA Engineer II to make a real impact every day. We say that because we know that every conversation we have, every interface we design, and every new feature we ship is another opportunity for us to elevate everyday life experiences for our customers and the people and communities they serve.


Purpose

As a Quality Assurance (QA) Engineer, you will be essential to all aspects of quality assurance and testing processes within our organization. Leveraging your experience and expertise in software quality, you will help define and implement strategic initiatives to enhance product quality, improve testing efficiency, and drive continuous improvement. You will be part of one of our software engineering teams where you will be writing and executing the test scripts for the new features that the team is responsible for. You will help ensure the quality and understanding of often complex business requirements. Additionally, you will be part of our QA community that continuously assesses the current state of the system and is driving the strategy for QA going forward, including both how to test already existing functionality, and how to ensure proper QA on future development (incl. the tools and practices used for testing).


Key Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with product managers, developers, and stakeholders to understand project requirements and define test objectives, scope, and timelines.
  • Develop and maintain detailed test plans, test cases, and test scenarios to validate software functionality, performance, and security.
  • Execute manual and automated tests to verify software functionality, detect defects, and ensure adherence to quality standards.
  • Analyze test results and quality metrics to identify areas for improvement and implement enhancements to testing processes, methodologies, and tools.
  • Collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams to ensure alignment between testing activities and project goals, priorities, and timelines.


Experience and Skills

  • Minimum 3 years of experience in manual testing and understanding of test automation.
  • Problem-Solving: Ability to analyze requirements and identify gaps in test coverage.
  • Manual Testing: Solid experience in writing, executing, and reviewing test cases.
  • Experience supporting complex ERP systems.
  • QA Process Knowledge: Strong understanding of SDLC, Agile methodologies and defect lifecycle.
  • Knowledge of version control and build management tools (Git, Maven/Gradle).
  • CI/CD & Tools: Exposure to Jenkins, GitHub Actions or similar.
  • Hardware peripherals and network troubleshooting.
  • Automation Expertise: knowledge of Java, Cucumber, BDD, and Gherkin is a plus.
  • Experience in implementing automation test cases is a plus.
  • Database Knowledge: Proficiency in SQL is a plus.
  • Knowledge or experience of the Health and Fitness industry is a plus.


Qualities we appreciate

  • Can-do attitude
  • Proactive
  • Team player
  • Self-motivated
  • Well organized
  • Process-oriented but at the same time, flexible to circumstances
  • Adaptability
  • People Person: Natural relationship builder with integrity, reliability and maturity
  • Keen attention to detail and adherence to deadlines


Working Conditions:

Enjoy the flexibility to organize your workday while staying aligned with your team for collaboration and key meetings. You'll thrive in a fast-paced environment where our senior development team drives rapid product evolution. We invest in your growth through dedicated Exerp Time, empowering you to learn, explore new ideas, and make a meaningful impact beyond your day-to-day work. Quality is at the heart of everything we build. As a QA Engineer, you'll play a key role in delivering software our customers can trust, helping shape a product that powers fitness businesses around the world.


At Xplor, we believe that the best innovation and ideas happen at the intersections of our differences - people of diverse cultures, generations, disciplines, and lived experiences. So even if you think you do not tick all the boxes, we still encourage you to apply.

Values and Life at Xplor

Our five core values guide us from how we hire and recognise our team members to how we interact with our customers day to day:

  • Find a better way
  • Do the right thing
  • Say it straight
  • Win together
  • Own the outcome

If these values sound like you and describe people you want to work with, you will thrive at Xplor.

As an Xplorer, you will be part of a global network of talented colleagues who will support your success. We look for commonalities and shared passions and give people the tools they need to deliver great work and grow at speed.


Ready to apply?

To start your application, please submit your resume, and we will be in touch as soon as we can.


Got questions? You can email us at talentsupport@xplortechnologies.com.

description:
Animator

Job title: Animator

Location: Sofia


Overview of the role:

We are the Animation Team within the Creative Department, responsible for bringing the artwork and ideas of our games to life through animation. Our goal is to create engaging, polished and fun animations for mobile slot games, while continuously developing our skills and improving the quality of our work. We work with Spine 2D, After Effects, Photoshop and Leonardo AI, combining solid animation fundamentals with modern tools and workflows. We value creativity, teamwork, attention to detail and willingness to learn. We enjoy experimenting, sharing knowledge and finding better ways to bring ideas to life.


We are looking for a 2D Animator who can bring characters, objects and game elements to life.

You should be comfortable with both realistic and stylized animation and have a good understanding of animation fundamentals and the 12 Principles of Animation.

You will work mainly in Spine 2D, creating animations that feel natural, expressive and fun, while fitting the visual style and technical requirements of mobile games.

We are looking for someone who has a good sense of timing, spacing, weight and movement, pays attention to detail, and is open to learning and improving.


This role follows a hybrid approach to working, allowing you to combine working from home with working in our modern offices. These discussions are between you and your manager to find the best pattern for you both, while recognising that quality time together is essential for keeping us mission-aligned.

Our teams work from a lively location nestled within this historic city. Enjoy the best of both worlds with winter and summer offices, tantalizing free snacks and a gaming paradise for endless entertainment.


What you’ll do:

  • Create high-quality animations and visual effects for characters, creatures, animals, symbols, props and other game elements, ensuring proper staging, timing, and seamless integration with other game elements. Work with both stylized and realistic animation.

  • Plan and present animation concepts, including animatics for prototypes and early-stage ideas, based on product specifications and project constraints.

  • Review and quality-check final animations and effects, ensuring they meet product requirements and the team's quality standards.

  • Collaborate with designers and cross-functional teams throughout the game development process to ensure all creative elements work together to deliver the best possible player experience.

  • Contribute to creative discussions, including art reviews and brainstorming sessions, staying open to feedback and direction.

  • Research market trends and competitor games to keep animation work fresh, relevant, and competitive.

  • Drive innovation by introducing new tools, techniques, and best practices to improve the animation process.

  • Maintain a library of reusable animation and visual effect assets to support efficiency on future projects.


What you’ll bring:


Experience, Skills & Knowledge

Must have:

  • A demo reel showcasing your most outstanding animation and visual effects work.

  • Hands-on experience creating animations and visual effects for games or interactive media.

  • Strong understanding of core animation principles (timing, spacing, staging, etc.) and their application in game design.

  • Proficiency in animation software (Spine 2D or similar).

  • Ability to create compelling visual effects and understand how they enhance user experience.

  • Excellent collaboration skills - you work well with designers, developers, and stakeholders across teams.

  • Strong communication skills and confidence presenting your work to audiences at all levels.

  • Meticulous attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously without compromising quality.

  • A problem - solving mindset and willingness to adapt and take on varied tasks as needed.


Nice to have:

  • 5+ years of professional experience in animation and visual effects.

  • Familiarity with casino slot games or gaming industry trends.

  • Knowledge of video editing techniques and marketing - focused storytelling.

  • Experience with game design tools and workflows beyond animation software.

  • A degree or formal qualification in Animation, Fine Arts, or a related field.

  • Experience with innovation initiatives or introducing new techniques to animation workflows.


It’s ok if you don’t think you tick every box on this list. We love people who want to challenge themselves and are passionate about what they do. If you believe you can contribute in some areas and are eager to learn, we encourage you to apply.

title: Director, Strategy & Operations—Employee Experience Group
description:
This is a high-impact role at the center of how the Employee Experience Group sets its direction, places its bets, and scales. The Director of Strategy & Operations will work alongside senior product leadership to shape the business strategy, translate market opportunities into investment priorities, and build the operating model needed to deliver durable growth.

You will bring together Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, and Finance around the decisions that matter most—from where to invest and how to win in the market to how success is measured. You will lead annual and long-range planning, develop the market and competitive insights that inform our choices, and turn strategy into focused, coordinated execution across the business.

We are looking for a trusted advisor and hands-on builder—someone who sees around corners, brings structure to ambiguity, and can move fluidly from executive-level strategy to the work required to make it real. The right leader will combine sharp business judgment, analytical depth, and strong influence with the energy to build what does not yet exist.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as a strategic advisor to product and business leadership, providing analysis and recommendations on priorities, investment choices, operating tradeoffs, and execution plans
  • Own the business unit’s annual and long-range planning and financial modeling, including forecasting, annual operating plans, OKRs, budget, and headcount in partnership with Finance
  • Develop outside-in perspectives on the employee experience and enterprise AI markets, including market sizing, growth drivers, customer trends, and competitive dynamics
  • Translate complex, ambiguous business questions into structured analyses, clear recommendations, and executable plans
  • Own the business unit’s planning and operating cadences, business reviews, and executive reporting to create visibility, accountability, and alignment across leadership
  • Define the KPIs, targets, dashboards, and performance frameworks used to assess business health, growth, and execution
  • Partner with and influence Sales, Marketing, Product, and Finance on go-to-market strategy, providing analysis and recommendations on pricing and packaging, sales plays, and growth opportunities
  • Identify operating gaps and design scalable processes, decision mechanisms, and systems that improve execution velocity and organizational effectiveness
  • Partner on high-priority cross-functional initiatives from problem definition through implementation, influencing clear ownership, milestones, risk management, and measurable outcomes
  • Build the first version when needed—developing analyses, tools, processes, and operating mechanisms before scaling them through the organization

To be successful in this role you have:

  • 10–12+ years of overall experience, including either 2+ years of management consulting experience combined with 4+ years of product strategy experience at a SaaS or AI company, or 6+ years of product strategy experience at a SaaS or AI company
  • Demonstrated ownership of complex business planning, operating rhythms, and cross-functional initiatives with measurable results
  • Strong strategic and analytical judgment, including the ability to develop hypotheses, build structured analyses, interpret data, and translate findings into decisions; hands-on financial modeling capability, with the ability to create models and review and challenge analyst output
  • Experience partnering with senior executives and influencing across Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, and Finance in a matrixed organization
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex topics and create clear executive-level narratives
  • A hands-on, outcome-oriented approach and a track record of building practical solutions in ambiguous, fast-moving environments
  • Experience with go-to-market strategy and pricing and packaging is preferred

title: Hub Supervisor
description:
In een notendop

Ben jij een duizendpoot, een meester in het houden van overzicht en raak je enthousiast van het helpen van je collega's? Dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou! Als Hub Supervisor bij Picnic zorg je samen met de Hub Lead voor een soepele dagelijkse operatie, met als einddoel dat onze klanten hun boodschappen veilig en met de hoogste servicekwaliteit ontvangen.   • Procescoördinatie: Je coördineert de dagelijkse processen zodat we een soepele en veilige operatie kunnen draaien.

  • Administratieve ondersteuning: Je ondersteunt bij administratieve taken, zodat Runners goed hun werk kunnen doen.

Over jou

Op de Hub zorgen we voor lunch, koffie, snacks en fruit zodat je energie op peil blijft!

En verder

title: Lead, Affiliate Partner Programs
description:
About Us

Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting & Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally.

About the Company

Fanatics Collectibles is a new company operating at the intersection of collectibles, culture, and technology. Backed by world-class investors, operators, and sports & entertainment partners, we are building the global leader in next-generation collectibles. As part of the broader Fanatics ecosystem, we leverage a digital sports platform that spans over 900 sports properties and engages more than 81 million fans. Together, we are reimagining every part of the collectibles experience for fans, partners, and creators.

Role Summary

The affiliate and partner program at Fanatics Collect is one of the highest-leverage acquisition channels in the business — and it is significantly underdeveloped relative to its potential. As Lead, Affiliate & Partner Programs, you will own the end-to-end affiliate ecosystem across Fanatics Collect and Topps.com: program architecture, commission design, tracking infrastructure, partner recruitment, and performance optimization.

This role is built for a rigorous, analytically-driven operator who brings genuine depth in affiliate program mechanics — someone who understands the difference between a program that looks productive and one that actually drives incremental revenue. You will own the infrastructure, set the standards, and build the systems that make the partner channel a durable growth engine.

You will also serve as the program architecture partner for creator partnerships — contributing commission design thinking, performance frameworks, and deal structure expertise to the broader creator ecosystem as it scales.

Key Responsibilities

Affiliate Program Ownership

  • Define and own the affiliate program strategy across Fanatics Collect and Topps.com, including program structure, partner mix, commission models, and growth roadmap
  • Recruit, onboard, and manage a portfolio of affiliate and brand partners — from content publishers and media brands to hobby-adjacent platforms, loyalty partners, and cashback networks
  • Design and evolve tiered incentive structures, rev share models, promotional frameworks, and activation calendars to maximize incremental new buyer acquisition
  • Own affiliate tracking infrastructure and attribution systems (Impact.com and related tools), ensuring data integrity, reporting accuracy, and fast resolution of any tracking disruptions

Partner Recruitment & Activation

  • Build and maintain a high-performing partner pipeline — from outbound prospecting through signed agreement and active production
  • Develop activation playbooks that go beyond link placement: content angles, promotional hooks, and audience-specific offers that actually convert
  • Identify and prioritize partners by revenue density, not partner count — recruit with quality in mind and cut the bottom tier ruthlessly
  • Manage relationships with hobby-adjacent platforms including CollX, PSA, Sports Card Investor, Collectr, and Sports Card Pro, deepening integrations over time

Performance & Measurement

  • Own performance outcomes across the affiliate channel including new user acquisition, GMV influence, affiliate revenue, and channel ROI
  • Establish KPIs, dashboards, and reporting frameworks — including incrementality measurement and revenue-per-partner tracking — to drive data-informed investment decisions
  • Partner with Analytics and Growth to understand cohort LTV, CAC by partner tier, and attribution across the full funnel
  • Proactively identify and resolve tracking disruptions, attribution gaps, and program inefficiencies in partnership with engineering

Program Architecture for Creator Partnerships

  • Serve as the commission design and deal structure partner for the creator partnerships function — contributing performance-based incentive frameworks, milestone structures, and rev share models
  • Ensure consistency and integrity across affiliate and creator compensation structures so the program operates as a coherent system
  • Support the development of promo code attribution, partner-visible tracking dashboards, and acquisition mechanics as the technical infrastructure matures

Cross-Functional Influence

  • Partner closely with Growth, Product, Marketing, and Analytics to align affiliate and partner strategy with the product roadmap and campaign calendar
  • Influence development of partner-facing tools, monetization features, and platform capabilities that improve the partner experience and program economics
  • Oversee contract strategy and negotiation in partnership with legal and business stakeholders
  • Act as the internal subject-matter expert on affiliate marketing, program economics, and partner channel best practices

Qualifications

  • 5–8+ years of experience in affiliate marketing, partner programs, or performance marketing within e-commerce, marketplaces, or digital platforms
  • Proven track record of building and scaling affiliate programs with measurable acquisition and revenue impact
  • Deep experience designing performance-based structures — commission models, tiered incentives, rev share formulas, holdback mechanisms, and fraud controls
  • Hands-on experience with affiliate platforms (Impact.com strongly preferred) and comfort owning tracking, attribution, and reporting infrastructure
  • Strong analytical skills with fluency in attribution models, incrementality measurement, revenue-per-partner analysis, and funnel diagnostics
  • A genuine understanding of program quality over quantity — optimizing for revenue density, activation rate, and partner cohort value rather than raw partner count
  • Demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders and senior leadership with data-backed business cases
  • Strong communication and negotiation skills, with experience managing partner relationships across publishers, media brands, and platform partners

Preferred

  • Experience in sports, gaming, collectibles, or other passion-driven verticals where community trust and authenticity drive partner performance
  • Familiarity with the sports card, TCG, or hobby creator ecosystem
  • Background in or exposure to live commerce, marketplace platforms, or creator-affiliate hybrid programs
  • Experience managing compliance infrastructure across a large affiliate partner base

title: Internal Tools Engineer
description:
About Us

We are a stealth-stage fund and tech startup operating at the intersection of alternative markets and quantitative strategy. Backed by experienced operators and growing quickly, we are building the infrastructure to scale a high-performance, data-driven business.

We are a lean team with outsized ambition. Almost everything we do runs on software we built ourselves, and the pace of the business is now set by how good that software is.

The Role

You will own our internal platform. It is what our operations, finance and delivery teams work in every day: the systems that move money, track work, sync communications, and tell us what is actually happening in the business.

One person built most of it. You are taking it over, making it something the company can depend on rather than something one person holds in their head, and then extending it.

This is not a product engineering job with a designer, a product manager and a groomed backlog. You will sit with the people doing the work, find the thing costing them the most hours, and go fix it. Judgment about what to build matters more here than depth in any particular stack.

What You'll Do

Take over what exists. Learn the running systems, document them properly, and get them to a state where they are not dependent on any single person, including you.

Give the business its numbers. Several of the things leadership most needs to see are not currently visible anywhere. You will build the data capture and reporting that changes that, starting from agreed definitions rather than a blank dashboard.

Turn spreadsheets into systems. A lot of important work still lives in shared sheets with no state, no ownership and no history. You will move it into the platform, one workflow at a time.

Find the constraint and remove it. There is far more to build than one person can build. The job is choosing correctly, repeatedly, and being able to explain the choice.

Be the person who says where things stand. Short weekly written updates, honest dates, early warnings when something is going to slip. Leadership should never have to ask.

Work directly with the founder. No layers.

Requirements

  • You have been the engineer an operations team depended on. Ideally you were early at a startup and built the internal systems the company ran on.
  • You are a strong writer. You can explain a technical tradeoff to a non-technical reader in a paragraph, and your status updates are short, specific and on time.
  • You are operations-minded before you are engineering-minded. You would rather ship the boring fix that saves ten hours a week than the elegant one that saves none.
  • You have real range: application development, integrations between third-party tools, data modelling, and enough infrastructure to keep your own work running.
  • You are effective with AI tooling and use it to move at a multiple of normal pace.
  • You are genuinely autonomous and reliable when remote. You set your own priorities, you follow through, and you flag problems before they land on someone else.
  • You handle sensitive data and money-adjacent workflows with discretion and care.

Bonus Points For

  • Having inherited an undocumented system from a departing engineer and made it dependable
  • Operations-heavy businesses: logistics, field services, fintech onboarding, marketplaces, anything with physical or financial workflows
  • Payments, reconciliation, or multi-account financial tooling
  • Familiarity with Notion, Discord, Google Workspace, Airtable, and lightweight project management tools
  • Interest in startups, investing, alternative markets, or behavioral strategy

Benefits

  • Own an entire function from day one, working directly with a high-caliber founder
  • No red tape. You propose an improvement and you ship it
  • Shape how a fast-growing company is built from the ground up
  • Competitive compensation based on experience
  • Fully remote with flexible hours

title: DevOps Engineer - Contract
description:
DevOps Engineer

12 months contract

India, Remote

Growth through diversity, equity, and inclusion. As an ethical business, we do what is right — including ensuring equal opportunities and fostering a safe, respectful workplace for each of us. We believe diversity fuels both personal and business growth. We're committed to building an inclusive community where all our people thrive regardless of their backgrounds, identities, or other personal characteristics.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Platform Design, Development & Evolution: Architect, build, and continuously evolve the core M&O platform and services, leveraging modern technologies and best practices to provide comprehensive observability and data quality functions.
  • Ensuring System Reliability & Performance: Actively maintain and enhance the stability, availability, and performance of critical applications and data infrastructure by integrating Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) principles directly into the platform's design and operation.
  • Proactive Issue Detection & Resolution: Develop and integrate intelligent systems within the platform to proactively identify, diagnose, and trigger automated or semi-automated resolution for technical issues, performance bottlenecks, and anomalies across all operational and data systems.
  • Advanced Data Quality Platform Implementation: Build and integrate capabilities within the M&O platform for continuously measuring, monitoring, and reporting on all critical data quality dimensions (Timeliness, Consistency, Completeness, Accuracy, Validity, Uniqueness) across diverse supply chain pipelines, including Warehousing, Transformation, SAP, Manufacturing, and other critical data sources.
  • Centralized Insights & Dashboarding: Develop and manage a unified dashboarding interface (e.g., Grafana, Power BI, Databricks) within the platform to visualize key performance indicators, system health, operational metrics, financial insights (FinOps), and granular data quality metrics for various stakeholders.
  • Automating Infrastructure & Operations: Drive the platform's automation capabilities through Infrastructure as Code (IaC), Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) pipelines, and extensive scripting (Python, Shell) for provisioning, deployment, and operational workflows.
  • Managing Core Data & Cloud Technologies: Integrate and optimize essential technologies like Fivetran, AKS, Kafka, Azure SQL Server, Databricks, and Flink into the M&O platform, ensuring seamless operation and data flow within the Azure cloud environment.
  • Optimizing Cloud Resources & Costs: Embed FinOps practices and reporting into the platform to monitor cloud resource utilization and spending, identifying opportunities for cost reduction and ensuring efficient allocation of infrastructure investments.
  • Fostering a Culture of Continuous Improvement: Leverage platform data and SRE practices to continuously analyze operational incidents, performance trends, and data quality issues, driving ongoing enhancements to both the platform and the systems it monitors.
  • Enabling Data-Driven Decision Making & Compliance: Ensure the M&O platform provides accurate, timely data and insights, derived from both monitoring and high-quality data across all domains, to support informed business decisions, while also guaranteeing compliance with regulatory requirements for data integrity and auditability.

What We’re Looking For:

  • 5+ years of experience in DevOps, Cloud Engineering, or a similar role.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure and cloud infrastructure.
  • Experience with Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) and containerized environments.
  • Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines and Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
  • Strong scripting and automation skills using Python and Shell scripting.
  • Experience with Grafana, Prometheus, and observability and monitoring solutions.
  • Strong understanding and practical experience with Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) principles.
  • Experience with Kafka, Azure SQL Server, Databricks, Flink, and Fivetran.
  • Experience with infrastructure automation, system monitoring, performance optimization, and incident management.

title: Product Manager
description:
Product Manager

Product Manager

Blip is a leading tech company focused on software engineering solutions for sports entertainment.

We operate at scale. As part of Flutter Entertainment, we play an essential role in the Group's goal of becoming the global leader in online sports betting and iGaming, developing innovative products and platforms for over 14 million monthly customers worldwide.

We are serious about Tech. We are problem-solvers with big ambitions, keeping a people-first mindset at the core of our work. We prioritize flexibility as we strive to deliver the best technological products and tackle the greatest industry challenges.

Recognizing that everyone brings their own strengths, backgrounds and new perspectives, we empower you to be yourself. That uniqueness shapes the culture of belonging we are so proud of.

The role

As a Product Manager for Sports Operational Excellence, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the core systems and capabilities that power FanDuel's global sports betting experience. This platform processes millions of transactions across major sporting events, serving as the backbone for all customer-facing betting products.
In this role, you will work closely with cross-functional product development teams to evolve the foundational services, APIs, and workflows that keep the platform reliable, observable, and safe to change at scale. description:
POSITION PURPOSE

Direct and organize the Food & Beverage functions within the outlets of the resort in order to maintain high standards of food and beverage quality, service, and merchandising to maximize profits. Ensure a positive guest experience, taking ownership of situations and following up on every request.

ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Plan and direct the functions of the F&B Outlets to meet the daily operation needs.
  • Responsible for short and long term planning of all outlets including Restaurant, Bar, and In-Room Dining.
  • Monitor industry trends, take appropriate action to maintain a competitive and profitable operation, including updating beverage lists and menu items as necessary.
  • Prepare the F&B budget and monitor department performance accordingly
  • Maintain consistent communication with vendors and suppliers for timely rollout of seasonal food options.
  • Participate in department monthly/quarterly/annual inventories; prepare and submit inventory reports to accounting in a timely manner.
  • Develop and implement creative strategies for revenue enhancement and cost containment.
  • Develop, implement, and monitor schedules for the operation of restaurants, bars and in room dining teams to achieve profitable results.
  • Collaborate with the culinary team, in the creation menus designed to attract a predetermined customer market.
  • Consult with the Sales Manager and banquets team on an ongoing basis, as well as with other departments as necessary.
  • Manage the payroll and time & attendance for the F&B staff.
  • Implement effective control of food, beverage and labor costs among departments.
  • Establish and achieve predetermined profit objectives and desired quality standards of food, service, cleanliness, merchandising and promotion.
  • Conduct orders of food and beverage supplies.
  • Stay up to date on brand requirements and changes to the restaurant.
  • Responsible for maintaining quality of food product and ensuring consistency in food delivery and standards.
  • Ensure attendance at all mandatory meetings.
  • Lead and coach the team towards achieving exceptional guest service and staff satisfaction results.
  • Responsible for maintaining high energy, positive attitude, and professional appearance.
  • Regularly review and evaluate the degree of customer acceptance of the restaurant and bar. Recommend to management new operating and marketing policies whenever declining or constant sales imply dissatisfaction by the customers, a material change in the make-up of the customer market, or a change in the competitive environment.
  • Continuously evaluate the performance and encourage improvement of the staff members in the food and beverage department.
  • Arrange, provide, and supervise training of new staff members to include familiarization of property, standard operating procedures, and policies. Cross-train staff members in all positions within their area of responsibility and all types of equipment to perform their duties, in addition to successful implementation and follow-up checklists. Ensure that all staff members are retrained as needed.

SUPPORTIVE FUNCTIONS

SPECIFIC JOB KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES

The individual must possess the following knowledge, skills and abilities and be able to explain and demonstrate that he or she can perform the essential functions of the job, with or without reasonable accommodation, using some other combination of knowledge, skills, and abilities:

  • Thorough knowledge of federal, state and local laws governing equal employment opportunity and civil rights, occupational safety and health, wage and hour issues, and labor relations, including, but not limited to the following statutes and their state and local analogues (where applicable): Title VII, ADEA, Equal Pay Act, Pregnancy Discrimination Act, FLSA, ADA, OSHA, FMLA, and NLRA.

EXPERIENCE

EXEMPT POSITION

Exempt Staff Members are not covered by the overtime provisions and do not receive overtime pay. Exempt Staff members are paid a fixed salary that is intended to cover all the compensation to which they are entitled.

GROOMING

ATTENDANCE

Regular attendance in conformance with the standards, which may be established by Azul Hospitality, from time to time, is essential to the successful performance of this position. In addition, attendance at all scheduled training sessions and meetings is required. title: Head of Hardware Engineering - Onsite in Albuquerque, NM
description:
About Roadrunner Venture Studios

Roadrunner Venture Studios is the nation's leading platform for founding breakthrough ventures in frontier technology. We partner with scientists, engineers, and entrepreneurs to turn deep technology into real companies. Our work spans energy, manufacturing, semiconductors, quantum computing, aerospace, advanced materials, artificial intelligence, and high performance computing.

About the Role

Roadrunner Venture Studios is recruiting a Head of Hardware Engineering for a portfolio company developing rainfall enhancement technology.

You will lead the deployment system from architecture and prototyping through operational qualification and production-scale manufacturing.

You will apply aerospace rigor to industrial hardware that must operate reliably in the field and support repeatable manufacturing at automotive scale. The work spans mechanical, thermal, combustion, fluid, structural, controls, and instrumentation systems.

This is a hands-on role. You will work with internal science and field teams and lead external engineering firms, fabricators, suppliers, and manufacturing partners.

This role includes significant equity.

This is an early-stage startup building something that has not been built before. Priorities will change quickly. If this working environment does not excite you, this role is probably not for you.

What You Will Do

Technical Leadership

  • System Architecture: Own requirements and architecture across mechanical, thermal, combustion, structural, fluid, gas-handling, controls, and instrumentation systems.

  • Hardware Development: Lead the system from early design through prototypes, integrated builds, field-ready hardware, and production planning.

  • Combustion and Thermal Systems: Lead the design and qualification of combustion hardware, fuel and gas handling, flow and pressure systems, and thermal management.

  • Qualification and Field Operations: Define verification methods and lead shop tests, integrated system tests, field qualification, troubleshooting, and failure reviews.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or higher in mechanical engineering, aerospace engineering, systems engineering, or a related field.

  • Experience leading complex hardware from concept through prototype builds, operational qualification, and production planning.

  • High proficiency with computer aided design software such as SolidWorks or NX and product lifecycle management systems.

  • Experience with engineering release processes, configuration control, drawings, bills of materials, and supplier documentation.

  • Experience with design for manufacturing and assembly for industrial, aerospace, automotive, robotics, energy, or other complex hardware.

  • Experience with combustion hardware, thermal systems, fluid systems, gas handling, pressure systems, large field equipment, or power systems.

  • Experience managing engineering firms, fabrication shops, suppliers, contract manufacturers, or engineering, procurement, and construction partners.

  • Experience with computational fluid dynamics (CFD), especially for combustion, heat transfer, fluid flow, or gas-handling systems.

  • Experience taking hardware from prototype builds into first-article or low-rate production.

  • Experience with aerospace, defense, energy, automotive, robotics, or other high-reliability hardware programs.

Location
