title: AI Research Engineer: Vision AI / VLM / Physical AI-1
description:
About Centific

Centific is a frontier AI data foundry that curates diverse, high-quality data, using our purpose-built technology platforms to empower the Magnificent Seven and our enterprise clients with safe, scalable AI deployment. Our team includes more than 150 PhDs and data scientists, along with more than 4,000 AI practitioners and engineers. We harness the power of an integrated solution ecosystem—comprising industry-leading partnerships and 1.8 million vertical domain experts in more than 230 markets—to create contextual, multilingual, pre-trained datasets; fine-tuned, industry-specific LLMs; and RAG pipelines supported by vector databases. Our zero-distance innovation™ solutions for GenAI can reduce GenAI costs by up to 80% and bring solutions to market 50% faster.

Our mission is to bridge the gap between AI creators and industry leaders by bringing best practices in GenAI to unicorn innovators and enterprise customers. We aim to help these organizations unlock significant business value by deploying GenAI at scale, helping to ensure they stay at the forefront of technological advancement and maintain a competitive edge in their respective markets.

About Job

AI Research Engineer: Vision AI / VLM / Physical AI

Company: Centific

Location: Seattle, WA (or Remote)

Type: Full‑time

Build the Future of Perception & Embodied Intelligence

Are you pushing the frontier of computer vision, multimodal large models, and embodied/physical AI—and have the publications to show it? Join us to translate cutting-edge‑ research into production systems that perceive, reason, and act in the real world.

The Mission

We are building state of‑ t‑heart Vision AI across 2D/3D perception, egocentric/360° understanding, and multimodal reasoning. As an AI Research Engineer, you will own high‑ ‑leverage experiments from paper → prototype → deployable module in our platform.

We are seeking passionate Engineersto join our cutting-edge labs, you could be part of :

Computer Vision team as a Research Engineer and dive into the world of 3D reconstruction, scene understanding, and visual AI. You’ll explore innovative techniques like those used to transform real-world spaces into immersive 3D models—such as the 3D Reconstruction projects —and work with cutting-edge architectures like VGG-T (Visual Geometry Grounded Transformers), known for advancing deep learning in vision tasks. This role is perfect for those excited to develop AI systems that interpret, reconstruct, and interact with the visual world, using state-of-the-art tools and methodologies. Physical AI Robotics team, where you’ll work at the intersection of simulation, robotics, and AI. You’ll leverage NVIDIA’s Omniverse for advanced 3D simulation and collaboration, Isaac Sim for robotics training and testing, and GR00T for foundation models in robotics. Experience with Holoscan SDK for real-time medical and industrial robotics pipelines, Newton Physics for dynamic simulation, and NVIDIA’s NERD for neural robot dynamics will be a plus. This role is ideal for those eager to push the boundaries of AI-driven robotics using state-of-the-art tools and frameworks.

What You’ll Do

  • Advance Visual Perception: Build and fine‑tune models for detection, tracking, segmentation (2D/3D), pose & activity recognition, and scene understanding (incl. 360° and multi‑view).
  • Multimodal Reasoning with VLMs: Train/evaluate vision–language models (VLMs) for grounding, dense captioning, temporal QA, and tooluse; design retrieval‑ augmented and agentic loops for perception‑ action‑ tasks.
  • Physical AI & Embodiment: Prototype perception‑in‑the‑loop policies that close the gap from pixels to actions (simulation + real data). Integrate with planners and task graphs for manipulation, navigation, or safety workflows.
  • Data & Evaluation at Scale: Curate datasets, author high‑signal evaluation protocols/KPIs, and run ablations that make results irreproducible impossible.
  • Systems & Deployment: Package research into reliable services on a modern stack (Kubernetes, Docker, Ray, FastAPI), with profiling, telemetry, and CI for reproducible science.
  • Agentic Workflows: Orchestrate multi-agent pipelines (e.g., ‑LangGraphstyle graphs) that combine perception, reasoning, simulation, and ‑codeg eneration to ‑selfc heck and ‑selfcorrect‑.

Example Problems You Might Tackle

  • Long horizon‑ video understanding (events, activities, causality) from egocentric or 360° video.
  • 3D scene grounding: linking language queries to objects, affordances, and trajectories.
  • Fast, privacy preserving perception for ‑ondevice‑ or edge inference.
  • Robust multi‑modal evaluation: temporal consistency, open‑set detection, uncertainty.
  • Vision conditioned‑ policy evaluation in sim (Isaac/MuJoCo) with sim2real stress tests.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Masters/Ph.D in CS/EE/Robotics (or related), actively publishing in CV/ML/Robotics (e.g., CVPR/ICCV/ECCV, NeurIPS/ICML/ICLR, CoRL/RSS).
  • Strong PyTorch (or JAX) and Python; comfort with CUDA profiling and mixed precision‑ training.
  • Demonstrated research in computer vision and at least one of: VLMs (e.g., LLaVA style, video‑ language‑ models), embodied/physical AI, 3D perception.
  • Proven ability to move from paper → code → ablation → result with rigorous experiment tracking.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with video models (e.g., TimeSFormer/MViT/VideoMAE), diffusion or 3D GS/NeRF pipelines, or SLAM/scene reconstruction.
  • Prior work on multimodal grounding (referring expressions, spatial language, affordances) or temporal reasoning.
  • Familiarity with ROS2, DeepStream/TAO, or edge inference optimizations (TensorRT, ONNX).
  • Scalable training: Ray, distributed data loaders, sharded checkpoints.
  • Strong software craft: testing, linting, profiling, containers, and reproducibility.
  • Public code artifacts (GitHub) and first‑author publications or strong open source‑ impact.

Our Stack (you’ll touch a subset)

  • Modeling: PyTorch, torchvision/lightning, Hugging Face, OpenMMLab, xFormers
  • Perception: YOLO/Detectron/MMDet, SAM/Mask2Former, CLIP‑style backbones, optical flow
  • VLM / LLM: Vision encoders + LLMs, RAG for video, toolformer‑/agent loops
  • 3D / Sim: Open3D, PyTorch3D, Isaac/MuJoCo, COLMAP/SLAM, NeRF/3DGS
  • Systems: Python, FastAPI, Ray, Kubernetes, Docker, Triton/TensorRT, Weights & Biases
  • Pipelines: LangGraph‑like orchestration, data versioning, artifact stores

What Success Looks Like

  • A publishable or open‑sourced outcome (with company approval) or a production‑ready module that measurably moves a product KPI (latency, accuracy, robustness).
  • Clean, reproducible code with documented ablations and an evaluation report that a teammate can rerun end‑to‑end.
  • A demo that clearly communicates capabilities, limits, and next steps.

Why Centific

  • Real impact: Your research ships—powering core features in our MVPs and products.
  • Mentorship: Work closely with our Principal Architect and senior engineers/researchers.
  • Velocity + Rigor: We balance top‑tier research practices with pragmatic product focus.

Salary: $180,000-$240,000 + OTB

Centific is an equal-opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, age, mental or physical disability, medical condition, sex (including pregnancy), gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, marital status, familial status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

title: Program Manager - Assistant Manager - Lending Collection
description:
About Us: Paytm is India's leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. Pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce. Paytm’s mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology.

Role Overview
We are looking for a high-ownership Project/Program Manager to lead AI-led transformation initiatives across the Lending Collections ecosystem.
This role sits at the intersection of Business, Product, Technology, Data, and AI. The ideal candidate should be equally comfortable understanding a business problem, translating it into a structured product/technology requirement, driving engineering execution, and taking the initiative all the way to production and measurable business impact.
This is not a traditional project-management role. We are looking for someone who can own the problem statement, bring structure to ambiguity, drive stakeholders, and turn AI opportunities into production-grade solutions.

Key Responsibilities
1. Business Requirement & Problem Discovery
Work closely with Business and Collections stakeholders to identify operational pain points, automation opportunities, and AI use cases.
Conduct requirement-gathering workshops and translate business needs into clear, actionable requirements.
Challenge requirements where necessary and bring structure to ambiguous problem statements.
Understand lending collections journeys, customer touchpoints, workflows, operational processes, and relevant business metrics.
2. BRD, Workflow & Solution Documentation
Create and maintain detailed BRDs, functional requirements, user stories, process flows, workflows, and solution documentation.
Define end-to-end process journeys, including inputs, outputs, decisioning logic, exceptions, dependencies, and integrations.
Convert business requirements into granular user stories with clear acceptance criteria.
Ensure documentation remains aligned with the evolving product and technology solution.
3. AI & Automation Program Management
Identify and evaluate opportunities to leverage Generative AI, Agentic AI, AI automation, LLMs, and intelligent workflows within lending collections.
Work with AI/Tech teams to translate business use cases into viable AI solutions.
Understand the capabilities and limitations of AI technologies and challenge proposed solutions constructively.
Drive AI initiatives from ideation → requirement → solutioning → development → testing → deployment → adoption → measurement.
Track business outcomes and ensure AI initiatives deliver measurable improvements in productivity, collections, customer experience, or operational efficiency.
4. Technology & Engineering Collaboration
Act as the bridge between Business/Product and Engineering.
Clearly communicate the “what” and “why” behind requirements to technology teams.
Break complex requirements into executable user stories and development milestones.
Work closely with Engineering, Data, AI/ML, QA, and other technology teams to resolve dependencies and blockers.
Ensure the technology team has sufficient clarity to execute without repeated requirement ambiguity.
Participate actively in solution discussions, technical walkthroughs, testing, UAT, and production readiness.
5. Program Governance & Execution
Own project/program trackers and maintain complete visibility on milestones, dependencies, risks, issues, owners, and timelines.
Drive regular governance forums and stakeholder reviews.
Proactively identify risks and unblock teams rather than waiting for escalations.
Manage cross-functional dependencies across Business, Product, Technology, Data, Operations, and external partners.
Drive initiatives firmly towards closure, adoption, and business outcomes.
6. Data & Analytics
Should be comfortable using SQL to independently fetch, analyse, and validate data required for product and business decisions.
Work with Data/Analytics teams to define data requirements and validate outputs.
Use data to size opportunities, validate assumptions, monitor performance, and measure the impact of AI initiatives.
Ability to translate data insights into actionable product/program decisions.

Must-Have Skills
Project / Program Management experience, preferably in FinTech, Lending, Banking, Collections, or Financial Services.
Strong understanding of lending and collections processes.
Excellent requirement-gathering and stakeholder-management skills.
Strong capability to create BRDs, FRDs, workflows, process maps, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
Proven ability to drive Technology/Engineering teams and manage delivery end-to-end.
Hands-on proficiency with JIRA for backlog, sprint, issue, and project management.
Working knowledge of Figma for reviewing/contributing to product flows, wireframes, and user journeys.
Strong understanding of AI/GenAI/LLMs/Agentic AI and automation use cases.
Working proficiency in SQL for data extraction and analysis.
Strong analytical and problem-solving ability.
Excellent written and verbal communication.
High ownership, strong execution bias, and the ability to operate effectively in ambiguity.

Good-to-Have
Experience working on AI agents, conversational AI, LLM-powered workflows, RAG, AI copilots, or intelligent automation.
Experience integrating AI solutions with existing enterprise systems/APIs.
Understanding of collections technology platforms, dialers, CRM, payment systems, customer communication platforms, or workflow engines.
Exposure to Agile/Scrum methodologies.
Experience managing multiple concurrent AI/product initiatives.
Familiarity with AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Copilot, or equivalent enterprise AI platforms.
Experience defining AI success metrics, evaluation frameworks, and operational KPIs.

What Success Looks Like
Within this role, the candidate should be able to take a statement such as:
“Can we use AI to improve this part of the collections journey?”
…and independently drive it through:
Business problem → Opportunity sizing → Requirement discovery → BRD → Workflow → AI solution definition → User stories → Tech execution → Testing/UAT → Production → Adoption → Business impact.
The right candidate will be someone who doesn't merely maintain a tracker—they own the outcome.
Experience
3-4 years of relevant experience in Project/Program Management, Product Management, Business Analysis, or Technology Program Management, with meaningful exposure to FinTech/Lending/Collections and AI/Automation.
Education
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Technology, Business, Finance, or a related discipline. MBA/PGDM is a plus.

Why Join Us:
1. A collaborative output driven program that brings cohesiveness across businesses through technology

4. Respect, that is earned, not demanded from your peers and manager

With enviable 500 mn+ registered users, 21 mn+ merchants and depth of data in our ecosystem, we are in a unique position to democratize credit for deserving consumers & merchants – and we are committed to it. India’s largest digital lending story is brewing here. It’s your opportunity to be a part of the story!

title: Senior Java Developer
description:
We are seeking Intermediate to Senior Java Developers to join a highly technical front-office development team supporting Financial Markets activities.

This is a hands-on development role for engineers who can design, build and implement scalable applications and systems. The team values developers who understand how systems work end to end, participate in design discussions and take ownership of implementing practical solutions.

The team operates with a startup-style culture within a major financial institution. Candidates from smaller organizations or startups are particularly welcome. Developers from larger enterprises will also be considered if they demonstrate substantial hands-on technical ownership.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain Java applications supporting Financial Markets trading activities.
  • Design and build scalable, robust and maintainable solutions.
  • Participate in system design discussions and implement technical solutions.
  • Support applications across multiple asset classes and business functions, including:
  • e-Trading, Equity, FX and Fixed Income
  • Structured Products Pricing and Risk
  • CVA, XVA and PFE
  • Equity Swaps and Delta One
  • Regulatory Reporting and Operations
  • Understand existing applications, processes and development practices.
  • Prepare technical documentation supporting deployment and application support.
  • Contribute to quantitative development for Front Office and Market Risk, depending on qualifications.
  • Investigate problems and develop solutions with incomplete or evolving requirements.
  • Collaborate with quantitative specialists and other developers.
  • Identify opportunities to improve existing applications and processes.

Required Technical Skills and Experience

  • Demonstrated ability to construct and implement applications and systems.
  • Understanding of software design and scalable application development.
  • Experience participating in system design discussions.
  • Strong debugging, analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Experience with Linux environments and some Windows exposure.

Ideal Candidate Profile

  • A genuinely hands-on Java developer who writes code regularly.
  • Experience building scalable applications and understanding how system components work together.
  • Ability to participate in design discussions and personally implement solutions.
  • Experience in a startup or smaller organization with meaningful technical ownership, or similar initiative demonstrated in a larger enterprise.
  • Comfortable working independently with limited requirements.
  • Genuine interest in Financial Markets and learning the underlying business.
  • Interest in developing long-term expertise within the team.
  • Financial Markets experience is helpful but not mandatory. Approximately five years of experience in a Canadian work context is preferred. Candidates with less experience may be considered if they come from a startup environment with strong mentorship and demonstrate the necessary technical capability.

The current codebase primarily uses Java 24/25, with Java 8 used for specific Excel add-in applications. Experience with a particular Java version is not a hard screening requirement; strong core Java fundamentals and adaptability are more important.

The team is not focused on low-latency or high-frequency trading systems, although application responsiveness to user requests is important.

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
Circle (NYSE: CRCL) is one of the world’s leading internet financial platform companies, building the foundation of a more open, global economy through digital assets, payment applications, and programmable blockchain infrastructure. Circle’s platform includes the world’s largest regulated stablecoin network anchored by USDC, Circle Payments Network for global money movement, and Arc, an enterprise-grade blockchain designed to become the Economic OS for the internet. Enterprises, financial institutions, and developers use Circle to power trusted, internet-scale financial innovation. Learn more at .

What you’ll be part of:

Circle is committed to visibility and stability in everything we do. As we grow as an organization, we're expanding into some of the world's strongest jurisdictions. Speed and efficiency are motivators for our success and our employees live by our company values: High Integrity, Future Forward, Multistakeholder, Mindful, and Driven by Excellence. We have built a flexible work environment where new ideas are encouraged and everyone is a stakeholder.

What you'll be responsible for

You will own product areas within Managed Payments, Circle’s regulated payments infrastructure that enables PSPs, financial institutions, banks, and enterprises to use stablecoin-powered payment rails without operating crypto infrastructure themselves. You will define and evolve product capabilities that support managed pay-ins, payouts, conversion, and transaction lifecycle management across stablecoin and fiat endpoints. Working closely with Engineering, Compliance, Operations, Treasury, and commercial teams, you will translate complex customer and business needs into clear product priorities, lead cross-functional execution, and deliver measurable improvements to how customers move money across geographies and payment rails.

What you'll work on

  • Own the roadmap for product areas across managed pay-ins, payouts, fiat endpoints, conversion, and transaction lifecycle management, aligning priorities with customer needs and Circle’s goals.

  • Define and launch capabilities that expand Managed Payments across Circle’s regulated hubs, including new entities, corridors, payout methods, and geographic coverage.

  • Shape simple, reliable customer experiences for accepting funds, converting value, and disbursing globally across stablecoin and fiat rails, including integrations with CPN and other Circle systems.

  • Improve customer and operator workflows across onboarding, account setup, transaction visibility, reporting, exception handling, reconciliation, refunds, RFIs, and bulk payments.

  • Use customer, product, payment, and operational data to identify friction, prioritize investments, and measure improvements in reliability, efficiency, adoption, and customer experience.

  • Evaluate opportunities to support new payment rails, payout use cases, and digital assets based on customer demand, regulatory requirements, technical feasibility, and business priorities.

  • Lead complex cross-functional initiatives with Engineering, Compliance, Operations, Legal, Treasury, BD, and Product, navigating technical and business trade-offs and driving alignment from definition through launch.

What you'll bring to Circle

Core requirements

  • 4+ years of relevant experience, including product management experience building payments, fintech, financial infrastructure, or similarly complex B2B products.

  • Experience owning product vision, roadmaps, and execution for B2B capabilities such as payments, pay-ins, payouts, settlement, treasury infrastructure, APIs, or financial operations.

  • Demonstrated ability to independently lead complex cross-functional initiatives spanning Engineering and partners such as Compliance, Operations, Legal, Treasury, or commercial teams.

  • Strong analytical and technical fluency, with experience using customer, product, payment, and operational data to identify opportunities and guide product decisions.

  • Track record of delivering measurable improvements to customer experience, product adoption, operational efficiency, reliability, or business performance.

  • Ability to evaluate technical and business trade-offs, resolve ambiguity, and translate complex requirements into clear product priorities and execution plans.

Preferred requirements

  • Knowledge of cross-border payments, PSP infrastructure, settlement systems, correspondent banking, or other payment network concepts.

  • Familiarity with stablecoins, blockchain-based financial infrastructure, or crypto-enabled payment systems.

  • Experience with enterprise APIs, payment networks, or compliance-forward systems involving payment lifecycle states, reconciliation, exception handling, sanctions screening, RFIs, or SLAs.

Why this role matters

Managed Payments is a core part of Circle’s strategy to make stablecoin-powered payments accessible to businesses beyond crypto-native customers. Customers increasingly need complete payment programs that allow them to accept funds, manage balances, convert across assets, and disburse globally without assembling wallets, banking partners, liquidity providers, compliance systems, and payout networks themselves. As Senior Product Manager, you will help turn that complexity into an integrated customer experience and scale Managed Payments into a reliable, global, enterprise-grade product.

Circle is on a mission to create an inclusive financial future, with transparency at our core. We consider a wide variety of elements when crafting our compensation ranges and total compensation packages.

Starting pay is determined by various factors, including but not limited to: relevant experience, skill set, qualifications, and other business and organizational needs. Please note that compensation ranges may differ for candidates in other locations.

We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status, or any other protected status required by the laws in the locations where we hire. Additionally, Circle participates in the E-Verify Program in certain locations, as required by law.

Should you require accommodations or assistance in our interview process because of a disability, please reach out to accommodations@circle.com for support. We respect your privacy and will connect with you separately from our interview process to accommodate your needs.

title: Summer 2027 Engineering Intern
description:
Engineering Intern

Category: Engineering

Location: Mojave, CA

Citizenship Required: United States Citizenship

Clearance Type: None

Schedule: 9/80 Work Schedule

Benefits: 100% Paid Benefits and 401k Matching

Summary:

Founded by Burt Rutan in 1982, Scaled Composites has been in the business of Designing, Building, and Flying unique airplanes (and occasionally spacecraft) for now over 40 years. We are a modestly sized company, constantly building small teams of empowered and capable employees to achieve extraordinary accomplishments in aerospace. From the farthest (Global Flyer), to the largest (Stratolaunch), to the highest (SpaceShipOne, Proteus), and many in between, Scaled’s track record of innovation has pushed against and expanded some of the most stubborn corners of the flight envelope.

If you have a passion for aviation, solving challenging problems, and pushing the envelope of what’s possible, Scaled is the place for you!

Interns at Scaled will perform meaningful work that will directly contribute to the success of our company. You’ll be mentored by some of the brightest minds in the industry and have opportunities to build connections that can last a lifetime. Our paid internship program will last between 10-12 weeks during the summer of 2027.

We are accepting applications from now until October 16, 2026. Expect to hear back from us in early December once interview candidates have been selected.

title: Product Manager Airspace & Autonomy - DoorDash Air
description:
About the Team

The DoorDash Air team is bringing drone delivery to reality. To make this happen, we’re building a strong electrical team to design high reliability, high power density converters, and fault-tolerant controls electronics. Come join us to build a new class of aircrafts and deploy at scale.

DoorDash Labs, established in 2018, serves as the innovation hub for DoorDash, focusing on developing automation and robotics solutions to enhance last-mile logistics. The team's mission is to create technologies that support and augment human networks, aiming to improve efficiency for Dashers, merchants, and consumers alike. We’re ruthlessly focused on business impact. We are a highly senior team composed of former pioneers from a variety of different robotics industries. As of 2025, DoorDash has completed 10B lifetime deliveries. We’re focused on how to do the next 10B even better.

About the Role

As the Product Manager Airspace & Autonomy for DoorDash Air’s Airspace and Autonomy capabilities, you will own the end-to-end product strategy for the software, services, autonomy, perception, human interfaces and related capabilities required to deploy autonomous drone delivery at scale.

You will connect DoorDash’s order and logistics platform with the aircraft, autonomy stack, mission-planning services, UTM capabilities, fleet-management tools, and operator workflows that execute each delivery. You will define how an order moves from merchant readiness through dispatch, airspace validation, autonomous flight, delivery, and completion within the broader DoorDash marketplace, ensuring that new features align to DoorDash Air’s roadmap across teams while balancing execution timelines against technical debt.

You will lead product direction across autonomy, aviation software, services, hardware, systems engineering, flight operations, UTM, safety, regulatory, data, and DoorDash platform teams. You will work closely with the Head of UTM and senior Engineering and Operations leaders to establish the product roadmap, clarify system boundaries, make build-versus-partner decisions, and align technical investment with operational scale and unit economics. You will also coach and mentor engineers to help them understand how their work contributes to the broader vision and enables safe and scalable drone delivery operations.

This is not a coordination-only role, nor is it purely an internally facing role. You will already have deep credibility in standards development organizations and will promote best practices to help ensure that DoorDash Air’s software, services and hardware meet technical standards required for regulatory compliance in the U.S. and abroad. You will set the vision, establish priorities, make informed technical and product tradeoffs, and hold cross-functional teams accountable for delivering an integrated drone delivery system.

You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…

  • Own the end-to-end product strategy for DoorDash Air’s safety critical software, services and platform infrastructure. Define the long-term vision, platform architecture, capability roadmap, and investment priorities across aircraft, onboard software, cloud services, operational tooling, and DoorDash platform integrations.
  • Integrate drone delivery into the DoorDash marketplace. Define how merchant preparation, order readiness, dispatch timing, routing, customer promises, delivery-zone eligibility, and fulfillment decisions interact with aircraft availability, weather, airspace, and operational constraints.
  • Lead the autonomy product roadmap. Establish priorities across mission planning, autonomous path and motion planning, contingency behaviors, rerouting, detect-and-avoid integration, vehicle health, payload handling, landing and delivery behaviors, and remote assistance.
  • Create the roadmap to progress from 1:1 to m:N operations. Define the incremental technical capabilities required to move from one operator supervising one aircraft toward increasingly autonomous multi-aircraft operations, including exception management, alert prioritization, task allocation, fleet orchestration, remote intervention, and human-autonomy interface design.
  • Define the data strategy for autonomous aviation. Determine which geospatial, terrain, obstacle, weather, airspace, population-risk, connectivity, landing-zone, and operational data layers should be built internally, licensed, sourced through partners, or generated by the fleet.
  • Build UTM and airspace-management capabilities. Lead product requirements for operational-volume generation, strategic and tactical deconfliction, dynamic rerouting, airspace authorization, constraint management, conformance monitoring, and interoperability with UTM service providers and public airspace systems.
  • Lead standards compliance and engagement. Champion compliance with relevant standards — ASTM F3201 (software), F3548 and F3411 (UTM-specific functions) — across the airspace software roadmap and specs. Maintain an active leadership role in ASTM standards-development activities on behalf of DoorDash.
  • Productize regulatory compliance. Translate Part 135 operating requirements, BVLOS approvals, safety cases, operational limitations, and emerging Part 108 concepts into reusable software, data, workflow, auditability, and configuration-management capabilities.
  • Make build, buy, and partner decisions. Evaluate technology providers, data sources, autonomy components, and infrastructure partners based on strategic differentiation, integration complexity, operational risk, economics, and time to market.
  • Define system-level success metrics. Work across the organization to establish instrumentation and KPIs across delivery success, order-to-dispatch time, route efficiency, intervention frequency, operator-to-aircraft ratio, aircraft utilization, mission completion, system availability, regulatory conformance, and cost per delivery.
  • Connect technical investment to business outcomes. Develop business cases and sequencing recommendations that balance safety, customer experience, operational scalability, engineering effort, deployment speed, and long-term unit economics.
  • Shape the technical organization. Identify the product, systems, autonomy, platform, data, hardware, test, and operational capabilities required to achieve the roadmap. Partner with functional leaders to define roles, close talent gaps, and build an organization capable of scaling beyond individual experts.

We’re excited about you because…

  • 10+ years of product management, technical product leadership, systems leadership, or related experience, including significant responsibility for complex software or cyber-physical platforms.
  • 5+ years of experience in autonomous systems, robotics, UAS, aviation technology, safety-critical systems, or another highly regulated real-world operating environment.
  • A demonstrated track record of taking technically complex products from early concept or prototype through validation, deployment, and operational scale.
  • Experience owning products that span multiple layers of a technology stack, including embedded or vehicle software, cloud services, APIs, data infrastructure, operational applications, and hardware integration.
  • Strong technical fluency across autonomous-system concepts such as mission planning, path planning, motion planning, perception, localization, guidance and control, behavior management, contingency handling, simulation, telemetry, and command and control.
  • Experience defining product strategy and architecture for distributed, real-time, or mission-critical systems in which reliability, safety, and operational performance are fundamental product requirements.
  • Working knowledge of UTM, airspace-management systems, geospatial data, flight-planning services, operational volumes, conformance monitoring, and airspace interoperability.
  • Experience operating within or building technology for FAA-regulated environments, including familiarity with any combination of National Airspace System hardware/software/procedures, Part 107, Part 135, Part 108, Part 146, BVLOS operating approvals, UTM or USS services, and evolving autonomous-flight regulations.
  • Experience designing or scaling human-supervised autonomy, remote operations, multi-vehicle systems, fleet orchestration, or m:N operating models.

Compensation

The successful candidate’s starting pay will fall within the pay range listed below and is determined based on job-related factors including, but not limited to, skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions. Base salary is localized according to an employee’s work location. Ranges are market-dependent and may be modified in the future.

In addition to base salary, the compensation for this role includes opportunities for equity grants. Talk to your recruiter for more information.

DoorDash cares about you and your overall well-being. That’s why we offer a comprehensive benefits package to all regular employees, which includes a 401(k) plan with employer matching, 16 weeks of paid parental leave, wellness benefits, commuter benefits match, paid time off and paid sick leave in compliance with applicable laws (e.g. Colorado Healthy Families and Workplaces Act). DoorDash also offers medical, dental, and vision benefits, 11 paid holidays, disability and basic life insurance, family-forming assistance, and a mental health program, among others.

To learn more about our benefits, visit our careers page here.

See below for paid time off details:

  • For salaried roles: flexible paid time off/vacation, plus 80 hours of paid sick time per year.
  • For hourly roles: vacation accrued at about 1 hour for every 25.97 hours worked (e.g. about 6.7 hours/month if working 40 hours/week; about 3.4 hours/month if working 20 hours/week), and paid sick time accrued at 1 hour for every 30 hours worked (e.g. about 5.8 hours/month if working 40 hours/week; about 2.9 hours/month if working 20 hours/week).
The national base pay range for this position within the United States, including Illinois and Colorado.
$193,800—$285,000 USD

About DoorDash

At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.

DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees’ happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks including premium healthcare, wellness expense reimbursement, paid parental leave and more.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

Whether blatant or hidden, barriers to success have no place at DoorDash. We value a diverse workforce – people who identify as women, non-binary or gender non-conforming, LGBTQIA+, American Indian or Native Alaskan, Black or African American, Hispanic or Latinx, Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander, differently-abled, caretakers and parents, and veterans are strongly encouraged to apply. title: Vehicle Inspector (Evening Shift)
description:
About Clutch

We’re on a mission to reinvent the way people buy, sell, and own cars. Are you game?

Clutch is Canada’s largest online used car retailer, delivering a seamless, hassle-free car-buying experience to drivers everywhere. Customers can browse hundreds of cars from the comfort of their home, get the right one delivered to their door, and enjoy peace of mind with our 10-Day Money-Back Guarantee… and that’s just the beginning.

Named five years in a row to the Globe & Mail’s list of the Top Growing Companies in Canada and also awarded spots on Deloitte’s Technology Fast 50™ and Fast 500™ lists, we’re looking to add curious, hard-working, and driven individuals to our growing team.

Headquartered in Toronto, Clutch was founded in 2017 and currently services Ontario, New Brunswick, Nova Scotia, British Columbia, and Prince Edward Island. Clutch is backed by a number of world-class investors, including D1 Capital, Canaan, Real Ventures, BrandProject, and Upper90. To learn more, visit clutch.ca.

About the Role

We are on a mission to build a world-class team that drives innovation, growth, and excellence. As we scale rapidly, we are looking for a Vehicle Inspector (Evening Shift) to join our reconditioning facility team. This role is ideal for someone dependable, customer-focused, and comfortable working in a fast-paced, target-driven environment. Evening availability is required. The shift schedule is Monday to Thursday, 4:30 PM – 3:00 AM, and includes a $1.50 per hour shift premium.

What You’ll Do:

  • Inspect incoming vehicles for damage, cleanliness, and mechanical issues.
  • Identify and report problems that fall outside Clutch’s quality standards.
  • Move, start, and park cars around the lot safely and efficiently.
  • Track inspection results using checklists and digital tools.
  • Collaborate with reconditioning, detailing, and mechanical teams to prioritize vehicle flow.
  • Perform basic troubleshooting for minor vehicle issues.
  • Keep work areas organized and follow all safety procedures.

What We’re Looking For:

  • Education: Post-secondary education preferred
  • Skills: Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and teamwork
  • License: Minimum G2 Driver’s License with a clean driver’s abstract
  • Work Authorization: Legally authorized to work in Canada
  • Location: Ability to commute to Mississauga
  • Availability: Able to commit to a full-time schedule of 40 hours per week, including overtime based on business needs.

It'd be Great if You Have:

  • Previous experience in automotive, logistics, or warehouse operations.
  • Familiarity with Google Sheets or other digital tools.
  • Ability to drive manual transmission vehicles.

Why You’ll Love It at Clutch:

  • Autonomy & Ownership – play a key role in ensuring vehicles meet Clutch’s high standards.
  • Career Growth – opportunities to develop skills in automotive operations.
  • Team Environment – collaborate with passionate colleagues committed to quality and efficiency.
  • Competitive Compensation – hourly wage with overtime opportunities.

Employment Type

  • Existing ,Permanent Full-Time

Compensation & Benefits

Wage: $20.00 + 1.50 Shift Premium

Benefits: Comprehensive healthcare, dental, vision, prescription, life insurance, and dependent coverage starting day one

Pay decisions reflect objective criteria: skills, performance, market benchmarking, responsibilities, and working conditions

Clutch is committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where all individuals have an opportunity to succeed. If you require accommodation at any stage of the interview process, please email talent@clutch.ca.

description:
Vil du omsætte ESG-data til indsigt, fremdrift og reel forandring?

Hos RIIS Group søger vi en analytisk og nysgerrig ESG Data Specialist, der vil være med til at styrke vores arbejde med klima, miljø og ansvarlig virksomhedsdrift. Du får en central rolle i at sikre et solidt data- og beslutningsgrundlag for vores ESG-indsatser og i at omsætte komplekse krav og data til brugbare indsigter og konkrete forbedringer.

Du bliver en del af en international virksomhed i fortsat udvikling og kommer til at arbejde tæt sammen med vores ESG Compliance & Sustainability Manager samt kolleger på tværs af organisationen. Som ESG Data Specialist får du en bred og selvstændig rolle, hvor du både arbejder analytisk med data og koordinerer indsatser på tværs af forretningen. Dine hovedopgaver bliver blandt andet at:

  • Drive og koordinere ESG-relaterede projekter og initiativer i samarbejde med ESG Compliance & Sustainability Manager og relevante afdelinger.
  • Indsamle, strukturere og kvalitetssikre data til klima- og miljøregnskaber i overensstemmelse med GHG-protokollen og øvrige relevante rapporteringskrav.
  • Bidrage til ESG-rapportering i overensstemmelse med VS/VSME samt understøtte den løbende udvikling af rapporteringsprocesser og datakvalitet.
  • Håndtere faste ESG-relaterede rapporterings- og complianceopgaver, herunder rapportering via Data Exchange Platforms, kundeforespørgsler og nye lov- og markedsmæssige krav.
  • Analysere data, identificere sammenhænge og omsætte indsigter til konkrete anbefalinger og forbedringstiltag.

Analytisk profil med blik for både detaljer og helhed

Din uddannelsesbaggrund er ikke afgørende for, om du er kvalificeret til stillingen, men vi forventer, at du har mindst 2-3 års erfaring med ESG. Det vigtigste er, at du har den rette kombination af analytisk sans, nysgerrighed og evnen til at se sammenhænge og skabe fremdrift. Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har erfaring med klimaregnskaber efter GHG-protokollen, ESG-rapportering efter VSME og generelt arbejde med ESG- og bæredygtighedsdata.
  • Har forståelse for ESG-krav, transparens og de forretningsmæssige perspektiver, der følger med rapporteringen.
  • Arbejder struktureret, selvstændigt og detaljeorienteret med fokus på datakvalitet og opfølgning.
  • Kan skabe overblik i komplekse datamængder og formidle dine indsigter klart til forskellige interessenter.
  • Er erfaren bruger af Excel.

Kendskab til ledelsessystemer, supplier data exchange-platforme, EUDR og PPWR er en fordel, men ikke et krav.

Bliv en del af familien

Hos RIIS Group får du ikke blot et job, men en rolle med mulighed for at gøre en synlig forskel. Vi er en familieejet og tværfaglig virksomhed med en flad organisation, hvor dørene er åbne, og hvor der er kort vej fra idé til handling. Her bliver idéer lyttet til, ansvar delt og engagement værdsat.

Du får mulighed for at præge vores ESG-arbejde, drive egne initiativer og samarbejde med kolleger på tværs af fagligheder og lande. Samtidig bliver du en del af et miljø, hvor vi hjælper hinanden, og hvor faglig udvikling og nysgerrighed går hånd i hånd med en uformel omgangstone.

Vi tilbyder attraktive vilkår og medarbejdergoder, der matcher dine kvalifikationer og ansvaret i rollen. Vi prioriterer trivsel og fællesskab højt – blandt andet gennem en aktiv personaleforening, egne fitnessfaciliteter og holdtræning samt sociale arrangementer og events hen over året. Engagementet er frivilligt, men mulighederne er mange, hvis du har lyst til at være en del af et socialt fællesskab.

Klar til næste skridt?

Send din ansøgning hurtigst muligt – vi indkalder løbende til samtaler og ansætter, når vi har fundet det rette match. Stillingen ønskes besat, så snart den rette kandidat er fundet.

Har du spørgsmål til rollen, kan du kontakte ESG Compliance & Sustainability Manager Karoline Schou på +45 2210 3728 fra mandag den 19. oktober.

Om RIIS Group

RIIS Group er en veletableret virksomhed inden for butiks- og indretningsløsninger og befinder sig i fortsat international vækst. Vi arbejder med kunder inden for blandt andet retail, restaurant og café, kontor og mode og guider dem gennem både etablering og videreudvikling af deres brands. Sammen med vores kunder har vi gennemført projekter i Europa, Mellemøsten, Asien, Amerika, Australien og Afrika.

RIIS Group beskæftiger mere end 250 medarbejdere, hvoraf hovedparten har base på hovedkontoret i Kolding.

title: Manager, Production - Applied AI
description:
About LILT

AI is changing how the world communicates — and LILT is leading that transformation.

We're on a mission to make the world's information accessible to everyone, regardless of the language they speak. We use cutting-edge AI, machine translation, and human-in-the-loop expertise to translate content faster, more accurately, and more cost-effectively without compromising on brand, voice, or quality.

At LILT, we empower our teammates with leading tools, global collaboration, and growth opportunities to do their best work. Our company virtues—Work together, win together; Find a way or make one; Dance in the customer's shoes; Quicker than they expect; Quality is Job 1—guide everything we do. We are trusted by Intel Corporation, Canva, the United States Department of Defense, the United States Air Force, ASICS, and hundreds of global Enterprises. Backed by Sequoia, Intel Capital, and Redpoint, we’re building a category-defining company in a $50B+ global translation market being redefined by AI.

Key Responsibilities

  • PM Performance

    • Outcome: Every active program has accountable Project Manager(s), and every PM carries a workload within the agreed span. Programs hit on-time delivery and first-pass acceptance targets without escalation; each PM is reviewed monthly against a scorecard of throughput, quality, and cost-per-task.

  • PM Hiring, Onboarding, and Development

    • Outcome: PM pool capacity keeps pace with signed demand: new PMs are sourced, onboarded, and running their first program within the agreed ramp window, all programs start on time, and PM attrition is below threshold.

  • Quality Interventions Across Programs

    • Outcome: Quality dips are caught mid-program through QA loops and corrected via retraining of annotator pools or guideline updates. Repeated misses by a PM or annotator pool lead to documented remediation or replacement. Issues are proactively discovered.

  • Process Standardization & Software Improvements

    • Outcome: Programs launch from shared playbooks, guideline templates, and dashboard standards rather than being rebuilt per engagement. Every post-mortem produces documented improvements that lead directly into our custom software stack, and time from program handoff to first delivery declines quarter over quarter.

  • Escalation and Cross-Functional Interface

    • Outcome: Risks surface to Technical Program Managers early enough to be managed. Escalations between the PM pool, Quality, Talent, and Delivery are resolved within agreed timelines.

Qualifications

  • People management in AI data operations: 5+ years in AI/ML data operations or production, including 2+ years directly managing project managers or team leads in a distributed, multi-time-zone contractor environment.

  • LLM knowledge: Strong understanding of LLM training processes (pre-training, SFT, RLHF) and evaluation methodologies (human-in-the-loop, red teaming), and of what drives quality and throughput in annotation workflows.

  • KPI-driven management: Has run teams against throughput, quality (accuracy, IAA, gold-set), and cost-per-task targets; advanced proficiency with spreadsheets and dashboards, and able to use SQL to extract and analyze performance data.

  • Delivery track record: Has sustained on-time delivery and acceptance targets across multiple concurrent data collection or evaluation programs for enterprise or research lab customers.

  • Contractor workforce operations: Has hired, ramped, performance-managed, and offboarded hourly and freelance staff across regions and languages.

  • Methodology: Proven track record using Agile, Scrum, or Kanban to manage complex workflows across a portfolio of programs.

  • Communication: Writes clear, unambiguous guidelines and feedback for multilingual audiences and communicates status, risk, and tradeoffs crisply to leadership.

Preferred Skills

  • Fluency in multiple human languages.

  • Experience with multilingual data deliveries (pre-training, SFT, RLHF, machine translation, multimodal, etc.), especially in rare-resource languages

  • Experience with data annotation platforms (e.g., Label Studio, SuperAnnotate) and project management tooling (e.g., Jira).

  • Background in ML engineering, computer science, or data science.

Where You’ll Work

This position is based in our Boston office and will be expected to work in the office in a hybrid capacity. LILT is hybrid with hubs in SF, NY, Indianapolis, Boston, London, and Berlin.

Authorization to work in the U.S. is a precondition of employment.

  • Boston (highly preferred)

  • Others: SF Bay Area, New York, Indianapolis, London

Our Story

Our founders, Spence and John met at Google working on Google Translate. As researchers at Stanford and Berkeley, they both worked on language technology to make information accessible to everyone. While together at Google, they were amazed to learn that Google Translate wasn’t used for enterprise products and services inside the company.The quality just wasn’t there. So they set out to build something better. LILT was born.

LILT has been a machine learning company since its founding in 2015. At the time, machine translation didn’t meet the quality standard for enterprise translations, so LILT assembled a cutting-edge research team tasked with closing that gap. While meeting customer demand for translation services, LILT has prioritized investments in Large Language Models, human-in-the-loop systems, and now agentic AI.

With AI innovation accelerating and enterprise demand growing, the next phase of LILT’s journey is just beginning.

Our Tech

What sets our platform apart:

  • Brand-aware AI that learns your voice, tone, and terminology to ensure every translation is accurate and consistent

  • Agentic AI workflows that automate the entire translation process from content ingestion to quality review to publishing

  • 100+ native integrations with systems like Adobe Experience Manager, Webflow, Salesforce, GitHub, and Google Drive to simplify content translation

  • Human-in-the-loop reviews via our global network of professional linguists, for high-impact content that requires expert review


LILT in the News

  • Featured in The Software Report’s Top 100 Software Companies!

  • LILT makes it onto the Inc. 5000 List.

  • LILT’s continues to be an intellectual powerhouse, holding numerous patents that help power the most efficient and sophisticated AI and language models in the industry.

  • Check out all our news on our website.

title: Security-PRN
company: LINCOLN COMMUNITY HOSPITAL AND NURSING HOME
description:
PURPOSE:

This position is responsible for the safety and security of the facilities they protect. Our security officers act as a visible deterrent to crime and client rule infractions; they detect and report suspicious, unsafe, or criminal acts at or near their assigned posts which may be a threat to the property, clients, guests, or employees at the site.

DIMENSIONS:

Security will ensure the safety and security of the property, staff, and visitors of Lincoln Health to include the outlying clinics.

ENVIRONMENT:

Lincoln Health is a 15-bed Critical Access Hospital co-located with 22-bed Long Term Care Unit. The facility employs 150-200 employees. There are three additional external clinics that are operated by Lincoln Health.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

Those duties necessary to meet the minimum requirements of the position. Other duties may be assigned:

• Ensure the facility is provided with high quality security services to protect people and property.

Escort staff and visitors to their vehicles upon request. Complete other assigned duties and tasks.

• Report safety concern, security breaches and unusual circumstances both verbally and in writing.

• Build, improve, and maintain effective relationships with both client employees and guests.

• Answer questions and assist guests and employees.

• Answer phones or greet guests/ employees in a professional, welcoming manner.

• Could be required to work for multiple clients at multiple locations, covering special projects, call offs, vacations, and open shifts.

EXPOSURE RISK:

Possible contact with biohazards to include body fluids and waste. Employee will perform duties in an area where diseases and sicknesses are constantly present. Risk of assaultive visitors, staff, and patients.

EDUCATION AND/OR EXPERIENCE:

Previous law enforcement or security experience preferred. A Security Management Degree is also acceptable.

LANGUAGE SKILLS:

The employee must be able to read, write and speak / understand fluently.

REASONING ABILITY:

The employee must have the ability to think clearly under pressure or in high stress situations. The ability to remain calm to help with de-escalating a potentially violent or out of control situation.

OTHER SKILLS AND ABILITIES:

The employee will maintain certifications in CPR / First Aid and any other required trainings.

title: Customer Relationship Assistant
description:
Working at The Bank of Missouri

At The Bank of Missouri we know it takes great people to support the communities we serve! We are passionate about caring for people and communities, and know how to recognize and reward our employees for their talent and contributions. When you work at The Bank of Missouri, you not only get to help others, but you also get the resources, opportunities and support to grow your own career.

About our Company

Staying in business for more than 130 years is hard. Really hard. If you think about it, we’ve endured many events, like the Great Depression and two World Wars. We’ve survived and thrived, thanks to our great customers and communities. We were founded on core values of accountability, community service and financial conservatism. Those principles are the reason we are still in business today. Caring for people and communities is our foundation!

We’ve built a reputation of being financially secure and community focused. We are an independent community bank and fully intend to stay that way. We are big enough to accommodate any financial need, yet small enough to give every customer the personal treatment they deserve.

About this job:

The Customer Relationship Assistant (CRA) performs a variety of tasks, the most important of which involves serving as the first point of contact for our customers. The CRA is expected to maintain the highest standard of service while providing assistance to current and potential customers who seek guidance with routine transactions, have questions about new services and products or have issues they may be experiencing.

Here are some of the great benefits you will enjoy as a member of our team:

  • Competitive Salary
  • Personal paid time off, as eligible and paid holidays
  • 401K and Employee Stock Option Plan, as eligible
  • Generous medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance
  • Fitness reimbursement
  • Learning, development and growth opportunities

As a Customer Relationship Assistant you will:

  • Understand and protect all customer information. Adhere to all customer confidentiality procedures.
  • Proactively engage customers with each interaction to build strong relationships
  • Accurately and efficiently process a wide variety of monetary transactions while adhering to the Bank’s procedures.
  • Confidently know our bank products and explain the benefits to our customers.
  • Actively listen to the customer in daily interactions and offers product recommendations when the product fills a financial need.
  • Balance cash drawers while adhering to bank policies
  • Play an active role in assisting the customer with problems or questions
  • Build, develop and maintain partnerships with team members to enhance the customer experience
  • Be an active participant in your own personal and professional development
  • Complete required training in a timely manner.

Qualifications for Success:

  • High school diploma or general education degree (GED); two to three years bank related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Customer service and cash handling skills are preferred.
  • Must be eager and willing to learn.

The Bank of Missouri is an Equal Opportunity Employer

title: Paediatric Community Speech and Language Therapist
description:
Job Title: Locum Paediatric Speech and Language Therapist– Birmingham

Banding: Band 6/7
Location: Birmingham – Citywide Community Services
Start Date: ASAP
Salary: £27.50–£32.00 per hour
Working Hours: Full-time or part-time
Contract Duration: 3 months

Job Overview

We are currently seeking an experienced and motivated Band 6/7 Specialist Paediatric Speech and Language Therapist (SALT) to join a community-based service in Birmingham on a locum basis for an initial period of three months.

The successful candidate will provide specialist Speech and Language Therapy assessment and intervention for children, young people and their families across a range of community settings, including clinics, Child Development Centres, educational settings and patients’ homes.

Working as part of multidisciplinary and multi-agency teams, you will contribute to the holistic assessment, diagnosis and intervention of children and young people within the Neurodevelopmental Pathway. You will deliver highly specialist interventions in line with agreed packages of care and clinical pathways, while working collaboratively with families, carers and other professionals.

This role also offers the opportunity to contribute to the ongoing development of the Neurodevelopmental Pathway, support service improvement and demonstrate clinical leadership across Birmingham.

With an immediate start available, flexible full-time or part-time working options and an initial three-month contract, this is an excellent opportunity for a specialist clinician seeking their next locum position.

Key Responsibilities

In this role, you will:

  • Provide specialist Speech and Language Therapy assessments and interventions for children and young people within community settings across Birmingham.
  • Support the holistic assessment, diagnosis and intervention of children and young people within the Neurodevelopmental Pathway.
  • Deliver highly specialist interventions in line with agreed clinical pathways and packages of care.
  • Work collaboratively with multidisciplinary and multi-agency teams to coordinate care and achieve positive outcomes for children and their families.
  • Build and maintain effective working relationships with parents, carers, education professionals and other healthcare providers.
  • Use highly developed communication, negotiation and interpersonal skills when working with children, young people, families and professionals.
  • Collaborate with service leads to develop and improve clinical pathways and packages of care within the Neurodevelopmental Pathway.
  • Contribute to the ongoing development of the Neurodevelopmental Pathway Team and promote evidence-based clinical practice.
  • Demonstrate clinical leadership and represent the local service at relevant meetings to support service planning and development across the city.
  • Identify training needs within the team and deliver specialist training to colleagues and other professionals where appropriate.
  • Contribute to service quality improvement and promote safe, effective and equitable clinical practice.
  • Where delegated, support the management of waiting lists and active caseloads to help ensure equitable service delivery across Birmingham.

Qualifications and Experience

To be considered for this role, you must have:

  • A recognised degree in Speech and Language Therapy (or equivalent).
  • Current Health and Care Professions Council (HCPC) registration.
  • Relevant experience working as a Paediatric Speech and Language Therapist.
  • Experience providing specialist assessment and intervention for children and young people in community settings.
  • Knowledge and understanding of neurodevelopmental conditions and their impact on speech, language and communication.
  • Experience working collaboratively within multidisciplinary and multi-agency teams.
  • Strong clinical reasoning and the ability to develop and deliver evidence-based intervention plans.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation and interpersonal skills.
  • The ability to manage a clinical caseload effectively and work autonomously when required.
  • A proactive approach to service development, clinical governance and continuous professional development.

title: ATM Systems Engineer II
description:
Job Description:

ATM Systems Engineer

Location: Must be able to work onsite 3-4 days in the Valparaiso, Indiana office

The ATM Systems Engineer is responsible for the implementation, maintenance, monitoring, and support of Automated Teller Machine (ATM) infrastructure and associated systems. This role ensures high availability, security, performance, and compliance of ATM networks, transaction processing systems, and supporting technologies. The engineer works closely with banking operations, infrastructure teams, vendors, and application support teams to deliver reliable ATM services to customers.

Essential Functions:

  • Deploy, configure, and maintain ATM hardware, software platforms, operating systems, middleware, and transaction processing applications.
  • Monitor ATM network performance and system health to ensure maximum uptime.
  • Coordinate ATM upgrades, relocations, and decommissioning activities.
  • Diagnose and resolve ATM software, communication, transaction-related, and peripheral incidents, including card readers, cash dispensers, receipt printers, and PIN pads.
  • Perform root cause analysis for recurring issues and implement corrective actions.
  • Support production incidents and participate in on-call support rotations.
  • Manage secure connectivity between ATMs and payment switches.
  • Implement and maintain ATM security controls, encryption standards, key management, certificate management, authentication mechanisms, and compliance requirements.
  • Ensure adherence to PCI-DSS, banking regulations, and security best practices.
  • Develop and maintain monitoring dashboards and alerts; analyze transaction performance and ATM availability metrics.
  • Perform capacity planning, recommend infrastructure improvements, and proactively identify and mitigate system risks.
  • Collaborate with ATM vendors, managed service providers, financial network partners, product teams, and internal stakeholders.
  • Coordinate software releases, patch deployments, hardware upgrades, vendor support cases, and service-level agreements.
  • Maintain technical documentation, operational procedures, disaster recovery plans, and support audit and regulatory compliance activities.

  • Familiarity with ISO 8583 messaging standards.
  • Experience with monitoring tools such as Prognosis and Gasper.

Technical Skills:

  • Operating Systems: Windows Server, Linux
  • Networking: TCP/IP, VPN, DNS, routing, firewalls
  • Databases: SQL Server, Oracle

  • Scripting: PowerShell, Bash
  • Security: Encryption, PKI, PCI-DSS, key management

title: Vice President, Clinical Development Program Leader
description:
Madrigal is a biopharmaceutical company focused on delivering novel therapeutics for metabolic dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis (MASH), a serious liver disease that can progress to cirrhosis, liver failure, need for liver transplantation and premature mortality. Every member of our Madrigal team is connected by our shared purpose: leading the fight against MASH.

Madrigal’s medication, Rezdiffra (resmetirom), is a once-daily, oral, liver-directed THR-β agonist designed to target key underlying causes of MASH. Rezdiffra is the first and only medication approved by both the FDA and European Commission for the treatment of MASH with moderate to advanced fibrosis (F2 to F3). An ongoing Phase 3 outcomes trial is evaluating Rezdiffra for the treatment of compensated MASH cirrhosis (F4c).

Our success is driven by our people. We are building a dynamic, inclusive, and high-performing culture that values scientific excellence, operational rigor, and collaboration. To support our continued growth, we are strengthening our workforce strategy to ensure we have the right talent, at the right time, in the right way.

Vice President, Clinical Development Program Leader

Company Background
Madrigal Pharmaceuticals is a biopharmaceutical company focused on delivering novel therapeutics for metabolic dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis (MASH), a serious liver disease with high unmet medical need. The company’s medication, Rezdiffra (resmetirom), is the first and only FDA and European Commission-approved treatment for MASH with moderate to advanced fibrosis. Madrigal’s pipeline includes ongoing Phase 3 trials and new assets in early development.

Role Overview
The Vice President, Clinical Development Program Leader is a senior clinical leader responsible for shaping, leading, and executing clinical strategy across one or more therapeutic programs. This role blends strategic clinical leadership, cross-functional program oversight, and hands-on execution from early development through registration. The VP will guide assets from preclinical stages through IND submission, first-in-human (FIH) studies, and late-stage development, ensuring scientific rigor, patient safety, and alignment with corporate priorities.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead cross-functional program teams, shaping product strategy and driving integrated development plans.
  • Transition from direct clinical oversight in early development to strategic leadership of a growing clinical team.
  • Set program goals in collaboration with executive leadership, ensuring alignment across functions.
  • Maintain accountability for program timelines, budget, and deliverables, aligning activities with portfolio management and internal reporting needs.
  • Develop clinical and translational strategy for new assets, including Target Product Profile (TPP) definition, clinical hypotheses, and indication prioritization.
  • Lead creation of Clinical Development Plans (CDPs) from FIH through Proof-of-Concept (PoC) and late-stage trials.
  • Oversee design and medical oversight of FIH, SAD/MAD, translational, and PoC studies, as well as Phase I–IV trials.
  • Ensure high-quality medical monitoring, patient safety oversight, and timely clinical decision-making.
  • Lead early regulatory interactions (pre-IND, Scientific Advice, ITF meetings) and respond to regulatory feedback.
  • Oversee development and medical accuracy of IND submissions, Investigator Brochures, and regulatory documentation.
  • Serve as senior clinical representative in global regulatory interactions (FDA, EMA, PMDA, etc.).
  • Support preparation and defense of regulatory submissions, including IND amendments, meeting packages, and marketing applications.
  • Integrate clinical development, biostatistics, operations, CMC, regulatory, and safety functions for assigned programs.
  • Partner with Translational Medicine, Nonclinical, CMC, Commercial, and Market Access teams to shape biomarker development, assay readiness, and patient stratification strategies.
  • Foster robust cross-functional collaboration, scenario planning, and contingency strategies.
  • Build and maintain relationships with KOLs, investigators, scientific advisors, and development partners.
  • Represent Madrigal at scientific meetings, advisory boards, and collaborative consortia.
  • Support scientific publication and external communication strategies.
  • Mentor and guide clinical scientists and cross-functional team members.
  • Contribute to building early-development capabilities, frameworks, processes, and scalable best practices.
  • Foster a culture of openness, trust, and scientific integrity.

Required & Desired Qualifications

  • MD or DO; board certification in a relevant specialty (Internal Medicine, Gastroenterology, Endocrinology, Hepatology, or related field) preferred.
  • 10–15+ years of clinical development experience, including significant leadership of early-phase and late-stage programs, with 20+ years of total relevant experience.
  • Proven success in leading clinical programs across all development phases, including regulatory filings (INDs/NDAs/BLAs), launch, and commercialization.
  • Strong background in translational medicine, biomarkers, and early-phase PK/PD.
  • Demonstrated success leading pre-IND and IND interactions with global regulatory agencies.
  • Extensive experience working in matrixed, global teams, with the ability to influence across functions without direct reporting lines.
  • Deep understanding of the commercial landscape, regulatory strategy, and CMC considerations relevant to drug development.

Competencies

  • Strategic clinical leadership and ability to create strategy from incomplete data.
  • Translational and hypothesis-driven thinking.
  • Cross-functional integration and collaboration.
  • Scientific rigor and disciplined decision-making.
  • Organizational leadership and talent development.
  • External engagement and influence.
  • Strong clinical judgment, communication, and ethical conduct.

All full-time employees receive equity, which reinforces our ownership culture and offers meaningful opportunity for our employees to share in the success they help create. By aligning individual and company performance, we empower employees to think like owners, giving them a stake in the organization.

Full-time employees are also eligible for comprehensive benefits, including flexible paid time off, medical, dental, vision and life/disability insurance, and 401(k) offerings (i.e., traditional, Roth, and employer match) in accordance with applicable plans. title: Shipper-Receiver/Parts & Service Administrator (3902)
description:
Position Overview

This role combines parts and service administration with hands-on warehouse shipping. About half your time will be spent coordinating the parts department and supporting the service department's administrative needs: ordering, receiving, and tracking parts; keeping inventory records accurate; and ensuring service repairs have the parts they need. The other half will be spent in the warehouse shipping parts and service radios, and shipping new radio orders as needed.

The ideal candidate is organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable moving between computer-based administrative work and physical warehouse tasks. Experience working inside a warehouse or parts/inventory department is required.

Duties and Responsibilities

Parts Department & Service Administration (approximately 25%)

  • Maintain parts inventory by reviewing the backorder report and parts needed for service repairs (AWAP – Awaiting Parts) and generate parts orders to Icom Inc. (Home Company).
  • Monitor stock levels, set minimum reorder quantities, and reorder as needed to keep parts flowing to the service department, dealers, and customers.
  • Handle all parts-related correspondence with the Home Company, including purchase order requests. Make sure all AWAP orders are communicated and follow up on any ordering issues until they are resolved.
  • Receive parts in E1 (JD Edwards), create part numbers for new items, and maintain pricing, item descriptions, part number changes, and discontinued parts.
  • Release parts from backorder once new shipments arrive.
  • Record inventory adjustments for parts used by the service department.
  • Respond to parts inquiries from dealers, customers, and internal staff by phone and email, providing part numbers, pricing, and availability, and entering parts orders.
  • Support service department administration, including logging incoming service radios, tracking repair and parts status, and preparing return shipping paperwork.
  • Perform cycle counts and take part in scheduled physical inventory counts.

Warehouse Shipping & Receiving (approximately 75%)

  • Ship in this order of priority: (1) parts orders, (2) repaired service radios, (3) new radio orders as workload allows.
  • Pick, verify, and pack orders using handheld warehouse scanners, choosing the right packaging so products arrive safely.
  • Review packing lists for special shipping and handling instructions.
  • Choose the best courier for each shipment, process manifests and shipping paperwork, and sort outgoing packages by carrier (e.g., FedEx, UPS, Purolator, Canada Post).
  • Unload incoming shipments with the warehouse team, check them against shipping documents, and put product away in the correct bin locations.
  • Complete special order requirements such as kits and battery or antenna swaps.
  • Keep the warehouse and parts department clean, safe, and organized.

General

  • Cross-train in other departments as needed to support coverage.
  • Perform other related duties as assigned.

title: Art Services Technician
description:
Art Services Technician

Temporary Full-Time

(35 hours per week; must be available to work Monday through Friday from 8:30AM to 4:30PM)

ART + AUDIENCE + LEARNING

Located in Toronto, the Art Gallery of Ontario is one of the largest art museums in North America, attracting approximately one million visitors annually. The AGO Collection of more than 120,000 works of art ranges from cutting-edge contemporary art to significant works by Indigenous and Canadian artists and European masterpieces.

Under the direction of the Manager, Logistics and Art Services, the incumbent will install and dismantle works of art in gallery spaces as well as temporary artist installations for events; they will prepare gallery spaces. The Art Services Technician will assist with preparation, installation and maintenance of lighting for gallery spaces. They will transport works of art to/from various spaces throughout the gallery. They will safely handle works of art at all times.

The rate of pay for this position is $27.38 - $34.20 per hour.

What is this position responsible for?

  • Under the direction of the Senior Art Services Technician and/or Manager, installs and dismantles works of art in gallery spaces as well as temporary artist installations for events. Assesses hanging and installation requirements and sources necessary tools and equipment to safely install art. Determines appropriate placement and installation methods for works of art in consultation with Supervisor, Curators, Conservators and other project team members as required. Assists with the preparation and installation of display furniture for art objects as needed.

Loads/unloads crated/uncrated works of art for exhibition onto/off trucks. Works with Administrator, Logistics and Art Services to record art movements and update location information in collections database.
  • Under the direction of the Senior Lighting Technician assists with the preparation and installation of lighting in gallery spaces as well as temporary artist installations for events. Works with the Senior Lighting Technician to maintain lighting throughout the galleries – replaces bulbs, adjusts fixtures and helps to maintain fixtures and lamp inventory as required.

What are we looking for?

  • 1 to 2 years directly related experience handling and installing works of art
  • Well-developed interpersonal and communication skills
  • Thorough knowledge of installation/hanging methods and devices.

  • Demonstrated ability to operate a variety of hand and power tools including table saws, jointers and drills, lift trucks, scissor lift and motor vehicles.
  • Working knowledge of applicable computer programs
  • Demonstrated ability to operate audio-visual equipment including repairs and troubleshooting.

What are the benefits of working at the AGO?

  • Discounts to GoodLife Fitness.
  • Free tickets to every major exhibit at AGO.
  • Discounts to major attractions as a part of the Provincial/City Reciprocal Programs.
  • Free admission to the AGO for friends and family, discounts at the gift shop, bistro, and Learning Centre.

If this sounds like the opportunity you are looking for, apply now!

Our commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Accessibility:

At the AGO, we lead global conversations from Toronto through extraordinary collections, exhibitions, and programs, reflecting the diverse community we serve. Committed to fostering inclusion, diversity, equity, and accessibility, we embed these values into our strategic plan and ongoing priorities.
