title: Test Technician
description:
The Engineering Technician supports semiconductor test operations involving automated test equipment (ATE), wafer probers, handlers, and associated test instrumentation. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience with probers and testers, strong troubleshooting capability, and the ability to collaborate closely with engineering teams to maintain high-quality, high-efficiency test operations. The role also contributes to continuous improvement of test processes and equipment performance.

Business context

Our test operations organization supports new product introduction (NPI), engineering sample evaluation, and production test readiness for advanced Analog, Power, MCU, and EP semiconductor products. This position is key to dependable test cell operation, data generation for engineering analysis, and smooth coordination with suppliers, cross-functional engineering teams, and production support groups.

Key Responsibilities

Test cell operations

  • Support small-volume engineering sample and low-volume production programs.

  • Set up, dock, and undock ATE systems with probers and handlers according to daily engineering and production needs.

  • Perform device-level testing manually using ATE and laboratory test equipment.

Equipment troubleshooting and debug

  • Diagnose and troubleshoot handlers, probers, and testers, coordinating with Renesas engineers and vendors as needed to restore operation.

  • Debug ATE hardware, including load boards, probe cards, and socketed test fixtures.

  • Identify intermittent test board performance issues and escalate to engineering for root-cause resolution.

Data collection

  • Collect engineering data using oscilloscopes, network analyzers, multimeters, and basic semiconductor diagnostic tools.

Maintenance, calibration, and compliance

  • Perform preventive maintenance (PM) and calibration support for ATE, handlers, probers, and other test equipment.

  • Maintain calibration records and PM logs to support ISO-9001 audits.

  • Ensure compliance with safety and quality requirements.

Education

  • Bachelor / Associate of Science (AS) degree or equivalent in EE, Mechanical or Industrial Engineering

Experience

  • 5–10 years of hands-on experience testing on ATE systems.

  • Proficiency with wafer probers and handlers, including setup and operation.

  • Hardware inventory management system

Technical skills

  • Good knowledge of circuit design and troubleshooting.

  • Understanding of basic semiconductor test flows and of industry test standards.

  • Soldering skills.

  • Basic proficiency with MS Word and Excel. Python scripting will be a plus.

Professional skills

  • Strong troubleshooting skills and willingness to take on challenging technical tasks.

  • Skilled with documentation; excellent verbal and written communication, including with engineers and cross-functional support teams.

  • Self-motivated and conscientious; able to complete tasks with minimal supervision.

  • Ability to multi-task while maintaining attention to detail.

Preferred Experience

Test Platforms

Advantest 93K, Teradyne Eagle/UFlex, Cohu DiamondX, SPEA DOT800C

Wafer probers

TEL, Accretech

Handlers

Talos, Seiko, JHT, Hontech

The expected annual pay range for this position is 35.00-45.00/hr. This position is also eligible for bonus opportunities. Please note that final offer amount will be dependent on geographic location, applicable experience, and skillset of the candidate

Renesas is an embedded semiconductor solution provider driven by its Purpose, To Make Our Lives Easier. title: Vice President, Enterprise Operations & Integration
description:
We're looking for a Vice President, Enterprise Operations & Integration

Miami, FL | Full-Time | In-Office

We’re looking for a Vice President, Enterprise Operations & Integration to help build the operating infrastructure behind INF1NITY as we scale into a multi-strategy, AI-native investment institution.

This is a senior, hands-on role for an experienced operator who can translate strategy into execution, build scalable systems, and drive accountability across a complex, growing organization.

About Us

INF1NITY is an AI-native investment platform spanning private markets, real assets, income, technology, private equity, infrastructure, strategic acquisitions, and other investment strategies.

Our mission is to grant access to investments previously reserved only for the ultra-wealthy.

We’re not building a traditional asset manager. We’re building an institution designed to compound capital, intelligence, relationships, and distribution over decades.

As part of this growth, we are integrating and evolving the existing Rastegar Capital real estate platform while launching new investment vehicles, expanding distribution, deploying AI across the enterprise, and building the infrastructure required for the next stage of growth.

The Role

As VP, Enterprise Operations & Integration, you’ll work directly with the Founder & CEO and senior leadership to translate vision into coordinated execution across INF1NITY and the broader Rastegar organization.

Your focus will be on building the enterprise operating system that connects teams, initiatives, investment strategies, and technologies — ensuring clear ownership, accountability, visibility, and execution across the organization.

This is not a traditional administrative or project-management role. You’ll operate across functions and own the critical intersections between departments where execution can break down.

What You’ll Do

  • Build and manage company-wide operating rhythms, KPI dashboards, executive reviews, and accountability systems.

  • Create clear ownership, objectives, timelines, KPIs, and definitions of success for major initiatives.

  • Coordinate execution across Operations, Marketing, Capital Formation, Real Estate, Legal, Finance, Accounting, Events, and other key functions.

  • Lead the operational integration of Rastegar Capital into the broader INF1NITY platform while protecting existing assets, investors, projects, and relationships.

  • Build repeatable operating playbooks for new investment vehicles across Real Estate, Income, Technology & Venture, Private Equity, and Infrastructure.

  • Identify and solve cross-functional bottlenecks before they become execution failures.

  • Build executive dashboards that provide leadership with visibility into the metrics that matter most across the enterprise.

  • Partner with technology leadership to embed AI, automation, and decision-support tools throughout the organization.

  • Help design the organizational structure, roles, hiring plans, processes, and capabilities required for INF1NITY’s next stage of growth.

  • Work closely with Corporate Finance to connect operating decisions with budgets, capital requirements, resource allocation, and investment economics.

  • Create leverage for the Founder & CEO by translating strategic priorities into coordinated organizational action.

What We’re Looking For

Must-Haves

  • 10–15+ years of experience across alternative asset management, private equity, real estate investment management, financial services, fintech, high-growth companies, investment platforms, strategy/operations, or management consulting.

  • Experience operating across multiple business lines and scaling organizations through significant growth.

  • Demonstrated ability to work directly with a Founder/CEO and senior leadership.

  • Strong experience building operating systems, processes, and cross-functional accountability.

  • Strong financial literacy across P&Ls, budgets, operating leverage, investment economics, and capital allocation.

  • Strong judgment, high ownership, and the ability to manage complexity without creating unnecessary bureaucracy.

  • Fluency with modern technology, AI, and automation as operating leverage.

Nice to Have

  • Experience integrating businesses, launching new products, or transforming legacy organizations.

  • Experience within alternative investments, private equity, real estate, fintech, or a multi-entity investment platform.

  • Experience designing KPI systems, executive dashboards, and operating cadences.

  • Experience scaling teams and organizational infrastructure.

Why Join Us

  • Most operations executives step into an established structure. At INF1NITY, you’ll have the opportunity to help build one.
  • Competitive compensation + ~25% target annual bonus
  • Carry/equity component tied to the investment vehicles you help build
  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • 401(k) with 6% company match
  • Opportunity to work directly with leadership and a fast-moving team
  • Long-term growth opportunities

Ready to join the team?

We’d love to hear from you! You can apply through one of these ways:

  • Send your resume in English to domenica@axiskey.com

  • Apply through LinkedIn

  • Apply through our hiring platform: Trakstar

Job Description

Job Purpose

The Intermediate Full stack Developer is responsible for developing, enhancing, and maintaining software solutions within Amrod's Business Systems landscape. The role works closely with QA, Product, Architecture, and Infrastructure teams to ensure successful delivery while continually expanding technical knowledge and expertise. Operating in a fast-paced and delivery-focused environment, this position requires strong ownership of assigned work, analytical thinking, and adaptability within an agile development framework. This is a deadline-driven role that may occasionally require overtime or weekend work, particularly during deployment cycles. Development is structured around 2-week sprints, planned by the Scrum Master and coordinated by the Development Manager, spanning support, enhancement, and strategic project initiatives.

Key Performance Areas

Development Delivery

  • Timely completion of tasks aligned with sprint commitments.
  • Variance between estimated and actual delivery effort.
  • Predictable delivery performance across sprints.

Code Quality

  • Clean, efficient, and well-documented code.
  • Positive peer review outcomes and appropriate unit test coverage.
  • Adherence to development standards and best practices.

Defect Resolution

  • Timely response to QA/UAT findings and production issues.
  • Quality of fixes and reduction of recurring defects.

Collaboration & Continuous Improvement

  • Active participation in sprint ceremonies and peer reviews.
  • Knowledge sharing and contribution to team improvements.
  • Positive collaboration with development and business stakeholders.

Stakeholder Satisfaction

  • Feedback from internal business and technical stakeholders.
  • Responsiveness to change requests and incident resolutions.
  • Delivery alignment with business and operational objectives.

Job Requirements

Minimum Skills and Knowledge Required

  • Bachelor's Degree or Diploma in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent; relevant work experience will also be considered in lieu of formal qualifications.
  • Microsoft / Azure certifications advantageous.
  • Certifications in modern web frameworks beneficial.
  • 3+ years of experience in software development in a full stack, back end, or front-end capacity.
  • Proficient in ASP.NET Core, C#, Entity Framework (code-first approach), and SQL Server.
  • Experience with modern JavaScript/TypeScript frameworks such as React, Angular, or Vue.js.
  • Understanding of RESTful APIs, Swagger/OpenAPI, and API integration principles.
  • Working knowledge of Git, automated testing (e.g., NUnit, xUnit, Playwright), and CI/CD practices.
  • Experience working in an agile environment, participating in sprint planning, retrospectives, and daily stand-ups.
  • Exposure to Postman, Microsoft Entra, message queues (e.g., RabbitMQ or Kafka), and modern DevOps tools is advantageous.
  • Understanding of software design principles, application performance, and code quality best practices.

title: Principal Electric Propulsion Engineer
description:
ABOUT ROCKET LAB

Rocket Lab is the end-to-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity’s reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We move fast, build real hardware for meaningful missions, and make the impossible routine. Come shape the future with us.

SPACE SYSTEMS

At Rocket Lab, we’re not just launching rockets — we're building the future of space. Our Space Systems team builds everything from complete spacecraft, precision payloads to the components and subsystems that allow them to thrive in space, like solar panels, flight software, star trackers, optical systems, separation systems, radios, and more.

Our Space Systems team has enabled more than 1,700 missions, ranging from interplanetary exploration, in-space manufacturing to national security and defense initiatives. The team has built spacecraft, payloads, and components for missions to the Moon and Mars, working with partners including NASA, the Space Development Agency, and the U.S. Space Force. Whether it’s a single high-performance spacecraft, constellation, or the vertically integrated components that help them get to space — our world class Space Systems team is empowering some of the boldest and most ambitious space missions.

PRINCIPAL ELECTRIC PROPULSION ENGINEER

We’re currently seeking a Principal Electric Propulsion Engineer for our propulsion engineering team based out of Long Beach, CA. As an Electric Propulsion Engineer, you are responsible for system-level and component-level ownership of space systems propulsion and fluidic development. These teams support our Space Systems division, and lead cutting-edge programs for civil, commercial, and defense customers.

WHAT YOU’LL GET TO DO:

  • Own development of new or existing products or systems, acting as technical lead to guide team through end-to-end development process
  • Conceptual and detailed performance calculations, systems modelling, analysis, and system designs
  • Requirements gathering, definition, and management
  • Systems engineering activities and leadership within the team
  • Test planning, setup, instrumentation, execution, and data analysis
  • Communicate with project stakeholders internal and external to the team
  • Technical risk-based decision making to the right/best solution when faced with an engineering challenge
  • Project management, including: schedule building and maintenance, identifying top priority items, tasking of other engineers and technicians, and communication of status to leadership and other teams
  • Mentor and coach people within the team on technical and professional development
  • Define and maintain standard of excellence for their team through documentation, training, coaching, and review of others’ work
  • Contribute to engineering process development and documentation at Rocket Lab related to areas of experience

YOU’LL BRING THESE QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 12+ years of experience in propulsion system development, or equivalent high-performance field
  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, (aerospace, mechanical, mechatronics, or other technical engineering discipline)
  • Expertise in propulsion system modelling, static and transient analysis, and model validation using test data using software such as Amesim, EcosimPro, Simulink, or Simscape
  • Experience with end-to-end development process including gathering requirements, detailed design, qualification, production, and acceptance testing
  • Strong grasp of all steps in the Systems Engineering V and risk-based decision making
  • Experience working on electric propulsion systems
  • U.S. citizenship is required, due to program requirements
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a security clearance

THESE QUALIFICATIONS WOULD BE NICE TO HAVE:

  • A genuine passion for engineering, curious mindset, and willingness to learn
  • Comfortable working with high levels of ambiguity
  • Makes decisions using basic engineering principles, available literature and standards, technical risk assessments, test data, and physics-based models
  • Practice in identifying the necessary steps to achieve high level technical goals, scheduling them in a plan, and managing delivery against that plan
  • Experience with Jama
  • Capabilities using Python for data manipulation and post-processing
  • Detailed mechanical design experience using NX (preferred) or equivalent industry standard CAD software
  • Experience with GD&T and engineering drawings
  • Experience using Product Lifecycle Management software such as Teamcenter (preferred), Windchill, or similar
  • Experience using National Instruments data acquisition systems
  • Experience with testing and troubleshooting flight hardware
  • Masters or PhD
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to work well within a team environment
  • Demonstrated hands on engineering skills, inside or outside the workplace

This position may require prolonged periods of sitting, standing, walking, computer work, and occasional exposure to moderate levels of noise, dust, and fumes in production areas.

Anticipated annual equity grant value is designed around function, level, experience, and other factors; realized value depends on vesting and stock-price performance.

Join one of the world's fastest-growing space companies and own a piece of it. In addition to competitive base pay, you'll receive company stock as part of your total compensation package, giving you a direct stake in our success. As we expand to new launch sites, groundbreaking missions, and global markets, your ownership has the opportunity to grow alongside the company.

Our comprehensive benefits package includes our industry-leading Employee Stock Purchase Program (with a 15% discount on company stock), top-tier medical plans (HMO, PPO, and a zero cost HDHP option with a significant HSA company contribution), dental and vision coverage, paid vacation and sick time, 11 paid holidays, flexible spending and dependent care accounts, paid parental leave, disability and life insurance, and a 401(k) retirement plan with company match.

Additional perks include subsidized EV charging, onsite fitness centers (where available), discounted gym memberships, complimentary snacks and beverages, 50% employee discount on our popular merch store, and a variety of other employee discounts.

Level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Total Compensation (base and equity)
$212,000—$350,000 USD
Base Salary
$162,000—$270,000 USD

WHAT TO EXPECT

We’re on a mission to unlock the potential of space to improve life on Earth, but that’s not an easy task. It takes hard work, determination, relentless innovation, teamwork, grit, and an unwavering commitment to achieving what others often deem impossible. Our people out-think, out-work, and out-pace. We pride ourselves on having each other’s backs, checking our egos at the door, and rolling up our sleeves on all tasks big and small. We thrive under pressure, work to tight deadlines, and our focus is always on how we can deliver, rather than dwelling on the challenges that stand in the way.

title: Full Stack Engineer - Junior

We go far beyond traditional payment processing. Breeze combines global payments, AI, stablecoins, and a Merchant of Record-like model to take on the complexity businesses typically manage themselves, including compliance, risk, fraud, chargebacks, reconciliation, and customer support.

Our goal is simple: let businesses focus on building and selling great products while Breeze handles the complexity behind getting paid.

  • Excellent communication skills and comfort working cross-functionally with non-engineering partners.
  • Familiarity with building scalable, reliable systems and modern web architectures.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

description:

Job Overview

We are currently seeking an experienced and specialist Band 7 Paediatric Speech and Language Therapist (SALT) with expertise in dysphagia and neonatal care to join a community children's service in Hounslow.

This role is ideal for a confident and autonomous clinician with experience managing children with complex feeding and swallowing difficulties, particularly neonates and infants under one year of age.

The successful candidate will predominantly work within the Community Children's Dysphagia Clinic, based at Heart of Hounslow, with some clinics and visits across the wider borough. You will work closely with dietitians, community nurses and other healthcare professionals to provide specialist assessment, clinical management and ongoing support to children and their families.

The role will involve covering an existing vacancy and supporting a smooth clinical handover. This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced Band 7 Speech and Language Therapist to utilise their specialist skills within a collaborative community healthcare setting.

Key Responsibilities

In this role, you will:

  • Independently assess and manage children presenting with dysphagia and complex feeding difficulties.
  • Provide specialist Speech and Language Therapy input for neonates and infants under one year of age.
  • Undertake comprehensive clinical assessments and develop individualised dysphagia management plans.
  • Provide evidence-based advice and recommendations to support safe and effective feeding practices.
  • Work collaboratively with dietitians, community nurses and other multidisciplinary team members to coordinate patient care.
  • Support families and carers by providing guidance on feeding strategies and the management of swallowing difficulties.
  • Manage an autonomous community caseload, prioritising clinical needs and ensuring appropriate follow-up.
  • Deliver clinic appointments primarily at Heart of Hounslow, with additional clinics and visits across the borough as required.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date clinical records in line with professional and organisational standards.
  • Support the transition and handover of the existing caseload to ensure continuity of care.

Qualifications and Experience

To be considered for this role, you must have:

  • A recognised degree in Speech and Language Therapy (or equivalent).
  • Current Health and Care Professions Council (HCPC) registration.
  • Extensive relevant experience in paediatric Speech and Language Therapy, appropriate to a Band 7 specialist role.
  • Specialist experience in the assessment and management of paediatric dysphagia.
  • Demonstrable experience working with neonates and children under one year of age.
  • The ability to independently manage a caseload of children with complex feeding and swallowing needs.
  • Strong clinical reasoning, assessment and decision-making skills.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, particularly when working with families and carers.
  • The ability to work autonomously and collaboratively within a multidisciplinary team.
  • Good organisational skills and the ability to manage competing clinical priorities.

Previous experience in a community children's dysphagia service would be advantageous.

From the moment you register with Pulse, our focus is entirely on you. Our specialist consultants understand your profession and are committed to finding the right opportunities to match your skills and aspirations. With exclusive access to roles across the UK, we offer a personalised and supportive recruitment experience that puts your career first.

title: Industry Specialist (Land Software)
description:
Do you have the kind of land industry knowledge that makes people say, “Ask them, they’ll know”?

Pandell-ESG is looking for an Industry Specialist with strong land industry knowledge who can bring real-world context into conversations with our customers and across Product, Sales, Implementation, Support, Development, and QA.

You understand land workflows, terminology, and the day-to-day realities behind the data and processes our customers work with. More importantly, you can listen to a customer question, get to the heart of what they’re trying to accomplish, and help connect that back to how our software can support them.

That’s what makes this role interesting. You’ll sit at the intersection of the customer, the land industry, and our products, helping different teams understand how those pieces fit together. One day, you might be joining a customer discovery session or supporting a product demo. The next, you could be helping untangle a tricky workflow question, providing context during an implementation, sharing customer feedback with our LandWorks Product team, or helping an internal team understand why a land process works the way it does.

You’ll likely enjoy this role if you know the land industry well, enjoy solving problems, and are good at turning what you know into something practical and useful for others.

About Us:

ESG, along with its subsidiary Pandell, is a global leader in energy software, providing Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) solutions that support companies across utilities, renewables, retail energy, and oil and gas.

Across North America and the UK, our combined platforms help teams manage key parts of their business, including billing, asset management, regulatory requirements, and geospatial data. These tools bring together the information and workflows teams rely on every day, making it easier to run operations and stay organized.

Through cloud-based technology and data-driven insights, we help energy companies navigate complex markets and continue progressing toward Net-Zero goals.

Life at Pandell-ESG

Picture a workplace where what you do truly matters, your voice is heard, and your teammates are some of the smartest, kindest, and funniest people you’ll meet.

That’s Pandell-ESG.

We’re a fast-moving, high-performing software company filled with talented, purpose-driven people. Our culture is challenging, rewarding, and genuinely supportive. Diversity, equity, and inclusion are part of who we are, and we want you to show up as your authentic self. In return, we’ll support you with the trust, tools, and flexibility you need to do your best work.

About Our Land Product Team:

Our Land Product team supports a suite of industry-leading products, including LandWorks and Projects, serving customers across North America. It’s a supportive, collaborative team where people share ideas openly, help one another, and work through challenges together.

Requirements

What You’ll Do

  • Bring your land industry knowledge into conversations with Product, Sales, Implementation, Support, Development, QA, and other teams.
  • Help teams understand customer land workflows, terminology, business processes, and how those connect to our products.
  • Join customer discovery sessions, needs assessments, product demonstrations, and other customer conversations.
  • Help explain how product functionality supports real-world land processes and customer needs.
  • Identify gaps between customer workflows, product functionality, and expected outcomes.
  • Gather customer feedback and help surface recurring workflow challenges, product gaps, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Support implementation and post-sales teams by providing context around land workflows, configuration needs, and practical considerations.
  • Help investigate product or workflow questions where land expertise and customer context are needed.
  • Share your knowledge through training, documentation, customer education, and internal knowledge sharing.
  • Stay current on changes and trends in the land industry that could affect our customers or products.

What You Bring

EPIC Essentials

You embody Pandell-ESG’s core values:

  • Excellence: Deliver your best, every time.
  • Passion: Show how much you care each day.
  • Integrity: Do the right thing, even when no one’s looking.
  • Collaboration: Work together to succeed together.

What Makes You a Great Fit

  • Strong knowledge of the land industry, including land workflows, terminology, processes, and customer operations.
  • Hands-on experience working in land, land administration, land systems, or a closely related area.
  • A good understanding of how land processes connect to software functionality and customer needs.
  • Experience working with customers or stakeholders through discovery sessions, demonstrations, training, needs assessments, implementations, or similar conversations.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to explain complex land concepts in a clear, practical way.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to connect customer workflows to practical product solutions.
  • Comfortable working across teams, gathering information from different sources, and bringing in the right people when deeper technical or product input is needed.

Your Experience

  • 5+ years of experience working in the land industry, land administration, land systems, or a related field.
  • Practical experience working with land workflows, customer processes, and industry terminology.
  • Experience working directly with customers, stakeholders, or internal teams in a consultative or support capacity.
  • Experience using software or technology as part of land-related business processes.
  • Post-secondary education in land administration, business, technology, energy, information systems, or a related field is considered an asset.

Bonus Points If You Have

  • Experience with land management software or enterprise land systems.
  • Knowledge of Pandell products (LandWorks, Projects, LandRite...).
  • Experience working with Product, Sales, Implementation, Support, Development, or QA teams.
  • Familiarity with software implementations, configuration, requirements analysis, troubleshooting, or post-sales support.
  • Experience creating training materials, documentation, procedures, or customer-facing resources.
  • Experience supporting oil and gas, renewables, or other land-based energy operations.

Benefits

Benefits

What’s In It for You?

At Pandell-ESG, we believe in creating a workplace where you can do your best work while enjoying meaningful projects and a strong sense of belonging.

Here are just a few things we offer:

  • Work-from-home or office flexibility - choose where you work best!
  • Flexible hours to support work-life balance
  • Competitive benefits package, including 100% dental reimbursement
  • Retirement Savings Plan with company matching
  • Training budget and professional development opportunities
  • Fully stocked kitchen at the office with healthy options, snacks, and plenty of coffee
  • A fun and engaging culture with virtual and in-person events, learning opportunities, and a games room and lounge
  • A wellness budget to support your version of wellbeing

Join us and be part of something EPIC.

If you’re excited about helping customers succeed, bringing software to life through training, and collaborating with an incredible team, we’d love to hear from you!

Apply today and let’s Craft the Future of Energy Software together

title: Senior High-Speed PCB Layout Engineer
description:
Array Labs builds advanced radar systems to help humanity understand and respond to changes across the physical world.
We’re launching a coordinated fleet of radar satellites to create a high-resolution 3D map of the Earth – updated in real time – enabling faster, smarter decision-making for government and commercial organizations supporting disaster response, infrastructure resilience, and mission-critical geopolitical intelligence.
We design and build our satellites end-to-end, producing the world’s most advanced earth observation satellites. Our fleet will deliver unprecedented levels of accuracy, coverage, and responsiveness to power critical insights precisely where they’re needed most.
About the Job
As a Senior High-Speed PCB Layout Engineer, you will own the physical implementation of Array’s high-speed digital and mixed-signal electronics in Altium, translating schematics and performance requirements into layouts and functional designs. Your work will include component placement, constraint-driven routing, stack-up definition, return path and reference plane strategy, and partitioning between sensitive mixed-signal domains and high-speed digital interfaces.
You will partner closely with electrical design, firmware, mechanical, and test engineers to drive layout constraints, reviews, and manufacturing releases. The boards you ship will directly determine signal integrity, power integrity, noise performance, and overall system reliability in the lab and on orbit.
Responsibilities:
  • Own high-speed PCB layout from initial placement through manufacturing release in Altium
  • Define and implement stack-ups, impedance targets, length-matching constraints, and reference plane/return-path strategies for high-speed interfaces
  • Translate schematic intent into layouts that meet signal integrity and power integrity requirements across mixed-signal and digital domains
  • Partner with electrical design, firmware, mechanical, and test engineers to develop layout constraints, run reviews, and de-risk first-pass success
  • Drive DFM/DFT considerations with fabrication and assembly partners, including documentation and release artifacts
Basic Qualifications:
  • B.S. in Electrical Engineering, or a related field with 4+ years of relevant experience
  • Experience in PCB layout, fabrication, and release of high-speed digital and mixed-signal electronics
  • Excellent teamwork and communication skills
  • Learns new concepts rapidly, completely, and in a self-directed manner
  • High levels of self-motivation and personal accountability
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment under significant time constraints
Preferred Skills and Experience:
  • Experience designing high-speed digital and mixed-signal PCB layouts including constraint-driven routing, impedance control, and length matching
  • Comfort with Altium Designer for complex layout and clean manufacturing outputs; familiarity with Allegro and/or OrCAD
  • Experience developing PCB stack-ups and layout constraints for high-speed interfaces and dense, high-performance boards
  • A strong intuition for layout-driven SI/PI behavior, including return paths, reference plane strategy, via transitions, and noise coupling between domains
  • Experience working closely with electrical design engineers to translate schematic intent into layouts that work on the first spin
  • Experience with manufacturing release, DFM/DFT considerations, and collaborating with fabrication and assembly partners
  • Experience supporting lab bring-up and debug alongside design and test engineers, including investigating SI/PI issues observed on hardware
  • Familiarity with SI/PI analysis workflows and tools such as Ansys SIwave, Keysight Power Analyzer, HyperLynx, or Sigrity
  • Experience taking high-performance hardware from prototype through qualification and environmental testing
ITAR Requirements
To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) you must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State
Equal Opportunity Employer
Array Labs is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made on the basis of merit, competence, and job qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by gender, color, race, ethnicity, national origin, sexual orientation, religion, age, gender identity, veteran status, disability status, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status
Interview Process
We will conduct interviews via Google Meet; the typical process takes around 2-4 weeks to complete from start to finish.
Hiring and Compensation Strategy
Our hiring and compensation strategy is simple:
1) find uncommonly good people
2) pay them uncommonly well
You can anticipate competitive pay, with high flexibility between salary and equity-based compensation.
Why Join Array Labs?
Array Labs is launching a constellation of satellites to create the first high-resolution, real-time, three-dimensional model of Earth. Our next-generation satellite technology will offer image quality 60x greater than traditional techniques, profoundly expanding humanity’s ability to understand and respond to events on a global scale.
In forging an affordable, accessible, accurate representation of Earth, our work has the potential to transform the face of dozens of fields, including autonomy, telecommunications, disaster relief, gaming, climate science, defense and construction.

title: Senior Spacecraft Propulsion Components Engineer II
description:
ABOUT ROCKET LAB

Rocket Lab is the end-to-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity’s reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We move fast, build real hardware for meaningful missions, and make the impossible routine. Come shape the future with us.

SPACE SYSTEMS

At Rocket Lab, we’re not just launching rockets — we're building the future of space. Our Space Systems team builds everything from complete spacecraft, precision payloads to the components and subsystems that allow them to thrive in space, like solar panels, flight software, star trackers, optical systems, separation systems, radios, and more.

Our Space Systems team has enabled more than 1,700 missions, ranging from interplanetary exploration, in-space manufacturing to national security and defense initiatives. The team has built spacecraft, payloads, and components for missions to the Moon and Mars, working with partners including NASA, the Space Development Agency, and the U.S. Space Force. Whether it’s a single high-performance spacecraft, constellation, or the vertically integrated components that help them get to space — our world class Space Systems team is empowering some of the boldest and most ambitious space missions.

SENIOR SPACECRAFT PROPULSION COMPONENTS ENGINEER II

We are currently seeking a Senior Spacecraft Propulsion Components Engineer II for our propulsion engineering team based out of Long Beach, CA. As a Propulsion Components Engineer, you are responsible for system-level and component-level ownership of space systems propulsion and fluidic development. These teams support our Space Systems division, and lead cutting-edge programs for civil, commercial, and defense customers.

WHAT YOU’LL GET TO DO:

  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to work well within a team environment
  • Hands-on integration and testing experience (ideally using NI equipment and software)
  • Experience working on propulsion systems utilizing different storable propellants, such as electrical and chemical
  • US citizenship and willingness to obtain a security clearance required, due to program requirements

THESE QUALIFICATIONS WOULD BE NICE TO HAVE:

  • A genuine passion for engineering, curious mindset, and willingness to learn
  • Comfortable working with high levels of ambiguity. Makes decisions using basic engineering principles, available literature and standards, technical risk assessments, test data, and physics-based models
  • Practice in identifying the necessary steps to achieve high level technical goals, scheduling them in a plan, and managing delivery against that plan
  • Experience developing requirement and verification sets, as well as writing test plans, performing testing, and writing test reports
  • Capabilities using Python for data manipulation and post-processing
  • Demonstrated hands on engineering skills, inside or outside the workplace
  • Detailed mechanical design experience using NX (preferred) or equivalent industry standard CAD software
  • Experience with GD&T and engineering drawings
  • Experience using Product Lifecycle Management software such as Teamcenter (preferred), Windchill, or similar
  • Experience using National Instruments data acquisition systems
  • Experience with testing and troubleshooting flight hardware
  • Master's or PhD

This position may require prolonged periods of sitting, standing, walking, computer work, and occasional exposure to moderate levels of noise, dust, and fumes in production areas.

Anticipated annual equity grant value is designed around function, level, experience, and other factors; realized value depends on vesting and stock-price performance.

Join one of the world's fastest-growing space companies and own a piece of it. In addition to competitive base pay, you'll receive company stock as part of your total compensation package, giving you a direct stake in our success. As we expand to new launch sites, groundbreaking missions, and global markets, your ownership has the opportunity to grow alongside the company.

Our comprehensive benefits package includes our industry-leading Employee Stock Purchase Program (with a 15% discount on company stock), top-tier medical plans (HMO, PPO, and a zero cost HDHP option with a significant HSA company contribution), dental and vision coverage, paid vacation and sick time, 11 paid holidays, flexible spending and dependent care accounts, paid parental leave, disability and life insurance, and a 401(k) retirement plan with company match.

Additional perks include subsidized EV charging, onsite fitness centers (where available), discounted gym memberships, complimentary snacks and beverages, 50% employee discount on our popular merch store, and a variety of other employee discounts.

Level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

$165,000—$277,000 USD
Base Salary
$132,000—$220,000 USD

WHAT TO EXPECT

We’re on a mission to unlock the potential of space to improve life on Earth, but that’s not an easy task. It takes hard work, determination, relentless innovation, teamwork, grit, and an unwavering commitment to achieving what others often deem impossible. Our people out-think, out-work, and out-pace. We pride ourselves on having each other’s backs, checking our egos at the door, and rolling up our sleeves on all tasks big and small. We thrive under pressure, work to tight deadlines, and our focus is always on how we can deliver, rather than dwelling on the challenges that stand in the way.

title: Head Account & Finance
description:
Job Description: Head – Accounts & Finance

Department: Accounts & Finance
Location: Plant / Manufacturing Unit [location to be added]
Reports to: Managing Director / Director / CEO
Direct reports: Manager / Sr. Manager Accounts, Finance & Costing, Taxation & Compliance Executives, Accounts Executives, Store & Purchase Accounting Staff
Employment type: Full-time, Permanent
Experience required: 15+ years, with at least 5 years in a leadership role in a manufacturing set-up

1. Position Summary

KBPL is looking for a hands-on and accomplished Head of Accounts & Finance to own and lead the complete finance function of our manufacturing plant. The person will be fully accountable for accurate and timely accounting, statutory compliance, direct and indirect taxation, costing, budgeting, cash flow, and financial reporting, and will guide and supervise the entire accounts and finance team.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical depth in accounting and taxation with a practical understanding of plant operations, and is a leader who can build a disciplined team, strengthen internal controls and act as a trusted financial adviser to top management.

2. Key Responsibilities

A. Accounting & Financial Reporting

• Oversee day-to-day accounting: purchase, sales, journal, bank, cash, fixed assets and inventory accounting, with timely and accurate booking of all entries.

• Ensure monthly, quarterly and annual closing within defined timelines, including accruals, provisions, prepaid items and reconciliations.

• Prepare and review Profit & Loss account, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow Statement and MIS reports for management.

• Ensure books are maintained as per Companies Act, 2013, applicable Accounting Standards (Ind AS / AS) and sound accounting policies.

• Review and ensure regular reconciliation of bank, vendor, customer, inter-unit and GST/TDS ledgers.

• Lead preparation of audit schedules and coordinate statutory, internal, tax and cost audits.

B. Manufacturing Plant Accounting & Costing

• Supervise inventory accounting for raw material, WIP, finished goods, stores and spares; monitor valuation methods and stock reconciliation with physical verification.

• Oversee product costing, BOM-based cost sheets, standard vs actual cost analysis and variance reporting (material, labour, overhead, yield and wastage).

• Monitor production cost, scrap, consumption norms and conversion cost, and recommend cost-reduction measures.

• Ensure accounting of job work, subcontracting, returnable and non-returnable challans, and goods in transit.

• Oversee fixed asset capitalisation, CWIP, depreciation, asset tagging and verification.

• Support pricing, quotation and margin analysis for products and customers.

C. Direct Taxation

• Ensure compliance with the Income Tax Act: advance tax computation and payment, return filing, tax audit (Form 3CA/3CB-3CD), assessments and notice replies.

• Oversee TDS and TCS: correct deduction, deposit, quarterly returns (24Q, 26Q, 27Q), TDS certificates, reconciliation with Form 26AS / AIS, and lower-deduction matters.

• Handle tax planning, deferred tax computation, and transfer pricing compliance where applicable.

• Represent the company before tax authorities, appellate bodies and consultants.

D. Indirect Taxation (GST and others)

• Own end-to-end GST compliance: GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, GSTR-9/9C, ITC reconciliation (GSTR-2A/2B vs books), e-invoicing, e-way bill and RCM compliance.

• Ensure correct classification (HSN), rate application, ITC eligibility, blocked credits and timely ITC utilisation.

• Manage refunds (including export / inverted duty structure), LUT, and compliance for exports and SEZ supplies, where applicable.

• Handle GST audits, departmental queries, show-cause notices, assessments and appeals.

• Keep track of customs, excise-related residuals, professional tax, and other indirect or local levies relevant to the business.

E. Statutory & Regulatory Compliance

• Ensure timely compliance under the Companies Act (ROC filings, board and AGM financial requirements, MSME payment rules including Form MSME-1 and Section 43B(h) implications).

• Oversee PF, ESI, professional tax, labour-welfare and bonus-related financial compliances in coordination with HR.

• Ensure compliance with RBI / FEMA norms for imports, exports, foreign remittances and forex transactions, where applicable.

• Maintain a compliance calendar, monitor due dates and eliminate penalties, interest and notices.

• Track changes in tax, accounting and corporate law and implement them proactively.

F. Budgeting, Forecasting & Financial Planning

• Lead preparation of annual budgets, rolling forecasts and capex plans in coordination with production, procurement and sales.

• Monitor budget vs actual performance and present variance analysis with corrective actions.

• Evaluate capital expenditure proposals, ROI, payback and project feasibility.

• Provide financial inputs for expansion, new product launches, make-or-buy and pricing decisions.

G. Treasury, Working Capital & Banking

• Manage cash flow, fund planning and daily / weekly liquidity position.

• Control working capital: receivables, payables and inventory cycles; drive collections and negotiate vendor credit terms.

• Manage banking relationships, working capital limits, term loans, LC / BG, stock statements, and bank audits and renewals.

• Ensure compliance with loan covenants and lender reporting; manage forex exposure and hedging where relevant.

H. Internal Controls, Audit & Risk Management

• Design, implement and monitor internal financial controls (IFC), SOPs and authorisation matrices across purchase, stores, production, sales and finance.

• Prevent leakages, fraud and errors through regular checks, reviews and system controls.

• Ensure timely closure of audit observations and implement recommendations of internal and statutory auditors.

• Safeguard company assets and ensure correct documentation and approvals for all financial transactions.

I. ERP, Systems & Process Improvement

• Ensure effective use of ERP / accounting software (Tally / SAP / Oracle / Zoho or equivalent) with accurate master data and controls.

• Drive automation of reporting, reconciliations, GST and TDS workflows and MIS dashboards.

• Continuously streamline processes between stores, purchase, production, dispatch and accounts.

J. Team Leadership & Management

• Lead, guide, mentor and supervise the entire accounts and finance team; define roles, targets and accountability.

• Allocate work, review output, set closing and compliance deadlines, and ensure discipline and quality of work.

• Conduct performance appraisals, identify training needs, and build a second line of leadership.

• Build a culture of integrity, ownership, accuracy and timeliness.

K. Management Support & Stakeholder Interface

• Act as financial adviser to the Director / MD and the leadership team, with clear and timely MIS and insights.

• Coordinate with production, purchase, stores, sales, HR and logistics for smooth financial operations.

• Interface with statutory auditors, tax consultants, bankers, lenders, regulators and legal advisers.

• Support due diligence, funding, investor or group reporting requirements as needed.

3. Qualifications & Experience

Essential

• Chartered Accountant (CA) is mandatory. CMA / MBA (Finance) will be an added advantage.

• 15+ years of overall experience in accounts and finance, with a minimum of 5 years as Head / Senior Manager of Finance in a manufacturing plant.

• Proven, hands-on experience in end-to-end accounting, costing, GST, TDS, income tax, statutory audit and compliance.

• Experience leading a finance team of 8-15 members or more.

Preferred

• Experience in mid-size, owner-managed or growing manufacturing companies.

• Exposure to bank funding, export-import transactions, and ERP implementation or migration.

• Experience handling tax assessments, GST audits and litigation.

4. Skills & Competencies

Technical

• Thorough knowledge of the Companies Act, Income Tax Act, GST laws, Accounting Standards, TDS / TCS provisions and cost accounting.

• Strong command of manufacturing accounting, inventory valuation and cost control.

• Advanced proficiency in MS Excel, ERP / accounting software and MIS tools.

• Strong analytical, budgeting and financial modelling skills.

Behavioural

• Strong leadership, people management and decision-making ability.

• High integrity, confidentiality and ethical conduct.

• Hands-on and detail-oriented, with a strategic outlook.

• Excellent communication and presentation skills with senior management, auditors and authorities.

• Ability to work under pressure, meet deadlines and manage multiple priorities.

• Proactive, solution-oriented and process-driven.

5. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

• Monthly book closing within X working days of month end [target to be set, e.g., 7 days].

• 100% timely filing of GST, TDS, Income Tax, PF / ESI and ROC returns with zero penalty or interest.

• Accuracy of financial statements and zero major audit qualifications.

• Reduction in debtor days, inventory days and improvement in working capital cycle.

• Budget vs actual variance within an agreed range.

• Timely and accurate delivery of MIS and costing reports.

• Closure of audit observations within agreed timelines.

• Team performance, attrition, skill development and process improvements.

6. Authority & Accountability

• Full accountability for the plant's accounts, finance, taxation, costing and compliance functions.

• Authority to approve payments, vouchers and finance decisions as per the delegation of authority set by management.

• Authority to recruit, assign, evaluate and recommend rewards or action for finance team members.

• Sign-off on statutory filings, bank submissions and financial statements along with the Director / authorised signatories.

7. Working Conditions

• Based at the manufacturing plant, working regular hours with flexibility during month-end, quarter-end, year-end and audit periods.

• Occasional travel to the head office, banks, consultants, tax offices and other locations.




Requirements

. Qualifications & Experience

Essential

• Chartered Accountant (CA) is mandatory. CMA / MBA (Finance) will be an added advantage.

• 15+ years of overall experience in accounts and finance, with a minimum of 5 years as Head / Senior Manager of Finance in a manufacturing plant.

• Proven, hands-on experience in end-to-end accounting, costing, GST, TDS, income tax, statutory audit and compliance.

• Experience leading a finance team of 8-15 members or more.

Preferred

• Experience in mid-size, owner-managed or growing manufacturing companies.

• Exposure to bank funding, export-import transactions, and ERP implementation or migration.

• Experience handling tax assessments, GST audits and litigation.



Benefits

As per the industry, years of experience and knowledge

As part of our exciting growth, we are currently searching for a Critical Facilities Technician.


Under the direction of the Facility Manager, this position requires extensive hands-on analysis, maintenance and troubleshooting of our 24x7 facility operations within Aligned Data Centers. Work includes installation, repair, and maintenance of critical and non-critical mechanical and/or electrical machinery and controls located in the interior and exterior of building.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES (to include, but not limited to):

  • Maintains, monitors, and performs preventive, predictive, and corrective maintenance on critical and non-critical equipment
  • Mechanical areas to include operation and maintenance of multiple components within the HVAC system, plumbing installation/maintenance, generator operations, fire detection and suppression, life safety, temperature control systems, building management systems, and digital systems (including fire alarm, duress, card access, CCTV).
  • Electrical responsibilities include plan, implement, coordinate and supervision of all electrical operations, maintenance, and energy management programs for a critical facilities environment. Ensure conformance with all Change control development, approvals and execution.
  • Scheduling, development and quality assurance for all preventive maintenance, contracted maintenance, general maintenance.
  • Routinely performs all work in strict accordance with governing MOP/SOP/ERP procedures, and maintenance work instructions.
  • Operates and monitors critical and non-critical system equipment and components. Oversees work efforts (including 3rd party contractors) for safe and compliant operation, maintenance (corrective and preventive), and modification of critical equipment. Disables and enables fire alarm control panels and systems.
  • Receive and execute work orders for preventative and corrective maintenance on critical systems and building physical structure. Consult with Facility Manager or Lead CFT to order necessary materials to complete all maintenance and perform necessary work. Finalize work orders by completing necessary documentation in the computerized maintenance management system.
  • Respond immediately to emergency situations (fire, evacuation, equipment failure, etc.) and customer concerns.
  • Monitors building operations and tours properties periodically during scheduled shift.
  • Receives work order for Preventative and Corrective maintenance on electrical systems and building physical structure. Consult with supervisors and staff as appropriate to identify and order necessary materials to complete all maintenance and perform necessary work. Finalize work orders by completing necessary documentation.
  • Understand the engineering design and operational aspect of all electrical systems.
  • Evaluate, assign and monitor the safe work responsibilities and safety procedures capabilities of employees and contractors.
  • Respond quickly to emergency situations, develop and communicate and improve ADC’s processes to ensure continuous improvement and innovation.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • High school diploma and minimum 3-5 years’ experience in electrical or mechanical critical facilities support; or 7+ years’ experience as HVAC or mechanical/electrical technician.
  • Electrical/Mechanical certifications preferred.
  • Able to work overtime and longer shifts (12 hour).
  • Shifts may require work day/night/weekend/holiday .
  • Computer skills required: MS Office.

Hourly Pay Range: $35.00-45.00.


BENEFITS & PERKS:

  • Health Coverage: Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • Health Savings and Flexible Spending Accounts: HSA with employer contribution for eligible participants. FSA's offered for health and dependent care to increase tax savings.

title: Join Our Talent Network (Non-US)
description:
Skillshare is an online learning community whose mission is to connect curious, lifelong learners everywhere and, in so doing, build a more creative, more generous, and more prosperous world. Millions of members come to Skillshare to explore their creativity, learn new skills, pursue their passions, and learn from inspiring teachers and creators around the world.

And just like our community, we’re always learning, evolving, and looking for talented people who are excited to help us build what’s next.

Requirements

Don't See the Right Role? Let's Stay Connected

Maybe you’ve been following Skillshare for a while. Maybe you’re a member, a teacher, or simply someone who believes in what we’re building. Or maybe you came across us today and thought, I’d love to work there.

If you don’t see an open role that feels like the right fit right now, we’d still love to hear from you.

Join our Talent Network by sharing your resume and telling us a little about yourself, what you’re great at, and the kind of work you’d be excited to do at Skillshare.

As opportunities come up, our team can look back at our Talent Network for people whose experience and interests align with what we’re looking for.

At Skillshare, you could have the opportunity to:

  • Work alongside a small, passionate team of creative thinkers, builders, and problem-solvers.
  • Help shape products and experiences used by millions of curious, creative people around the world.
  • Collaborate across disciplines and have meaningful ownership over your work.
  • Bring new ideas and perspectives to a team that values curiosity, creativity, and continuous learning.
  • Help us build the next chapter of Skillshare.

Joining our Talent Network isn’t an application for a specific position, and we may not have the right opportunity immediately. But when something opens up that looks like a strong match, we’d love to already know who you are.

Benefits

Why Skillshare?

  • Our mission: We’re doing work that matters. We connect lifelong learners around the world and empower people to explore their creativity, develop new skills, and pursue the things they care about.
  • Our team: We’re a passionate, creative, and collaborative group that cares deeply about the work we do and the people we do it with.
  • Your impact: We’re a small team, which means your work matters. You’ll have the opportunity to contribute meaningfully, take ownership, and see the impact of what you build.
  • Flexibility: We believe doing your best work means having the flexibility to live a full life, too. We’re a remote team built around trust, autonomy, and thoughtful collaboration.
  • Your growth: Curiosity is core to who we are. You’ll have opportunities to stretch beyond your lane, learn from people across disciplines, and continue developing your craft.
  • Our benefits: We support our team with benefits designed around flexibility, creativity, learning, and well-being, including unlimited PTO with a required minimum, gender-neutral parental leave, anniversary sabbaticals, and stipends that support creativity, learning, and personal wellness.

Come Build What’s Next With Us

At Skillshare, we believe creativity thrives when different perspectives, experiences, and ideas come together.

We’re committed to building a diverse team and an inclusive environment where people can do meaningful work and feel empowered to contribute. If you’re excited about Skillshare and what we’re building, we’d love to learn more about you.

Share your resume, tell us what you’d love to work on, and let’s stay connected.

title: Community Organiser
company: Friends of the Earth England, Wales and Northern Ireland
description:
Contract Type

Fixed Term


Salary

Regional £31,792 - £34,983 per annum.


Job Description

**Contract Details:** Fixed term contract for 24 months, in relation to funding.

**Hours:** Full time (30 hours over 4 days)

**Location:** Hull – Homebased. The role holder will need to be able to attend frequent meetings and events in person within the location.

**The role:**

Are you passionate about supporting communities to create lasting change? Do you believe that people most affected by climate breakdown, nature loss and inequality should have the power to shape the decisions that affect their lives?

Friends of the Earth is looking for a Community Organiser to work alongside local communities, activists and our local action groups to build power, develop leadership and support community-led campaigns that achieve meaningful local change.

This is an exciting opportunity to help strengthen grassroots organising locally, supporting people to come together around shared priorities and take action on the issues that matter most to them.

**Key Skills and Attributes:**

You’ll be skilled in:

- Relationship Building: Able to build trusted relationships with diverse communities, partner organisations, activists and decision-makers, engaging people around shared priorities and creating inclusive spaces for participation.
- Community Organising and Campaigning: Ability to support communities to identify issues, build collective power and develop campaigns that influence decision-makers and deliver meaningful local change.
- Facilitation and Leadership Development: Skilled in facilitating meetings, workshops and community activities, with the ability to develop the confidence, skills and leadership of others through training, mentoring and support.

**The team:**

The England team is at the heart of grassroots organising at Friends of the Earth and is responsible for supporting nearly 200 Local Action Groups across England to build power and campaign for change.

**Closing date: Wednesday 11th November 2026 (23:59).**

**Please note we only accept applications via the Friends of the Earth Application System.**

We offer a competitive range of benefits, good work/life balance including a 4-day working week with no loss of pay, excellent learning and development opportunities and a vibrant organisational culture.

Our staff body is currently under-representative of People of Colour, LGBTQIA+ people and people with long term conditions or impairments. We are committed to eroding these historic barriers, so as to create a movement in which people from all walks of life see themselves in, and so we particularly encourage you to apply if you belong to one of these groups or sit at multiple intersections of disadvantage. We are committed to the Disability Confident standard and will guarantee an interview to any candidates who declare a disability and who meet the essential criteria for the role.

Friends of the Earth staff who publicly represent Friends of the Earth (including all campaigners) are not allowed to also represent a political party. This is to ensure that there can be no confusion in the minds of the public about Friends of the Earth's party-political independence. Affected staff should also seek permission from the Senior Management Team if they wish to hold a non-public facing official role in a political party. If this is an issue, please do raise this with us as soon as possible.

Friends of the Earth is an international community dedicated to protecting the natural world and the wellbeing of everyone in it. We lead campaigns, provide resources and information, and drive real solutions to the environmental problems facing us all.

title: Solutions Architect
description:
See yourself at Dataminr

Dataminr is seeking a talented and experienced Solutions Architect to join our Customer Success team. In this customer-facing technical role, you will sit between our customers, Product, and Engineering to help organizations aggregate, analyze, and act on threat intelligence to reduce risk. Reporting to the Director of Customer Success Architecture, you will combine strong technical, problem-solving, and account management skills to ensure customers gain real, measurable value from their threat intelligence programs. The ideal candidate brings deep knowledge of threat intelligence and security technologies to resolve problems quickly and provide proactive guidance in a fast-paced environment. This role directly supports customer retention and growth, driving deeper platform usage and scaling solution design best practices across the team.

This is a hybrid role based in either the NYC or DC area, requiring two days a week in our NYC or Arlington, VA based offices unless traveling.

AI Innovation at Dataminr

Working at Dataminr you’ll have the opportunity to tackle the most exciting trends in AI on a daily basis to power a revolutionary product that uncovers critical events around the world as they unfold.

Regenerative AI: our AI technology, ReGenAI, is a new form of generative AI that automatically regenerates real-time Live Event Briefs as events unfold. Learn more here.

Agentic AI: we recently launched our Agentic AI capability, what we’re calling our Intel Agents, that autonomously generates critical context for our clients on real-time events, threats, and risks allowing them to see the clearest, most accurate view of what’s happening on the ground. Learn more here

Multimodal AI: our platform detects events from many different types of data (images, video, sensor data, audio, and text in over 150 languages). Learn more here.

The Opportunity


  • Drive Platform Adoption & Guidance: Train administrator and analyst users across diverse use cases, and, in partnership with Customer Success Managers, deliver workshops, best practice deep dives and architectural reviews that help customers adopt new features and capabilities.
  • Map Requirements & Process Architecture: Lead technical discovery sessions to understand customer goals, workflows and systems, then map processes, intelligence requirements and infrastructure into platform capabilities, data models & automated playbooks and workflows.
  • Integrate Security Ecosystems: Connect third-party security tools and data sources—including SIEM, EDR, SOAR, threat feeds, and STIX/TAXII—with our platforms to support seamless customer workflows.
  • Design Automations & Workflows: Design and build playbooks, integrations, and AI-assisted (agentic) workflows tailored to solve complex customer security challenges.
  • Customer Advocacy & Relationship Building: Build lasting relationships with customers' technical stakeholders and manage communications for service and product requests.
  • Voice of the Customer & Best Practice: Bring customer feedback to Product and Engineering to influence the roadmap and escalate bugs, and develop and maintain best practices, playbooks and documentation for solution design across the team.
  • Mitigate Adoption & Renewal Risks: Spot adoption and renewal risks early in collaboration with Customer Success Managers, while occasionally traveling to customer sites for workshops, implementations, and problem resolution.

What You Bring


At Dataminr, we value you for who you are. We encourage you to apply for this role, even if you don't meet every qualification. Our candidates are reviewed on the basis of their skill and potential to succeed.


  • Core Experience: 3+ years in Customer Success, Support, or a technical role in cybersecurity, threat intelligence, or a related engineering field.
  • Hands-On Technology Expertise: Direct experience with Threat Intelligence Platforms (TIP), SOAR, SIEM, or similar security automation technology, along with a strong background in Linux, network security, and cloud platforms (SaaS/IaaS).
  • Cyber & Threat Intelligence Knowledge: Strong understanding of cybersecurity principles and the threat intelligence lifecycle (PIRs, collection, processing, analysis, dissemination), standard frameworks (MITRE ATT&CK), and sharing standards (STIX/TAXII).
  • Development & Scripting Skills: Experience with Python scripting, REST API integrations, and skilled at troubleshooting network connectivity across varied customer environments.
  • Communication & Stakeholder Management: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with proven ability to explain both business value and technical advantages to analysts, engineers, and senior executives.
  • End-to-End Project Ownership: Proven ability to own projects of increasing complexity from discovery to deployment, working cross-functionally to deliver results.
  • Education & Methodological Execution: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related discipline (or equivalent experience), paired with strong organizational and methodical problem-solving skills.

#LI-WC1

About Dataminr

At Dataminr, we are a mission driven team of talented builders, creators and visionaries who have real-world impact on how organizations are able to respond to events. Dataminr’s groundbreaking, AI-powered, intelligence platform provides organizations with the earliest signals of emerging risks, events, and threats before they unfold. Trusted by two-thirds of the Fortune 50 and half of the Fortune 100, Dataminr’s platform analyzes billions of public data inputs spanning text, image, video, audio and sensor data across 150+ languages, empowering our clients to stay one step ahead in an increasingly complex world where every second counts.

Founded in 2009, we have pioneered the world’s first real-time event detection platform, long before the recent Gen AI ‘boom.’ Dataminr operates all around the world united by our passion to use AI for the greater good, be agents of positive change and put our technology into the hands of clients charged with the responsibility to keep organizations running and keep people safe.

As our employees focus on developing our revolutionary technology, we focus on our employees. Dataminr is proud to offer a variety of flexible work arrangements, offices all over the world to foster collaboration, generous PTO and sick leave, and more, as part of our competitive benefits package aimed at keeping all our employees happy and healthy. Explore all our benefits here.

We believe our differences give us strength. Our employees are empowered to be their best, authentic selves through various opportunities, such as our robust employee resource group (ERG) network, manager development programming, professional development funds, and more.

We serve a global community made up of many cultures and strive to reflect the world and clients we serve, with a workforce built on merit and equity. We actively condemn racism and discrimination in any form. We stand for social good, fostering a culture of allyship, and standing up for those who face systemic barriers to equality. We lead with empathy and strive to be agents of positive change in our company and in our communities.

title: Supply Chain Business Systems Analyst
description:
Applied Intuition, Inc. is powering the future of physical AI. Founded in 2017 and now valued at $15 billion, the Silicon Valley company is creating the digital infrastructure needed to bring intelligence to every moving machine on the planet. Applied Intuition services the automotive, defense, trucking, construction, mining and agriculture industries in three core areas: tools and infrastructure, operating systems, and autonomy. Eighteen of the top 20 global automakers, as well as the United States military and its allies, trust the company’s solutions to deliver physical intelligence. Applied Intuition is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, with offices in Washington, D.C.; San Diego; Ft. Walton Beach, Florida; Ann Arbor, Michigan; London; Stuttgart; Munich; Stockholm; Bangalore; Seoul; and Tokyo. Learn more at .

We are an in-office company, and our expectation is that full-time employees primarily work from their Applied Intuition office 5 days a week. However, we also recognize the importance of flexibility and trust our employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work, starting the day with morning meetings from home before heading to the office, or leaving earlier when needed to accommodate family commitments. This in-office expectation does not apply to contractor positions

About the role

We are looking for a systems-minded procurement professional who thrives in a rapidly evolving environment. The Supply Chain Business Systems Analyst will partner with stakeholders to optimize our ERP environments, building scalable workflows. This role will continue to evolve alongside advancements in AI and automation within the company.

At Applied Intuition, you will:

  • Own product direction for the systems and data that run the end-to-end supply chain

  • Turn a complex map of supply chain elements into clear data models and specs

  • Define and own the workflows and product surfaces for all supplier management mechanisms

  • Define and own the workflows and product surfaces for logistics and trade compliance

  • Partner with IT on technical tradeoffs and system design

  • Work with Supply Chain, Finance, IT, Legal, Program Management, Engineering, Business, and Operations to understand each domain and validate what you build against real workflows

  • Define and track the metrics that prove the product is creating leverage

  • Identify where AI and automation should replace manual process

We're looking for someone who has:

  • Bachelors Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Economics, or related field

  • 7+ years of supply chain systems experience, ideally on data, platform, workflow, or internal tools

  • Ability to work with IT on technical tradeoffs and reason independently about system and data model design

  • Strong written communication: crisp requirements, clear prioritization rationale, and a documented point of view

  • Comfort with ambiguity and a track record of defining structure where none existed

  • Demonstrated ability to ship products with measurable operational impact

  • Experience with ERP or MRP systems in a supply chain or finance context; familiarity with NetSuite and Zip

  • Fluency working directly in underlying data and tables

Nice to Have:

  • Exposure to supply chain, manufacturing, procurement, or logistics operations, whether as a PM or an operator

  • Diverse background supporting both hardware and software products

  • Familiarity with trade compliance, including customs, export controls, and ITAR-regulated programs

  • Experience building LLM-powered applications or agentic workflows

  • Experience in a rapidly evolving startup or high-growth technology environment

Compensation at Applied Intuition for eligible roles includes base salary, equity, and benefits. Base salary is a single component of the total compensation package, which may also include equity in the form of options and/or restricted stock units, comprehensive health, dental, vision, life and disability insurance coverage, 401k retirement benefits with employer match, learning and wellness stipends, and paid time off. Note that benefits are subject to change and may vary based on jurisdiction of employment.

title: Engineer ("Ingeniero/Mantenimiento")
description:
