title: Data Architect
description:
**Purpose**

Turn disparate project and financial data into **clear, proactive insight -** linking trends, early warnings, and predictive signals to decisions made by senior stakeholders and the leadership team. You’ll work _with and around_ existing reporting requirements, adding analysis that explains the “why” and “what next,” not just the “what.”

**Key Outcomes**

- **Early warning:** Detect leading indicators of cost/schedule variance, risk exposure, and delivery slippage before they surface in monthly reporting.
- **Predictive view:** Build light‑weight forecasts and scenarios that quantify impact and recommend mitigations.
- **Decision support:** Deliver concise, executive‑ready narratives (one‑pagers, briefings) that drive action.

**What You’ll Do**

- Analyse large, multi‑source datasets (cost, schedule, risk, change, progress) to uncover trends, drivers, and anomalies.
- Perform **time‑series, regression, variance and sensitivity** analyses; translate results into **clear recommendations**.
- Create **fit‑for‑purpose visuals** (e.g., small-multiple charts, run‑charts, control charts) to evidence findings - no “dashboard factory.”
- Define and track leading **KPIs** and thresholds; set up alerts and watchlists for emerging risks.
- Partner with PMO/Project Controls/Finance to align insights with the reporting cycle and governance forums.
- Improve data quality and consistency; shape simple data models that make recurring analysis faster.

**Flexible working:** We welcome you to ask about the flexibility you need. This might be part-time, remote working, or compressed hours for example. Anyone who applies for a role can ask about flexibility at interview. In return, we will explore what is possible for the role.

### The Ideal Candidate

**What You’ll Bring**

- Strong analytical toolkit: advanced **Excel** (modelling, Power Query, complex formulas), sound statistics, and **storytelling with data**.
- Working knowledge of **Power BI** for light modelling/visuals (deep dashboard development not required).
- Ability to **join the dots** across data, context, and delivery realities; crisp written and verbal communication for senior audiences.
- Experience operating in **fast‑paced project environments** and influencing through evidence.

**Nice to Have (Desirable, not essential)**

- **Project Controls** background (EV, cost & schedule analytics, trends, PMB, WBS) and/or **Finance** (budgeting, forecasting, variance).
- Ability to interpret **Primavera P6** outputs (logic, slippage, float) and link schedule signals to cost/risk.
- Exposure to major **infrastructure** programmes.
- SQL and/or basic **Python/R** for heavier analysis or repeatable workflows
- Demonstrable experience in the development of reports and dashboards to a diverse set of stakeholders in a fast paced environmen
- Highly skilled in mainstream BI tools (including but not limited to Power BI
- Understand and promote data qualit
- Knowledge or experience with Extract Transform Load (ETL
- Knowledge with Azure integration services


### About The Company

The role will work on the HS2 project. HS2 is the UK’s new high speed rail network. It will be a catalyst for economic growth across Britain, freeing up space on the existing railways and connecting 8 out of the UK’s 10 biggest cities with fast, reliable and frequent high speed services

The Skanska | Costain | STRABAG (SCS JV) is delivering the HS2 London Tunnels Contract. Scope of works includes twin-bored tunnels (TBM), SCL tunnels, shaft sinking, bridge demolition and reconstruction, services diversions, earthworks and the construction of site compounds.

You’ll be a welcomed member of the wider team, with opportunities to take on additional responsibility, join our EDI Champions program or support the local community (e.g. as a STEM ambassador).

Your personal and professional development is important to us. We welcome a discussion about how we can support you with further study, or professional membership or attainment for example.

title: Head of Drone Hardware
description:
Applied Intuition, Inc. is powering the future of physical AI. Founded in 2017 and now valued at $15 billion, the Silicon Valley company is creating the digital infrastructure needed to bring intelligence to every moving machine on the planet. Applied Intuition services the automotive, defense, trucking, construction, mining and agriculture industries in three core areas: tools and infrastructure, operating systems, and autonomy. Eighteen of the top 20 global automakers, as well as the United States military and its allies, trust the company’s solutions to deliver physical intelligence. Applied Intuition is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, with offices in Washington, D.C.; San Diego; Ft. Walton Beach, Florida; Ann Arbor, Michigan; London; Stuttgart; Munich; Stockholm; Bangalore; Seoul; and Tokyo. Learn more at .

We are an in-office company, and our expectation is that full-time employees primarily work from their Applied Intuition office 5 days a week. However, we also recognize the importance of flexibility and trust our employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work, starting the day with morning meetings from home before heading to the office, or leaving earlier when needed to accommodate family commitments. This in-office expectation does not apply to contractor positions

About the role

As the Head of Drone Hardware, you will lead and scale the engineering organization responsible for all drone hardware products, from airframe and mechanical structures through full system integration. You will own the hardware roadmap and technical strategy for our drone and autonomy platforms, build and lead a multi-disciplinary team across Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Systems Integration, and Test, and work hands-on with your team through the full product lifecycle, from concept and prototyping through flight test and high-volume production. You will set the technical bar for a team that designs rugged, high-performance hardware, builds it, flies it, breaks it, and makes it better, while partnering directly with customers to deliver on critical commitments.

At Applied Intuition, you will:

  • Build, lead, and scale a multi-disciplinary hardware engineering organization spanning Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Systems Integration, and Test

  • Own the technical roadmap and architecture for all drone hardware products, from airframe and mechanical structures through full autonomy system integration

  • Set technical direction on the tradeoffs between weight, strength, durability, power, and manufacturability that determine whether hardware meets mission requirements

  • Drive projects through the full lifecycle, from 0 to 1 architecture and prototyping through high-volume production

  • Establish and scale the engineering department and processes needed to meet committed customer deliverables on aggressive timelines

  • Lead failure investigations and root cause analysis, and turn lessons learned into design and process improvements across the team

  • Champion design for manufacturability, reliability, and field serviceability across the team’s work

  • Hire, mentor, and grow engineering managers and individual contributors, and build a strong bench of technical leadership

  • Work directly with external customers as a core responsibility, aligning technical requirements and driving customer success

  • Partner cross-functionally with autonomy, software, program management, and manufacturing leaders to ensure hardware designs meet mission requirements

We're looking for someone who has:

  • BS, MS, or PhD in Mechanical Engineering, Product Design, or a related technical field

  • 15+ years of hardware engineering experience with 10+ years leading and scaling engineering teams or departments

  • Deep, hands-on background in mechanical engineering and product design, including structural design, enclosure design, thermal management, and environmental protection for ruggedized systems

  • Experience driving hardware designs through the full lifecycle, from concept and prototyping through high-volume production, with demonstrated expertise in Design for Manufacturing (DFM/DFA)

  • Experience in hardware test and validation methodologies, including environmental stress screening and field or flight testing

  • Proven track record of building, leading, and scaling hardware engineering organizations from the ground up

  • Experience working directly with customers to align technical requirements and drive delivery on committed timelines

Nice to have:

  • Background in Electrical Engineering, including PCB design, schematic capture, and power distribution systems

  • Background in Aeronautical/Aerospace Engineering, with an understanding of what makes an aircraft fly: aerodynamics, stability, and propulsion integration

  • Direct leadership experience in drones, space, uncrewed aerial systems (UAS), or similar complex hardware products

  • Blend of background in consumer electronics combined with experience in defense, automotive, trucking, construction, mining, or agriculture

  • Experience executing committed deliverables for defense programs or major enterprise customers

title: Staff Security Engineer
description:
We’re looking for a Staff Security Engineer to join Procore’s Security Engineering team. In this role, you’ll be a key contributor, focused on building, implementing, and operating the foundational security controls that protect our platform, data, and users. Your primary goal is to help build and maintain a secure, scalable, and resilient cloud product and infrastructure.

As a Staff Security Engineer you’ll work with Engineering, IT, Security Operations, and GRC to apply security principles to our systems. Use your experience in cloud security, automation, and core security principles to implement and operate automated security controls across our SaaS ecosystem. This is a fantastic opportunity to grow your skills and make a real impact on protecting the data of millions of users - Apply today.

This position reports into the Senior Manager, Security Engineering and will be based in our Bengaluru, India office. We’re looking for someone to join us immediately.

What you’ll do:

At Procore, AI isn’t a specialized tool, it's a core competency. We expect every team member to be AI-literate, leveraging generative tools and agentic workflows to move faster and work smarter. You won’t just use AI; you’ll be building the agentic future of construction.

  • Configure and support IAM guardrails for cloud (AWS/GCP/Azure) and corporate (Okta) environments.

  • Implement and support automated pipelines for asset inventory and Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) generation.

  • Support the implementation of data protection tools and processes, including key management and encryption.

  • Implement secure configurations for our containerized (Kubernetes, EKS) and IaC (Terraform) workflows under the guidance of senior engineers.

  • Collaborate with Product & Technology teams to test and document resilience patterns.

  • Assist GRC and Internal Audit teams by gathering data and providing context on security controls.

  • Operate and triage alerts from security tools and platforms, and help drive remediation.

  • Participate in the evaluation of new security technologies and tools. Provide on-call support on a rotational basis

What we’re looking for:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.

  • 8+ years of experience in a hands-on technical security or IT/ops role with a security focus.

  • Solid understanding of core security domains such as IAM, network security, and infrastructure security.

  • Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud provider (AWS preferred).

  • Hands-on experience identifying and exploiting common web/API vulnerabilities (e.g., Burp Suite usage) and secure API design. Proficiency in scripting to automate simple security tasks or checks.

  • Familiarity with identity and access management platforms platforms (IdP, IGA, PAM), joiner-mover-leaver (JML) mechanisms, and concepts (SAML, OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SCIM).

  • Experience with, or a strong desire to learn, IaC (Terraform preferred) and container orchestration (Kubernetes). Understanding of data protection principles, including encryption and key management.

  • A passion for automation and experience with scripting languages (Python, Go, or similar). Good communication skills and a collaborative, team-oriented attitude.

title: Director, Legal - Commercial
description:
About Us
Highland Electric Fleets’ mission is to make electric fleets accessible and affordable for all, enabling communities to realize the benefits of cleaner, quieter and healthier fleets. Highland is North America’s leading provider of Electrification-as-a-Service (EaaS). Founded in 2019, Highland partners with school districts, municipalities, and fleet operators to make the transition to electric fleets simple and affordable.
Highland proudly serves as the Official Electric School Bus Provider of the LA28 Olympic and Paralympic Games and Team USA. From pioneering vehicle-to-grid technology to managing some of the nation’s largest electric school bus fleets, Highland delivers reliable, cost-effective solutions that support local communities and drive the future of transportation.

Summary:

Highland has an opportunity for a seasoned commercial counsel with an entrepreneurial mindset. This Director role reports to the General Counsel and supports our core business in driving revenue contracts with public agencies and transportation firms. The ideal candidate will have at least six years of legal experience, including law firm and in-house roles as well as supervisory experience. The candidate should be comfortable navigating strategic partnerships, drafting and negotiating a variety of commercial contracts, and supporting related financings. Experience in one or more of the following industry areas is strongly preferred: transportation, fleet leasing, or energy services (such as power purchase agreements, battery storage, or energy savings contracts).

The candidate will work in a fast-paced startup environment and will be comfortable taking on an array of matters.   • Draft and negotiate other contracts supporting sales (LOIs, teaming arrangements, license/lease agreements);
  • Provide pragmatic, business-minded guidance on contract-related issues;

  • Support special and ancillary services projects, including stationary storage and other energy optimization solutions; and
  • Supervise one or more attorney(s) and/or legal professional(s) in support of the above responsibilities.
Other responsibilities may include:
  • Support financing and M&A transactions, including collaborating with internal stakeholders on drafting matters, responding to due diligence inquiries, and managing outside counsel;
  • Develop support materials and provide training to educate the sales and origination team members on contract terms and other legal issues;
  • Support continued development of scalable contracting strategies and tools in coordination with legal operations and the commercial team;
  • Tackle new areas of growth and product development; and

  • Excellent commercial negotiation and contract drafting skills
  • Executive-level business acumen and judgment
  • Exceptional accuracy and attention to detail
  • Ability to work flexibly with a variety of internal and external stakeholders and to manage multiple matters simultaneously
  • Prior experience supervising attorneys and/or legal professionals
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States without current or future employer sponsorship

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Industry experience in one or more of the following: transportation, fleet leasing, or energy services
  • Prior experience executing in a fast-paced, high-ambiguity environment
  • Ability and availability to work at least two (2) days a week in-office at the company’s Beverly, MA headquarters*

title: VP Systems Engineering
description:
Fluence (Nasdaq: FLNC) is a global market leader delivering intelligent energy storage and optimization software for renewables and storage. With gigawatts of successful implementations across nearly 50 markets, we are transforming the way we power our world for a more sustainable future. Job Description:

ABOUT THE POSITION

The Vice President, Systems Engineering serves as the executive technical authority for the Product Business Unit and is accountable for ensuring Fluence products perform as fully integrated systems throughout the product lifecycle. Reporting to the Head of Product Business Unit, this leader owns system architecture, requirements management, interface definition, integration, verification and validation, certification, product assurance, global laboratories, Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) testing, and field reliability. The role establishes engineering standards and governance while ensuring alignment across Product Management, Hardware Engineering, Software & Controls Engineering, Program Management, Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain, and Customer Success.

RESPONSIBILITIES INCLUDE

Executive Leadership

  • Develop and execute the long-term Systems Engineering strategy aligned with the Product Business Unit strategy, technology roadmap, and business objectives.
  • Establish the global Systems Engineering operating model, organizational capability roadmap, engineering standards, and technical governance.
  • Lead investment planning for engineering capabilities including digital engineering, MBSE, simulation, laboratories, HIL infrastructure, and engineering productivity.

Technical Authority

  • Serve as the executive technical authority for all commercial product platforms, providing final technical approval for architecture decisions, technical tradeoffs, and release readiness.
  • Chair architecture reviews and technical design reviews while resolving cross-functional engineering conflicts.
  • Own enterprise system architecture, requirements decomposition, interface management, and requirements traceability across the product lifecycle.
  • Ensure platform consistency, modularity, scalability, reuse, and technology standardization.

Product Assurance

  • Own verification and validation strategy, systems integration, certification, functional safety, compliance, and release approval.
  • Lead global laboratories, HIL testing, product validation, and engineering assurance.
  • Drive field reliability, warranty learning, root cause analysis, and corrective action processes.

Product Lifecycle Leadership

  • Provide technical leadership from concept through launch, sustainment, and end-of-life planning.
  • Partner with Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain, and Customer Success to improve product performance and customer satisfaction.

Organizational Leadership

  • Build and lead a world-class global Systems Engineering organization through talent acquisition, succession planning, leadership development, and mentoring.
  • Own organization design, resource planning, engineering KPIs, budget planning, and continuous improvement.

Business Leadership

  • Partner with Product Management to evaluate technology investments, product portfolio decisions, and architecture alternatives balancing cost, performance, quality, manufacturability, and customer value.
  • Represent Fluence with executive leadership, customers, certification agencies, suppliers, and industry organizations.

WHAT WILL OUR IDEAL CANDIDATE BRING TO FLUENCE?

  • 20+ years of engineering leadership in complex product development organizations.
  • 10+ years leading global Systems Engineering teams.
  • Executive-level experience influencing cross-functional organizations and technical strategy.
  • Deep expertise in architecture, systems integration, verification & validation, certification, and reliability.
  • Proven success developing high-performing engineering leaders and organizations.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree in Systems, Electrical, Mechanical, Computer Engineering, or related field required; Master's or PhD preferred.
  • 20+ years of progressive engineering experience including integrated hardware/software products.
  • 10+ years leading global engineering organizations.
  • Expertise in systems architecture, requirements management, MBSE, V&V, certification, and product release.
  • Experience with functional safety, regulatory compliance, reliability engineering, and PLM.
  • Demonstrated success leading complex technical tradeoff decisions and executive stakeholder engagement.
  • Experience building engineering organizations, succession pipelines, and technical capability.
  • Energy storage, industrial automation, automotive, aerospace, or similar complex industry preferred.

EXPERIENCE IN

  • System Architecture
  • Requirements Management
  • Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE)
  • Verification & Validation
  • System Integration
  • Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL)
  • Reliability Engineering

title: Principal Data Quality and Governance Engineer
description:
Position Title: Principal Data Quality and Governance Engineer

Position Type: Regular - Full-Time

Grade: Grade 05

Requisition ID: 44511

In every role, McCainers are ambitious, curious, and passionate about creating exceptional work experiences - together. With a customer-first mindset, we make doing business with McCain easy.

About The Role.

As part of McCain’s digital transformation, we are making significant investments in our data foundations, structures, and policies to improve data quality, strengthen confidence in business decision-making, and generate greater value from data.

The Principal Data Quality and Governance Engineer is responsible for helping ensure that enterprise data is accurate, trusted, secure, discoverable, and well governed. This role leads complex data profiling and quality assessments, operationalizes metadata management and cataloging capabilities, and implements effective access, classification, and data protection controls across enterprise data platforms.

Working closely with business data governance stakeholders, data engineering, architecture, analytics, and security teams, the Principal Data Quality and Governance Engineer enables consistent data practices, reduces data risk, and strengthens the organization’s ability to use data confidently for operations, reporting, analytics, and strategic decision-making.

What You’ll Be Doing.

  • Establish and maintain enterprise data quality frameworks and standards covering data accuracy, completeness, consistency, timeliness, and validity.
  • Lead data quality discovery workshops with business stakeholders and collaborate with data owners, stewards, and technical teams to define quality metrics, key performance indicators, validation processes, and remediation priorities.
  • Perform data profiling, cleansing, validation, and ongoing monitoring using data quality tools, SQL, Python, and AI-enabled anomaly detection capabilities.
  • Lead root-cause analysis and remediation activities for complex data quality issues, using data lineage and transformation details to identify upstream and downstream impacts.
  • Document business rules, validation logic, exception-handling procedures, and quality controls for critical enterprise datasets.
  • Maintain the enterprise data catalog, business and technical metadata, and end-to-end data lineage to reflect new data sources, system enhancements, business terminology, transformations, and architectural changes.
  • Identify and document data transfers across business units, legal entities, systems, and third parties, partnering with data engineers, architects, and business teams to capture associated data flows and transformations.
  • Implement tools and practices that standardize metadata capture, classification, tagging, lineage, and documentation, including AI-enabled auto-classification capabilities that improve data discoverability.
  • Support the implementation and optimization of enterprise data governance, reference data, metadata management, data catalog, and data quality platforms, while driving adoption through training, onboarding, and documentation.
  • Define and maintain enterprise data sensitivity taxonomies and a data protection control framework covering structured and unstructured data, including personal, health, financial, commercially sensitive, and trade-secret information.

What You’ll Need To Be Successful.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Management Information Systems, Engineering, Mathematics, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • At least five years of experience in data governance, data quality, metadata management, or a related data discipline.
  • Proven experience working in a large, matrixed, global organization with multiple business units and regional data environments.
  • Strong understanding of data quality principles, metadata standards, data lineage, data classification, data cataloging, and data protection controls.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead data quality discovery, root-cause analysis, issue remediation, and governance initiatives across cross-functional teams.
  • Strong SQL or Python skills, with experience developing and optimizing queries or scripts for data profiling, validation, monitoring, and analysis.
  • Hands-on experience with enterprise data governance and data management platforms such as Ataccama, Syniti, Collibra, Microsoft Purview, Informatica, or Alation.
  • Experience supporting the implementation, configuration, rollout, and adoption of enterprise data governance, cataloging, reference data, or data quality platforms.
  • Experience with modern cloud data platforms and technologies such as Databricks, Snowflake, or AWS.
  • Ability to establish meaningful metrics and key performance indicators that measure data quality, governance adoption, business impact, catalog coverage, and process compliance.
  • Strong stakeholder-management and communication skills, with experience working with data owners, data stewards, IT teams, business functions, and senior leaders.
  • Ability to operate independently, manage competing priorities, and deliver results in a fast-paced environment with limited supervision.
  • Familiarity with recognized data management and governance frameworks such as DAMA-DMBOK, DCAM, or similar frameworks.
  • Understanding of consumer-packaged goods data, including product hierarchies, SKU proliferation, and regulatory data requirements, is preferred.
  • Familiarity with AI-enabled metadata classification and tagging techniques is preferred.
  • Exposure to AI governance, responsible AI principles, or data requirements for AI and machine-learning use cases is preferred.
  • Artificial Intelligence Governance Professional certification is preferred.

About The Team.

This role is part of McCain’s Global Data Governance team, which enables regional and global business functions to adopt consistent, sustainable, and trusted data practices.

The Principal Data Quality and Governance Engineer operates as an experienced individual contributor and works closely with business data owners, data stewards, data engineering, enterprise architecture, analytics, information security, IT teams, and regional business stakeholders. The role provides technical leadership and subject-matter expertise across data quality, metadata management, lineage, classification, governance technology, and data protection.

title: Software Engineer, AI TCO
description:
Employment Type: Full-TimeWork Setting: United States / Canada
Work Location: RemoteWork Hours: Office hours
Find out more here:

About SemiAnalysis

SemiAnalysis is an independent research and analysis firm specializing in the Semiconductor and AI industries. Our in-depth coverage spans the entire supply chain, from semiconductor fabrication processes to cutting-edge AI Models, software, and infrastructure. We are recognized as the leading authority on the semiconductor supply chain, with the highest concentration of industry experts within one team, and a deep-rooted passion for delving into the intricacies.

We are a global team of analysts, each with extensive networks across the semiconductor supply chain and AI ecosystem, publishing industry shaping articles while participating in numerous conferences annually.

Our newsletters reach more than 200,000 subscribers worldwide, including senior management and c-suite leaders at the leading semiconductor and AI companies.

We also offer three core products:

  • Industry Models – we develop and publish industry models on accelerator shipments, datacentre demand and supply, GPU total cost of ownership, and more. We work with hyperscalers, neoclouds, many of the world’s largest hedge funds, and government agencies.

  • Core Research – our public equity markets product, geared towards financial investors, distils our deep technical research and knowledge into key insights on technology and product trends.

  • Consulting and Technical Due Diligence – We conduct custom research and project work to guide key strategic and investment decisions for the largest private equity funds, leading venture capital firms, companies across the AI ecosystem, and government agencies.

Position Overview

We’re hiring a Software Engineer to build and support the dashboards that deliver our institutional models to clients. Our clients use these dashboards to decide what to buy, what to charge, and what to finance. Every dashboard must be as accurate and reliable as the models behind it.

You will work directly with the analysts who build our models across three dashboards:

  • TCO dashboard: Presents our AI Cloud TCO Model, covering the cost of buying, housing, powering, and financing GPU clusters. It calculates cost per GPU-hour and compares it with rental prices across NVIDIA, AMD, Google TPU, and custom accelerators.

  • Tokenomics dashboard: Presents our AI Tokenomics Model, tracking revenue, token prices, compute spending, and margins at AI labs and clouds.

  • CCM dashboard: Presents our Compute Capital and Markets Model, tracking AI financing deals and debt, GPU rental prices, funding costs, and token return benchmarks across neoclouds, hyperscalers, and AI labs.

This is a full-time, remote software engineering role. You will write code that turns our models into dashboards clients can trust while learning the economics of AI infrastructure. Our team uses AI coding agents every day, and we expect you to use them effectively and check their work.

Responsibilities

  • Help launch the TCO dashboard, then build new views and features across all three dashboards.

  • Load new model releases into the dashboards and develop checks to identify errors before clients see them.

  • Collect and validate data, including component prices, power costs, GPU rental prices, and token prices, while maintaining clear sources.

  • Work directly with analysts to translate model outputs into accurate, reliable dashboards.

  • Learn the models well enough to answer client questions about the numbers.

  • Turn results into charts and short written explanations.

  • Contribute to newsletter articles, with opportunities for direct authorship.

Requirements

  • A degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field.

  • Strong Python or TypeScript skills.

  • Software engineering experience.

  • Demonstrated interest in AI hardware, datacenters, or technology markets through projects, coursework, or work.

  • Ability to use AI coding agents effectively and verify their output.

  • Strong attention to numerical accuracy.

  • Ability to learn quickly and revise work based on feedback.

  • A self-driven approach and pride in the quality of your work.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience with React or Next.js.

Growth Areas

  • Develop expertise in AI infrastructure economics, including GPU cluster costs, cloud pricing, token economics, and financing.

  • Deepen your understanding of how institutional models inform client decisions.

  • Build experience explaining technical and financial results to clients.

  • Develop research and writing skills through newsletter contributions, with opportunities for direct authorship.

title: Sr. Scientist, Lentivirus Upstream Processing
description:
Legend Biotech is a global biotechnology company dedicated to treating and, one day, curing life-threatening diseases. Headquartered in Bridgewater, New Jersey, we are advancing the next generation of cell therapy through a portfolio of innovative technologies, including autologous, allogeneic, and in vivo cell therapy approaches. Our research spans chimeric antigen receptor T-cell (CAR-T), T-cell receptor (TCR-T), natural killer (NK) cell-based therapies, and other emerging platforms designed to transform the treatment of serious diseases. From our global network of research and development sites, we are committed to discovering and developing safe, effective, and cutting-edge therapies for patients worldwide.

Legend Biotech entered into a global collaboration agreement with Johnson & Johnson to jointly develop and commercialize CARVYKTI® (ciltacabtagene autoleucel; cilta-cel). Through this strategic partnership, we combine complementary expertise and capabilities to advance innovative immunotherapies for patients living with multiple myeloma.

Legend Biotech is seeking a Sr. Scientist, Lentivirus Upstream Processing as part of the Technical Development team based in Somerset, NJ.

Role Overview

The Senior Scientist, Lentivirus Upstream Process Development, will be a core technical contributor responsible for designing, executing, and optimizing upstream production processes for lentiviral vectors (LVV) within our innovative pipeline. This role focuses on delivering high-quality, high-titer vector products to support LVV generation and other advanced cell therapy programs. The successful candidate will apply technical expertise in upstream processing (USP)—including seed train optimization, mammalian cell culture (HEK293/HEK293T), large-scale transient transfection, and bioreactor scale-up—to ensure processes are robust, scalable, and phase-appropriate for GMP manufacturing. This position demands a blend of hands-on technical mastery and strong analytical thinking to support project timelines while maintaining a patient-focused approach.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and execute experimental strategies for lentiviral vector upstream production.
  • Perform development and optimization of upstream processes, including seed train expansion, suspension mammalian cell culture (HEK293/HEK293T), plasmid transient transfection optimization, and feed batch/perfusion bioprocessing in stir-tank and rocker bioreactors.
  • Support the establishment and validation of bioreactor scale-up and scale-down models to ensure process comparability and predictability.
  • Support the translation of bench-scale processes to GMP manufacturing, assisting in technology transfer and providing troubleshooting support during clinical production runs.
  • Execute study protocols to define operating parameters, feeding strategies, and performance limits; maintain accurate documentation for USP data.
  • Communicate technical findings, issues, and potential delays to project leads in a timely manner.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional team members, including CMC Project Management and other technical leads, to support project goals.
  • Apply scientific knowledge and technology to optimize vector titer, specific productivity, and quality.
  • Support team activities by providing technical guidance to junior staff, fostering a culture of scientific rigor and continuous improvement.
  • Author and review technical documents, including development reports, SOPs, and relevant sections for regulatory submissions (IND).
  • Work closely with Downstream Process Development and Analytical Development teams to ensure integrated process outcomes.
  • Support tech transfer activities to/from other Legend sites or CDMOs.
  • Ensure compliance with all internal and regulatory requirements.

Requirements

  • Advanced degree (PhD preferred, or MS) in Chemical Engineering, Bioengineering, or a related field.
  • Experience: 5-8 years (PhD) or 8+ years (MS) of experience in process development or manufacturing within a biotech or pharmaceutical setting
  • Hands-on experience in mammalian cell culture (HEK293, HEK293T), seed train expansion, feeding strategy, and transient transfection optimization specifically for viral vectors (Lentivirus preferred).
  • Demonstrated proficiency in developing and implementing bioreactor scale-up and scale-down models.
  • Solid understanding of GMP manufacturing requirements and CMC strategies for early-phase clinical trials.
  • Direct experience with cell and lentiviral vector technologies within the current emerging field.
  • Working knowledge in engineering modeling, mass transfer, and bioprocess optimization.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills; ability to maintain focus and collaborate effectively during challenging development timelines.
  • Analytical and creative thinking.
  • Effective troubleshooting skills.
  • Preferred experience in handling large-scale (>50L, e.g., 200L/500L) upstream bioreactor processes.
  • Language(s):
  • English. Mandarin is a plus.

This is a net new role and the capability that unlocks the team’s future-state vision. The Learning Experience Designer architects the microlearning ecosystem for Relativity’s sales enablement function — building fast, modular, AI-powered content that travels at the speed of the business.

They also own onboarding as a designed, measured program — not a maintenance task. This person serves as the shared content engine for the full team, partnering closely with the Sales Trainer to co-design and co-deliver programs, and with the Director to shape the team’s overall learning model.

Job Description and Requirements

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Design and build microlearning programs across all four workstreams: commercial & tech stack, sales playbooks, role of the seller, and onboarding

  • Own the onboarding program as a designed, role-specific, personalized journey that measurably reduces ramp time

  • Build AI-assisted content pipelines that allow the team to turn ideas into deployed training in days, not weeks

  • Partner with the Sales Trainer to co-design programs — the Trainer brings field insight and delivery expertise, the LXD brings learning architecture and production capability

  • Manage the learning tech stack and ensure content is optimized for Highspot, LMS, Slack, and in-flow delivery

  • Measure content effectiveness through completion rates, assessment scores, and downstream productivity signals

  • Stay current on AI-forward learning tools and bring new capabilities to the team proactively

QUALIFICATIONS

Required

  • 5+ years in instructional design, learning experience design, or content strategy with a sales enablement focus

  • Deep expertise in microlearning design principles, spaced repetition, and modern LXD frameworks

  • Hands-on experience with AI-assisted content creation tools and rapid authoring platforms (Articulate, Arist, or equivalent)

  • Track record of owning onboarding program design — not just maintaining it

  • Strong visual and UX sensibility: ability to build content that is engaging, not just informative

  • Experience integrating learning content into seller workflow tools (Highspot, Slack, Salesforce)

Differentiators (Preferred)

  • Experience in a high-growth SaaS or legal tech environment

  • Familiarity with the e-discovery market or Relativity’s product ecosystem

  • Experience building a content production system from scratch, not inheriting a mature one

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE IN YEAR ONE

  • Onboarding redesigned as a role-specific, measured journey with a documented ramp baseline and improvement target

  • A working AI-assisted content pipeline in place — idea to deployed asset measured in days

  • Microlearning library established and adopted across all four workstreams

  • Content effectiveness reporting running on a regular cadence and informing what gets built next

Relativity is committed to competitive, fair, and equitable compensation practices.

This position is eligible for total compensation which includes a competitive base salary, an annual performance bonus, and long-term incentives.

The expected salary range for this role is between following values:

$116,000 and $174,000

The final offered salary will be based on several factors, including but not limited to the candidate's depth of experience, skill set, qualifications, and internal pay equity. Hiring at the top end of the range would not be typical, to allow for future meaningful salary growth in this position.

Change Management, Content Development, Facilitation, Leadership, Process Improvements, Program Management, Project Management, Stakeholder Management, Strategic Planning, Vendor Management

title: Laboratory and Reliability Engineer
company: CCN26 Spellman High Voltage Electronics Ltd (UK)
description:
About Us

Spellman High Voltage Electronics Corporation, a family owned business for over 75 years, takes pride in powering progress in health, security and quality of life. We are key partners with the world’s leading medical devices, semiconductor, scientific analytics and industrial systems manufacturers. When they want to push the limits of what’s possible with high voltage applications, they turn to us to make it happen.

While Spellman is not a household name, our products are used to make and often power many of the most advanced technologies that make modern life possible. With design and manufacturing sites in North America, Europe and Asia, we have become the preferred provider of high voltage power solutions for OEMs pushing the boundaries of technology around the world by designing and producing the products they need to power progress.

Objetivo / Propósito de la función:
El Ingeniero de Laboratorio y Fiabilidad planificará y ejecutará actividades relacionadas con la fiabilidad, mantenibilidad, fabricabilidad y capacidad de prueba. Las actividades de fiabilidad incluyen asignaciones, modelado, predicciones, análisis FMECA y de efectos, pruebas de vida acelerada, HALT y HASS. Participará activamente en actividades de diseño detallado y mejora de productos, reuniones de intercambio técnico, revisiones de programas/proyectos y soporte a clientes y proveedores.

Desarrollar y ejecutar un plan estratégico para brindar soporte y mejorar continuamente el conocimiento, las habilidades y el entorno de aprendizaje en una organización multinacional de ingeniería y fabricación de tamaño mediano y alta variedad de productos.

Responsabilidades principales:
• Desarrollar predicciones de fiabilidad utilizando metodologías aprobadas para diseños mecánicos y eléctricos, así como para componentes suministrados.
• Interactuar con ingenieros, subcontratistas, proveedores, clientes, gerentes de programa, gerentes de producto, operaciones, calidad global y otras áreas durante la investigación, documentación y resolución de fallos del sistema, así como en la evaluación de productos y diseños (tanto nuevos como existentes).
• Revisar especificaciones, planos y avisos de cambio de ingeniería (ECN); apoyar el desarrollo de productos y el control de configuración; y colaborar con el área de desarrollo de negocios y otras organizaciones según sea necesario.
• Apoyar las revisiones de diseño, las revisiones de preparación para la producción, el desarrollo de nuevos productos y la introducción de nuevos productos.
• Comunicar los resultados de proyectos de modelado basados ​​en datos, tanto en términos del estado de desarrollo como de los hallazgos y acciones operativas en curso.
• Establecer procesos que permitan a otros adoptar y mantener con éxito aplicaciones de modelos bajo una supervisión mínima, y ​​actuar como enlace entre las aplicaciones de datos y los departamentos operativos, así como con ejecutivos y terceros.
• Actuar como traductor estratégico interno, proporcionando verificación independiente y una crítica fundamentada de los análisis de datos realizados por terceros, los análisis internos y otras fuentes de información sobre fiabilidad.
• Traducir conceptos, ideas, nuevos productos y nuevos componentes en modelos cuantitativos claramente definidos y objetivos de optimización de procesos que integren los requisitos tanto del negocio como del usuario.
• Liderar el diseño, la implementación y la evaluación de modelos de datos.
• Cumplir con la Política de Salud, Seguridad y Medio Ambiente, siguiendo los procedimientos e instrucciones de trabajo aplicables a sus actividades para contribuir a los objetivos y metas establecidos.

Competencias / habilidades:
• Certificación ASQ como Ingeniero de Confiabilidad (Reliability Engineer): deseable.
• Experiencia mínima de 3 a 5 años como Ingeniero de Laboratorio y Confiabilidad.
• Competencia sólida en comunicación escrita y verbal.
• Experiencia en Diseño de Experimentos (DOE).
• Amplia experiencia en ensamblaje eléctrico, mecánico y electromecánico, dieléctricos, moldeo por inyección y placas de circuito impreso (PCB).
• Experiencia en la comunicación y presentación de datos y conceptos técnicos ante audiencias con diversos perfiles.
• Habilidades demostradas en análisis cuantitativo y capacidad para trabajar con desarrolladores de aplicaciones, TI, ingeniería de diseño y otras áreas técnicas.
• Experiencia en la norma ISO 13485: deseable.
• Excelente experiencia en SPC (gráficos de control, análisis de Pareto, histogramas, FMEA, etc.).
• Experiencia con HALT y HASS: deseable.
• Inglés: (avanzado).

title: Associate, Strategy & Operations, Merchant Onboarding & Experience
description:
About the Team

The New Vertical Onboarding Strategy & Operations team drives a fast, seamless onboarding experience for merchants across the SMB segments. We collaborate closely with cross-functional partners to enhance visibility, streamline workflows, and reduce onboarding friction through scalable process and product improvements. Our mission is to ensure every merchant launches smoothly and efficiently, powered by data-driven insights and strong operational alignment.

About the Role

The SMB Onboarding Strategy & Operations (S&O) role focuses on improving the end-to-end onboarding experience for small and medium-sized merchants by identifying process inefficiencies, building visibility tools, and driving scalable solutions across cross-functional teams. This role acts as the single-threaded owner for SMB onboarding, ensuring merchants are launched quickly, accurately, and with minimal friction through data-driven insights, process automation, and clear ownership alignment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Process Visibility & SLA Tracking: Build dashboards to monitor true onboarding timelines, identify delays, and surface insights to inform process and tooling improvements.
  • Root Causing Blocked Cases: Develop a shared tracker for blocked cases, analyze trends, and work with cross-functional partners to resolve issues and implement sustainable fixes.
  • Integrations Enablement: Design and refine onboarding workflows for new integration types (e.g., Shopify), and establish scalable processes as SMB Retail expands in 2026.
  • Product & Tooling Guidance: Translate workflow gaps into actionable product requirements for systems like SFDC, and advocate for automation that reduces manual work.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with MXO, GTMT, IA, Sales, and Product to ensure end-to-end alignment on onboarding priorities and execution.
  • Data & Insights: Create and maintain onboarding performance dashboards to measure success and track progress toward SLAs and OKRs.

You will report into the Manager of the Onboarding S&O pod on our Merchant Onboarding & Experience S&O team in our New Verticals Business Development organization.

You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…

  • Drive meaningful impact by transforming how SMB merchants onboard — reducing friction, accelerating launch timelines, and improving the overall merchant experience.
  • Shape strategy and process from the ground up, building visibility tools, performance metrics, and scalable workflows that become the foundation for SMB onboarding excellence.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Sales, Ops, and GTMT to design solutions that balance speed, quality, and automation across the onboarding journey.
  • Own high-visibility problem areas, using data to identify blockers and lead systemic, cross-team improvements that directly impact business growth.
  • Be at the forefront of innovation, helping define the future of merchant onboarding as new integrations, verticals, and tooling capabilities are unlocked in 2026 and beyond

We’re excited about you because…

  • You have 2+ years of experience in a fast-paced environment, where you’ve built and optimized processes from the ground up.
  • You’re proficient in SQL and comfortable using data to uncover insights, measure impact, and inform operational or strategic decisions.
  • You thrive in dynamic, fast-moving environments, adapting quickly while maintaining a high bar for execution and detail.
  • You’re a strong cross-functional collaborator.
  • You’re known for your ability to “herd cats” — driving accountability, clarifying ownership, and keeping complex projects on track amid competing priorities.
  • You possess a strategic and analytical mindset, able to diagnose root causes and translate findings into actionable, scalable solutions.
  • You have exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, capable of influencing without authority across seniority levels and functions.
  • You’re systems- and process-oriented, with a knack for identifying inefficiencies and translating workflow pain points into clear product or tooling requirements.
  • You’re impact-driven, motivated by improving merchant experiences and accelerating business outcomes through operational excellence.
  • You’re energized by ambiguity, eager to define structure, build visibility, and create sustainable frameworks that set the foundation for long-term success.

We expect this position to be filled by 10-17-2026

Compensation

Actual compensation within the pay range listed below will be decided based on factors including, but not limited to, skills, prior relevant experience, and specific work location. Base salary is localized according to employee work location.

DoorDash cares about you and your overall well-being. That’s why we offer a comprehensive benefits package to all regular employees, which includes a 401(k) plan with employer matching, 16 weeks of paid parental leave, wellness benefits, commuter benefits match, paid time off and paid sick leave in compliance with applicable laws (e.g. Colorado Healthy Families and Workplaces Act). DoorDash also offers medical, dental, and vision benefits, 11 paid holidays, disability and basic life insurance, family-forming assistance, and a mental health program, among others.

To learn more about our benefits, visit our careers page here.

See below for paid time off details:

  • For salaried roles: flexible paid time off/vacation, plus 80 hours of paid sick time per year.
  • For hourly roles: vacation accrued at about 1 hour for every 25.97 hours worked (e.g. about 6.7 hours/month if working 40 hours/week; about 3.4 hours/month if working 20 hours/week), and paid sick time accrued at 1 hour for every 30 hours worked (e.g. about 5.8 hours/month if working 40 hours/week; about 2.9 hours/month if working 20 hours/week).
The national base pay range for this position within the United States, including Illinois and Colorado.
$74,800—$110,000 USD

About DoorDash

At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.

DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. description:

title: Functional Consultant
company: o9 Solutions Management India Private Limited
description:
Transforming the Future of Enterprise Planning

At o9, our mission is to be the Most Value-Creating Platform for enterprises by transforming decision-making through our AI-first approach. By integrating siloed planning capabilities and capturing millions—even billions—in value leakage, we help businesses plan smarter and faster.

This not only enhances operational efficiency but also reduces waste, leading to better outcomes for both businesses and the planet. Global leaders like Google, PepsiCo, Walmart, T-Mobile, AB InBev, and Starbucks trust o9 to optimize their supply chains.

Job Title – Functional Consultant

At o9, we invest in people. We seek talented, driven individuals to power our transformative approach. You’ll thrive in a dynamic, supportive environment, growing while making a real impact.

What You’ll Do for Us

The responsibilities include end-to-end solution design, configuration, implementation, data analytics, testing of solutions and communication with internal and external stakeholders.

Design

  • Participate in process and business requirements sessions with client and document to-be business process leveraging industry best practices.

  • Work with clients to identify and collect data, such as historical sales, shipment, inventory, logistics, and other operations / supply chain data from sources like databases, Excel sheets, emails, and others.

  • Ability to convert business logic to technical platform design, including knowledge of platform infrastructure.

Configuration

  • Work closely with architects and directors to develop clear functional and technical design, document data requirements, and build complex datasets.

  • Configure a technical specification document and tool configuration in the o9 platform, as per the design, to solve deep operations / supply chain problems and institute rigorous performance monitoring systems.

Data Analytics

  • Use mathematical models, predictive methods, statistical techniques, optimization algorithms and simulations to analyze, manipulate and interpret large enterprise data and provide business insights and data visualization to the client management.

  • Be proficient in statistical and optimization tools and programming languages to conduct data integration through extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) and create models to generate time series forecasts and operational plans.

Testing

  • Work with internal Research and Development teams to resolve solution gaps and deploy fixes in the customer environment.

  • Create and execute workflow and data analytics test-cases, document issues, and track progress at resolving issues.

  • Ability to design and implement a testing protocol, with support from junior analysts, with the end goal of automating testing.

Communication

  • Work with clients, cross-functional teams, and IT and business stakeholders, to ensure successful planning and execution of projects.

  • Plan, develop and deliver Super User and End User training, for a global user base.

What You’ll Have

Education

Experience

  • 0 - 3 years+ of experience presenting complex topics in a clear, concise, and easily understood manner.

  • Firsthand experience leading a team through the full lifecycle of a supply chain planning solution implementation including business requirement gathering, solution design & development, UAT/SIT, go-live/cutover and value realization is preferred.

Skills and Abilities

  • Ability to identify key insights and critical thinking to prioritize and focus on the highest value opportunities or the biggest risks.

  • Coursework and strong background in mathematics and statistics.

  • Strong verbal, written, presentation and demonstration / training skills are required.

  • Ability to work in teams, distributed across locations and time zones and at executive and junior levels in a corporate hierarchy.

  • English: business communication level.

  • Korean: native level.

More about us…

At o9, transparency and open communication are at the core of our culture. Collaboration thrives across all levels—hierarchy, distance, or function never limit innovation or teamwork. Beyond work, we encourage volunteering opportunities, social impact initiatives, and diverse cultural celebrations.

With a $3.7 billion valuation and a global presence across Dallas, Amsterdam, Barcelona, Madrid, London, Paris, Tokyo, Seoul, and Munich, o9 is among the fastest-growing technology companies in the world. By automating millions of decisions and reducing manual interventions by up to 90%, we empower enterprises to drive profitable growth, reduce inefficiencies, and create lasting value.

o9 is an equal-opportunity employer that values diversity and inclusion. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, ensuring a fair and unbiased hiring process. Join us as we continue our growth journey!

title: Legal Drafting Specialist
description:
Legal Drafting Specialist

Employment Type: Full-Time
Work Schedule: Day Shift
Experience Level: Mid-Level

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Legal Drafting Specialist to provide high-level legal drafting and research support across commercial, corporate, intellectual property, M&A, litigation, and property matters.

This is a legal drafting-focused position, not a general administrative role. The successful candidate will prepare high-quality first drafts based on instructions, precedents, and research, with all work reviewed by supervising solicitors before use.

The role requires strong legal knowledge, excellent written English, exceptional attention to detail, and the ability to understand the legal and commercial intent behind instructions.

Key Responsibilities

Legal & Commercial Drafting

  • Draft and review commercial contracts, agreements, and correspondence.
  • Prepare documentation relating to M&A, corporate structuring, capital raising, shareholders' agreements, and subscription agreements.
  • Draft manufacturing, distribution, supply, SaaS, franchise, and joint venture agreements.
  • Prepare employment contracts, incentive plans, and other corporate documentation.
  • Draft correspondence to clients, counterparties, and third parties.

Intellectual Property

  • Prepare and assist with trade mark applications and IP documentation.
  • Draft IP assignment and licensing agreements.
  • Conduct trade mark and IP searches and prepare summaries.
  • Assist with cease-and-desist correspondence and other IP-related documentation.

Litigation & Dispute Support

  • Draft letters of demand, statements of claim, defences, and legal correspondence.
  • Prepare affidavits, witness statements, and supporting documentation.
  • Assist with court documents, briefs to counsel, and court books.
  • Prepare settlement deeds, costs agreements, and enforcement documentation.
  • Conduct legal research and prepare concise research memoranda.

Property & Corporate Matters

  • Draft and review commercial leases and property documentation.
  • Assist with building and property dispute matters.
  • Conduct property, title, ASIC, and company searches.
  • Prepare company and business structuring documentation.

Legal Research & Administration

  • Conduct research into legislation, case law, regulations, and procedural requirements.
  • Review instructions and identify missing information, risks, or ambiguities.
  • Maintain accurate matter-related documentation and records.

title: Launch Technician - Electrical

Electron is one of the world’s most frequently-launched rockets, and our team behind its success are diligent, move fast, and have each others’ back to deliver a reliable rocket to the launch pad time and time again.ELECTRICAL TECHNICIAN - LAUNCH

As a Electrical Technician - Launch, you will be based in Mahia, Hawkes Bay. In this role you will play an integral part in all launch activities. title: Lead High-Speed PCB Layout Engineer
description:
Array Labs builds advanced radar systems to help humanity understand and respond to changes across the physical world.
We’re launching a coordinated fleet of radar satellites to create a high-resolution 3D map of the Earth – updated in real time – enabling faster, smarter decision-making for government and commercial organizations supporting disaster response, infrastructure resilience, and mission-critical geopolitical intelligence.
We design and build our satellites end-to-end, producing the world’s most advanced earth observation satellites. Our fleet will deliver unprecedented levels of accuracy, coverage, and responsiveness to power critical insights precisely where they’re needed most.
About the Job
As a Lead High-Speed PCB Layout Engineer, you will own the physical implementation of Array’s high-speed digital and mixed-signal electronics in Altium, translating schematics and performance requirements into layouts and functional designs. Your work will include component placement, constraint-driven routing, stack-up definition, return path and reference plane strategy, and partitioning between sensitive mixed-signal domains and high-speed digital interfaces.
You will partner closely with electrical design, firmware, mechanical, and test engineers to drive layout constraints, reviews, and manufacturing releases. The boards you ship will directly determine signal integrity, power integrity, noise performance, and overall system reliability in the lab and on orbit.
Responsibilities:
  • Own high-speed PCB layout from initial placement through manufacturing release in Altium
  • Define and implement stack-ups, impedance targets, length-matching constraints, and reference plane/return-path strategies for high-speed interfaces
  • Translate schematic intent into layouts that meet signal integrity and power integrity requirements across mixed-signal and digital domains
  • Partner with electrical design, firmware, mechanical, and test engineers to develop layout constraints, run reviews, and de-risk first-pass success
  • Drive DFM/DFT considerations with fabrication and assembly partners, including documentation and release artifacts
Basic Qualifications:
  • B.S. in Electrical Engineering, or a related field with 8+ years of relevant experience
  • Experience in PCB layout, fabrication, and release of high-speed digital and mixed-signal electronics
  • Excellent teamwork and communication skills
  • Learns new concepts rapidly, completely, and in a self-directed manner
  • High levels of self-motivation and personal accountability
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment under significant time constraints
Preferred Skills and Experience:
  • Experience designing high-speed digital and mixed-signal PCB layouts including constraint-driven routing, impedance control, and length matching
  • Comfort with Altium Designer for complex layout and clean manufacturing outputs; familiarity with Allegro and/or OrCAD
  • Experience developing PCB stack-ups and layout constraints for high-speed interfaces and dense, high-performance boards
  • A strong intuition for layout-driven SI/PI behavior, including return paths, reference plane strategy, via transitions, and noise coupling between domains
  • Experience working closely with electrical design engineers to translate schematic intent into layouts that work on the first spin
  • Experience with manufacturing release, DFM/DFT considerations, and collaborating with fabrication and assembly partners
  • Experience supporting lab bring-up and debug alongside design and test engineers, including investigating SI/PI issues observed on hardware
  • Familiarity with SI/PI analysis workflows and tools such as Ansys SIwave, Keysight Power Analyzer, HyperLynx, or Sigrity
  • Experience taking high-performance hardware from prototype through qualification and environmental testing
ITAR Requirements:
  • To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) you must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State
Equal Opportunity Employer:
  • Array Labs is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made on the basis of merit, competence, and job qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by gender, color, race, ethnicity, national origin, sexual orientation, religion, age, gender identity, veteran status, disability status, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status
Interview Process
We will conduct interviews via Google Meet; the typical process takes around 2-4 weeks to complete from start to finish.
Hiring and Compensation Strategy
Our hiring and compensation strategy is simple:
1) find uncommonly good people
2) pay them uncommonly well
You can anticipate competitive pay, with high flexibility between salary and equity-based compensation.
Why Join Array Labs?
Array Labs is launching a constellation of satellites to create the first high-resolution, real-time, three-dimensional model of Earth. Our next-generation satellite technology will offer image quality 60x greater than traditional techniques, profoundly expanding humanity’s ability to understand and respond to events on a global scale.
In forging an affordable, accessible, accurate representation of Earth, our work has the potential to transform the face of dozens of fields, including autonomy, telecommunications, disaster relief, gaming, climate science, defense and construction.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Senior Data Engineer

Salary - $125,000 (Chicago)


About Retail Insight


At Retail Insight, we're transforming the way some of the world's biggest retailers and CPG brands use data, analytics and technology to make smarter decisions.


Our people are at the heart of what we do. We bring together talented people with different experiences, perspectives and expertise to solve complex problems, challenge the status quo and make a real impact for our clients.


We're growing, and we're looking for a Senior Data Engineer to join our Engineering team.



About the role


We're looking for an experienced Senior Data Engineer to build and support the reliable, scalable data systems that power our solutions for US retail clients.


As our US client portfolio grows, you'll work with complex data environments, helping translate business requirements into practical technical solutions. Working closely with our Chicago-based Lead Data Engineer, alongside data scientists, analysts and product teams, you'll build data pipelines and products that help our clients make better decisions.


This is a hands-on role combining strong technical skills with collaboration and clear communication. You'll contribute to the evolution of our data platform, improve reliability and performance, and help maintain high engineering standards.


You'll also work with colleagues and client stakeholders to understand their needs and support successful delivery.



What you'll be doing


  • Building and maintaining scalable data pipelines, developing and optimising batch and streaming workflows for reliability and performance.
  • Contributing to the design and implementation of data architecture.
  • Implementing data quality checks, monitoring and observability across pipelines.
  • Applying security, access control and governance standards established by our platform team.
  • Collaborating with data scientists and analysts to deliver data products that support their work.
  • Working with the Lead Data Engineer to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
  • Participating in code reviews, setting a high bar for engineering quality and contributing to team standards.
  • Helping identify opportunities to optimise cloud costs and platform performance.
  • Contributing to platform documentation, tooling choices and continuous improvement.



What we’re looking for


  • Solid, demonstrable experience in data engineering, including building and maintaining production-grade Databricks pipelines.
  • Experience with Databricks Unity Catalog and Databricks Asset Bundles.
  • Strong hands-on knowledge of Apache Spark, Delta Lake and Databricks Workflows.
  • Proficiency in Python and SQL, with a good understanding of data modelling, ETL/ELT patterns and distributed data processing.
  • Experience with Azure data platforms, including Azure Data Factory, ADLS Gen2 and Azure DevOps, or equivalent services on AWS or GCP.
  • Experience implementing data quality checks and pipeline monitoring.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with technical and non-technical colleagues.
  • A collaborative approach, ownership of quality outcomes and a drive to learn and improve.
  • A degree in computer science, data engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Willingness to travel as required.


Bonus points if you also have


  • Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform or Bicep.
  • Familiarity with dbt or similar data transformation frameworks.
  • Exposure to real-time streaming technologies such as Kafka or Event Hubs.
  • Exposure to retail or consumer packaged goods (CPG) data, such as point of sale, inventory or supply chain.
  • Experience working directly with clients.



Some of our extras...


We believe in flexibility, growth, and taking care of our people, both in and out of the office.


Hybrid & Flexible Working: Work from anywhere benefits, plus summer hours and extra days off for life’s big moments (including your birthday and wedding).


Generous Time Off: 26 days PTO (accrued with service), paid volunteer days, and full support for your wellbeing, including mental health resources.


Career & Learning: Access to a top-tier learning platform, career progression plans, and support to create your ideal home workspace.


Health & Financial Benefits: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, plus a 6% matched retirement plan.


Personal Perks: Annual phone reimbursement, onsite gym access, and customizable benefits via our online platform.


Plus much more!



Our Interview Process


Our interview process may vary slightly depending on the role. We’ll always let you know what to expect at each stage and give you plenty of opportunities to ask questions along the way.


People Team Introduction and Cultural Drivers Interview

An initial conversation with a member of our People Team to learn more about you, your experience and what you’re looking for in your next role. We’ll also introduce you to Retail Insight and explain the opportunity and interview process. During the call, we’ll ask interview questions based on our cultural drivers to understand how your values, behaviours and ways of working align with ours.


Role and Technical Interview

This stage explores your experience and the skills most relevant to the role, as well as how you approach your work. Depending on the position, it may include a practical task, presentation or technical assessment. We’ll always explain what’s involved in advance.


Senior Leadership Coffee Chat

The final stage is an informal coffee chat with a member of our senior leadership team. It’s an opportunity to learn more about our business and culture, ask any remaining questions and make sure Retail Insight feels like the right fit for you.



Be your authentic self - Retail Insight is committed to promoting equal opportunities in employment. All employees and any job applicants will receive equal treatment. We actively seek to create an environment where everyone feels respected, supported, and encouraged to contribute their best work.

title: Workers' Compensation Excess/SDF Claims Specialist

title: Kirketjener til Folkekirken Vesterbro
description:
- med base i Kristkirken
Fuldtidsstilling Trives du med skiftende arbejdstider – også aften og weekend – og med meget varierede opgaver? Og sætter du en ære i at skabe orden, gode rammer og en varm velkomst for alle, der træder ind ad døren?
Så er du måske vores nye kirketjener i Folkekirken Vesterbro, med base i Kristkirken!

Om stedet

Kristkirken er et levende hus med mange børnefamilier, konfirmander og daglige besøgende. Som kirketjener møder du ofte børn og forældre i hverdagen, men du skal ikke stå for indholdet i kirkelige aktiviteter eller undervisning. Din rolle er at skabe trygge, praktiske og velkomne rammer omkring kirkens liv.

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være:

  • rengøring, oprydning og løbende praktisk drift
  • klargøring og medvirken til gudstjenester, kirkelige handlinger og arrangementer
  • indkøb og forsyning af varer
  • kontakt til brugere, frivillige og samarbejdspartnere
  • at tage godt imod gæster – også dem der “bare kommer forbi”


Vi søger en kollega der:

  • trives i et hus med mange mennesker, hvor hverdagen sjældent er ens
  • sætter en ære i praktisk arbejde – herunder rengøring, klargøring og oprydning
  • er imødekommende og kan være kirkens ansigt udadtil over for gæster, frivillige og samarbejdspartnere
  • taler i øjenhøjde med både små og store
  • arbejder selvstændigt og har blik for, hvad der skal gøres – også før andre ser det
  • kan koordinere opgaver med kollegaer og frivillige
  • har situationsfornemmelse og ved, hvornår en samtale bør henvises til en præst
  • møder andre med respekt – også når der er travlt
  • trives med at ca. halvdelen af arbejdstiden består af rengøring.

Vi lægger vægt på dine personlige og sociale kompetencer. Din uddannelsesmæssige baggrund er mindre vigtig. Hvis du allerede har kirketjeneruddannelsen, er det dog et plus.


Vi kan byde på:

  • gode kollegaer og en hverdag præget af samarbejde, engagement og fælles ansvar
  • en arbejdsplads, hvor dit praktiske arbejde er med til at skabe velfungerende rammer for husets aktiviteter
  • en nærværende daglig ledelse, som er ansat til opgaven og kan kontaktes alle ugens dage
  • fokus på balance mellem arbejde og privatliv, blandt andet med mulighed for at tilpasse arbejdstiden ved særlige behov
  • en stor og mangfoldig kirkelig arbejdsplads med en varieret hverdag, mange samarbejdsflader og opgaver tæt på mennesker
Har du lyst til at være en del af et engageret fællesskab, hvor praktisk sans, gæstfrihed og samarbejde gør en forskel hver dag? Så glæder vi os til at høre fra dig.

Arbejdstider
Der er skiftende arbejdstider, som varsles ca. 30 dage i forvejen. Du forventes i høj grad selv at kunne strukturere dine opgaver og arbejdstid omkring de aktiviteter, du medvirker i.

  • Fast ugentlig fridag fredag (kan evt. aftales til anden hverdag)
  • Yderligere én fleksibel fridag pr. uge, som kan skubbes til andre uger
  • Ca. hver 4. uge kan to fleksible fridage samles til sammenhængende lørdag–søndag
Eksempel på fire uger:

  • Uge 1: Fri torsdag og fredag
  • Uge 2: Fri fredag
  • Uge 3: Fri torsdag og fredag
  • Uge 4: Fri fredag, lørdag og søndag

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår
Arbejdstiden udgør gennemsnitligt 37 timer pr. uge.

Ansættelse sker i henhold til Fællesoverenskomsten mellem Finansministeriet og CO10 samt Organisationsaftale mellem Kirkeministeriet og CO10. Årslønnen aftales inden for intervallet 255.000 kr. – 321.112 kr. i grundbeløb pr. 31.marts 2012. Dertil kommer OK18-tillæg på 1.100 kr. samt rådighedstillæg på 26.100 kr. i grundbeløb pr. 31.marts 2012. I nutidskroner svarer det til en samlet årsløn i intervallet 359.298,17 kr. – 442.013,40 kr. pr. 1. august 2026 for en fuldtidsstilling. Aftalerne kan ses på www.folkekirkenspersonale.dk.

Nuværende tjenestemandsansatte kirketjenere kan bevare deres tjenestemandsstatus ved ansættelse med direkte overgang. Der skal i så fald ske en klassificering af stillingen.

Der vil blive indhentet børneattest i forbindelse med ansættelsen.

Ansøgning
Du bedes sende din ansøgning via linket i dette opslag senest 4. november 2026 – bilag skal vedlægges som pdf-filer.

Vi forventer at afholde samtaler i uge 47.

Stillingen er ledig til besættelse snarest muligt.

Folkekirken Vesterbro er Danmarks største sogn. Menighedsrådet har høje ambitioner og stærkt fokus på at være relevant kirke for folk på Vesterbro. For at møde forskellighederne på Vesterbro arbejder kirkerne med at udvikle forskellige profiler inden for en fælles ramme. Kirkerne drives og bæres af frivillige kræfter i tæt samspil med 14 præster og ca. 50 medarbejdere.
