title: Manufacturing Process & Equipment Engineer
description:
Divergent is building the new industrial age. Every day, our teams design, manufacture, and assemble advanced systems for some of the world’s most demanding industries. Our integrated engineering and manufacturing platform transforms complex designs into production-ready solutions, helping customers move faster, build smarter, and deliver critical systems when they matter most. Divergent is a qualified Tier 1 supplier to global automotive OEMs and supports leading U.S. aerospace and defense companies.

Join us and help push the boundaries of what can be built.

Purpose

Join our mission to redefine aerospace and automotive manufacturing through advanced Additive Manufacturing. We are seeking a hands-on Manufacturing Process & Equipment Engineer to help transition next-generation Laser Powder Bed Fusion (L-PBF) production equipment from development into high-volume manufacturing.

This role helps ensure our production equipment is stable, reliable, scalable, and capable of delivering world-class safety, quality, delivery, and cost performance. As our manufacturing footprint expands across multiple factories, you will solve equipment problems at the machine level and help transform those solutions into engineering standards deployed across the entire fleet.

Success in this role requires strong troubleshooting skills, independent technical judgment, and the drive to grow into broader fleet-level ownership. You will work alongside senior equipment engineers to stabilize new machines, improve reliability, and build the standards that carry the fleet as it scales.

The Role

As a Manufacturing Process & Equipment Engineer (known internally as Additive Manufacturing Equipment Engineer II), you will take technical responsibility for assigned production equipment after engineering qualification. You will work at the intersection of equipment engineering, manufacturing, quality, reliability, and operations, applying independent judgment to solve complex problems and improving standard work with input from your manager and senior engineers.

You will:

  • Support the transition of newly developed production equipment from qualification into sustained manufacturing.
  • Drive improvements in equipment reliability, throughput, yield, and overall equipment effectiveness (OEE) on assigned machines.
  • Troubleshoot mechanical, electrical, controls, and process-related issues affecting production, adapting established methods to new problems.
  • Apply and improve engineering standards that ensure consistency across production assets.
  • Provide production feedback to design engineering on machine performance and reliability.
  • Support technical investigations and Root Cause Corrective Actions (RCCA) for equipment failures.
  • Contribute to cost reduction through equipment optimization and process improvements.
  • Support capital equipment installation, commissioning, and production readiness activities.
  • Act as a technical resource for operators, technicians, and peers.

Equipment Performance & Machine Ownership

  • Take technical responsibility for assigned production L-PBF equipment following Operational Qualification (OQ).
  • Track performance against established baselines and improve machine capability across safety, quality, delivery, and cost.
  • Execute standardized equipment configurations and flag deviations between machines and factories.
  • Contribute to engineering standards supporting future factory deployments.

Troubleshooting & Reliability Engineering

  • Troubleshoot equipment issues involving mechanical, electrical, controls, software, and process interactions.
  • Perform root cause investigations using structured engineering methodologies.
  • Implement corrective actions that eliminate recurring failures.
  • Improve preventative maintenance procedures based on equipment performance, with manager input.

Process & Manufacturing Optimization

  • Improve L-PBF equipment capability to increase throughput, yield, dimensional accuracy, and repeatability.
  • Implement engineering solutions that increase machine utilization and operational efficiency.
  • Support qualification and validation activities for new equipment, process changes, and manufacturing improvements.

Engineering Collaboration & Equipment Development

  • Provide structured production feedback to equipment design teams on machine performance, serviceability, and manufacturability.
  • Collaborate with controls, software, mechanical, electrical, and systems engineers to resolve technical challenges.
  • Support Design for Manufacturability (DFM) and Design for Reliability (DFR) initiatives.

Fleet Standards & Technical Documentation

  • Develop and improve standard work, maintenance procedures, and calibration documentation with manager input.
  • Support configuration management and engineering change implementation across the production fleet.
  • Document lessons learned so they can be institutionalized into future machine deployments.

Quality & Compliance

  • Support qualification of additive manufacturing equipment and processes to aerospace and automotive quality requirements.
  • Support Quality Engineering during audits, customer reviews, and process validation activities.
  • Analyze manufacturing defects and equipment-related quality issues and implement engineering solutions.
  • Follow AS9100, AMS, PPAP, and internal quality system requirements.

Capital Equipment & Factory Expansion

  • Execute assigned scopes within capital equipment projects supporting factory growth.
  • Support factory acceptance testing (FAT), site acceptance testing (SAT), commissioning, and production ramp activities.
  • Contribute to technical readiness plans ensuring new equipment achieves production targets rapidly.

Basic Qualifications

  • Ability to lawfully access information and technology that is subject to US export controls
  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, or related discipline.
  • 4–6 years of experience in manufacturing engineering, equipment engineering, reliability engineering, or advanced production environments.
  • Experience supporting the launch or ramp of production equipment or processes.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills across mechanical, electrical, and/or controls systems.
  • Experience with structured root cause analysis methodologies (e.g., RCCA, 5 Whys, Fishbone).
  • Ability to work cross-functionally with engineering, operations, quality, and maintenance teams.
  • Strong analytical and data-driven decision-making skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Laser Powder Bed Fusion (L-PBF) or other metal additive manufacturing technologies.
  • Experience in aerospace, automotive, semiconductor, or other high-volume precision manufacturing environments.
  • Knowledge of AS9100, AMS, PPAP, APQP, or equivalent quality systems.
  • Exposure to equipment reliability engineering, OEE improvement, or preventative maintenance programs.
  • Experience working with machine sensor data or manufacturing analytics.
  • Experience with controls systems, PLCs, industrial automation, or machine integration.
  • Experience supporting capital equipment installation or commissioning.

Compensation

At Divergent, our pay range is based on the level of the job. For this role, we will consider candidates at levels E04 - E05 as evaluated through our interview process.

  • Engineer II / E04: $111,300 - $153,040
  • Sr. Engineer / E05: $128,520 - $176,720

$111,300—$176,720 USD

What We Offer:

  • Holistic Compensation Package: Enjoy a world-class compensation package that includes a competitive salary, equity plan, and discretionary results-based incentive bonus opportunities, ensuring you're truly valued for your contributions.
  • Wellness and Time Off: Embrace a healthy lifestyle with paid vacation, sick time, and company holidays, including a year-end shutdown to recharge. We support growing families with paid parental leave, recognizing the importance of bonding time.
  • Comprehensive Health and Wellness: Prioritize your well-being with our comprehensive health and wellness benefits, offering both HMO and Premium PPO options. Additionally, benefit from company-sponsored life insurance and short and long-term disability coverage for peace of mind.
  • Investment in Growth: We're committed to your professional development. Take advantage of reimbursement opportunities for learning and development initiatives, empowering you to continuously expand your skill set and reach peak performance.
  • Collaborative and High-Performing Environment: Join our collaborative, dynamic, and high-performing team within a fast-paced, mission-driven company. Together, we're disrupting the traditional manufacturing industry, fostering innovation, and integrating people and technology to reduce our footprint.

title: Post-Doctoral Research Associate
description:
**Grade UE07: £41,064 - £48,822 per annum pro-rata if part-time**

**Institute of Genetics and Cancer**

**Full-time: 35 hours per week**

**Fixed term: for 24 months in the first instance**

**The Opportunity:**

Cancer Grand Challenges – from DNA damage to the mechanisms of mutagenesis

We are looking to employ a post-doctoral researcher to join the group of Professor Martin Taylor at the Institute of Genetics and Cancer (IGC), working to understand the mechanisms that drive mutagenesis. In this post you will be a key member of the international [**Cancer Grand Challenges CAUSE team**](https://www.cancergrandchallenges.org/cause) mechanistically relating DNA damage to the mutations it generates. This is pioneering research in a highly collaborative international team embedded within a well-supported, collegiate and enthusiastic research group.

This specific role is will drive the development and application of technologies to enrich for and map DNA damage and modifications within the human genome. You will explore how that damage is processed leading to repair, mutagenesis or damage tolerance. Within the IGC you will be co-supervised by biochemist Dr Tom Deegan.

The successful candidate will have experience in molecular biology and nucleic acid manipulation along with core biochemistry techniques including protein purification. You will have ownership of your own projects and work closely with experts in the analysis of high-throughput sequencing and mass-spectrometry data, familiarity with such platforms would be an advantage.

The post holder will have many opportunities for multidisciplinary collaborative working both within the IGC and with CAUSE partners based at the Sanger Institute, Hubrecht Institute, Harvard University, University of San Diego and University of Minnesota. The wider Cancer Grand Challenge community will also provide excellent opportunities for training, professional and network development.

Applicants must have a PhD in molecular biology, biochemistry or a related discipline for appointment at Research Associate level. Applicants close to completion of their PhDs will also be considered where experience is directly relevant. Please see the job description and person specification document associated with this advert for the full list of criteria.

This post is full-time (35 hours per week); however, we are open to considering part-time or flexible working patterns. Initially a 24-month contract is offered, with the possibility of extension.

Reporting to the EVP, Treasury and Financial Operations, this executive will oversee all statutory financial reporting activities, drive process improvements, manage regulatory filings, and ensure compliance with NAIC and state insurance regulations. This opportunity is ideal for a collaborative finance leader who combines strong technical accounting expertise with exceptional project management, team development, and stakeholder engagement skills.

title: Director, Partner Content Strategy
description:
Risepoint is an education technology company that helps regional universities launch and grow online programs for modern learners. Risepoint supports more than 100 universities and colleges across five countries, with programs concentrated in high-demand fields including nursing, healthcare, teaching, business, technology, and public service. Our suite of products and services supports the full student journey and each university’s long-term goals. Together, we increase access to affordable education that delivers a strong return on investment for learners and meets employer and community needs. Learn more at risepoint.com.


The Impact You Will Make

As Director, Partner Content Strategy, you will lead and evolve Risepoint’s partner content strategy function from the ground up, lead a team of roughly 10 across the Partner Content and Brand teams, and define how partner content strategy connects with every channel team it depends on and serves — SEO, Paid Media, Lifecycle, Digital Experience, and Field Marketing — across an 80+ university partner portfolio.

How You Will Bring Our Mission to Life

What You Will Do

  • Lead and evolve Risepoint’s partner content strategy function, aligning the operating model, org structure, and workflows for the Partner Content and Brand teams with broader strategy, and partnering with channel teams to align partner content strategy across the portfolio.
  • Integrate evolving SEO, AEO/GEO, and AI search practices into all partner content plans, briefs, and templates. Partner with SEO leadership to co-lead AI search imperatives, testing, and future partner content strategies, ensuring partner content is built to be discovered and cited by both traditional search engines and AI agents.
  • Set quarterly partner content priorities based on partner needs, SEO/AEO insights and imperatives, funnel performance, and the broader marketing roadmap, and own a strategic mix of partner content across formats — program and degree partner content, articles, brand storytelling, guides, FAQs, and more.
  • Help evolve new partner content operating models (intake processes, briefing systems, editorial calendars, and prioritization frameworks) that let a lean team scale high-quality, AI-assisted partner content production across an 80+ partner portfolio. Own governance for partner content refresh, archiving, and quality standards.
  • Lead, grow, and develop the Partner Content and Brand teams (~10 people, including two people-manager direct reports).
  • Own adoption of AI-enabled partner content tools, increasing output and speed without sacrificing quality or brand voice.
  • Evolve and own the recurring forums, rituals, and governance (planning cycles, cross-team reviews, shared roadmaps) that keep partner content strategy continuously aligned with SEO, Paid Media, Lifecycle, Digital Experience, and Field Marketing as those channels evolve.
  • Partner with Analytics to define and implement measurement frameworks to track and optimize partner content performance across search visibility, AI citation/visibility, and enrollment funnel impact.

What Success Looks Like

  • A fully operational partner content strategy function with clear roles, workflows, and regular check-ins across every channel team.
  • Partner Content consistently discovered and cited by both traditional search engines and AI agents, with SEO, AEO/GEO, and AI search practices built into every partner content plan, brief, and template.
  • Partner Content strategy staying aligned with SEO, Paid Media, Lifecycle, Digital Experience, and Field Marketing as those channels evolve.

How Impact Will be Measured

  • Partner Content and Brand teams staffed correctly, structured, and operating against a clear content strategy operating model.
  • Regular optimizations set up with SEO, Paid Media, Lifecycle, Digital Experience, and Field Marketing to keep everyone connected.
  • AI-assisted partner content production workflows implemented and adopted across the team, with clear ownership for ongoing improvement.

What You’ll Bring to the Team

Experience That Matters Most

  • 8+ years in content strategy, SEO/AEO-driven content leadership, or digital marketing.
  • 4+ years managing people managers and cross-functional content teams.
  • Experience operating within a large, multi-stakeholder or multi-brand organization.
  • Advanced SEO/AEO/GEO expertise and experience adopting AI content production tools.

Experience That’s Great to Have

  • Master’s degree in Marketing, Communications, or a related field.
  • Experience building or scaling a content operations function from scratch.
  • Background in higher education, EdTech, or multi-brand marketing.
  • Familiarity with CMP, DAM, or AI content tooling at scale.

Risepoint is an equal-opportunity employer and supports a diverse and inclusive workforce.

title: Brand & Editorial Marketer
description:
Who We Are

🏔Product: TLDR’s mission is to increase tech's signal-to-noise ratio.

Today that means the largest network of tech newsletters in the world, with over 8M subscribers covering startups, software engineering, AI, cybersecurity, product, and more. What makes it work is who writes it. Every issue comes from people building in tech, not reporters covering it. Our writers keep their day jobs: two engineers at Coinbase write TLDR Crypto, engineers at DeepMind and Meta write TLDR Dev, researchers at Anthropic and Adobe write TLDR AI, and robotics and datacenter strategy leads at OpenAI and Meta write TLDR Hardware.

If it matters in tech, it's in TLDR. That's what makes TLDR the best place to find what you need to learn.

💪Team: Our 31-person full-time team includes alumni of TikTok, Reddit, Amazon, Business Insider, Asana, Morning Brew, and Pinterest. We've stayed intentionally small, which means every person here owns a function rather than a slice of one.

📈Traction: We're bootstrapped, profitable, and on track for $35M in revenue this year - after $9M in 2024 and $20M in 2025. The advertisers who fund it want tech's decision-makers: AWS, Google Cloud, Anthropic, Slack, Notion, and GitHub.

About the Role

Every week, TLDR reaches millions of technical and business readers by distilling the industry’s news into something worth reading. We’ve built real authority, but we haven’t yet built a content engine that puts TLDR’s own data, insights, and perspective front and center.

As our Brand & Editorial Marketer, you’ll build it. You’ll turn positioning and audience insights into compelling content that strengthens the TLDR brand, supports Sales, and helps us test new narratives and channels.

This is our first dedicated brand and editorial hire! You’ll report to the VP of Marketing and work closely with Growth, Product Marketing, and Demand Generation.

In this role, you will:

  • Define TLDR’s voice. Turn our positioning into a clear brand story, own our voice and tone guidelines, and help shape executive and thought-leadership content.

  • Own the editorial strategy and story pipeline. Build the content calendar and develop the themes, angles, and stories that fuel our owned social, Growth, and Demand Generation channels.

  • Turn data into insight. Partner with Strategy & Ops to transform first-party audience and performance data into trend reports, predictions, and other publishable content.

  • Create content that builds the brand and supports Sales. Develop B2B assets for Sales and Account Management, consumer-facing brand work, and test new formats and channels such as video, social campaigns, and creative brand projects.

  • Set the editorial bar. Own quality across Content Studio and partner with our curators to ensure a consistent TLDR voice across the brand.

What Success Looks Like

Within six months:

  • A year-ahead editorial calendar is published, with a defined B2B cadence and identified consumer moments.

  • The brand voice and tone guide is written, socialized, and applied to live Content Studio and curator output.

  • A set of B2B assets is the market (trend reports, predictions, performance guides), and reps reach for it without being asked.

  • A working story pipeline is handing narrative to the team for channel execution.

Within twelve months:

  • Content is a named contributor to inbound demand, with attribution in place.

  • Brand-voice review is a standing function that you own.

  • Consumer-facing narrative and campaign work is underway, not just planned.

About You

  • 7–10 years of content or editorial experience, with deep expertise in either B2B SaaS or media/newsletters and familiarity with the other.

  • Strong editorial and brand instincts, with experience owning an editorial calendar, developing brand voice and tone, and writing and editing across long- and short-form content.

  • A strategic, data-informed approach to content, using metrics like traffic, CTR, engagement, and attribution to understand performance.

  • Cross-functional experience, including partnering with Sales or Account Management on buyer-facing content and managing freelance or contract writers.

  • Bonus: You’ve built a content function from the ground up, worked in digital media or newsletters, or owned both B2B buyer content and consumer brand storytelling.

You’ll Thrive Here If…

  • You have strong editorial judgment. You know what’s worth publishing, can turn positioning into compelling content, and aren’t afraid to make the call.

  • You lead through influence. You’re comfortable working across Growth, Product Marketing, Content Studio, and external contributors without direct authority.

  • You’re a hands-on player-coach. You’d rather set the standard and ship great work than manage a large team. This is an individual contributor role by design.

  • You think audience-first and commercially. You understand both what resonates with readers and how content can support buyers, Sales, and broader business goals.

  • You’re excited to build from zero. You’ll define TLDR’s owned voice and content approach from the ground up—with an existing audience of millions already in place.

Why You'll Love It

🤑 Compensation: Total cash at target is $211,500 - $253,500

  • Base salary: $168,500 to $210,500

  • Annual bonus: $43,000 when we hit our company revenue goal, paid in cash each January, with upside up to $86,000 if we beat it

💲How we pay: One of our values is to simplify aggressively, and that includes pay. You get a base and a bonus, both in cash.

We place you in the band based on what the interview process shows about your experience. If you’ve done this role at this level before, we’d typically start you around $232.5k in total cash, which leaves room to grow. You move up with performance, and we review pay every year.

We keep the team small and pay well, so you work alongside strong people. If comp is the only thing stopping you from applying, tell us.

🌎 Location: We're 100% remote across the US and Canada. Work where you want - our bands are set to tier-1 city rates wherever you live.

🤝 Team Events: Biannual team offsites. Most recently we’ve gone to New Orleans, San Diego and Park City!

🏝️ Time to Recharge: Flexible PTO. Most of the team takes 2–3 weeks a year, plus holidays.

🏥 Health Benefits: Comprehensive medical, dental and vision benefits with a 100% paid option

📈 401(k) Plan: Empower 401(k)

🍼 Paid Parental Leave

💻 Home Office Stipend: Whatever makes you productive - standing desk, second monitor, chair, walking pad.

🔰 Learning & Development Stipend: For anything that makes you better at your work, and for AI tools especially. Don't ration your tokens.

📥 If you're ready to make a real dent at a bootstrapped, profitable company, apply. Tell us if you need any accommodation at any point in the process.

title: Senior Technical Governance Program Manager
description:
About Lead Bank

Lead is a banking infrastructure platform trusted by the most innovative companies to power complex financial products. We enable fintechs to offer compliant, programmable services like payments, lending, and digital assets at scale. Banking has moved beyond traditional institutions and is now embedded directly into everyday experiences, meaning companies need modern infrastructure that is safe, secure, and operationally sound.

Today, Lead is one of the only API-first, developer-focused partner banks with the financial, regulatory, and legal expertise required to help fintechs succeed. We operate offices in San Francisco, Sunnyvale, and New York City, and an FDIC-insured bank in Kansas City.

Information Security Team at Lead

The Information Security team helps Lead stay nimble enough to move fast without compromising on safety. They own cybersecurity, overseeing detection and response, and building security controls for all data networks, cloud infrastructures, and IT systems. Working closely with the Risk, Compliance, and Audit teams, they ensure Lead meets and stays up to date on all security standards. Scaling the systems that protect Lead and the fintechs we serve requires critical thinking, good judgment, and an ownership mentality. This is a collaborative team of builders who approach problems creatively, constantly iterating to improve the security of our platform.

Role description:

Lead Bank is seeking a Senior Security Technical Governance Program Manager to lead the strategy, execution, and continuous optimization of the bank’s technology governance, compliance, and risk programs. This role will be responsible for ensuring that security controls across the bank’s technology environment, internal operations, and Banking-as-a-Service (BaaS) ecosystem meet rigorous regulatory requirements, industry standards, and internal risk tolerance.

The Senior Technical Governance Program Manager will play a critical role in standardizing security compliance processes, driving continuous monitoring, and embedding automated security controls into everyday operations. This position will partner closely with Security Engineering, Technology, Data, Compliance, and Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) teams to modernize control frameworks, maintain constant audit readiness, and safely govern emerging technologies across the organization.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead and manage enterprise technology governance, risk, compliance, and control initiatives across Information Security, Technology, Engineering, and Data organizations.

  • Lead, mentor, and develop team members, including setting priorities and goals, providing ongoing coaching and feedback, and supporting professional growth and performance.

  • Drive enterprise Data Management and Governance initiatives, including data security, data classification, retention, data quality, governance controls, and regulatory compliance requirements.

  • Lead governance and readiness programs for enterprise Disaster Recovery (DR), including readiness assessments, control reviews, tabletop exercises, recovery testing, lessons learned, and resiliency improvement initiatives.

  • Manage Security Compliance programs across Information Security, Technology, and Engineering teams, ensuring alignment with applicable regulatory requirements, industry frameworks, internal policies, and security best practices.

  • Manage and oversee the enterprise Security Third-Party Risk Program, including risk assessments, due diligence, ongoing monitoring, control reviews, audits, issue management, and remediation tracking.

  • Drive automation of audit and compliance evidence gathering, control monitoring, and governance workflows to improve efficiency, consistency, audit readiness, and control effectiveness.

  • Lead coordination of internal and external audits covering technology, cybersecurity, cloud, engineering, infrastructure, and related controls. Manage evidence collection, lead control walkthroughs, audit requests, findings, and remediation activities through closure.

  • Support and lead strategic initiatives and special projects including but not limited to emerging technology risk, Artificial Intelligence (AI) governance and risk management, compliance program enhancements, automation, regulatory readiness, and technology control modernization.

  • Identify opportunities to strengthen technology governance and compliance through automation, continuous monitoring, risk-based controls, standardized processes, and scalable program improvements.

  • Perform all other duties as assigned.

Qualifications:

  • 5–8 years of experience in Technology, Information Security, Cybersecurity, Engineering, Technology Risk, Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC), or a related discipline.

  • Experience managing, mentoring, and developing teams, with demonstrated ability to set priorities, provide feedback, and drive individual and team performance.

  • Demonstrated experience leading complex, cross-functional technology governance, risk, compliance, or security programs in high-growth technology, fintech, startup, or similarly fast-paced environments.

  • Experience in banking, financial services, or other highly regulated industries preferred.

  • Familiarity with AI tools, AI governance, AI risk management, and emerging technology controls.

  • Strong understanding of technology governance, cybersecurity frameworks, cloud platforms, infrastructure security, engineering controls, technology risk, enterprise risk management, and compliance practices.

  • Experience working with internal and external auditors and managing remediation activities from identification through closure.

  • Demonstrated ability to automate, streamline, or modernize compliance, governance, risk, and audit evidence processes.

  • Experience developing governance metrics, executive reporting, risk assessments, control frameworks, or compliance dashboards.

  • Strong program management, stakeholder management, communication, organizational, analytical, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

  • Ability to operate effectively across technical and non-technical teams and translate complex technology, security, risk, and compliance concepts into actionable business outcomes.

What we offer:

At Lead, we design our benefits to support company culture and principles, to foster an efficient and inspiring work environment, and to create the conditions for our team to give their best in both work and life

  • Competitive compensation based on experience, geographic location, and role

  • Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, 401k Matching, and other wellness benefits, including FSA, HSA and HRA

  • Paid parental leave

  • Flexible vacation policy, including PTO and paid holidays

  • A fun and challenging team environment in a dynamic industry with ample opportunities for career growth

*Lead Bank is proud to have an inclusive culture committed to ensuring equal employment opportunity in all employment decisions regardless of race, color, gender, national origin, religion, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, military status, veteran status or any other legally protected status.

*Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

*Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

**Our compensation reflects the cost of labor across several US geographic markets. Pay is based on a number of factors and may vary depending on geographical market location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. These ranges may be modified in the future.

Zone 1: $176,400 - $206,168 (SF/Bay Area, NYC, Seattle)

Zone 2: $ 162,069 - $184,322 (Los Angeles, Chicago, Austin, Denver, Boston, Washington DC, San Diego, Philadelphia, Portland, Sacramento, Miami)

title: Senior Spacecraft Propulsion Systems Engineer I
description:
ABOUT ROCKET LAB

Rocket Lab is the end-to-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity’s reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We move fast, build real hardware for meaningful missions, and make the impossible routine. Come shape the future with us.

SPACE SYSTEMS

At Rocket Lab, we’re not just launching rockets — we're building the future of space. Our Space Systems team builds everything from complete spacecraft, precision payloads to the components and subsystems that allow them to thrive in space, like solar panels, flight software, star trackers, optical systems, separation systems, radios, and more.

Our Space Systems team has enabled more than 1,700 missions, ranging from interplanetary exploration, in-space manufacturing to national security and defense initiatives. The team has built spacecraft, payloads, and components for missions to the Moon and Mars, working with partners including NASA, the Space Development Agency, and the U.S. Space Force. Whether it’s a single high-performance spacecraft, constellation, or the vertically integrated components that help them get to space — our world class Space Systems team is empowering some of the boldest and most ambitious space missions.

SENIOR SPACECRAFT PROPULSION SYSTEMS ENGINEER I

We're seeking a Senior Spacecraft Propulsion Systems Engineer I for our propulsion engineering team based out of Long Beach, CA. As a Senior Propulsion Systems Engineer, you are responsible for system-level and component-level ownership of space systems propulsion and fluidic development. These teams support our Space Systems division, and lead cutting-edge programs for civil, commercial, and defense customers.

WHAT YOU’LL GET TO DO:

  • Owning development of new or existing products or systems, acting as technical lead to guide team through end-to-end development process
  • Conceptual and detailed performance calculations, systems modelling, analysis, and system designs
  • Requirements gathering, definition, and management
  • Systems engineering activities and leadership within the team
  • Test planning, setup, instrumentation, execution, and data analysis
  • Communicating with project stakeholders internal and external to the team
  • Technical risk-based decision making to the right/best solution when faced with an engineering challenge
  • Project management including schedule building and maintenance, identifying top priority items, tasking of other engineers and technicians, and communication of status to leadership and other teams
  • Mentorship and coaching of people within the team on technical and professional development
  • Defining and maintaining standard of excellence for their team through documentation, training, coaching, and review of others’ work
  • Contributing to engineering process development and documentation at Rocket Lab related to areas of experience

YOU’LL BRING THESE QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering (aerospace, mechanical, mechatronics, or other technical discipline)
  • 5+ years of experience in propulsion system development, or other high-performance field
  • US citizenship is required, due to program requirements
  • Expertise in propulsion system modelling, static and transient analysis, and model validation using test data software such as Amesim, EcosimPro, Simulink, or Simscape
  • Experience with end-to-end development process, including gathering requirements, detailed design, qualification, production, and acceptance testing
  • Experience with all steps in the Systems Engineering V and risk-based decision making
  • Experience working on propulsion systems utilizing different storable propellants, such as electrical and chemical

THESE QUALIFICATIONS WOULD BE NICE TO HAVE:

  • A genuine passion for engineering, curious mindset, and willingness to learn
  • Demonstrated hands-on engineering skills, inside or outside the workplace
  • Comfortable working with high levels of ambiguity
  • Ability to make decisions using basic engineering principles, available literature and standards, technical risk assessments, test data, and physics-based models
  • Practice in identifying the necessary steps to achieve high level technical goals, scheduling them in a plan, and managing delivery against that plan
  • Experience with Jama
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to work well within a team environment
  • Capabilities using Python for data manipulation and post-processing
  • Detailed mechanical design experience using NX (preferred) or equivalent industry standard CAD software
  • Experience with GD&T and engineering drawings
  • Experience using Product Lifecycle Management software such as Teamcenter (preferred), Windchill, or similar
  • Experience using National Instruments data acquisition systems
  • Experience with testing and troubleshooting flight hardware
  • Master's or PhD

This position may require prolonged periods of sitting, standing, walking, computer work, and occasional exposure to moderate levels of noise, dust, and fumes in production areas.

Anticipated annual equity grant value is designed around function, level, experience, and other factors; realized value depends on vesting and stock-price performance.

Join one of the world's fastest-growing space companies and own a piece of it. In addition to competitive base pay, you'll receive company stock as part of your total compensation package, giving you a direct stake in our success. As we expand to new launch sites, groundbreaking missions, and global markets, your ownership has the opportunity to grow alongside the company.

Our comprehensive benefits package includes our industry-leading Employee Stock Purchase Program (with a 15% discount on company stock), top-tier medical plans (HMO, PPO, and a zero cost HDHP option with a significant HSA company contribution), dental and vision coverage, paid vacation and sick time, 11 paid holidays, flexible spending and dependent care accounts, paid parental leave, disability and life insurance, and a 401(k) retirement plan with company match.

Additional perks include subsidized EV charging, onsite fitness centers (where available), discounted gym memberships, complimentary snacks and beverages, 50% employee discount on our popular merch store, and a variety of other employee discounts.

Level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

$135,000—$208,000 USD
Base Salary
$115,000—$173,000 USD

WHAT TO EXPECT

We’re on a mission to unlock the potential of space to improve life on Earth, but that’s not an easy task. It takes hard work, determination, relentless innovation, teamwork, grit, and an unwavering commitment to achieving what others often deem impossible. Our people out-think, out-work, and out-pace. We pride ourselves on having each other’s backs, checking our egos at the door, and rolling up our sleeves on all tasks big and small. We thrive under pressure, work to tight deadlines, and our focus is always on how we can deliver, rather than dwelling on the challenges that stand in the way.

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
We are growing our development team and looking to bring on a Full Stack Developer who is excited about a modern, AI-augmented way of building software: someone who ships quickly, works closely with product and design, and cares about what we build as much as how we build it. You will join a small, high-trust squad where engineers, product, and design make decisions together. You will pair with AI coding tools like Claude Code as a core part of your daily workflow, move features from idea to production fast, and grow your skills alongside experienced engineers on a platform used by legal professionals every day. This is a builder’s role for someone who treats the product as their own. You will help build software that real legal professionals rely on every day, at a global, award-winning company that moves fast, trusts its engineers, and is investing in a modern, AI-first way of working. Your ideas about the product will be heard and shipped.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Build and ship full-stack features across our React/TypeScript front end and C#/.NET back end, taking them from idea to production fast.
  • Work as part of a squad alongside product and design, contributing to scope, priorities, and trade-offs rather than waiting for tickets.
  • Use AI to move faster by pairing with agentic coding tools such as Claude Code to accelerate development, raise quality, and spend more time on the hard, high-judgement problems.
  • Bring a product mindset by understanding our users, our domain, and the “why” behind features, then using that understanding to ask good questions and propose better solutions.
  • Contribute to technical decisions by working within our architecture, patterns, and standards, and speaking up when you see a better way.
  • Collaborate with our global platform team across InfoTrack’s international engineering group to build on shared services and contribute back to common infrastructure.
  • Care about quality by writing clean, maintainable code, participating in code reviews, and paying attention to performance, reliability, and the user experience.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

  • Experienced. 3+ years building and shipping production web applications as a full stack developer.
  • Capable across the stack. Comfort with React, TypeScript, HTML/CSS and modern state management on the front end; solid with C# (ASP.NET Core) and relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL) on the back end.
  • Fast and pragmatic. You ship iteratively, value speed to market, and know how to balance “good enough to learn” with “built to last.”
  • AI-forward. You already use, or are genuinely eager to adopt, AI coding assistants and agentic workflows.
  • Product-minded. You want to understand the domain and the user, and you see contributing to product and design decisions as part of the job.
  • A strong collaborator. You communicate clearly, work well in a tight-knit squad, and are keen to learn from the engineers around you.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience in legal tech, conveyancing, fintech, or another regulated/document-heavy domain.
  • Cloud platform experience (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
  • Exposure to DevOps, CI/CD, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and Agile delivery.
  • Experience working across distributed or global engineering teams.

OUR STACK

  • Front end: React, TypeScript, modern state management (e.g., Redux, MobX).
  • Back end: C# (ASP.NET Core / Framework).
  • Platform: cloud infrastructure, relational databases, Docker, Kubernetes.
  • Tooling: AI-assisted development with Claude Code and related agentic tools.

COMPENSATION

The base salary range for this role is $110,000 – $130,000 CAD annually, plus a performance bonus of up to 10% of base salary tied to team and company metrics. Final compensation will reflect your experience, domain depth, and demonstrated delivery. In accordance with provincial pay transparency legislation — including Ontario’s Pay Transparency Act and British Columbia’s Pay Transparency Act — InfoTrack Canada discloses a pay range for all advertised positions.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & STATUTORY NOTICES

**Work Authorization** Candidates must be legally eligible to work in Canada and must reside in Canada for the duration of their employment. This role operates on a hybrid basis; regular in-office attendance at our Canadian office is required. InfoTrack Canada does not provide immigration sponsorship for this role at this time.

**Equity, Diversity & Inclusion** InfoTrack Canada is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion in the workplace. We comply with the Canadian Human Rights Act and all applicable provincial human rights codes. We welcome applications from all qualified individuals, including women, Indigenous Peoples, persons with disabilities, members of visible minorities, and members of the 2SLGBTQIA+ community.

**Accommodation** InfoTrack Canada is committed to an accessible and inclusive recruitment experience. Accommodation is available on request throughout the hiring process, in accordance with the Ontario Human Rights Code, the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act (AODA), and applicable provincial accessibility legislation.

**Use of AI in Recruitment** InfoTrack Canada may use artificial intelligence (AI) to support certain administrative aspects of the recruitment process. However, all applications and resumes are carefully reviewed by members of our hiring team, and all screening, evaluation, and hiring decisions are made solely by human decision-makers.

title: International Tax Partner
description:
About the Company

At Current, everything starts with people. We believe that when you invest in talent through opportunity, development, and support, you unlock growth for individuals, firms, and clients alike. This role serves as the senior technical and relationship leader for complex matters (including U.S. inbound/outbound structuring, international reporting, and treaty analysis), exercises independent judgment on matters of significance, and ensures delivery quality and risk management aligned to professional standards and firm policies. The International Tax Partner drives practice growth through business development and referral relationships, develops technical talent and leaders, and collaborates with tax and advisory leadership to deliver consistent outcomes.

Key responsibilities

  • Lead senior client relationships for international tax engagements; define objectives, scope, and success measures and serve as executive escalation point

  • Direct the delivery and technical oversight of complex international tax compliance and reporting requirements to ensure accurate, timely, and supportable filings and workpapers

Equal Opportunity

We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or any other applicable legally protected characteristic.

title: Adult Acute Speech and Language Therapist
description:
Job Title: Locum Adult Acute Speech and Language Therapist

Banding: Band 6
Location: Royal Liverpool Hospital, Liverpool
Start Date: ASAP
Salary: £24.00–£27.50 per hour
Working Hours: Part-time or full-time
Contract Duration: 3 months

Job Overview

We are currently seeking an experienced and motivated Band 6 Speech and Language Therapist (SALT) to join the team at Royal Liverpool Hospital on a locum basis for an initial period of three months.

This role is ideal for a clinician with experience in an acute adult inpatient setting, covering both critical care and medical wards. The successful candidate will be confident in assessing and managing adults with complex communication and swallowing difficulties, with a particular emphasis on dysphagia management.

You will play a key role in delivering high-quality, evidence-based assessment and intervention, working collaboratively with the wider multidisciplinary team to support patient safety, recovery and rehabilitation.

This opportunity offers flexible part-time or full-time working arrangements and an immediate start for a suitably qualified and experienced clinician.

Key Responsibilities

In this role, you will:

  • Assess and manage adult inpatients presenting with speech, language, communication and swallowing difficulties.
  • Provide Speech and Language Therapy services across critical care and acute medical wards.
  • Undertake comprehensive dysphagia assessments and develop appropriate management plans.
  • Make evidence-based clinical recommendations to support safe and effective patient care, including advice on swallowing and dietary management.
  • Work collaboratively with the multidisciplinary team to support patient recovery, rehabilitation and discharge planning.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date clinical records in line with professional and organisational standards.
  • Prioritise and manage a varied acute caseload, responding to changing clinical needs.
  • Where appropriately trained and competent, undertake Fibreoptic Endoscopic Evaluation of Swallowing (FEES) and Videofluoroscopic Swallowing Assessments (VFSS).

Qualifications and Experience

To be considered for this role, you must have:

  • A recognised degree in Speech and Language Therapy (or equivalent).
  • Current Health and Care Professions Council (HCPC) registration.
  • Experience working within an acute adult inpatient setting.
  • Experience covering critical care and acute medical wards.
  • Competence in the assessment and management of dysphagia.
  • Strong clinical reasoning, assessment and decision-making skills.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • The ability to work effectively as part of a multidisciplinary team and manage an acute caseload.

Desirable experience:

  • Competence in conducting FEES assessments.
  • Competence in conducting videofluoroscopic swallowing assessments (VFSS).

FEES and VFSS competencies would be advantageous but are not essential for this role.

Why Choose Pulse?

From the moment you register with Pulse, our focus is entirely on you. Our specialist consultants understand your profession and are committed to finding the right opportunities to match your skills and aspirations. With exclusive access to roles across the UK, we offer a personalised and supportive recruitment experience that puts your career first.

How to Apply

If you are an experienced Band 6 Speech and Language Therapist with a background in acute adult inpatient care and dysphagia management, we would love to hear from you.

This is an excellent opportunity to secure a locum position at Royal Liverpool Hospital, with an immediate start, a three-month contract and flexible part-time or full-time working options.

Please apply using the link below or contact our specialist team to find out more about this opportunity.

Reasonable Adjustments

If you have a disability or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process or within the workplace, please let us know as early as possible. We are committed to providing the support you need throughout your journey with us.

International Recruitment Notice

Please note that we are unable to accept applications from individuals residing in countries listed on the Red or Amber list of the Code of Practice for the International Recruitment of Health and Social Care Personnel in England, as defined by the World Health Organization (WHO) Workforce Support and Safeguard List.

title: Full Stack Software Developer
description:
This role helps establish Built by Mainstreet:

Mainstreet is building an internal software development capability. This role is for a practical full stack developer who wants to build real applications, support them in production, and help shape how software gets built inside a Microsoft-based financial institution. Built by Mainstreet exists to solve internal business problems with software we can understand, improve, reuse, and support ourselves. We use modern tools, including AI-assisted development, to build software faster and more accurately. This is the first dedicated software development hire in Built by Mainstreet, so the role also helps establish practical, repeatable development standards as the capability matures.

You will turn internal workflows into reliable software products:

As our Full Stack Software Developer you will build, deploy, and maintain internal software applications for Mainstreet Credit Union. You will work within a primarily Microsoft technology ecosystem. C#/.NET is our preferred application development stack, with PowerShell used extensively for scripting, automation, and environment administration. You will take applications from prototype through production for tools that support member origination, lending analysis, and staff operations. You will work with business analysts, business users who create prototypes or workflow tools, Business Intelligence, and department leaders to turn real workflows into reliable, secure products that meet our data handling and access control expectations. You will work with the Technology Architect and Systems Administrator on platform patterns, security and integration approaches, Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID integration, and production environment configuration.

Success in your first year means you have taken ownership of at least one application end to end, including code, testing, deployment, documentation, monitoring, and support. You contribute to a working application pipeline and documented deployment process. You help mature practical standards for Git-based source control, code review, automated builds and tests, CI/CD, deployment, documentation, support, and general development practices. You respond to staff-reported issues with reliable triage and resolution cadence. You leave the codebase and operating model clearer, safer, and easier to maintain.

You will work with support across business, data, infrastructure, and architecture:

You will not be expected to own every infrastructure, security, database, or business domain decision independently. You will work with the Technology Architect, Systems Administrator, Business Intelligence, business analysts, and business teams to make practical decisions and build reliable software within shared standards. The Technology Architect will set the overall architecture, platform patterns, engineering standards, security and integration approaches, and technical direction. You will own implementation and day-to-day software engineering within those patterns, while contributing practical feedback as the standards evolve.

Major Duties and Responsibilities:

Application Development:

  • Build web applications using C#, ASP.NET Core, and Blazor against a REST API backend.
  • Implement data models, business logic, and API endpoints following clean architecture principles.
  • Build and maintain application database schemas using Entity Framework Core migrations against SQL Server, with Azure SQL or other approved data platforms used where appropriate.
  • Integrate applications with internal APIs, vendor APIs, CGI RFS 360, credit bureau services, e-signature platforms, Microsoft 365 and Teams, existing SQL data sources, legacy applications, identity services, and AI-assisted development or large language model APIs where they support practical application delivery.
  • Work collaboratively with Business Intelligence and the Technology Architect/SQL Administrator when designing application databases, integrating with existing data sources, and developing or optimizing production SQL queries.
  • Write unit and integration tests and maintain test coverage across Core, Infrastructure, and API layers.

Deployment and Operations:

  • Contribute to the development and improvement of Git-based source control, code review, automated build, testing, and CI/CD practices for internal application projects.
  • Deploy and support applications primarily within Mainstreet’s Windows Server/IIS environment, with the ability to support cloud-hosted platforms such as Azure App Service where appropriate.
  • Manage application secrets and configuration using approved secure mechanisms appropriate to the hosting environment, with no secrets stored in source-controlled code or configuration. This may include environment-level configuration and cloud secret-management services such as Azure Key Vault where appropriate.
  • Coordinate releases through dev, test, and production environments with documented rollback steps
  • Monitor application health, review logs via Serilog, and respond to alerts?

Security and Compliance:

  • Apply least-privilege access controls using the authentication and authorization approach appropriate to the application and hosting environment, including Active Directory, Windows Authentication, Microsoft Entra ID, security groups, and role-based authorization.
  • Ensure sensitive member and financial data is encrypted in transit and at rest.
  • Conduct or coordinate static code scanning on every change, triage and fix flagged dependencies.

title: TAM Director
description:
About Oscilar

At Oscilar, we're building the most advanced AI Risk Decisioning™ Platform. Banks, fintechs, and digitally native organizations rely on us to manage their fraud, credit, and compliance risk with the power of AI. If you're passionate about solving complex problems and making the internet safer for everyone, this is your place.

Why Join Us?

Mission-driven teams: Work alongside industry veterans from Meta, Uber, Citi, and Confluent, all united by a shared goal to make the digital world safer.

Ownership and impact: We believe in extreme ownership. You'll be empowered to take responsibility, move fast, and make decisions that drive our mission forward.

Innovate at the cutting edge: Your work will shape how modern finance detects fraud and manages risk.

Role Overview

Oscilar is looking for a Director of Technical Account Management to lead and scale a high-performing team responsible for customer success, retention, expansion, and long-term value realization.

This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who leads through expertise, judgment, and example. You'll build a team of Technical Account Managers who operate as general managers of their portfolios — owning customer relationships, driving technical adoption, anticipating risks, identifying growth opportunities, and delivering measurable business outcomes.

Reporting to the VP of Solutions Engineering & Customer Success, you'll set the standard for technical account ownership, serve as an executive partner to our most strategic customers, and develop the team's expertise in AI-driven risk decisioning and agentic AI.

You'll also serve as a critical bridge between customers, Product, and Engineering, translating field intelligence into actionable insights that influence Oscilar's platform and product roadmap.

This role sits at the intersection of technical customer success, commercial strategy, agentic AI adoption, and product innovation. We're looking for a leader who can build an exceptional team while remaining deeply connected to customers, technology, and the outcomes that matter.

What You'll Do

  • Lead, hire, and develop a high-performing Technical Account Management team, fostering a culture of extreme ownership, technical excellence, and customer accountability.

  • Empower TAMs to operate as GMs of their portfolios, independently owning customer engagement from onboarding and implementation through adoption, renewal, and expansion.

  • Own team-level performance against Gross Revenue Retention (GRR), Net Revenue Retention (NRR), customer satisfaction, product adoption, and time-to-value objectives.

  • Establish clear standards for account success planning, executive engagement, customer health management, and proactive identification of retention and expansion opportunities.

  • Serve as the senior escalation point for strategic accounts, complex technical challenges, critical incidents, and high-stakes customer engagements.

  • Build trusted relationships with executive stakeholders, leading strategic business reviews and ensuring customers realize measurable value from Oscilar's platform.

  • Partner closely with Account Executives, Sales Engineers, Solutions Architects, and Customer Success leadership on renewal strategies, commercial expansion, and complex implementations.

  • Provide technical leadership across the TAM organization, ensuring the team can confidently navigate API integrations, SQL, Python, cloud infrastructure, and enterprise data workflows while engaging specialized engineering resources when appropriate.

  • Champion agentic AI adoption, developing the team's ability to guide customers through AI-driven automation strategies, workflow design, deployment, and ongoing optimization.

  • Build team fluency in AI agent evaluation, human-in-the-loop workflows, performance monitoring, and production governance across fraud, credit, and compliance use cases.

  • Leverage AI tools such as Claude, Cursor, GPT, or similar technologies to accelerate analysis, improve team productivity, and develop scalable customer enablement resources.

  • Act as the voice of the customer in Product and Engineering discussions, translating deployment insights, recurring challenges, and emerging customer needs into actionable roadmap recommendations.

  • Partner with Product and Engineering on beta programs, early-access initiatives, and reusable implementation frameworks that improve customer outcomes.

  • Build scalable operating processes, customer health frameworks, performance dashboards, and team development programs that enable consistent execution without sacrificing autonomy.

  • Communicate portfolio performance, renewal risk, expansion opportunities, and strategic customer insights to senior leadership.

What You'll Bring

  • 10+ years of experience in Technical Account Management, Customer Success, Solutions Engineering, or related technical customer-facing roles within enterprise SaaS, fintech, or AI-driven platforms.

  • 5+ years of leadership experience, with a demonstrated ability to hire, coach, develop, and scale high-performing technical customer-facing teams.

  • Proven experience leading enterprise customer portfolios with accountability for GRR, NRR, customer adoption, retention, and expansion.

  • A track record of building teams that operate with independent account ownership, commercial accountability, and strong technical judgment.

  • Deep understanding of enterprise customer success, including executive business reviews, customer health frameworks, renewal strategy, account planning, and expansion motions.

  • Strong technical foundation across REST APIs, SQL, Python, data integrations, and cloud infrastructure(AWS, GCP, or Azure).

  • Ability to guide teams through complex customer implementations, troubleshoot technical escalations, and collaborate effectively with Solutions Architects, Product, and Engineering.

  • Familiarity with AI/ML platforms, agentic AI, or LLM-powered enterprise workflows, including their deployment, evaluation, and operational considerations.

  • Practical experience leveraging LLMs and AI tools to improve productivity, accelerate analysis, automate workflows, or solve complex business problems.

  • Strong commercial instincts and the ability to connect technical adoption and customer value realization with retention and revenue expansion.

  • Exceptional executive communication skills, with the ability to influence C-suite stakeholders and translate complex technical concepts into clear business outcomes.

  • Data-driven approach to leadership, with experience defining KPIs, tracking leading indicators, and using performance insights to guide decisions.

  • Proven ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders and translate customer insights into meaningful product, engineering, and business outcomes.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Domain expertise in fraud prevention, credit risk, identity, AML/KYC/KYB, compliance, or financial-services risk decisioning.

  • Experience at a fintech, financial institution, fraud or risk management platform, or enterprise AI company.

  • Experience deploying, supporting, or advising on agentic AI systems, AI agents, or LLM-powered enterprise workflows.

  • Familiarity with rules engines, ML-driven decisioning, case management, alert management, and risk operations.

  • Experience with customer success platforms such as Salesforce, Gainsight, Totango, or similar tools.

  • Experience building or scaling a Technical Account Management function in a high-growth startup or scale-up environment.

What Success Looks Like

  • Build a high-performing TAM organization where every team member demonstrates independent portfolio ownership, technical credibility, and commercial accountability.

  • Drive measurable improvements in customer retention, net revenue retention, product adoption, and time-to-value.

  • Establish strong executive relationships and proactive engagement strategies across Oscilar's most strategic customer accounts.

  • Accelerate customer adoption of AI-powered decisioning and agentic AI capabilities, translating technical innovation into measurable business value.

  • Create a structured feedback loop between customers, Product, and Engineering that meaningfully influences platform capabilities and roadmap priorities.

  • Establish scalable customer success frameworks that support Oscilar's growth while preserving the speed, ownership, and customer intimacy of a high-performing startup.

Benefits and Other Perks

  • Compensation: Competitive salary and equity packages, including a 401(k) plan.

  • Flexibility: Remote-first culture.

  • Health: 100% employer-covered comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance with a top-tier plan for you and your dependents (US).

  • Balance: Unlimited PTO policy.

  • Culture: Family-friendly environment with regular team events and offsites.

  • Development: Unparalleled learning and professional development opportunities.

  • Impact: Making the internet safer by protecting online transactions.

title: System Administrator 2
description:
At Wyetech, you’ll be at the center of an award-winning corporate culture, breaking technological barriers and solving real-world problems for our federal government customers. We are committed to hiring the best of the best, and in return, we offer a world-class, truly unique employee experience that is rare within our industry.
The System Administrator will provide hands-on administration, maintenance, and troubleshooting support for mission-critical IT systems operating within secure and classified environments. This role is responsible for maintaining reliable and secure Linux and Windows infrastructure, supporting core enclave services, and resolving technical issues from the operating system through the application layer. The ideal candidate will bring strong Linux administration experience, a solid understanding of networking, virtualization, storage, and security, and the ability to support complex operational environments. This position requires a proactive administrator who can independently diagnose issues, maintain system compliance, and ensure infrastructure availability and performance.
Due to federal contract requirements, United States Citizenship and position appropriate security clearance is required. (e.g. Active TS/SCI security clearance with agency appropriate polygraph).

Capabilties

  • System Administration & Troubleshooting: Administer, maintain, and troubleshoot Linux and Windows systems, diagnosing and resolving technical issues ranging from the operating system through the application layer.
  • Linux Server Administration: Install, configure, patch, upgrade, secure, and maintain Linux servers, including RHEL, Rocky Linux, CentOS, or comparable enterprise Linux distributions.
  • Core Infrastructure Services: Configure and maintain core enclave infrastructure services, including DHCP, DNS, domain services, identity management, authentication, and related network services.
  • Virtualization & Infrastructure Support: Deploy and support virtualized and/or containerized environments while managing supporting infrastructure, including compute, storage, networking, and system resources.
  • Network & Storage Administration: Support storage platforms, network connectivity, system interfaces, and associated infrastructure; troubleshoot performance, availability, and connectivity issues across complex environments.
  • Security & Compliance: Maintain systems in accordance with applicable System Security Plans (SSPs) and secure administration requirements, including Secure the Enterprise (STE)/Secure the Network (STN) activities. Configure, monitor, and maintain security tools required to support DoD networks and cybersecurity requirements.
  • Classified Environment Support: Provide day-to-day administration and technical support within classified operational environments, maintaining secure and reliable mixed Linux/Windows environments while ensuring systems remain operational, compliant, and mission ready.

Required Qualifications

  • TS/SCI with agency appropriate poly
  • Ten (10) years’ experience as a SA in programs and contracts of similar scope, type, and complexity is required.

  • Experience with enterprise identity and authentication technologies such as FreeIPA, Centrify, LDAP, and Active Directory.
  • Knowledge of PKI, TLS, certificates, encryption, and other cryptographic technologies.
  • Experience with container technologies such as Docker, Podman, Kubernetes, or comparable platforms.
  • Familiarity with automation and configuration management tools such as Ansible, Bash, Python, or PowerShell.
  • Strong understanding of TCP/IP networking, DNS, routing, firewalls, system hardening, and secure network architecture.
  • Ability to independently troubleshoot complex infrastructure issues, identify root causes, and implement sustainable technical solutions.

The Benefits Package

The company automatically contributes 20% of each employee's gross compensation to a Simplified Employee Pension (SEP) IRA, with no requirement for employee matching. All contributions are fully vested from day one, ensuring immediate ownership of retirement funds.

Full-time employees have the option to participate in a variety of voluntary benefit plans including:

title: Head of Product, Core Journeys
company: Safeguard Global GEO Costa Rica S.R.L.
description:
About Safeguard Global: We enable global expansion without the risk.

Safeguard Global has been at the forefront of global workforce enablement since we pioneered centralised global payments in 2008 and launched the employer of record (EOR) category globally in 2010. And we haven't stopped there.

Today, with our 500+ in-country HR experts, cutting-edge technology, and comprehensive solutions, we've helped over 2,000 organisations hire, recruit, pay, and manage employees in 170+ countries.

Because we created this category, we've learned that successful global expansion isn't driven by technology alone. It requires deep global expertise. We call this the marriage of expert and technology, human when it matters.

This means we have the people and the technology to ensure 100% compliance with local, regional, national, and international laws. Together, this ethos and our solutions portfolio allow businesses to scale up or down wherever, however, and whenever they want to expand, without the risk.

Overview of the role

We're looking for a Head of Product, Core Journeys to lead the platform experience across our core client journey, from hiring a worker through to invoicing for them.

The role is accountable for the platform experience, delivery, and outcome achievement across the core transactional workflows. You'll translate that target experience, combined with the product strategies set by the Directors of Product into a prioritised order of work; leading the product managers who deliver it and ensuring we deliver on business and customer experience objectives.

What you will be responsible for

Platform experience

  • Own the end-to-end platform experience across the core client journey, including the transitions between one part of the platform and the next

  • Identify where the experience is failing clients and set the plan to correct it

  • Own regulatory and compliance obligations as product requirements within your area, working with legal, tax, and the in-country teams so that they are designed in rather than retrofitted

Prioritisation and roadmap

  • Translate the platform strategy and commercial priorities into a prioritised order of work for your area

  • Feed that prioritisation into the single prioritised roadmap owned by the SVP, Product

  • Recommend what is built, what is deferred, and what is retired within your area, and secure agreement with the SVP, Product and the Directors of Product

  • Build the case for significant investment, including the value expected, the payback, and the trade-off against the alternatives

  • Work with the Directors of Product to sequence commercial priorities in a way the platform can deliver

Delivery

  • Hold accountability for delivery against commitment, on time and to the quality bar set in the definition of done

  • Work hand in hand with engineering and design leadership, from the earliest shaping of an idea through to release, so that trade-offs between client need, technical feasibility, and cost are made together

  • Work with sales, marketing, customer success, finance, and legal so that what we build is understood, sellable, supportable, and compliant on the day it launches

  • Identify and resolve delivery risk early, including teams that are blocked, unclear, or behind

  • Manage dependencies within your area and into the connected experience areas

Customer insight and product performance

  • Build the relationships, with clients and with internal teams, that sustain a continuous understanding of customer and internal pain points, and of the opportunities they point to

  • Ground product decisions in client insight, usage data, and market evidence

  • Raise the standard of discovery and validation across your teams

  • Define the expected outcome for each investment and own the value delivered against it

  • Own platform NPS and adoption for the core journey, and act on the results

  • Act as the product expert in senior client and prospect conversations, and represent the platform externally where it helps us win and keep clients

Team leadership

  • Line manage the product managers within your area

  • Set clear expectations, give direct feedback, and address performance issues early

  • Work with each product manager to understand their individual development needs, and take a coaching approach to growing their capability

  • Drive AI adoption where it creates the best outcome, recognising that it serves some tasks well and others poorly, and help the product team keep pace with how the role of product is rapidly changing

What will give you an advantage

  • Eight or more years in product, including at least five leading people

  • Proven experience leading product managers in a B2B SaaS or platform business, ideally where several teams contribute to a single client experience

  • Experience owning a multi-team product area end to end, with accountability for both delivery and the value delivered

  • A record of defining the expected value of an investment up front and evidencing what was realised

  • Knowledge of the HR industry is preferred but not critical

  • Experience of building products in a regulated environment, where compliance shapes what can be built

  • Enough technical depth to hold a credible conversation with engineering leadership on architecture, platform scalability, and data

  • A demonstrable record of developing product managers

  • Experience leading globally distributed teams across multiple countries and time zones

Primary performance metrics

  • Delivery: commitments delivered on time and to quality

  • Business impact: value delivered against the outcomes committed at the point of investment

  • Experience: platform NPS

  • Adoption: adoption of the core journey, from hiring to invoicing

Baselines and annual targets are set with the SVP, Product at the start of each financial year.

Competencies

  • Product judgement: makes clear recommendations on scope, sequencing, and trade-offs that hold up over time

  • Strategic thinking: sets a direction for the platform that connects client need, market direction, and commercial goals

  • Systems thinking: designs the journey around what matters most to the customer, and focuses only on the work that delivers value

  • Delivery leadership: maintains a predictability and quality bar across multiple teams without becoming a bottleneck

  • Communication: strong written and verbal communicator at all levels of the organisation, from SLT to team

  • People development: understands what each individual needs and coaches them to grow

  • Influencing: aligns commercial, engineering, and design leadership around a single sequence of work without direct authority

  • Commercial judgement: determines what is worth building next, and evidences the case

Key personal attributes

  • Grit and determination: moves work forward despite obstacles, and does not give up easily

  • Curiosity: actively seeks out different points of view, customer needs, and the problems worth solving

  • A leader and a doer: operates strategically while staying close to the detail

  • Warm, open, honest, and fun to work with

description:
