title: Director, Ultra-High-Voltage SiC Device Technology
description:
Job Purpose:

Navitas Semiconductor (Nasdaq: NVTS) is a next-generation power semiconductor leader driving innovation in gallium nitride (GaN) and high-voltage silicon carbide (SiC) technologies. Our products enable faster, more efficient power delivery across AI data centers, high-performance computing, energy and grid infrastructure, and industrial electrification.

With more than 30 years of combined expertise in wide bandgap technologies, GaNFast™ power ICs integrate GaN power, drive, control, sensing, and protection, delivering faster power delivery, higher system density, and greater efficiency. GeneSiC™ high-voltage SiC devices leverage patented trench-assisted planar technology to provide industry-leading voltage capability, efficiency, and reliability for medium-voltage grid and infrastructure applications.

We are seeking a Director of Ultra-High-Voltage SiC Device Technology to join our fast-growing, collaborative team. The ideal candidate is self-motivated, energetic, and able to thrive in a high-growth, innovative environment, contributing directly to technologies that are shaping the future of power electronics.

The Director of Ultra-High-Voltage SiC Device Technology reports to the SVP & Chief Technology Officer and owns device and process technology for our ultra-high-voltage SiC roadmap, from 3.3 kV to 10 kV and beyond: MOSFETs, PiN diodes, JFETs and bipolar devices. The director leads U.S. government-funded technology programs as technical lead and principal investigator, and works hands-on with foundry and research partners to take new device concepts from simulation to qualified silicon.

Key Responsibilities and Duties:

  • Ultra-High-Voltage Device Technology: Lead device architecture and process technology for ultra-high-voltage SiC devices (3.3 kV to 10 kV+), including MOSFETs, PiN diodes, JFETs and IGBTs or other bipolar devices.
  • Government Program Leadership: Serve as technical lead and principal investigator on U.S. government-funded development programs: define technical plans, own deliverables and milestones, and represent Navitas in program reviews.
  • Process Integration with Partners: Define process flows and key modules (implantation and activation, gate oxide, ohmic contacts, edge termination, passivation) with foundry and research partners, and drive split-lot experiments to closure.
  • Design, Simulation and Characterization: Direct device simulation (TCAD), mask design reviews and characterization plans, and translate results into design and process changes.
  • Reliability and Test Methods: Establish ultra-high-voltage characterization and reliability methods (HTRB, HTGB, avalanche and short-circuit ruggedness) with the reliability and test teams.
  • Team Development: Mentor device engineers across U.S. and India sites, and help grow the ultra-high-voltage SiC team.
  • IP and Customer Engagement: Build Navitas' intellectual property through patents and selected publications, and support customers and business units on ultra-high-voltage product definition.

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities, and Other Characteristics (KSAO’s)

  • Deep understanding of SiC device physics for blocking voltages from 3.3 kV to 10 kV+, including drift-layer design, edge termination and bipolar degradation
  • Strong knowledge of SiC process modules: implantation and activation, gate oxidation, ohmic contacts, etching and passivation
  • TCAD-driven device design and disciplined, data-driven experiment planning
  • Familiarity with high-voltage test and reliability methods (HTRB, HTGB, avalanche, short circuit)
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Excellent technical writing and communication, including proposals and government program reporting
  • Comfortable working with foundries, research institutes and teams across global time zones
  • Leading by example

title: Data Technisch Specialist (Data Engineer / Data Beheerder / Solution Engineer)

  • Evaluate the assigned function’s control environment, including assessing the adequacy, effectiveness, and design of controls to support alignment with Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) and other regulatory frameworks, as well as the firm’s risk priorities.
  • Execute testing processes with precision and accountability to assess the control environment, identify gaps, and prepare robust documentation (including process documents, process flows, and overview documents) that supports testing conclusions.
  • Collaborate with process and control owners and cross-functional teams on the testing schedule; obtain walkthroughs; document process changes; gather evidence; analyze potential issues; and facilitate timely reporting.
  • Support issue validation, action plan quality, and closure discipline by partnering with control owners to help ensure remediation aligns with risk acceptance and compliance expectations.
  • Lead walkthroughs and other meetings with business owners, fostering collaboration across engagements with minimal oversight.
  • Interpret policies, standards, and procedures to support accurate implementation of compliance requirements, while continuously improving control evaluation methodologies and interpreting control ratings and metrics to strengthen the compliance and operational risk management framework.
  • Propose and implement improvements to current testing methods, contributing to the overall efficiency and effectiveness of the firm’s risk management.

Required Qualifications, Capabilities and Skills:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, finance, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
  • Minimum of 4 years of experience in controls testing, audit, or operational risk management within a risk and control environment.
  • Strong understanding of risk management and compliance.
  • Demonstrated advanced analytical thinking and problem-solving skills, including analyzing large data sets to identify exceptions or patterns.
  • Ability to evaluate multiple aspects of a situation to identify key information.
  • Proven ability to build partnerships with key stakeholders and collaborate with business and functional experts to identify risks and gaps.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to remain flexible and productive through shifting priorities and deadlines.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence business leaders in a meaningful and actionable manner.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.

Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities and Skills:

  • Professional qualifications such as Chartered Accountant (CA), Certified Public Accountant (CPA), Master of Business Administration (MBA) in Finance, or Certified Internal Auditor (CIA).
  • Audit and control testing experience.
  • Experience using tools such as Alteryx or Tableau to support testing activities or metrics reporting.
  • Ability to innovate, challenge the status quo, and identify automation opportunities.

title: Head of Engineering
description:
Head of Engineering

London (Hybrid)


We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Head of Engineer / VP Engineering to lead our Powerdesk product group engineering organization. The ideal candidate will be responsible for overseeing the development and delivery of our software solutions, ensuring they meet the highest standards of performance and reliability.


At Brady Technologies, we are at the forefront of the energy transition, helping market participants navigate new challenges and opportunities with confidence. Our advanced software solutions bring clarity to complex problems and processes, enabling customers to enhance their trading and operations and meet tomorrow’s energy needs. Our product suite serves a diverse client base, including utilities, independent power producers, renewable asset developers, and energy and multi-commodity trading houses. We also provide solutions for oil & gas companies, particularly as they develop their power businesses, state power grid operators, hedge funds and investment management companies.


Our software solutions support critical decision-making and help these regional and global leaders optimise their trading, power operations, and manage complex risks. Our technology facilitates increased automation and efficiency in the face of changing market dynamics including decentralisation, decarbonisation, diversity of generation assets, volatility and evolving regulation. We are proud of the spirit of partnership we have with our customers, many of whom have been with us for a decade or more. Furthermore, we are committed to our values of collaboration, innovation and delivery, to ensure we continue to meet their and the energy market’s needs in the future.


Key Accountabilities:


  • Managing the Principal engineers in Powerdesk engineering, ensuring alignment and common approaches/standards as required.
  • Managing the operational costs of running the various Powerdesk products, and setting engineering direction to increase efficiency and performance in the longer term.
  • Setting consistent engineering standards and practices across the teams and promoting engineering excellence.
  • Working alongside sales and product, you will be the voice of Powerdesk engineering and will ensure planned development work is technically coherent – in particular, ensuring engineering involvement/design as capabilities move from roadmap to sprint planning.
  • Keeping Brady Powerdesk customers informed and engaged with technical delivery, being “the face of Powerdesk engineering” both to Brady customers and other divisions within Brady.
  • Ensuring consistent engineering delivery of product, building a culture of agile product development and continuous improvement.


Key Skills:


  • Strong leadership and team management abilities. You will lead mixed teams in a variety of geographic locations and will be comfortable managing at a distance.
  • Effective communication and collaboration skills. You will represent the short-term power engineering team across Brady and will need to ensure effective working practices with other divisions in the business. You will advocate for the engineering team and effective engineering decisions.
  • The ability to identify business opportunities arising from technology and developing an overall technology strategy to maximise these opportunities. You will articulate the future technology landscape for everyone in the business and will lead in that direction.
  • A strong set of technical skills across both cloud infrastructure and software development is necessary: while you will not often be coding, you will be capable of operating at a level of detail when necessary, challenging technical choices and bringing technical solutions to the team.
  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills. You will be involved in deeply technical decisions and will need to resolve differences in approach between teams.


Knowledge:


· Strong understanding of the principles of cloud-based development, secure development principles and the software lifecycle management of SaaS/cloud-based applications is crucial.

· Technical understanding of event-driven data architectures and streaming systems is important, and a high level of numeracy is required.

· Good understanding of soft real-time systems and meeting performance targets (such as latency requirements) in such an environment.

· General understanding of trading and markets is important to this role, especially knowledge of algorithmic trading technologies.

· Any knowledge of the energy sector and energy trading would be extremely valuable.

· Security, performance, and end-user experience are all important non-functional requirements for Brady products, and good working knowledge of these areas is essential.



Attitudes:


· Innovative and forward-thinking. You will be the final technical decision maker in Powerdesk, and will ensure alignment with overall Brady technology strategy.

· Detail-oriented with a commitment to delivery. You will build a culture of performance within the engineering teams, emphasising shipping product at regular cadence while improving quality

· Strong sense of ownership and responsibility. You will work alongside the product organisation to build the future of short-term energy trading.

· Reliability of forecasts. You will ensure that the planned workloads for the team are realistic and achievable, and you will provide credible estimates for delivery.



Experience:


· Extensive experience in software development and engineering management

· Proven track record in leading teams in similar industry sectors

· Experience with systems that process quantitative data in real-time

· Background in delivering high-quality SaaS solutions in a cloud environment

· Experience in International Energy trading markets is a plus

Job Title:

Senior Expert Gameplay Engineer - Raven Software - Middleton, WI

R028063

Job Description:

Your Mission

Your mission is to create, implement, and refine highly cinematic, player-first experiences that will be enjoyed by millions of gamers worldwide as a Senior Expert Gameplay Engineer.

Thriving in a dynamic and often ambiguous environment is essential. This role requires agility and flexibility, as you'll collaborate closely with a variety of internal and external partners. Through prototyping, iteration, and a commitment to high-quality standards, you'll craft engaging and rewarding player experiences.

This position demands a balance of creativity, technical expertise, leadership, and a deep understanding of player motivations to develop unforgettable in-game moments. Above all, we seek an innovative and dedicated engineer who will help bring our game to life—setting a new standard for excellence in the competitive AAA FPS space.

This role is based in our Madison, WI office and follows an onsite work schedule of four days per week. Work arrangements may change at the company's discretion to meet business needs.

What you bring to the table

The video game industry and therefore our business is fast-paced and will continue to evolve. As such, the duties and responsibilities of this role may be changed as directed by the Company at any time to promote and support our business and relationships with industry partners. Therefore, this role includes, but is not limited to, the following responsibilities:

  • Develop, modify, and debug gameplay and related engine C/C++ code
  • Develop, modify, and debug gameplay code in proprietary scripting language
  • Deploy, evaluate performance, optimize and test software on PC client and server platforms
  • Collaborate with other internal departments (art, design, audio, animation, QA, etc.)
  • Co-develop and collaborate with other Activision studios
  • Document software and features for internal and external engineering teams
  • Participate in the scheduling, design, performance and code review process

Player Profile

Minimum requirements

Experience

  • Shipped at least one game title
  • 13+ years of experience in software engineering
  • Experience in gameplay related fields like AI, physics, animation, weapons, scripting, networking
  • Background in working in multi-threaded code

Knowledge & Skills

  • Proven ability to collaborate, coordinate, communicate and support other team members

  • Comprehensive understanding of object-oriented programming

Key Attributes

  • Creative, motivated, focused, passionate, results-oriented

  • Passion for games

Extra Points

Experience

  • Experience working with first-person shooter gameplay
  • Experience with working with networking services like PSN, Xbox Live, or Steam

Your Platform

Founded in 1990 by brothers Brian and Steve Raffel in Middleton, Wisconsin, Raven Software began as a small studio focused on crafting fantasy and role-playing games. Since then, our award-winning portfolio has grown to include beloved titles such as Hexen, Star Wars Jedi Knight II: Jedi Outcast, Marvel: Ultimate Alliance, and - for the past 15 years - major contributions to the critically acclaimed Call of Duty® franchise. As the lead developers behind Call of Duty: Warzone and the force behind the campaigns of the Black Ops series, most recently Black Ops 6, we have established ourselves as a key player in shaping the FPS genre and pushing the boundaries of what games can achieve.

Our motto, “Our Work Speaks For Us,” symbolizes the dedication and passion that drives everything we do. We’ve built a team rooted in respect, collaboration, and a shared focus on what’s best for the game. We prioritize ambition balanced with care, direct communication, and a culture free of egos. By fostering innovation and owning our mistakes, we continually push boundaries to create unforgettable games for our players. As a studio located in Middleton - a suburb of Madison consistently ranked among the best places to live - we offer a thriving, supportive environment paired with exceptional quality of life.

As we grow and enter the next chapter of our journey, we’re looking for talented individuals eager to pave new ground in our industry. If you’re ready to work with a world-class team, we’d love to hear from you.

At Activision, we strive to create the most iconic brands in gaming and entertainment. We’re driven by our mission to deliver unrivaled gaming experiences for the world to enjoy, together. As a leading worldwide developer, publisher and distributor of interactive entertainment and products, our “press start” is simple: delight hundreds of millions of players around the world with innovative, fun, thrilling, and engaging entertainment experiences.

We’re not just looking back at our decades-long legacy; we’re forging ahead to keep advancing gameplay with some of the most popular titles and sophisticated technology in the world. title: Koordinátor/ka kancelářského provozu pro ESET
description:
Summary

Hledáme člověka, který bude mít na starosti, aby naše kancelář každý den fungovala tak, jak má.

Budete člověkem, který má přehled o tom, co se v kanceláři děje, co je potřeba objednat, doplnit, zařídit, poklidit nebo vyřešit.
Hledáme proto někoho, kdo má přirozený cit pro pořádek a rád tvoří příjemné prostředí kolem sebe.
Člověka, který si všimne, že něco chybí nebo nefunguje a vyřeší to.
Zkrátka někoho, díky komu kancelář funguje, dobře vypadá a lidé se v ní dobře cítí.

Job description

Co bude náplní Tvé práce:

  • Zajištění každodenního chodu kanceláře a dohled nad tím, aby vše fungovalo tak, jak má.
  • Zajištění chodu recepce, vyřizování telefonátů a e-mailů, příchozí a odchozí pošty a dalších souvisejících administrativních úkolů.
  • Péče o návštěvy – jejich přivítání, uvedení do zasedacích místností, příprava občerstvení a zajištění všeho potřebného pro jejich pohodlí.
  • Péče o společné prostory kanceláře a dohled nad jejich čistotou, pořádkem a celkovým vzhledem v průběhu dne.
  • Správa parkování pro kolegy.
  • Zajištění chodu kuchyněk – doplňování nápojů a dalších zásob, péče o myčky, lednice, kávovary a další vybavení.
  • Pravidelné objednávání kancelářských potřeb, potravin, občerstvení a dalších věcí potřebných pro chod kanceláře.
  • Péče o zásoby – jejich převzetí, vybalení, doplnění a průběžná kontrola toho, co je potřeba objednat.
  • Příprava zasedacích místností pro schůzky, školení, semináře a další interní či externí akce.
  • Zajišťování hotelů, jízdenek, letenek, parkování a dalších souvisejících služeb.
  • Být kontaktním bodem pro kolegy v otázkách spojených s každodenním fungováním kanceláře.
  • Řešení drobných provozních problémů a neočekávaných situací.
  • Komunikace s externími dodavateli a poskytovateli služeb.
  • Administrativní podpora kanceláře, práce s tabulkami, evidence došlých faktur a vystavování objednávek.
  • Zastoupení vedoucí kanceláře v době její nepřítomnosti a převzetí části jejích každodenních povinností.
  • V případě potřeby zastupování skladníka – například při kompletaci zásilek, přípravě materiálů na konference nebo obchodní a marketingové akce.
  • Pracovní doba je fixní, reflektuje provoz kanceláře a sice pondělí – pátek od 8:30 do 17:00, není možné vykonávat ji z domova. Pracovní smlouva zpočátku na dobu určitou s možností prodloužení na neurčitou.

Koho si představujeme:

  • Ukončené středoškolské vzdělání ekonomického směru.
  • Běžně pracuješ s MS Office – především s Wordem, Excelem a Outlookem
  • Máš přirozený cit pro pořádek a prostředí kolem sebe. Všímáš si věcí a vidíš, co je potřeba udělat, aniž by Ti to někdo musel říkat.
  • Nevadí Ti, že jeden den budeš řešit administrativu a druhý den vybalovat kartony, doplňovat lednice nebo několikrát za den obsluhovat myčku. Víš, že obojí je součástí dobře fungující kanceláře.
  • Máš příjemné a reprezentativní vystupování a kontakt s lidmi Tě baví.
  • Jsi samostatný/á, pečlivý/á a dokážeš si svou práci dobře zorganizovat.
  • Umíš si poradit i ve chvíli, kdy se sejde několik úkolů najednou, a dokážeš si určit priority.
  • Máš přirozenou potřebu věci dotahovat a hledat řešení.
  • Domluvíš se anglicky – nebudeš angličtinu používat každý den, ale občas Tě čeká telefonát, návštěva nebo e-mail v angličtině.
  • Nástup možný k 1. 11. 2026

Co ESET nabízí?

  • Smysluplnou práci v úspěšné technologické společnosti s více než 100 miliony uživatelů po celém světě.
  • Stabilní zaměstnání na plný úvazek a roli, ve které uvidíte výsledky své práce.
  • Finanční bonusy vyplácené 2x ročně podle výsledků společnosti a pracovního výkonu.
  • Týden dovolené navíc, sick days a širokou nabídku benefitů v rámci kafeterie, včetně příspěvků na Multisport kartu, penzijní připojištění nebo životní pojištění.
  • Plně hrazený stravenkový paušál ve výši 170 Kč za každý odpracovaný den.
  • Terapii nebo koučink hrazené firmou a asistenční program pro zaměstnance.
  • Firemní knihovnu jak klasickou, tak audio se zaměřením na rozvojový obsah.
  • Finanční podporu při významných životních událostech a věrnostní program s dodatečnými benefity pro dlouhodobé zaměstnance.
  • Moderní kanceláře na Praze 7 s ergonomickým vybavením, ovocem, zeleninou, kávou, čajem a nealko nápoji po celý den.
  • Skvělý tým lidí, se kterými je radost spolupracovat.

Více informací o tom, jak se u nás pracuje, se dozvíte na Atmoskopu pod profilem ESET software, spol. s r.o.

SUITABLE APPLICANTS

- Will be based in the UK / Europe

title: Staff Engineer, IT Infrastructure
description:
Staff Engineer, IT Infrastructure


About the Role


PacBio is looking for a Staff Engineer, IT Infrastructure to help design, operate, secure, and evolve the infrastructure supporting our research, engineering, and enterprise environments.


This is a senior individual contributor role for an experienced infrastructure engineer who enjoys remaining hands-on while also thinking about the bigger picture. You will work across Enterprise Linux, HPC and scientific computing, cloud infrastructure, networking, security, storage, observability, and automation.

As part of a relatively small infrastructure team, you will have broad technical ownership and the opportunity to directly influence architecture, engineering standards, modernization strategy, security practices, and operational processes.

We don't expect one person to be an expert in every technology in our environment. We do expect strong infrastructure fundamentals, deep troubleshooting skills, technical curiosity, and a demonstrated ability to take ownership of unfamiliar technologies.

What You'll Do


Infrastructure & HPC

  • Design, administer, and support Enterprise Linux environments across physical, virtual, cloud, and HPC infrastructure.
  • Manage system provisioning, configuration, patching, lifecycle, security hardening, capacity, performance, and automation.
  • Administer and evolve HPC and research-computing environments supporting scientific and engineering workloads.
  • Support enterprise workload scheduling, CPU/GPU compute, high-performance networking, and large-scale storage integration.
  • Partner with researchers and engineers to understand workload requirements, troubleshoot complex issues, and improve compute performance and user experience.


Cloud, Networking & Security

  • Design, operate, and improve infrastructure across on-premises and public-cloud environments.
  • Support cloud compute, networking, storage, identity/access management, security, monitoring, and related services.
  • Troubleshoot infrastructure networking across on-premises, cloud, and HPC environments, including routing, switching, DNS, firewalls, VPNs, segmentation, load balancing, and hybrid connectivity.
  • Apply Zero Trust and secure-by-design principles across infrastructure architecture and operations.
  • Incorporate security into infrastructure operations, including identity and access management, vulnerability management, endpoint protection, security telemetry, system hardening, and incident response.
  • Help establish practical infrastructure security standards, controls, monitoring, and remediation processes.


Storage & Data Infrastructure

  • Support Linux and HPC integration with enterprise storage and large-scale file-storage environments.
  • Troubleshoot storage performance, connectivity, capacity, availability, and data-access issues across the infrastructure stack.
  • Participate in storage capacity planning, architecture, lifecycle, and workload-placement decisions.
  • Work with internal specialists and external partners on complex storage issues and infrastructure improvements.


Automation, Observability & Operational Excellence

  • Automate infrastructure provisioning, configuration, maintenance, validation, and remediation using scripting, APIs, configuration management, and Infrastructure as Code.
  • Improve infrastructure observability through metrics, logging, telemetry, dashboards, and actionable alerting.
  • Apply CI/CD and declarative infrastructure-management practices where appropriate.
  • Explore opportunities to use AI-assisted automation for troubleshooting, telemetry analysis, security operations, documentation, and operational workflows.
  • Reduce technical debt and single-person dependencies through automation, documentation, cross-training, and shared technical ownership.


Technical Leadership

  • Lead complex infrastructure initiatives from requirements and architecture through implementation and operational handoff.
  • Establish engineering standards and reusable infrastructure patterns.
  • Influence technical direction and architecture across teams without requiring direct authority.
  • Mentor engineers and share technical knowledge while remaining hands-on.
  • Balance immediate operational needs with longer-term modernization, reliability, security, and architecture goals.


Required Qualifications

  • Significant experience designing, administering, and supporting production infrastructure at enterprise scale.
  • Deep hands-on Enterprise Linux administration and troubleshooting experience.
  • Experience supporting HPC, scientific computing, large-scale compute, or similarly complex distributed-compute environments.
  • Strong infrastructure networking fundamentals with the ability to troubleshoot across compute, network, storage, and application boundaries.
  • Hands-on experience operating public-cloud infrastructure.
  • Strong automation and scripting skills using modern scripting, configuration-management, API, and Infrastructure-as-Code approaches.
  • Experience with infrastructure monitoring, observability, incident response, and root-cause analysis.
  • Strong understanding of infrastructure security fundamentals, including identity/access management, system hardening, vulnerability management, network security, and secure architecture.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead complex technical initiatives, mentor others, and influence architecture across teams.
  • Excellent interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in several of the following areas is highly desirable, but we do not expect candidates to have worked with every technology or platform:
  • Enterprise HPC workload scheduling and resource management
  • GPU compute infrastructure
  • High-performance and low-latency networking
  • Container orchestration and container platforms
  • Hybrid on-premises/public-cloud infrastructure
  • Infrastructure as Code, configuration management, CI/CD, and declarative infrastructure practices
  • Enterprise NFS and large-scale file, block, or object storage
  • Zero Trust / ZTNA, firewalls, VPNs, and network segmentation
  • SIEM, EDR/XDR, security telemetry, and vulnerability-management platforms
  • SSO, MFA, and identity-security technologies
  • Enterprise monitoring, logging, tracing, and observability platforms
  • Scientific computing, bioinformatics, genomics, or research infrastructure
  • AI-assisted infrastructure operations and automation


Staff-Level Impact

This is not simply an operations role, nor is it an architecture role removed from day-to-day engineering.

We're looking for someone who can troubleshoot a difficult production issue today, understand why the environment allowed it to happen, and help design a better solution for tomorrow.

The right person will be comfortable moving between hands-on engineering and technical leadership: solving complex problems, establishing standards, mentoring others, influencing architecture, challenging assumptions, and helping define where PacBio's infrastructure goes next.

You do not need to already know every technology in our environment. We're more interested in deep infrastructure fundamentals, sound engineering judgment, intellectual curiosity, and a track record of successfully taking ownership of complex systems.

title: Director, Analytical Development
description:
California, US residents click here.

The job details are as follows:

Who We Are

We are the first publicly-traded biotech or pharmaceutical company to take the form of a public benefit corporation. Our public benefit purpose is to provide a brighter future for patients through the development of novel pharmaceutical therapies; and technologies that expand the availability of transplantable organs.

United Therapeutics (Nasdaq: UTHR) seeks to travel down the corridors of indifference to develop treatments for rare, deadly diseases. We were founded in 1996 by a family seeking a cure for their daughter’s pulmonary arterial hypertension (PAH). Today, we have six FDA-approved therapies that treat PAH, pulmonary hypertension associated with interstitial lung disease (PH-ILD) and neuroblastoma, a rare pediatric cancer. Our near-term pipeline seeks to develop additional therapies for PAH and pulmonary fibrosis (PF).

The cure for end-stage life-threatening diseases like PAH, PH-ILD, PF, and many others is an organ transplant, but only a small percentage of donated organs are available to address the vast need. For this reason, we are working to create manufactured organs to address the shortage of kidneys, hearts, lungs, and livers available for transplant. We believe an unlimited supply of tolerable, transplantable organs will eliminate the transplant waiting list and cure end-stage organ diseases for which transplant is not currently an option.

Thymmune, a United Therapeutics subsidiary is a biotechnology company developing a machine learning-driven thymic cell engineering platform to restore normal immune function in aging and disease. The company's cutting-edge approach in iPSC-thymic cell manufacturing can generate off-the-shelf cells at scale. The company is developing a pipeline of therapies to treat immunodeficiencies, transplant related, and autoimmune diseases.

Who You Are

Some people develop assays. Others help build the future of medicine. At Thymmune, you'll do both. As our Director of Analytical Development, you'll lead a high-performing team, shape analytical strategy for a pioneering cell therapy pipeline, and help advance technologies that could redefine how we treat immune disorders and expand the possibilities of transplant medicine. This is a rare opportunity to combine scientific leadership, innovation, and purpose in an environment where bold ideas are encouraged and meaningful impact is expected every day.

The Director, Analytical Development will be leading Thymmune's analytical development strategy to support Thymmune's iPSC derived cell therapy pipeline. This role will define and execute analytical development and method transfer activities to enable iPSC expansion and differentiation in GMP manufacturing throughout the product lifecycle.

  • Lead the strategy, priorities, and roadmap for analytical development and develop phase-appropriate and risk-based analytical assays and potency testing strategies to support Thymmune's pipeline of iPSC-derived cell therapy products
  • Recruit, manage, train, motivate, develop, and mentor Analytical Development staff
  • Provide leadership, direction, and resource allocation for analytical development activities to ensure achievement of departmental objectives and program milestones. Execute analytical development work and perform assays in a laboratory setting, as necessary
  • Oversee and perform the development, authoring, review, and approval of SOPs, test methods, method development reports, and supporting procedures for analytical method development and qualification in support of GMP manufacturing and QC testing
  • Act as an SME for analytical development and lead knowledge and technology transfer strategy and execution for in-process, release, and product characterization methods to CDMOs and CTLs
  • Provide strategic and technical leadership to resolve complex QC testing issues during clinical production at CDMOs. Provide person-in-plant support, as needed
  • Develop, review, and approve analytical development source documents, and provide oversight for relevant CMC sections for regulatory submissions. Support the Regulatory group in responding to agency questions and influence analytical strategies supporting regulatory submissions and agency interactions
  • Lead due diligence, evaluation, and selection activities for Contract Testing Labs (CTLs). Actively participate in due diligence exercise for CDMO selection
  • Ensure the team stays up to date with current technologies and trends, driving continuous improvement, operational excellence, and the advancement of analytical development capabilities
  • Support budget planning, resource forecasting, and capital requirement planning for the Analytical Development function, including developing business cases and recommendations to support departmental and organizational priorities
  • Establish and execute the strategic direction, priorities, and resource plans for the Analytical Development function, partnering cross-functionally with Regulatory, Quality, CDMOs, CTLs, and other R&D stakeholders to support organizational objectives and long-term departmental capabilities
  • Perform all other duties as assigned

Minimum Requirements

  • 15+ years of biotech/pharma industry experience preferably in cell and gene therapy with a Bachelor's Degree in biological sciences, immunology, cell biology, biomedical or biochemical engineering or 13+ years of biotech/pharma industry experience preferably in cell and gene therapy with a Master’s Degree in biological sciences, immunology, cell biology, biomedical or biochemical engineering or 10+ years of biotech/pharma industry experience preferably in cell and gene therapy with a PhD in biological sciences, immunology, cell biology, biomedical or biochemical engineering
  • 7+ years of previous managerial experience
  • Technical expertise in cell therapy analytical methods, such as potency assays, flow cytometry-based assays, and product characterization assays
  • Experience in analytical method development, optimization, qualification, and transfer, in accordance with regulatory guidelines and industry standards
  • Hands-on experience in the characterization of cell therapy products using methods such as flow cytometry, RT-PCR, and ddPCR
  • Knowledge of safety assays required for lot release such as endotoxin, mycoplasma, and sterility, including rapid release tests
  • Expertise in analytical control strategies including specification setting
  • Experience in setting and managing stability studies per ICH guidelines and establishing shelf life for drug substance and drug product
  • Experience with cell-based potency assay development and defining potency testing strategy for cell therapy products
  • Experience establishing and managing interactions with CDMOs and CTLs
  • In-depth understanding of regulatory guidelines and experience with CMC regulatory filings
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with a strong ability to troubleshoot critical issues or problems
  • Excellent communication, technical writing, and presentation skills
  • Ability to work hands-on with a high sense of urgency, accountability, and focus on delivering results
  • Exceptional teamwork and interpersonal skills with the ability to motivate others, influence, and negotiate difficult situations
  • Strong attention to detail and demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively on cross-functional teams and within a dynamic environment

Preferred Qualifications

  • Doctor of Philosophy (PhD) in biological sciences, immunology, cell biology, biomedical or biochemical engineering or Master’s Degree in biological sciences, immunology, cell biology, biomedical or biochemical engineering
  • Knowledge and experience in developing and qualifying analytical methods for iPSC derived cell therapy products
  • Experience with whole genome sequencing methodologies, bioinformatics pipeline, and scRNA Seq

Je beheert, ontwikkelt en vernieuwt het platform, om data diensten te ontsluiten voor VMware, Kubernetes, databases, enterprise applicaties en hybride cloud omgevingen, binnen zowel private en public clouds.

Je vervult een rol met veel impact. Je vertaalt klantbehoeften naar toekomstbestendige oplossingen, adviseert over data protectie, cyber recovery, compliance en business continuïteit en draagt bij aan nieuwe proposities, aanbestedingen en complexe klantvraagstukken. Je werkt volgens DevOps-principes en bent betrokken bij het hele traject: van ontwerp en implementatie tot operationeel beheer en continue verbeteringen.

Wat ga je doen?

  • Je beheert en ontwikkelt data protectie- en recoveryplatformen, met een sterke focus op Commvault.
  • Je bewaakt en verbetert de beschikbaarheid, prestaties en continuïteit van de dienstverlening.
  • Je implementeert en optimaliseert back-up-, recovery- en cyberresilience oplossingen, met o.a. immutable dataopslag en cleanroom recovery.
  • Je automatiseert beheerprocessen en draagt bij aan implementaties met Infrastructure as Code en scripting.
  • Je maakt de omgeving waar mogelijk, toegankelijk via API’s, voor optimale integratie en automatisering.
  • Je werkt intensief samen met collega’s, andere afdelingen binnen KPN en leveranciers om nieuwe functionality and innovaties beschikbaar te maken.
  • Je adviseert klanten over data protectie, cyber recovery, compliance en business continuïteit.
  • Je verbetert continue onze processen, platformen en klantbeleving en deelt actief jouw kennis binnen het team.

We zoeken een ervaren platform engineer met vloeiend Nederlands die woonachtig is in Nederland. Je hebteen een sterke technische basis en een passie voor data, security, continuïteit en cloudtechnologie. Je bent analytisch, klantgericht en voelt je thuis in complexe omgevingen. Je maakt technische vraagstukken inzichtelijk en beweegt gemakkelijk tussen ontwerp, implementatie en beheer. Voor jou blijft het niet bij het bedenken van een oplossing: je wilt deze ook bouwen, testen en samen met je team succesvol realiseren.

Je bent nieuwsgierig, kunt het uitvoeren en denkt in mogelijkheden. Je krijgt energie van innovatie, automatisering en samenwerking. In een omgeving waarin technische diepgang, kennisdeling en klantwaarde centraal staan, voel jij je helemaal thuis.

  • HBO- of WO-werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur in de richting IT, Informatica of vergelijkbaar.
  • Aantoonbare ervaring met complexe back-up- en recoveryoplossingen, ervaring met Commvault is hierin een pré.
  • Kennis van storageplatformen, object storage en cloudgebaseerde opslagdiensten; ervaring met systemen van Cloudian en Scality is gewenst.
  • Ervaring met Linux- en/of Windows-platformen.
  • Kennis van VMware, Kubernetes, OpenStack en public cloudplatformen, b.v. Microsoft Azure, AWS en/of Google Cloud.
  • Ervaring met automatisering en scripting, b.v. Python en/of PowerShell.
  • Inzicht in security-, compliance- en cyberresilience concepten.
  • Ervaring binnen een serviceprovider of system integrator is een sterke pré.
  • Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden in het Nederlands en in het Engels.
  • Een open houding ten opzichte van een aanvullende ABRO- of ABDO-screening.

Ben jij de persoon van wie onze klanten zeggen: “Hier zouden we er meer van willen hebben”? Denk je graag mee over hoe het werk slimmer, leuker en beter kan? Dan is dit jouw kans. Sluit je aan bij Private Cloud en maak het verschil!

Natuurlijk hebben we als werkgever jou ook veel te bieden. Dit krijg je van ons:

  • Een bruto maandsalaris van minimaal € 5216,- en € 7843,- afhankelijk van je werkervaring, op basis van 40 uur
  • Vaste 13e maand, een deel krijg je maandelijks uitbetaald en een deel in januari van het
    volgende jaar. Óf je zet het in voor een FLEX & BOOST doel naar keuze!
  • Jaarlijks een individuele en collectieve verhoging conform onze CAO
  • € 1500 per jaar aan inzetbaarheidsbudget dat je naar eigen inzicht mag gebruiken voor
    bijvoorbeeld trainingen, coaching en cursussen
  • Flexibele vrije dagen: onze collega’s mogen zelf (in samenspraak met de manager)
    bepalen hoe zij met verlof omgaan
  • Een goede werk-privé balans (zoals 2 dagen kantoor, 3 dagen thuis, transitieverlof,
    feestdagwissel naar een feestdag van jouw religieuze of culturele voorkeur)
  • Thuiswerkshop om je werkplek thuis optimaal in te kunnen richten, uiteraard met een
    mobiele telefoon & laptop
  • 50% korting op onze producten en diensten, zodat je voordelig kunt internetten, bellen
    én streamen
  • Goede reiskostenvergoeding: je krijgt je OV kosten volledig vergoed of € 0,23 per
    kilometer als je met de auto reist. Kom je liever op de fiets? Dan kun je aanspraak maken
    op onze fietsvergoeding € 0,40 per kilometer
  • Mogelijkheid tot het aanschaffen van een leasefiets waar KPN maandelijks aan
    meebetaalt (bij onbepaalde tijd contract): Van stadsfiets tot e-bike en van racefiets tot
    speed-pedelec; jij kiest waar je op fietst
  • Uitstekende pensioenvoorwaarden: een totale inleg van 25% van je pensioengevende
    salaris waarvan KPN 17,5% inlegt en jij 7,5%

Ons geloof in technologie is groot. Dit wordt nóg krachtiger samen met menselijk contact, daarom ontmoeten we je graag!

title: Sjuksköterska till Saltsjöbadens sjukhus
description:
Det här är ett jobb för dig som är driven, vill utvecklas i din yrkesroll och bidra till hälsa och livskvalitet för dem som bor hos oss. Här får du bra arbetstider, jobba självständigt och ha frihet att utforma dina arbetsdagar.

Hos oss på Vardaga får du också engagerade kollegor och duktiga chefer, utbildningar, karriärmöjligheter samt flera förmåner.

Här några av höjdpunkterna i vårt erbjudande till dig:

  • Bra schema och arbetstider. Dagtid, vissa kvällar samt helger.

  • Hög kvalitet och stöd av tydliga rutiner: Lättillämpliga rutiner, styrdokument, checklistor och kvalitetsledningssystem ger dig ett omfattande stöd i arbetet.

  • Kompetensutveckling: Du har tillgång till Vardagas interna utbildningsorganisation Lära med en mängd kurser. Du har också möjlighet att ansöka om utbildningstjänst för att bli specialistsjuksköterska.

  • Karriärmöjligheter: Som sjuksköterska kan du gå vidare och bli enhetschef eller verksamhetschef för ett boende.

  • Bra ledning och korta beslutsvägar: Din chef finns nära till hands för stöd och för att bolla idéer. En av boendets sjuksköterskor sitter också alltid med i den lokala ledningsgruppen.

  • Gemenskap och stöd: Du jobbar nära sjuksköterskekollegor, gruppchefer och omvårdnadspersonal. Inom Vardaga finns ett nationellt nätverk för sjuksköterskor för att utväxla inspiration och kunskap.

  • Förmånsportal med rabatter: Köp till exempel biobiljetter och resor med kollektivtrafik till bra priser.

    Höjdpunkterna är baserade på svar från Vardagas 180 sjuksköterskor som listat sina bästa argument för att jobba hos oss. Läs mer om deras svar här.

Om rollen

Du är spindeln i nätet kring de boendes hälso- och sjukvårdsinsatser och jobbar för att ge livskvalitet. Du ansvarar för att medicinska ordinationer följs. Regelbundet genomför du riskbedömningar och uppföljningar för att säkerställa god kvalitet i verksamheten.

Samarbete och stöd

Du ingår i ett team med omsorgspersonal, sjuksköterskor, arbetsterapeut och fysioterapeut. En viktig roll för dig är att coacha och utbilda omsorgspersonalen så att ni tillsammans ger varje boende ett så gott liv som möjligt. I detta jobbar du nära boendets gruppchefer som är ansvariga för omsorgspersonalen. Våra gruppchefer coachar också och jobbar tillsammans med teamen i det dagliga arbetet.

Vi satsar på ledarskapsutveckling för dig som sjuksköterska. En kurs vi kan erbjuda dig att gå är ”Att leda utan att vara chef”.

Lära känna de boende

Att förstå de boendes önskemål och se små förändring i deras hälsa och sjukdomstillstånd är många gånger avgörande för korrekta bedömningar och beslut.

Tydliga rutiner

För att skapa trygghet och tydlighet för dig som sjuksköterska finns ett omfattande stöd i form av praktiska och lättillämpliga rutiner, styrdokument och checklistor. Vårt kvalitetsledningssystem heter Qualimax och är branschledande.

Som ny sjuksköterska hos oss deltar du i vårt digitala introduktionsprogram tillsammans med din mentor för att säkerställa att du får en tydlig introduktion med målet att snabbt komma in i arbetet och våra rutiner.

Om Saltsjöbadens sjukhus

Saltsjöbadens äldreboende finns i en vacker och anrik miljö vid Baggensfjärden strax intill Stockholms skärgård med havet som granne. Här arbetar ett kompetent team som trivs på jobbet - vi välkomnar nu ytterligare en kollega till vår trevliga arbetsplats.

På Saltsjöbadens sjukhus finns 92 lägenheter och vi erbjuder både permanent boende (avdelningar för personer med demenssjukdom och somatiska avdelningar) samt korttidsboende.

Här finns en god arbetsmiljö som du aktivt kan påverka. Vi är en dynamisk arbetsplats med korta beslutsvägar, tydliga mål och där kvalitet och service prioriteras.

Det är cirka 10 minuters promenadväg till Saltsjöbanans station Saltsjöbaden. Fri parkering finns i anslutning till boendet.

Din erfarenhet och kunskap

Du är legitimerad sjuksköterska och vi ser gärna att du har arbetat några år inom äldreomsorgen. Våra boende är ofta multisjuka och det kräver att du har både översiktliga kunskaper kring olika sjukdomar och tillstånd samt ett intresse för den åldrande människan. God datorvana samt erfarenhet av dokumentation är viktigt.

Vi önskar att du

  • gillar att jobba självständigt och att ha friheten att utforma dina arbetsdagar

  • är trygg i din roll som sjuksköterska och kan fatta snabba beslut och föra en diskussion med ansvarig läkare

  • tar egna initiativ, har skinn på näsan och vågar ta för dig

  • tycker om att ha en ledarroll och att stötta dina kollegor

  • är van att strukturera och organisera ditt arbete.

"Jag har alltid blivit trodd och satsad på och när man har idéer så lyssnar arbetsgivaren. " - Mårten Hedberg, Medicinskt ansvarig sjuksköterska, Stockholm

Övrigt

Lön: Vi tillämpar individuell lönesättning
Tillträdesdatum: Enligt överenskommelse
Sista ansökningsdag: 29 november 2026. Intervjuer och rekrytering kommer att påbörjas innan sista ansökningsdag.
Registerkontroll: Utdrag ur belastningsregister skall uppvisas vid en eventuell anställning
Har du frågor? Kontakta gärna: Verksamhetschef Åsa Smedberg, mejl: asa.smedberg@vardaga.se. Observera att det inte går att ansöka via E-post. Vi tillämpar 6 månaders provanställning.
Om du vill veta mer om hur det är att jobba på Vardaga så läs gärna mer och träffa några av våra medarbetare här.

Facklig kontakt: Vårdförbundet Mail: vardforbundet@ambea.se

Ansökan

Välkommen att ansöka via knappen ”Skicka ansökan” nedan. Vänta inte med att ansöka då vi gör urval löpande.

Om du blir kallad till en intervju behöver du kunna styrka att du har rätt att arbeta i Sverige, genom att uppvisa att du har medborgarskap inom EU/EES eller ett giltigt arbetstillstånd.

Läs mer om oss på www.vardaga.se

title: Marine Historic Environment Record Officer
description:
**Summary**

Historic England is the public organisation that brings new life to heritage to build a better future for every place and everyone.

Historic England has a fantastic opportunity for you to join us as our Marine Historic Environment Record Officer.

**This is a Maternity Cover contract.**

The location of this role is Swindon, inclusive with hybrid working.

We offer a wide benefits package including a competitive defined benefit **pension scheme to which we make 28.97% employer contributions,** a generous 28 days holiday, corporate discounts, free entry into English Heritage sites across the country and development opportunities to ensure you achieve your goals.

To view our full range of benefits please follow the link [here](https://historicengland.org.uk/about/jobs/employee-rewards-and-benefits/).

**What you will be doing**

As Marine Historic Environment Record (HER) Officer, you will help maintain the Marine Heritage Environment Record (Marine HER) and provide information to support research and the preparation of policies and proposals for the management of sustainable change in the marine historic environment. You will work to ensure that Historic England (HE), its partners and members of the public have access to accurate and reliable information about the marine historic environment.

You will also assist the Marine HER Manager in the analysis and interpretation of data relating to the marine historic environment, as well as other relevant datasets, and will help provide a specialist customer service for internal and external users of the Marine HER.

**Who we are looking for**

- Relevant subject matter expertise

- Experience of using databases, spreadsheets and GIS

- Collaborative and team working

- Customer service experience

- Ability to time manage and work to deadline

- Communication skills


**Please note your application will be scored and assessed against the above criteria.**

Historic England is a Disability Confident Leader and normally offers guaranteed interviews to disabled candidates who meet the minimum criteria for the role, where it is practical and appropriate to do so. We want all candidates to shine in the recruitment process, so please tell us what we can do to help you show us your very best self. For more information, please visit our [Everyone is Welcome page](https://historicengland.org.uk/about/jobs/everyone-is-welcome/ "https://historicengland.org.uk/about/jobs/everyone-is-welcome/"), or contact us at [recruitmentTeam@Historicengland.org.uk](mailto:recruitmentTeam@Historicengland.org.uk) if you have any recruitment queries.

We are an equal opportunity employer which values diversity and inclusion. If you have a disability or neurodiversity, we would be happy to discuss reasonable adjustments to the job with you. Having won the Gold Award from MIND for workplace wellbeing in seven consecutive years, we also recognise the importance of a healthy work-life balance.

We are an inclusive employer and believe that flexible working options are for everyone. We want to make sure our working arrangements don’t prevent anyone from joining us because of their personal circumstances. We also want to provide you with the best balance in your home and work life that we can.

We are open to considering options including job sharing, part-time working, compressed hours working and different working locations, including hybrid working. Please visit our jobs pages or contact us to find out more.

**Why work for Historic England**

We are committed to promoting equality of opportunity for everyone. Diversity helps us to perform better and attract more people to support our work. We welcome and encourage job applications from people of all backgrounds.

We particularly encourage applications from Black, Asian and Minority Ethnic candidates and candidates with disabilities as they are underrepresented within Historic England at this level.

Historic England wants all of our candidates to shine in the recruitment process. Please tell us what we can do to make sure you can show us your very best self. You can contact us by email at [recruitmentTeam@Historicengland.org.uk](mailto:recruitmentTeam@Historicengland.org.uk) if you have any recruitment queries.

**At Historic England we use a hiring system called Applied. Applied is a behavioural science-backed recruitment platform that reduces bias, improves quality of hire and increases diversity. We do not use CV application for the majority of our hiring processes. You will answer a selection of questions that allow our hiring teams to test your skills and suitability for the role.**

At Historic England, we value the expertise and individuality each candidate brings and want to hear about this in your own words. If you require the use or AI tools or other resources to support your application, we ask that all information is factually accurate, original, and reflects your own experience. To best represent yourself, we encourage you to write in your own words and use AI-generated content only as inspiration—not as direct input.

Provisional interview dates: 23rd November 2026

Please follow the link for a full copy of the Job Description –

[https://historicengland.org.uk/media/5pshxitv/marine-historic-environment-record-officer.odt](https://cms.historicengland.org.uk/media/5pshxitv/marine-historic-environment-record-officer.odt)

**Historic England only accepts applications through our authorised recruitment platform, Applied. We will never ask applicants to pay any fee or provide payment details during the recruitment process. Please only apply using the application link provided within this advert.**

title: Senior Software Engineer (TS/SCI)
description:
Vantor is forging the new frontier of spatial intelligence, helping decision makers and operators navigate what’s happening now and shape what’s coming next. Vantor is a place for problem solvers, changemakers, and go-getters—where people are working together to help our customers see the world differently, and in doing so, be seen differently. Come be part of a mission, not just a job, where you can: Shape your own future, build the next big thing, and change the world.

To be eligible for this position, you must be a U.S. Citizen. This position requires an active U.S. Government security clearance, applicants who do not currently hold the required clearance will not be eligible for consideration. Employment for cleared roles is contingent upon verification of clearance status.



Export Control/ITAR: Certain roles may be subject to U.S. export control laws, requiring U.S. person status as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3).

Please review the job details below.

This position requires an active U.S. Government Security Clearance at the TS/SCI level.


Do you enjoy being an integral part of solving mission-critical, real-world problems? Do you like working with geospatial intelligence (GEOINT) data? If so, you’ll love working with us! Our solutions require innovative approaches that integrate bespoke capabilities and tools to solve our customers most complex challenges. We’re seeking an experienced full stack software engineer to support work across the full analytical workflow. Technical tasks include ELT, managing, analyzing, and enrichment of large geospatial data sets to extract meaningful knowledge with cloud-based processing technologies and emerging AI/ML techniques.


We want a self-motivated engineer who is comfortable digging into data, trying innovative approaches, and isn't afraid to fail fast and move on to other techniques/ideas.


  • Responsibilities:
  • Design and implement efficient, flexible solutions that can scale for mission critical applications.
  • Active in all aspects of the development lifecycle, including planning, requirements development, software design, implementation and build, documentation, testing, deployment and maintenance.
  • Apply software standards and processes to produce high quality, extensible, and maintainable software solutions.
  • Work with cloud tech stacks to perform data extraction, manipulation, transformation; visualization of geospatial-temporal data sets
  • Develop analytics/derivative data products to help users extract meaningful knowledge
  • Proactive approach to trouble shooting and problem-solving issues
  • Collaborate with diverse teams of engineers, clients, and users

Minimum Qualifications:

title: Staff Thermal Engineer - Space Payload Design, Analysis and Modeling
description:
Infleqtion is a global quantum technology company solving the world’s most challenging problems. The company harnesses quantum mechanics to build and integrate quantum computers, sensors, and networks. From fundamental physics to leading edge commercial products, Infleqtion enables “quantum everywhere” through our ecosystem of devices and platforms.

Location

Infleqtion has 6 office locations, operating out of Boulder/Louisville, CO; Madison, WI; Chicago, IL; Oxford, UK; and Melbourne, AU. This position is a full-time, hybrid position which will be located in our Louisville, CO office.

Position Summary

Infleqtion is seeking a highly experienced thermal analyst; this role is responsible for keeping our sensor head and electronics temperature limits in check when performing physics sequences enabling quantum sensing operations in space.

The role requires close collaboration with our prime customer(s), internal management, researchers, systems engineers, aerospace experts, manufacturing partners, suppliers, and external subcontractors. The individual will actively engage customers and partners throughout the program lifecycle, ensuring delivery against milestones and commitments while maintaining alignment with Infleqtion’s internal product lifecycle and quality standards. Cross-disciplinary engagement is expected, with this role driving technical alignment across hardware, software, systems, and mission domains.

Travel

Up to 10% travel may be required to support off-site testing, deliveries, and integration.

Job Responsibilities

The duties and responsibilities outlined below include essential functions of the role. Depending on business needs, this role may perform a combination of some or all the following duties. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change, or new ones may be assigned.

  • Update the existing system-level thermal model with the appropriate fidelity to ensure the physics sequence operates within space environmental constraints
  • Conduct regular technical discussions and model reviews of in-house and subcontractor electronic card and enclosure cooling designs, including some of them which have unique thermal requirements
  • Develop and test EDU thermal designs for microgravity environments
  • Adapt flight thermal designs for microgravity testing
  • Serve as a hands-on engineer with experience building both EDU and flight hardware
  • Install MLI and bond heaters and thermistors using ASTM-E595 approved materials
  • Presenting progress and results to senior management and the end customer
  • Execution of modelling, simulation, and analytical efforts required to enable product performance
  • Integration of subsystems and their thermal requirements / interfaces
  • Identifying and engaging key suppliers
  • Following Infleqtion’s Product Lifecycle Process and supporting Phase gate reviews, critical design reviews, and executive updates
  • Supporting development of risk management plans and risk resolution, and supporting reliability analysis and continuous improvement
  • Coaching and mentoring junior engineers
  • Other duties as assigned or required

Requirements

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree required, with a focus in thermal design or a related engineering field
  • 6+ years of relevant and progressive experience in similar roles
  • Hands on engineer with experience building both EDU and flight hardware
  • Experience installing MLI, bonding of heaters and thermistors using ASTM-E595 approved materials
  • Leverages AI appropriately; understands limitations of current offerings
  • Excellent proficiency in design first principles
  • Expert level understanding of opto-mechanics, including free space optical mounting, collimator design, free space and fiber coupled alignment design and tolerancing
  • Demonstrated Dfx (design to cost etc.)
  • Understanding of ASTM E595 – how to choose materials for space
  • Experience designing custom flexure mounts for both optics and instruments
  • Tolerance analysis
  • Hands on engineer with experience building both EDU and flight hardware
  • Uses AI appropriately for leverage; understands limitations of current platforms
  • Ability to travel domestically and (potentially) internationally up to 10%

Desired Qualifications

  • Comfortable with a hands-on approach to engineering leadership
  • Master’s or PhD degree in aerospace mechanical engineering or related field
  • Experience in delivering new, advanced technologies to commercial markets
  • Experience in hardware DFx (design for cost, manufacturing, assembly, test, sustainment)
  • Familiarity with quantum computing, mechanics, or physics

Working Conditions and Physical Requirements

This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws and regulations, including the Export Administration Regulations (EAR) and the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR). Please note that any offer for employment may be conditioned on authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export control laws and regulations without sponsorship for an export license


Work will normally be performed in an office and laboratory environment and around technical equipment including computers and lasers. Able to sit, stand, bend, lift and carry up to 40 pounds without assistance. Able to efficiently use automated office equipment such as laptops, copiers, and printers; able to effectively engage in communications (via phone, computer, or in-person). Any required Personal Protective Equipment will be provided and must be properly used in accordance with company requirements.

title: Senior Analytics and Business Insights Analyst
description:
Change people’s lives and love what you do! Cochlear is the most recognized brand in hearing health care.

Senior Analytics and Business Insights Analyst

Position Spotlight:

  • 3+ years of experience in finance, economics, analytics, or a related field; bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience.
  • Serve as a strategic analytics advisor to assigned business functions; translate business needs into actionable insights and recommendations; and develop dashboards, scorecards, forecasts, and reporting solutions.
  • Schedule, travel requirements, and location were not specified in the job description.

About the role

Change people’s lives and love what you do at Cochlear—the most recognized brand in hearing health care—helping people hear and be heard around the world. If you know business analytics, data visualization, and stakeholder partnership, this is a fantastic opportunity to join the Analytics Hub team at the global leader in implantable hearing devices! In this role, you will serve as a strategic advisor to assigned business functions, translating business needs into actionable insights, reporting solutions, and data-driven recommendations.

Your success in this role is measured by delivering accurate, actionable insights and reporting solutions that support decision-making, improve performance, and advance organizational objectives. Work collaboratively with business leaders, assigned stakeholder groups, and centralized analytics, reporting, and data platform resources within the Analytics Hub to identify trends, opportunities, risks, and performance drivers.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop trusted partnerships with business leaders and stakeholders, understand their goals and challenges, and serve as the primary analytics point of contact for assigned stakeholder groups.
  • Perform quantitative and qualitative analysis, including root-cause analysis, forecasting, scenario modeling, and performance assessments, to identify trends, opportunities, risks, and performance drivers.
  • Develop and maintain Tableau dashboards, scorecards, reporting solutions, and visualizations that communicate business performance and key insights to leadership teams and stakeholders.
  • Partner with the Analytics Hub to support data quality, reporting consistency, governance, automation, process improvement, self-service analytics, and standardization of metrics and business definitions.

Key Requirements

To add value to Cochlear in this role you'll be able to meet and demonstrate the following knowledge, skills and abilities in your application and at interview:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience.
  • 3+ years of experience in finance, economics, analytics, or a related field.
  • Proficiency in Tableau and/or Salesforce Health Cloud, or demonstrated ability to learn and apply these tools quickly.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel or similar tools to present, summarize, and manipulate data, including tables, charts, and graphs.
  • Proven ability to tell the story with data and present findings to senior leaders, managers/supervisors, and team members.
  • Ability to communicate effectively in writing and orally with stakeholders at all levels.
  • Commitment to high standards of data accuracy and visualization consistency.
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced environment, manage multiple changing priorities, seek varied input, and identify creative solutions that challenge the status quo.

Total Rewards

In addition to the opportunity to develop your knowledge and grow professionally, we offer competitive wages and benefits.

  • Pay Range in the United States: $90,000 - $106,000 based upon experience, as well as an annual bonus opportunity of 7.5% of base salary. Exact compensation may vary based on skills, experience, and location.
  • Benefit package includes medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance as well as 401(K) matching with immediate vesting, Paid Time Off, tuition reimbursement, maternity and paternity leave, Employee Stock Purchase Plan and pet insurance.

Who are we?

Human needs have always been our inspiration, ever since Professor Graeme Clark set out to create the first multi-channel cochlear implant because he saw his father struggle with hearing loss. We always start with people in mind – thinking about their needs.


For this reason, our products, services and support will continue to evolve and improve. We are by our customers’ side through the entire hearing journey, so they can experience a life full of hearing. Our employees tell us that the number one reason they enjoy working for Cochlear is the opportunity to make a difference to people’s lives and working in an organization where they can be part of bringing the mission to life each day.


Physical & Mental Demands

The physical and mental demands described below are representative of those that must be met to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the individual is regularly required to be in a stationary (seated/standing) position; utilize business technology for work product delivery, communicate orally and in writing with others internal or external to the organization, utilize problem solving/critical thinking skills to discern and convey information. May be asked to occasionally transport/move up to 30 pounds, depending on the position. Specific vision abilities required by this job include ability to adjust focus. The individual is regularly required to utilize comprehension, critical thinking, communication, problem solving, organization reasoning, relating to others and discernment of items such as product specifications, procedures and processes to customers (whether internal or external). Influence, organization/classification of information and planning are also required.

The work environment is a hybrid office /work from home environment. This is representative of the environment an individual may encounter while performing the essential functions of this job.

Since the start, we’ve raised $165M from Headline, Northzone, Eurazeo, Bpifrance, and the founders of King, Sorare, and Spotify, people who’ve built and backed the games and platforms we admire, now supporting our drive to create the next ones.

At Homa, we are building the next billion-player experiences from the ground up and shaping the future of entertainment.

The opportunity

You'll join the Chief of Staff and work directly with Homa's executive team on the projects that matter most to the company right now. There's no shadow work: you'll own missions from the first question to the final result.

You will develop a 360° understanding of Homa while building your analytical, project management, and communication skills. Based on your strengths, interests, and business needs, you will contribute to one or several core teams, taking on increasing responsibility with guidance from experienced colleagues.

What you'll do

  • Structure. Take messy business questions from stakeholders, break them down, and turn them into clear next steps.
  • Analyze. Run market research, competitive benchmarks, and quantitative analyses that feed decisions.
  • Automate. Work with our AI experts to design and deploy AI-powered workflows across the company.
  • Simplify. Map processes, cut what doesn't add value, and put practical fixes in place.
  • Deliver. Drive projects to completion by coordinating people, tracking progress, and measuring impact.
  • Recommend. Turn your work into short, sharp recommendations that leaders can act on.

Why Homa

  • Exceptional growth. We hire people of outstanding potential, then put them where they can grow fastest.
  • Real ownership, early. Your projects will change how Homa operates, and you'll see the results.
  • Learn from leadership. You'll work alongside leaders and people who make decisions.
  • A high talent bar. Our teams are small and demanding, and the people around you will push you to grow.
  • AI at the core. You'll have access to the best AI tools, and you'll help shape how an AI-first company works,.

Requirements

  • Extreme ownership. You drive outcomes rather than just attend meetings. When something breaks, you fix it instead of explaining why it broke.
  • Proactive. You don't wait for instructions or perfect conditions. You spot what needs doing and do it.
  • Pragmatism and simplicity. You look for the simplest solution that works, use whatever tools are available, and ship. Done and useful beats perfect and late.
  • Sharp thinking. You learn fast, reason from facts, and structure your ideas clearly. You can explain something complex in a few sentences.
  • AI-driven. AI is already part of how you work every day. You've used it to automate, speed up, or rethink at least one thing you're proud of.
  • Hungry and motivated. You're ambitious, high-energy, and grounded. You see this internship as a chance to learn faster than anywhere else, and you're ready to work for it.
  • Bonus: you've built something. A game, an app, a student initiative, a side business. We'd love to hear about it.

For this role, you'll also bring:

  • Strong analytical skills in Excel or Google Sheets. SQL is a plus.
  • The ability to switch between different topics in the same week.
  • A prior internship in consulting, a startup, tech, or gaming is a plus.
  • Current studies in Business, Engineering, Strategy, Finance, or related fields.

Practical details

  • A 6-month internship, with a flexible start date. We adapt to any month.
  • A convention de stage (internship agreement) is required.
  • Apprenticeships (alternance) are also welcome.
  • Paris based. You'll need to be able to work onsite at our Paris office.
  • Fluent English is required. French is a plus, not a requirement.
  • Top performers may be offered a full-time role at the end of the internship.

Our Culture

At Homa, we prioritise talent, energy, and determination over traditional credentials. We’re building a global community of brilliant, driven people who think boldly, act with pragmatism, move fast, and push boundaries. We believe true innovation comes from diverse perspectives, deep collaboration, and curiosity without limits. Our culture is grounded in four core values:

  • Humility: We recognise that we are always learning, we can always improve and grow - we stay grounded in a clear view of ourselves.
  • Curiosity: We continuously seek the “why” behind the “what” - we explore with purpose and practicality.
  • Focus: Our curiosity takes us deeper, not wider - we obsess over the details and let pragmatism guide our attention.
  • Ambition: We strive for the best - we don’t settle for “good enough,” - we use common sense to reach higher.

Benefits

Building great games starts with building a great place to work. Here’s what you can expect:

  • 🏥 Comprehensive Benefits: Depending on your location, you’ll enjoy a range of perks such as insurance, meal vouchers, public transport, gym memberships, and more.
  • 🏢 Paris HQ Access: Enjoy a desk at our private office in a well-located WeWork building that will give you access to WeWork perks like rooftop view and designed coworking spaces.
  • 🌍 Coworking Access: You will have access to WeWork spaces throughout Europe, along with all their perks and professional office environments.
  • 🌐 Global Team: Collaborate in English with top-tier talent from 35+ countries, spanning Europe, the UK, the US, and more. Diversity fuels our creativity and innovation.
  • ✈️ Team Gatherings: We value time together beyond the screen. Join us for occasional team gatherings, off-site retreats (Workations as we name them) to connect, recharge, and celebrate.
  • 📈 Performance Reviews: We’re committed to your growth. Every six months, we reflect on your progress, recognize your achievements, and align on clear development goals.
  • 💻 Equipment Support: From day one, we’ll provide everything you need to do your best work, including a home office setup allowance if you're working remotely.

Where We Hire

Our HQ in Paris is a vibrant hub of creativity, collaboration, and connection. From rooftop lunches and coffee chats to after-work apéros and community events, we’ve designed a space people genuinely enjoy - all within a cozy WeWork filled with good energy (and snacks).
