title: Web Developer
description:
About Presto Phoenix, Inc.

Presto is the leading Voice AI company for restaurant drive-thrus, operating at scale in complex, noisy, customer-facing environments. As the AI partner to more than a dozen of the most iconic American restaurant brands, Presto is building one of the most impactful real-world applications of AI that directly impacts revenue, labor efficiency, and a magical guest experience for millions of people.

About Presto Phoenix, Inc.

Presto is the leading Voice AI company for restaurant drive-thrus, operating at scale in complex, noisy, customer-facing environments. As the AI partner to more than a dozen of the most iconic American restaurant brands, Presto is building one of the most impactful real-world applications of AI that directly impacts revenue, labor efficiency, and a magical guest experience for millions of people. AI is not a feature at Presto; it is the foundation of how we build, evaluate, and evolve our products. We operate at lightning-speed iteration cycles and are solving some of the hardest problems in Voice AI. We are backed by Remus Capital, were a Y Combinator company, and are headquartered in Silicon Valley. This may not be the right fit for you if you are looking for a traditional 9-to-5 environment. We move at the pace of AI. Change is constant, and roadmaps evolve quickly. Presto is for builders, experimenters, and problem-solvers who thrive in ambiguity, learn continuously, and are excited to shape the future of real-world AI alongside a high-performance team.

The Role

We are looking for a Web Developer to help build the interfaces and web experiences that power Presto's Voice AI platform, from internal operator dashboards to customer-facing configuration tools. This is a hands-on engineering role where you will write production React code that real restaurant operators and internal teams rely on every day. You will work closely with backend, AI, and product teams to translate business requirements into clean, responsive, and reliable user interfaces. You are someone who cares about code quality, is comfortable moving quickly, and wants to grow your skills across the full front-end stack in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment. Success in this role requires strong fundamentals in modern web development, an ownership mindset, and the ability to move quickly from design to production.

What You'll Do

Build and maintain production web applications

  • Design, develop, test, and maintain responsive front-end applications using React, JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3.
  • Build reusable, efficient React components and maintain clean state management practices.
  • Work across the full front-end lifecycle, from prototyping through production deployment and monitoring.
  • Collaborate with backend engineers to integrate REST and GraphQL APIs into front end applications.

Apply strong engineering fundamentals

  • Write clean, well-tested, maintainable code and participate in peer code reviews.
  • Apply disciplined coding practices, version control, and testing standards to support fast, reliable releases.
  • Debug issues across the stack and boost the overall efficiency and reliability of the software.
  • Contribute to system design discussions and help define front end architecture and best practices.

Work with modern tooling and APIs

  • Build against GraphQL and REST API layers, working closely with backend teams on contract design.
  • Use Node.js for tooling, light backend services, and build processes as needed.
  • Stay current on front end tooling, frameworks, and techniques, and bring improvements back to the team.

Collaborate across teams

  • Work closely with product, design, AI, and backend teams to deliver new features end-to-end.
  • Translate business and operator needs into practical, scalable front-end solutions.
  • Communicate technical tradeoffs and progress clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Solid hands-on experience with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript as core front end languages.
  • Hands-on experience building applications with React.
  • Experience with Node.js for tooling, services, or full-stack work.
  • Experience integrating front end applications with GraphQL and REST API layers.
  • Strong understanding of software engineering fundamentals: data structures, debugging, and testing.
  • Ability to work in fast-paced, ambiguous startup environments with a high degree of ownership.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills; comfortable working asynchronously across time zones.
  • Experience with responsive, mobile-first design and cross-browser compatibility.
  • Experience with accessibility standards and testing (e.g., WCAG 2.1).
  • Familiarity with CI/CD tools and workflows (e.g., GitHub Actions, Jenkins).
  • Experience working on real-time or data-heavy dashboards and interfaces.
  • Prior experience at a high-growth startup or AI-native company.

What We're Looking For

Nice to Have

Why Presto

We move at the speed of AI. Change is constant, and iteration is rapid. This is not a traditional environment. Success requires adaptability, curiosity, and a willingness to solve problems in real time. This is a high-ownership environment where engineers have direct impact on real-world systems operating at scale. You'll work on technology that is deployed in live customer environments and directly drives business outcomes.

Compensation & Benefits

The Canada base salary range for this position is approximately CAD $55K-$92K annually, plus equity and benefits. Compensation is determined by role, level, location, and individual experience. Presto's compensation philosophy rewards high performers and aligns incentives with long-term value creation. Benefits for Canada-based employees include medical, dental, and vision insurance, and paid time off (PTO). Learn more at www.presto.com.

Our Commitment

We value people from all walks of life and are committed to building an inclusive and equitable work environment. We strongly encourage candidates from historically underrepresented backgrounds to apply. Presto Phoenix, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to protected characteristics. If you need an accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact recruiting@presto.com.

title: Silicon Photonics Test Development Engineer (2027 New College Graduate)
description:

New college graduates are provided with mentorship, networking, and leadership opportunities, which give our new team members life-long connections and skills.​


Summary of Role:

New College Graduate position within the GF Test Development organization supporting Silicon Photonics (SiPh) semiconductor technologies for high-speed data center, high-performance computing, and hyperscale computing applications. This engineer will develop and improve automated optical and electrical test solutions used to characterize photonic integrated circuits (PICs), analyze device performance, and support reliable technology development and product qualification.


Essential Responsibilities include:

  • Develop, execute, and document optical and electrical test plans for silicon photonic integrated circuits, including automated instrument control, test sequencing, data acquisition, and analysis in a Linux environment using Python and C/C++.
  • Perform device and circuit characterization, including DC current-voltage (I-V), capacitance-voltage (C-V), optical insertion loss, waveguide loss, wavelength response, fiber-to-chip coupling efficiency, photodetector responsivity, modulator transfer characteristics, and electro-optic bandwidth measurements.
  • Own and improve high-speed test methods using vector network analyzers, optical power meters, tunable lasers, oscilloscopes, optical spectrum analyzers, stimulus and measuring units, probe stations, and RF/optical probes; support calibration, de-embedding, correlation, measurement repeatability, and uncertainty evaluation.
  • Analyze large characterization datasets using AI, statistical methods to identify trends, outliers, correlations, and sources of variation; troubleshoot hardware, software, and data-quality issues, communicate results in technical reviews, and partner with cross-functional teams to improve test coverage, throughput, and measurement capability.

Other Responsibilities:

  • Perform all activities in a safe and responsible manner and support all Environmental, Health, Safety & Security requirements and programs.

Required Qualifications:

  • Education – Graduating with Bachelor’s in Physics, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Photonics, Optical Engineering or related field from an accredited degree program.
  • Must have at least an overall 3.0 GPA and proven good academic standing.
  • Language Fluency - English (Written & Verbal)

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Prior related internship or co-op experience.
  • Demonstrated prior leadership experience in the workplace, school projects, competitions, etc.
  • Strong interest in leveraging AI tools and emerging technologies to enhance productivity, streamline workflows, and support effective decision-making.
  • Project management skills, i.e. the ability to innovate and execute solutions that matter; the ability to navigate ambiguity.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Strong planning & organizational skills
  • Advanced programming experience in a Linux environment using Python and C/C++; experience with R or Perl is a plus.
  • Foundational knowledge of silicon photonics, optical and electrical device characterization, high-speed or mm-wave circuits, statistics, and experimental test methodology; hands-on laboratory, capstone, or research experience is preferred.

title: Principal Scientist
description:
Who we are

Arkeus builds AI-powered sensing systems that help autonomous platforms detect, track and understand what's happening in the most complex and contested environments. Our technology is deployed across defence and national security applications — already protecting lives and strengthening security across the U.S. and allied markets.

Backed by QIC, Main Sequence, R+VC, Salus Ventures, Folklore Ventures, DYNE Ventures and Beaten Zone Venture Partners, Arkeus is entering a major growth phase. We are a small, fast-moving company with the energy and ambition of a start-up and the technical credibility of a world-class defence technology provider.

We work at the intersection of optics, autonomy, robotics and real-time AI and we deploy what we build. If you want to ship technology that matters, not technology that ships decks, this is where you belong.

Check it yourself on News | Arkeus

We have developed an inclusive, transparent and engaging culture that focuses on building a diverse workforce — realising that to attract the very best, we need to ensure our culture is ready to welcome people from all ages, genders and backgrounds.

About the Role

As Principal Scientist, you will provide deep technical leadership across the development of disruptive technologies and capabilities.

You’ll work closely with engineers, scientists, product leaders and defence customers to identify opportunities, develop new concepts, test hypotheses and turn research into practical, scalable systems.

You will be expected to operate at both strategic and technical depth — setting scientific direction while being close enough to the technology to challenge assumptions, guide experiments and solve difficult problems.


About You

At Arkeus, we value Innovation, Responsiveness and Accountability.

That means we’re looking for someone who:

  • Innovates — challenges conventional thinking and pursues technically ambitious ideas.
  • Responds — moves quickly from hypothesis to experiment, learns from failure and adapts.
  • Takes accountability — owns technical outcomes and is willing to make difficult calls when the evidence demands it.

You don't need to have every answer. You do need to know how to find the answer.


Key Responsibilities

  • Define and lead the scientific roadmap for disruption technologies and capabilities.
  • Identify emerging technologies, research opportunities and technical approaches that could create a significant operational advantage.
  • Develop and test novel concepts through modelling, experimentation, prototyping and field trials.
  • Translate complex scientific problems into practical engineering challenges and deliverable outcomes.
  • Work across disciplines including sensing, optics, AI/ML, signal processing, physics, autonomy, electronics and systems engineering.
  • Provide technical leadership to scientists and engineers, raising the scientific and engineering capability of the team.
  • Partner with Product and Engineering to transition research concepts into robust, deployable technology.
  • Engage with defence customers, research organisations, universities and industry partners.
  • Define experiments and technical demonstrations that rapidly validate or kill ideas.
  • Build intellectual property, technical knowledge and differentiated capability for Arkeus.
  • Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Represent Arkeus externally through technical partnerships, research programs and relevant industry forums.


Your Experience and Skills

We're looking for a deep technical thinker and builder — someone who has demonstrated they can take difficult, ambiguous scientific problems and turn them into real-world capability.

You will likely have:

  • A PhD or equivalent advanced technical expertise in a relevant scientific or engineering discipline.
  • Significant experience in advanced R&D, applied science or deep-tech product development.
  • A track record of taking research from concept → experiment → prototype → operational capability.
  • Deep expertise in one or more relevant areas such as:
  • Physics / applied physics
  • Optics / photonics
  • Electromagnetics
  • Signal processing
  • RF / sensing
  • AI / machine learning
  • Control and autonomous systems
  • Electronic warfare / countermeasure technologies
  • Advanced materials or energy systems
  • Strong mathematical, analytical and experimental capabilities.
  • Experience working across multidisciplinary technical teams.
  • The ability to distinguish genuinely transformative technology from incremental improvement.
  • Strong communication and technical storytelling skills.
  • Experience working within defence, aerospace, national security or another highly regulated/high-consequence environment is highly desirable.


Why Join Arkeus

  • We make incredible things, you will be working in a company at the forefront of innovation in Australia.
  • You will collaborate with exceptional leaders who have 40+ years of combined experience in autonomy, optics and defence. You will be learning from — and contributing to — the best in the field.
  • You will become part of a close-knit, ego-free team where ideas compete on merit, not seniority. Low politics, high trust. The kind of team you will still be talking about in ten years.
  • You will work hard and be expected to bring your best — and in return, you will grow faster than you ever would at a large organisation.
  • You will work on technology that is already deployed in real environments — protecting lives and strengthening security across defence and national security applications.
  • You will receive a competitive, market-benchmarked salary, structured career pathways built to grow with you, and the opportunity to participate in our Employee Share Option Plan (ESOP).
  • You will have the opportunity to mentor bright emerging talent through our highly sought-after intern program and strong connections with leading universities.


If this sounds like you, please apply even if you don't check every box listed above and join our growing team in improving security and saving lives!

Jigsaw Homes Group is one of the largest housing groups in England with more than 37,500 homes across the North West and East Midlands.

As a valued team member will be confident in using a range of IT and software packages to support you in completing regular reporting and ensure accurate records are kept and maintained regarding our clients and service.

For more information regarding the role, please refer to the job pack below.

**Why join us?**

Jigsaw Homes Group offers employees a competitive 24 days holiday per annum rising incrementally to 29 days, plus statutory bank holidays and 3 concessionary days in December. We also offer our employees the option to buy/sell up to 5 days extra leave per year.

As a Jigsaw employee you will also receive incremental salaried pay, company sick pay, on-site gyms, access to our cash back health plan membership, enhanced maternity/paternity leave, training/development opportunities plus much more. See the benefits page on our website for more details.

**If this sounds like the perfect job for you then don’t hesitate to apply now!**

**We reserve the right to close this vacancy early should we receive a sufficient number of applications.**

**Use of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in Your Application**

Your application should reflect your own skills, experience and motivation for the role. title: Staff Engineer
description:
About Nexus

You don't have an AI story if you don't have your data story. That's where NexusOne comes in.


We're the converged data platform for the AI era — composable by design, built on an open-source foundation, and AI-native from the ground up. One identity, one governance envelope, one operational layer across every mainframe, data lake, warehouse, and streaming system in the business. For the first time, enterprises can bring their existing stack along instead of rebuilding it — and still give AI agents full context across the estate.


What we stand for is simple: sovereign data, interoperable systems, decoupled intelligence — delivered the way modern software should be. No rip-and-replace. No multi-year transformation. Our CEO Anu Jain puts it well: we turn the "ball of yarn" of data integrations into a unified engine — less like assembling car parts, more like buying the car ready to drive. 85+ open-source tools pre-integrated. AI-native automations that deploy and self-heal the stack without human toil. Forward-deployed engineers who build shoulder-to-shoulder with customer teams — hands on keyboards, not just on decks.


It's working, and fast. We're tripling revenue year over year, backed by Insight Partners, and running in production in environments most vendors won't touch. Our platform processes credit risk data for 90%+ of US small businesses — 40M+ — every month. Intent signals for 300M+ subscribers monthly for Africa's largest telco. The data and AI layer for a Top 3 US bank.


We're 100+ people across the US and India, headquartered in Atlanta. We think big, move fast, and don't mistake activity for progress. We hire people who'd rather ship the rocket than brief someone on it.

Check out this podcast of Anu talking about our solution here:

We're looking for a Staff Data Engineer to help set the technical direction for our data platform and mentor engineers across the organization. title: Strategic Account Director - Independent Software Vendors
description:
At Clarus, we are harnessing intelligence to propel pet health towards a brighter, smarter, more connected future. A future where information flows freely across caregivers & care environments, insights are more instant and actionable, and financial decisions are empowered.


For us, that future starts by fundamentally changing how pet insurance operates. We’re engineering systems that decomplexify coverage and facilitate reimbursement, so more pets can get the care they deserve.


Our team of pet industry veterans and passionate pet people come from across the tech and health continuums. Together, we’re openly challenging industry convention in service of creating totally new possibilities. Which is why our culture is built on the values of curiosity, entrepreneurship, humility and fierce collaboration.

Job Description


We are seeking a Strategic Account Director to lead strategic partnerships and enterprise growth across Practice Information Management Systems (PIMS) and other Independent Software Vendor (ISV) platforms. This role is highly commercial and partnership-driven, requiring expertise in contract structuring, pricing strategy, and long-term ecosystem collaboration.

You will serve as a senior advisor to partners, shaping how we integrate, co-market, and scale within the broader animal health technology and insurance ecosystem while coordinating internal teams to deliver results.


Location: Remote, USA

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Partnership Development

  • Identify, develop, and expand relationships with PIMS platforms, and veterinary engagement platforms; build a strategic partnership pipeline aligned to company priorities.
  • Develop and launch joint go-to-market strategies and partnership frameworks (e.g., referral models, co-selling motions, B2B integration roadmaps) that drive mutual growth across the veterinary and insurance ecosystem.
  • Lead co-selling and co-marketing initiatives with partners, including brand strategy, KOL engagement, and high-profile pilot programs that build trusted, long-term relationships.

Enterprise Sales & Deal Leadership

  • Own complex enterprise deal cycles involving PIMS integrations and veterinary engagement platforms, and multi-stakeholder alignment, from discovery through contract execution.
  • Develop business cases and ROI models tailored to partner needs; oversee business P&L and profitability recommendations tied to strategic agreements.
  • Drive sustained new revenue growth through strategic partnerships; track performance against targets and optimize based on results.
  • Build and maintain sales infrastructure and reporting processes (e.g., Zoho) to manage active deals, pipeline, and partner performance; communicate status, risks, and outcomes to stakeholders.

Advanced Contract & Pricing Negotiation

  • Lead contract negotiations, including pricing models, revenue-share structures, and multi-year agreements, across PIMS and engagement platform partners.
  • Partner with Legal, Finance, and executive leadership to structure scalable deals and formalize new long-term business partnerships.
  • Ensure contracts align with strategic objectives, partner economics, and long-term value realization within the software ecosystem.

Executive Stakeholder Engagement

  • Build and manage relationships with senior executives, key opinion leaders (KOLs), and corporate veterinary groups; establish governance and executive alignment across partner organizations.
  • Lead high-impact presentations and business reviews that translate industry insight into clear narratives, data, and action plans.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor on partnership strategy, integration priorities, and growth opportunities across the animal health technology and insurance landscape.

Onboarding, Integration & Retention

  • Monitor performance, adoption, and engagement; develop and execute retention and expansion plans with partners and internal teams.

  • Collaborate with Sales, Customer Success, Implementation, Finance, and Legal to align execution, governance, and commercial outcomes.
  • Use reporting and analytics to inform strategy, measure success, and optimize partner performance over time.

Qualifications

  • Proven track record structuring and closing large, strategic partnerships with multiple stakeholders across the veterinary and animal health industry.

title: Staff Software Engineer
description:
OAG is the essential intelligence partner transforming global travel. For nearly a century, we've been the foundation the travel industry builds on, trusted, proven, essential. Today, we're going beyond.

We combine unmatched data quality, quantity and access with breakthrough technology and deep industry expertise to deliver what the industry truly needs: not just more data, but better answers. From real-time operational intelligence to strategic decision-making, we power the entire travel ecosystem, from airlines and airports to technology companies and financial institutions. We are actively embedding AI throughout our intelligence layer, combining nearly a century of proprietary data with the latest technology to deliver answers that were simply not possible before. We exist because travel moves the world, and we move travel. By transforming complexity into clarity and questions into answers, we give our partners the intelligence they need to thrive in an evolving world. For more information visit

ABOUT THE ROLE:

OAG Digital is the team turning our world-class data into a product-led growth engine: a unified experience where customers can discovery, try, pay and use on their own. We build the platform customers use to find, buy and use our data, and the intelligence products that turn that data into answers.

This is the most senior individual contributor role on the technical side of Digital. Its purpose is to turn the Digital strategy into a technical strategy that delivers it: deciding what gets built, in what order and to what standard, so the business can sell what it has committed to sell. A decision taken in one team should still work in another, our promises to customers on access, security, reliability and cost should hold on every channel, and the hardest problems should get solved once.

You’ll work across two areas. Core is the platform backbone: identity, auth, entitlements, billing, usage metering and the infrastructure everything else depends on. Intelligence is the layer above the data: AI-powered insights, predictive models built on Databricks and Snowflake, anomaly detection, and agentic features.

The role is hands-on. You’ll write production code on the hardest parts of the platform while setting direction, reviewing designs and helping other engineers do better work. We care about UX as much as throughput, and we’re AI-native: tooling is part of how we develop, not an afterthought.

This role can be worked remotely from anywhere in the UK only. Please note that we’re unable to offer visa sponsorship, so applicants will need the existing right to work in the UK.

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

  • Design and build the hardest parts of the platform, hands on: how customers get to the right data and products, how that access is controlled, and what it costs us to serve. Stay close enough to the code that the design still holds once it’s built
  • Set the technical direction for problems that cross team boundaries: how customers are identified, what they’re allowed to use, how usage is measured and charged, and how existing customers and older systems move onto the new platform. Write the design down, get agreement, and stay with it through delivery so teams build to one approach rather than several
  • Set the standard for products built on AI and machine learning: define what a feature must do before it ships (show where its answer came from, be honest about how current the data is, fail predictably, be tested repeatably). Set the technical brief for data science teams, including how a model will be judged and the speed and cost it has to work within, and push back when a model isn’t the right tool
  • Work with the teams and partners outside Digital who build against your designs, including other parts of OAG and third parties. Share designs early, take feedback, change course where they’re right, and make the call when a cross-team decision has been open too long
  • Integrate AI models, data pipelines and event-driven systems on Databricks and Snowflake into the Intelligence layer
  • Improve how the whole of Digital builds software: review designs and code beyond your own team, mentor senior engineers, and make the good way to do something the easy way. This includes making AI-assisted development reliable, with the checks needed to keep quality high
  • Maintain the quality bar through code reviews, automated testing, observability, and CI/CD.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

  • Extensive experience building and running production software end to end, from system design through to operating it live
  • Technical leadership beyond a single team: a track record of influencing engineers and teams you don’t manage, and building agreement across them
  • System design across boundaries: systems that stay correct, fast and affordable when several teams, several delivery channels and a shared data platform are all involved, and sound judgement on when to solve something once centrally versus letting each team solve it
  • Hands-on experience in analytical or data-intensive contexts and depth in large-scale data platforms: how they’re built, governed and paid for, including keeping one customer’s data separate from another’s, controlling access at the data layer, tracking data lineage, and keeping query cost under control
  • Machine learning and AI in production: enough understanding of how models and agents are built, trained and evaluated to set the technical brief for the data science team, read an evaluation critically, and judge whether a result will hold up in the real world. Experience taking AI-powered features into production and making them reliable, cost-effective and trustworthy for customers.
  • Judgement under uncertainty, with commercial awareness: you understand that technical choices affect what the business can charge and what it costs to serve a customer, and you know when to decide and when to wait
  • Clear communicator who can explain direction, risk and trade-offs so that engineers, product, commercial and senior leaders all take away the same thing
  • A builder’s mindset. You understand the who and the why, and you own what ships
  • AI-native in how you build: you use AI tooling with judgement, stay current with how agentic development is evolving, and help make effective agentic practices the norm across the team

If you don’t meet every requirement but feel excited about this role, we’d still love to hear from you.

WE WILL OFFER YOU

🚀 A progressive, non-hierarchical culture where innovation drives everything we build

🏡 Flexible working arrangements that allow remote work or office attendance

💰 An attractive compensation and benefits package, including access to a Simplyhealth cash plan to support your everyday health and wellbeing, a company bonus scheme, Octopus EV salary sacrifice scheme and enhanced pension scheme

🏖️ 25 days holiday plus bank holidays, volunteering days and additional day off during your birthday month

👪 Inclusive family benefits designed to support you through parenthood and fertility journeys

🌍 Work remotely anywhere in the world for up to 1 month per year

📚 Annual learning and development budget.

OAG is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and able to perform at their best.

We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds and experiences. If you require reasonable adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process, please let us know. We are happy to have an open conversation about how we can support you.

title: Tobacco Treatment Specialist (58917)
description:
Summary

Are you ready to join a dynamic team of dedicated values-based leaders and professionals who are committed to creating a healthy, addiction-free world?

As Tobacco Treatment Specialist at Phoenix House, you will provide evidence-based education and training related to smoking cessation to staff and clients. The Tobacco Treatment Specialist would work under the direction of the Director of Residential Services.

If this sounds like you, we invite you to apply. Be part of something bigger — help us build a healthier, addiction-free future together.

***Phoenix House of NY is proudly offering 100% employer-paid medical insurance for all eligible employees and their dependents!***

About Us

Phoenix House of New York | Long Island is a nonprofit organization dedicated to helping individuals and families overcome substance use disorders and achieve lasting recovery. We provide treatment, housing, and support services for our clients and their families. Our core values— Integrity, Compassion, Appreciation, Respect, Excellence, and Forward Thinking —guide our approach, ensuring each person receives evidence-based care that promotes dignity and wellness. By upholding these values, we empower people to rebuild their lives with hope, accountability, and support.

What We Offer

At Phoenix House, we recognize that in today’s economic climate, stability and support matter more than ever. That’s why we offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to care for you as a whole person—supporting your health, financial well-being, and work-life balance. Here are some of our perks:

  • (10) Paid Holidays

  • Paid vacation, sick time, personal and wellness time

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance for those who are scheduled to work at least 30 hours per week

  • Pet insurance, legal support, and other supplemental insurance

  • A generous tuition reimbursement program

  • 403(b) retirement plan

  • Competitive wages and more...

You will have responsibilities including but not limited to:

  • Responsible for oversight of assistance in the development of the educational curriculum related to smoking cessation and harm reduction.
  • Provide evidence-based training and education workshops for residential clients and staff on harms of smoking, harm reduction strategies, pharmacologic and other treatment for tobacco use disorder, and motivational interviewing.
  • Conduct comprehensive assessments of tobacco and nicotine use, dependence, readiness to quit, and previous cessation attempts. Design treatment plans and follow ups for those interested in cessation or cutting down efforts.
  • Provide education regarding FDA-approved tobacco cessation medications and make appropriate referrals or recommendations within scope of practice. Collaborate with providers to ensure timely access to appropriate pharmacologic treatment for tobacco use disorder.
  • Participate in tobacco cessation outreach, education, prevention, and community health initiatives.
  • Provide individual and/or group tobacco cessation counseling using evidence-based behavioral interventions.
  • Document assessments, interventions, treatment plans, referrals, and outcomes accurately and in accordance with organizational requirements.
  • Aid in any data collection for grant programming related to the tobacco cessation initiatives.

title: Tilsynsmedarbejder til drift og vedligehold i Midt/Vestjylland
description:
Vil du arbejde for fremtidens jernbane? Så læs med her!

Banedanmark har besluttet, at 90 % af alt vedligehold af jernbanen skal udføres af eksterne entreprenører. Det betyder, at Banedanmark fremover får ansvaret for at sikre, at vedligeholdelsen af jernbanen sker i henhold til planer, kontrakter, normer og regler. Vi har derfor brug for dygtige medarbejdere, som har lyst til at bidrage til dette arbejde.

Du bliver ansat i divisionen Vedligehold i vores tilsynsafdeling for Jylland og Fyn. Du bliver en del af et team med 13 tilsynsmedarbejdere, der er fordelt på forskellige lokationer i landet. Dit arbejdssted bliver vores kontor i Herning, men med mulighed for at arbejde fra Fredericia.

Dine kommende arbejdsopgaver

Som tilsynsmedarbejder i Banedanmark får du en varieret hverdag, hvor du fører tilsyn med vedligeholdelsesopgaver på jernbanen og understøtter de Geografiske Fagspecialister og Svejseansvarlige. Du får både opgaver ude på jernbanen og administrative opgaver på kontoret.

Dine arbejdsopgaver vil blandt andet omfatte:

  • Tilsyn med vedligeholdelsesopgaver og i perioder også fornyelsesopgaver i forbindelse med projekter
  • Kvalitetskontrol af udført arbejde og tilsyn med arbejdsprocesser
  • Gående linjesyn og akut opståede tilsynsopgaver
  • Understøttelse af de Geografiske Fagspecialister og Svejseansvarlige samt vidensdeling med kollegaer
  • Administrative opgaver, herunder afrapportering og deltagelse i møder med tilsynsgruppen

Hovedparten af tilsynene foregår i dagtimerne, men der vil også være behov for tilsyn om natten i forbindelse med igangværende arbejde. Her fører du blandt andet tilsyn med arbejdsprocesser, arbejdsmiljø, jernbanesikkerhed og medarbejdernes kompetencer.

Du gennemgår et uddannelses- og træningsforløb, hvorefter vi forventer, at du selvstændigt kan føre tilsyn, vurdere væsentlige problemer og reagere hensigtsmæssigt på dem. Det gør du med en dialogbaseret tilgang.

Hvad søger vi?

Vi er på udkig efter tilsynsmedarbejdere, som har kendskab til sporområdet og fagtekniske løsninger.

Det forventes, at du som minimum har bestået kurserne Sporteknik 1 og 2 og har solid erfaring fra arbejde i sporet, særligt med fornyelse eller vedligeholdelse. Desuden skal du have Banedanmarks sikkerhedsuddannelse SR2 og OR-sikkerhedsuddannelsen. Du skal også være indstillet på at gennemgå et uddannelses- og træningsforløb inden for selve tilsynsdisciplinen.

Som tilsynsmedarbejder skal du udføre sikkerhedsklassificeret arbejde og skal derfor opfylde helbredskravene på jernbaneområdet. Det betyder, at du skal opfylde visse helbredskrav, som indebærer en lægelig vurdering af din hørelse, synssans og farvesans samt eventuelle helbredsmæssige forhold som sukkersyge, epilepsi og hjertekarsygdomme mv.

Hvis du vil vide mere om kravene, kan du læse mere på Trafik-, Bygge- og Boligstyrelsens hjemmeside.

Vi lægger vægt på, at du er motiveret for at varetage rollen som myndighedsperson, når du fører tilsyn med entreprenørernes arbejde. Du fremstår professionel og kan stå ved dine beslutninger, også når du møder modstand. Vi forventer desuden, at du arbejder struktureret, effektivt og målrettet. Du kender vigtigheden i at opbygge gode relationer til dine samarbejdspartnere og at du bidrager positivt og konstruktivt til samarbejdet både internt og eksternt. Du trives i et spændende og travlt miljø og har evne og lyst til at dykke ned i faglige udfordringer uden at miste overblikket.

Derudover forestiller vi os, at du:

  • er rutineret IT-bruger, gerne med kendskab til Excel
  • kommunikerer godt både mundtligt og skriftligt på dansk og engelsk
  • har kørekort til personbil

Det er desuden en fordel, hvis du har erfaring med værktøjerne SAP PM, F2 eller andre vedligeholdelsesstyrings- og forvaltningssystemer.

Hvad tilbyder vi?

Vi tilbyder en varieret hverdag med spændende opgaver både ude i sporet og ved skrivebordet. Hos os kan du:

  • Blive en del af et godt fællesskab med kollegaer, der hjælper dig godt i gang og altid er klar til at give en hånd med.
  • Få faglig sparring og dele viden med kollegaer, så I sammen finder gode løsninger.
  • Arbejde i et miljø med en åben og respektfuld omgangstone, hvor der er plads til forskellige perspektiver og dialog.

Vi lægger vægt på ærlighed, tillid og et godt samarbejde i hverdagen.

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår

Du ansættes efter den til enhver tid gældende Fællesoverenskomst mellem Finansministeriet og Offentligt Ansattes Organisationer – Det Statslige Område (OAO-S-fællesoverenskomsten) og organisationsaftalen mellem Banedanmark og Dansk Jernbaneforbund.

Stillingen er som udgangspunkt indplaceret i løngruppe 4, svarende til en basisløn ekskl. pension på 32.813,86 kr. jf. gældende overenskomst, som du finder her.

Afhængigt af dine kvalifikationer og kompetencer er der mulighed for forhandling af tillæg. Der vil til den samlede løn være tilknyttet en arbejdsgiverfinansieret pensionsordning på 16 %.

Ansøgning og kontakt

Vil du vide mere om stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Sektionschef Steen Guldmann på mail stg@bane.dk eller mobil 26731121.

Har du spørgsmål til løn- og ansættelsesvilkår, kan du kontakte vores personalekonsulenter på mail banedanmarkpersonale@BANE.dk.

Vi behandler ansøgninger løbende, så send gerne din ansøgning, CV samt seneste relevant bilag hurtigst muligt.

For at søge, klikker du på linket "Søg stillingen" og følger instruktionerne.

Banedanmark opfordrer alle kvalificerede uanset alder, køn, religion eller etnisk tilhørsforhold til at søge stillingen.

Går du videre fra de indledende samtaler, vil der blive indhentet referencer fra tidligere arbejdsgiver. Du vil blive informeret inden, at der bliver indhentet en reference.

Kom på banen!

Lige nu bygger vi en helt ny jernbane, mens vi holder den gamle kørende. Vi sætter strøm til banen, så der kan køre klimavenlige eltog. Vi indsætter nye, digitale signalsystemer og bygger en højhastighedsbane til Europa. Samtidig styrer vi togtrafikken og informerer om den på stationerne.

Hvor svært kan det være? Det er faktisk ret kompliceret. Derfor søger vi nye kolleger, der kan være med til at sætte Danmark på skinner.

Du bliver en del af et hold dygtige og specialiserede kolleger med vidt forskellige baggrunde og faglige profiler – fra spor til trafiktårn og kontor. Vi kommer fra over 40 forskellige lande, og vi er til stede i hele Danmark. Sammen arbejder vi dag og nat på at få den store modernisering af jernbanen til at lykkes– så de 180 millioner rejsende, der hvert år kører på skinnerne, kan komme grønt og hurtigt frem.

Banedanmark er en styrelse under Transportministeriet med mere end 3.000 medarbejdere. Hovedkontoret ligger på Carsten Niebuhrs Gade 43 i København, men vi har dygtige og dedikerede medarbejdere i hele landet.

Vil du være med?

title: Senior Staff Software Engineer
description:
Why This Role Matters
Senior Staff Software Engineers are the connective tissue across engineering at Bluestaq. You don't just own a system—you influence how multiple teams build their systems. The platform improvements you drive, the standards you establish, and the coaching you provide to Staff and Senior engineers produce compounding effects on delivery speed and quality across the organization. Your decisions directly affect the reliability, security, and scalability of the software Bluestaq's customers and mission partners depend on.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead engineering efforts that span multiple teams or product areas, including major re-architectures, new platform capabilities, and cross-cutting reliability or security programs
  • Serve as a key technical partner for program leadership, product management, and cross-functional leads
  • Design and drive implementation of large-scale architectures: platform components, shared libraries, major system migrations, and cross-product integrations
  • Apply deep expertise across the full stack—backend, frontend, data, and infrastructure—to navigate complex performance, scalability, reliability, and security tradeoffs
  • Drive improvements in core engineering practices across multiple teams: testing strategy, observability, CI/CD pipelines, coding standards, and security posture
  • Identify and reduce unnecessary technical fragmentation by harmonizing patterns, tooling, and shared standards across engineering groups
  • Own cross-team technical outcomes with minimal direction, anticipating long-term risk and downstream impact before they become urgent
  • Coach Staff and Senior engineers to run their own domains effectively and grow into broader technical leaders
  • Represent engineering in high-level technical discussions about roadmap priorities, architectural tradeoffs, and organizational investment decisions
  • Lead multi-team initiatives from concept to rollout, aligning multiple engineering groups around shared goals and compatible designs
  • Recognize systemic weaknesses,test fragility, performance gaps, security posture, developer experience—and design programs to address them at scale

Required Qualifications

  • Exceptional proficiency across multiple software engineering domains: distributed systems, API design, data architecture, frontend or backend development, and platform engineering
  • Demonstrated ability to lead multi-team technical initiatives from concept through production at organizational scale, with measurable impact on reliability, performance, or engineering velocity
  • Deep expertise in large-scale system design, platform architecture, and cross-cutting technical strategy spanning multiple stacks and deployment environments
  • Strong track record of driving cross-team engineering improvements in testing, observability, CI/CD, security, or shared infrastructure
  • Proven ability to identify and resolve systemic technical risks and fragmentation across multiple codebases and teams
  • Demonstrated success coaching and developing Staff-level engineers into broader technical leaders
  • Excellent technical communication skills: ability to influence and align multiple engineering teams behind shared architectural decisions, patterns, and standards
  • Experience navigating cross-team organizational dynamics and delivering technical outcomes across reporting boundaries without formal authority

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience designing or owning shared platforms, internal developer tooling, or cross-cutting infrastructure components used across multiple product teams
  • Background in large-scale system migrations, performance engineering programs, or multi-year reliability initiatives
  • Deep familiarity with DoD, intelligence community, or federal software delivery and security standards including RMF, NIST 800-53, or STIG compliance
  • Experience managing architectural technical debt at scale and driving simplification programs across large, complex codebases
  • History of developing Staff-level technical talent through direct coaching, structured mentorship, or technical leadership programs
  • Contributions to engineering strategy, hiring, or technical community beyond immediate team scope
  • External recognition as a technical leader: publications, conference presentations, open-source project ownership, or standards contributions

Required Experience and Education:

  • PhD in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field and 6+ years of software engineering or related experience, OR
  • Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field and 8+ years of software engineering or related experience, OR
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field and 10+ years of software engineering or related experience, OR
  • Associate degree in a related field and 12+ years of software engineering or related experience, OR
  • High School Diploma/GED and 14+ years of software engineering or related experience.

Location Requirement
Colorado Springs, CO · Washington, DC · Dallas, TX · Salt Lake City, UT

  • Colorado Springs is our HQ with an established office — 3–4 days on-site per week.
  • DC, Dallas, and Salt Lake City-based roles will be remote until offices are established there, and then will require 3–4 days on-site.

You use modern AI tools with judgment: integrating them into workflows where they're impactful, reviewing their outputs, and handling proprietary or sensitive data responsibly.

$150,000—$210,000 USD

Clearance Requirement: This position may require an active TS/SCI Clearance. Current clearance holders are strongly encouraged to apply. If you don't currently hold one, Bluestaq will sponsor eligible candidates through the clearance process based on program needs.

At Bluestaq, we build secure data platforms that matter for space missions, national defense, healthcare systems, and commercial innovation. Founded in 2018, we've become a leader in enterprise software and secure data management by staying focused on what counts: modern architecture, operational excellence, and mission impact.

We're engineers, problem-solvers, and builders who take the mission seriously, but not ourselves. We automate the repeatable, question the status quo, and design systems that are as reliable as they are scalable. Whether we're supporting space, defense systems, or healthcare advancements, we build with the same principles: cloud-native solutions, security by design, and relentless simplicity.

title: Senior Associate - Strategy & Operations - Insurance
description:
About the Team

The Risk & Insurance team at DoorDash is building the next generation of insurance capabilities for the company from the ground up. Insurance is one of DoorDash’s largest cost of revenue items, making this a highly impactful area with meaningful influence on the company’s bottom line. We partner across insurance, operations, and product development to create solutions that improve safety, reduce costs, and support long-term growth. This is a fast-evolving space with the opportunity to help shape new programs from early concept through launch and scale. We are looking for forward thinkers who are excited to build in a zero-to-one environment and work closely with cross-functional teams across DoorDash.

About the Role

We’re hiring a Senior Associate, Insurance S&O to help drive the operational, analytical, and cross-functional work needed to launch and scale multiple insurance initiatives in parallel. This person will support go-to-market execution through experiment management, reporting, vendor and procurement follow-through, and day-to-day program management, helping the team translate insights into product adoption and business impact. You will report into the Insurance Strategy & Operations lead on our Risk & Insurance team.

You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…

  • Run high-velocity operational tests and pilots that generate insights and help shape new products and programs from zero to one.
  • Partner with Analytics and cross-functional teams to track performance, synthesize learnings, and inform go-to-market decisions.
  • Support execution across a portfolio of insurance initiatives as they move from early concept through launch and scale.
  • Coordinate with internal teams and external partners to drive vendor readiness, procurement follow-through, and operational launch execution.
  • Help build the processes, reporting, and operating rhythm needed to support growth, including international expansion.

We’re excited about you because…

  • You have 4+ years of experience in Strategy & Operations, Product Operations, consulting, program management, or a related field.
  • You have strong analytical skills, including experience using SQL to answer business questions or evaluate performance.
  • You have experience independently managing complex, cross-functional initiatives with multiple stakeholders and moving parts.
  • You can communicate clearly in written and verbal formats and turn data and ambiguity into structured recommendations.
  • You are comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment and balancing executional detail with broader business context.

Compensation

The successful candidate’s starting pay will fall within the pay range listed below and is determined based on job-related factors including, but not limited to, skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions. Base salary is localized according to an employee’s work location. Ranges are market-dependent and may be modified in the future.

title: Senior Design Manager - Core Experiences
description:
When Apple developed the original Macintosh, the team wasn’t simply designing a new computer. They were establishing a new vocabulary for interacting with one: windows, menus, icons, pointing, dragging, selecting. Many of those ideas existed elsewhere, but the achievement was turning them into a coherent language that people could understand and carry from one application to another.

We’re at another interesting moment in the evolution of interfaces. Software can increasingly understand intent, converse, adapt, anticipate, and act on someone’s behalf. That creates an opportunity to reconsider some of the assumptions that have defined product design for decades.

At Mercury, we want to do more than add AI to interfaces designed for another era. We want to thoughtfully evolve how Mercury feels to use, creating experiences that are intelligent without being inscrutable, proactive without being intrusive, and distinctly Mercury.

You’ll lead the product designers responsible for some of Mercury’s core experiences and establish a point of view for how our interfaces should evolve as the possibilities of software change. You’ll work closely with Product, Engineering, and Design Systems to turn emerging interaction ideas into coherent, reusable patterns, while building a team known for exceptional product thinking and craft.

Our design organization consists of 40+ people who love solving complex problems through design and are equally passionate about cultivating, guiding, and inspiring one another.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Define and evolve Mercury’s interaction philosophy, with a particular focus on how AI-native, conversational, adaptive, and proactive experiences should work across our products
  • Set an exceptional bar for product quality across the Interfaces organization, helping teams like mobile, dashboard and our agentic product understand not only whether an experience works, but why it feels right
  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of product designers, creating an environment where designers can take creative risks, develop strong points of view, and consistently produce exceptional work
  • Shape product strategy alongside Product and Engineering rather than waiting for requirements to arrive. Bring design into ambiguous problems early and help teams identify the right problems to solve
  • Stay close to the work. Use critique, prototyping, exploration, and hands-on collaboration to push ideas further and help teams turn ambitious concepts into thoughtful, pragmatic experiences
  • Help raise the craft and product-thinking bar of Mercury’s broader Design organization, sharing frameworks, perspectives, and emerging ideas that make everyone around you a stronger designer

You should:

  • Have exceptional product taste: You have unusually strong judgment about how great software should behave and feel. You can move beyond subjective critique to articulate why an interaction works, where it falls short, and how to make it substantially better. You bring strong visual and interaction design fundamentals and inspire a higher standard of craft in others
  • Have a strong point of view on AI-native interfaces: You think deeply about how AI is changing the relationship between people and software. You’re actively experimenting with conversational, adaptive, intelligent, and proactive interaction models and have opinions about where these patterns create genuine value and where they don’t. You don’t need to have spent your career building AI products, but you should be intensely curious about what comes next
  • Be a craft-obsessed design leader: You’ve successfully led and developed product designers without becoming distant from the work. You know how to recognize what makes individual designers exceptional, give clear and thoughtful feedback, and create an environment where a team can experiment boldly while maintaining a very high quality bar
  • Think about interactions as systems: You see beyond individual screens and features to the patterns, information architecture, behaviors, and principles connecting them. You can turn excellent individual solutions into reusable ideas that make the broader Mercury experience more coherent without making it formulaic
  • Be a strategic cross-functional partner: You’re a genuine thought partner to Product and Engineering. You bring design thinking into strategy and roadmap conversations, collaborate comfortably on unfinished work, understand technical constraints, and earn trust through judgment and execution
  • Operate independently with a strong point of view: You thrive when the problem matters but the answer isn’t obvious. You can create structure where none exists, develop a perspective with incomplete information, and move work forward without significant coaching or prioritization. You balance conviction with curiosity and pragmatism and know when a great idea is worth fighting for

Experience designing AI-powered or consumer software, strong prototyping skills, close partnership with Design Systems, or deep motion and interaction expertise would all be especially relevant, but we care more about the quality of your thinking and work than checking every box. These qualifications and the role's emphasis on interaction quality, AI thinking, leadership, independence, and taste come directly from the role profile.

This is an opportunity to help define the future of Mercury’s product experience. You’ll have the autonomy to develop new ideas about how our interfaces should behave, the team to turn those ideas into excellent products, and the opportunity to create interaction patterns that can ultimately influence how Mercury builds software across the company.

title: Autonomy Test Engineer, Maritime Systems
description:
Applied Intuition, Inc. is powering the future of physical AI. Founded in 2017 and now valued at $15 billion, the Silicon Valley company is creating the digital infrastructure needed to bring intelligence to every moving machine on the planet. Applied Intuition services the automotive, defense, trucking, construction, mining and agriculture industries in three core areas: tools and infrastructure, operating systems, and autonomy. Eighteen of the top 20 global automakers, as well as the United States military and its allies, trust the company’s solutions to deliver physical intelligence. Applied Intuition is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, with offices in Washington, D.C.; San Diego; Ft. Walton Beach, Florida; Ann Arbor, Michigan; London; Stuttgart; Munich; Stockholm; Bangalore; Seoul; and Tokyo. Learn more at .

We are an in-office company, and our expectation is that full-time employees primarily work from their Applied Intuition office 5 days a week. However, we also recognize the importance of flexibility and trust our employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work, starting the day with morning meetings from home before heading to the office, or leaving earlier when needed to accommodate family commitments. This in-office expectation does not apply to contractor positions

About the role

As an Autonomy Test Engineer, you will own the verification of our autonomy software on real vessels. You’ll design and execute test scenarios that exercise autonomous behaviors (navigation, collision avoidance, mission planning, fault handling), analyze the resulting data to determine whether the autonomy did the right thing and why, and give the engineering team precise, reproducible findings. Much of the actual testing happens at sea, but the job is evaluating autonomy performance, not operating vessels.

You’ll help bridge the gap between cutting-edge R&D and mission-proven capability, ensuring our autonomous surface vehicles are performant, reliable, and safe in the most demanding environments on Earth.


At Applied, you will:

  • Design test scenarios and test cards that exercise specific autonomy behaviors and edge cases, with clear pass/fail criteria

  • Execute on-water test events, participating in sorties aboard test and chase vessels while monitoring autonomy performance against expected behavior

  • Analyze sortie data (logs, telemetry, sensor data) to characterize autonomy performance and isolate root causes of anomalies across perception, planning, control, and hardware

  • Reproduce field anomalies in simulation and Hardware-in-the-Loop (HITL) environments, and build regression tests so fixes stay fixed

  • Identify, document, and triage system discrepancies in Atlassian Jira with enough detail and reproducibility for autonomy and hardware engineers to act on

  • Contribute to test plans, test procedures, and test readiness reviews under the direction of the Test & Evaluation Director

  • Author clear, comprehensive test reports and after action reports that capture results, observations, and recommendations

  • Support pre-underway system checkouts and launch and recovery operations alongside the marine operations team

We're looking for someone who has:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant engineering discipline (e.g., Systems, Electrical, Mechanical, Ocean), Computer Science, or a related technical field, or equivalent hands-on experience

  • 2+ years of experience in test or systems integration engineering for complex, software-intensive systems

  • Hands-on experience testing or validating autonomous or robotic systems (air, ground, sea, or simulation), including designing test cases and evaluating system behavior against requirements

  • Experience analyzing test data (logs, telemetry, sensor data) using tools such as Python, MATLAB, or similar

  • Experience with simulation-based, software-in-the-loop (SIL), or HITL testing

  • Experience with agile program management tooling such as Atlassian Jira

  • Strong technical writing skills, with the ability to draft clear test reports and after action reports

  • Comfort and demonstrated ability working on vessels offshore for extended periods, in potentially harsh conditions

  • Willingness and ability to travel up to 40% of the time, including significant time offshore on vessels of various sizes

Travel Requirements:

  • Based in San Diego, CA

  • Up to 40% travel, including rotations offshore

Security Requirements:

  • Must be a U.S. Citizen

  • Must hold or be eligible for a U.S. Secret security clearance

Nice to have:

  • Direct, hands-on experience with Unmanned Surface Vehicles (USVs) or Unmanned Underwater Vehicles (UUVs)

  • Experience with on-deck maritime operations, including vessel handling, launch and recovery, and working with pier-side and port service partners; USCG credentials or small boat qualifications are a plus

  • Familiarity with marine electronics, RF communications, GPS/GNSS, and shipboard sensor systems

  • Experience supporting government test programs, particularly with the U.S. Navy

Base salary is a single component of the total compensation package, which may also include equity in the form of options and/or restricted stock units, comprehensive health, dental, vision, life and disability insurance coverage, 401k retirement benefits with employer match, learning and wellness stipends, and paid time off. title: Human Resource Specialist - Madison, WI
description:
JOIN THE TEAM THAT FUELS YOUR FAVORITE BEVERAGES

At WP Beverages, we're more than a manufacturer. We're the force behind some of the most recognized beverage brands in the country, including Pepsi-Cola, Mountain Dew, Lipton Iced Tea, Aquafina, Klarbrunn, Vita Ice, and Bubbl'r.

Unlike many manufacturing organizations focused solely on cost and profit, we take a broader view of success. We are committed to creating long-term shareholder value through operational excellence, innovation, strategic growth, and a culture that values and develops our people.

What We're Looking For

The HR Specialist is a salaried, exempt position responsible for delivering day-to-day human resources administration across the full employee lifecycle for a multi-state workforce of hourly manufacturing and salaried employees. This role manages offer letters, onboarding, personnel action forms, and terminations, and serves as a key point of contact for employees and leaders on HR processes. Approximately 25% of the role supports payroll, including garnishment administration, pay increase approvals, payroll spreadsheet maintenance, reporting, and manual check processing.

Team members enjoy a hybrid work arrangement that balances collaboration and flexibility, working onsite four days per week and remotely one day per week.

Our ideal candidate combines strong HR administration skills with working payroll knowledge, a service-oriented approach, and a passion for continuous improvement. This individual will partner closely with HR leadership, Payroll, Finance, Benefits, and Operations to ensure employee administration processes are accurate, compliant, efficient, and employee-focused while helping drive operational excellence across the organization.


Employee Lifecycle & HR Administration
• Prepare and issue offer letters in coordination with hiring managers and HR leadership, ensuring accuracy of compensation, title, and start date details.
• Coordinate new hire onboarding, including pre-employment requirements, new hire paperwork, I-9 and E-Verify completion, HRIS setup, and orientation scheduling.
• Prepare, review, and process Personnel Action Forms (PAFs) for new hires, pay changes, promotions, transfers, leaves, and status changes, ensuring proper approvals and documentation.
• Administer the termination process, including separation documentation, final pay coordination, benefits notifications, equipment return, and exit processing.
• Maintain accurate and confidential employee records and HRIS data in accordance with legal and company requirements.

Payroll Support
• Maintain the payroll spreadsheet and verify that changes from PAFs, new hires, and terminations are accurately reflected each pay period.
• Process and route payroll approvals for pay increases, confirming proper authorization and effective dates before changes are entered.
• Administer child support orders and wage garnishments, including setup, remittance, tracking, and correspondence with agencies and employees.
• Prepare and distribute payroll reports for HR, Finance, and Operations leadership.
• Prepare and mail manual payroll checks, maintaining appropriate documentation and controls.
• Processing cycles, audits, and year-end activities.

Compliance, Partnership & Service
• Support compliance with federal, state, and local employment laws, wage and hour regulations, and company policies.
• Partner with HR, Payroll, Finance, Benefits, and Operations leaders to ensure accurate employee data and seamless administration.
• Deliver exceptional customer service by resolving employee and leadership inquiries in a timely and professional manner.
• Support internal and external audits by providing accurate documentation and records.
• Participate in special projects and other initiatives that support departmental and organizational objectives.

Systems & Continuous Improvement
• Use HRIS and payroll systems to maintain data integrity and produce timely, accurate reporting.
• Identify opportunities to streamline HR and payroll administration processes, strengthen controls, and increase efficiency through automation and best practices.
• Develop, document, and maintain procedures and standard work for HR administration and payroll support activities.

Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field preferred, or 4+ years of human resources experience in a generalist or specialist capacity. Working knowledge of payroll administration, including garnishments and multi-state payroll and experience is preferred.

Strong attention to detail, along with organizational, analytical, and communication skills, is essential, as is the ability to handle confidential information with discretion. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Word is required. The ideal candidate brings a customer-focused approach and a continuous improvement mindset with a track record of improving HR processes and data accuracy.

What You'll Bring
• A commitment to accuracy, confidentiality, compliance, and service excellence.
• The ability to build strong relationships across HR, Finance, and Operations.
• A proactive approach to solving problems and improving processes.
• The ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced, multi-site environment.

Why Join Us?
Join a growing organization where human resources plays a critical role in supporting our employees and business success. This position offers broad exposure across the employee lifecycle and payroll, the opportunity to influence process improvements, and the chance to make a meaningful impact across a multi-site manufacturing environment.

Why You'll Love Working Here
We believe in taking care of our people. Here's what you can expect:
• Generous Paid Time Off
• Comprehensive Medical, Dental & Vision Coverage
• Flexible Spending Accounts
• Critical Illness & Accident Coverage
• Life Insurance
• Short & Long-Term Disability
• 401(K) with Profit Sharing
• Parental Leave
• Tuition Reimbursement
• Paid Holidays

Our Commitment to You
Wis-Pak/WP Beverage is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We comply with EEOC regulations and use E-Verify to ensure employment eligibility.

Ready to make a difference? Join us and be part of a team that's refreshing the world--one bottle at a time.

description:

Develop insights into the generation and financial performance of renewable projects and portfolios.

Analyze and understand electricity market, meteorological, and utility-scale wind, solar, and storage project data.

Calculate the project generation and settlement amount for clean energy contracts.

Audit invoices for accuracy of generation, price, and application of contract settlement clauses.

Continue the advancement of REsurety’s settlement and project performance assessment capabilities.

Execute quality control checks of data critical to business processes.

2+ years of industry experience in clean energy development, asset management, consulting, advisory or finance.

Background in math, finance, accounting, physics, engineering, atmospheric science, data science, or a related field.

Proficiency with Excel and foundational experience (or a strong interest in developing proficiency) in SQL and Python.

Robust medical, 401K and other benefits.

title: Senior Scrum Master
description:

Every day, we deliver innovative solutions to improve the life of millions of people, connecting employees, companies, and merchants all around the world.

We know there are hundred ways for you to grow. With us, you will expand your skills in a multicultural, challenging, and dynamic environment.

Dare to join Edenred and get ready to thrive in a global company that will offer you endless opportunities.

Edenred is all about meritocracy. You come as you are, and you contribute. Indeed, the Edenred Group recognizes, recruits and develops all talents and singularities.

We are committed to preventing all forms of discrimination and to providing all our candidates with equal opportunities regardless of their gender and gender expression, disability, origin, religious belief and sexual orientation or any other criteria.

Senior Scrum Master

Salary – £70,000 - £82,000 pa + Bonus

Hybrid - Swindon or London

Accountable to

  • Scrum/Kanban Team, Agile Team’s Scrum Masters

  • Agile Lead

Responsible for:

Championing delivering Better Value Sooner Safer Happier via improving Ways of Working (WoW) inside Scrum and/or Lean Agile (Kanban) teams, and contributing to such efforts across the wider organisation (both PayTech and wider Edenred).

You will be a self-learner who rapidly expands their knowledge of Lean, Agile, business, leadership, and other practices, frameworks, and techniques. It is likely that you attend Agile meetups either inside or outside the company, and share ideas and learning with your peers. You will be confident in presenting ideas to a diverse audience at meetup style events.

You will have a level 1 qualification in Agile such as PSM1, CSM, DASM, KMP, or ICP. Ideally you should have achieved a level 2 / advanced qualification in Agile. Additional qualifications in Lean, leadership, and Emotional Intelligence are highly relevant.

Your background and experience is of paramount importance to help teams adopt an holistic view of software engineering. You may come from a computer science, pure science, business, military, or any other background. The key is being able to demonstrate knowledge of, and application of agility in practice & context with those whom you work with.

You will have extensive experience of working in an Agile iterative and/or incremental environment regularly solving problems and delivering value to customers. This does not need to be a software delivery environment, however the nature of our work means that knowledge of various Software Delivery Lifecycles is advantageous.

You will practice the 8 stances of the Scrum Master, and will be able to shift your approach according to needs of the team.

Working relationships

  • Agile Team

  • Product Owner & Product Manager

  • Development & QA Managers

  • Operations & Service

  • Business stakeholders

  • Leaders across PayTech and Payment Solutions

  • Cross-collaboration with other teams via other Scrum Masters

Key result areas

  • Establishes Sprint Goals and enables team to focus upon, and achieve these. Ensures that Sprint Goals are aligned to quarterly team-level Programme Increments and associated value definitions .

  • Assists in establishing department-wide Goals.

  • Embeds good Lean and Agile practices, and associated Ways of Working (WoW) at team and department levels, and influences the Engineering, Infrastructure, Operations, and Product departments via wider conversations, for example through our Agile Community of Practice.

  • Discovers and commits Objectives and Key Results at the team level to measure success of WoW changes; uses metrics-as-feedback (eg: via LinearB) to establish a culture of evidence-based continuous improvement.

  • Coaches and influences the Scrum Team towards improving WoW while taking into account, and balancing all aspects of Better Value Sooner Safer Happier.

  • Takes leadership, coaching, and mentoring stances with other Scrum Masters to accelerate individual and collective learning and WoW improvements inside the Agile Team.

  • Proactively identifies, triages, unblocks, and escalates impediments impacting the Scrum Team. Establishes a culture of preventing impediments from occurring in preference to mitigating after-the-event.

Key tasks

  • Personal development in Agile methods, practices, and frameworks.

  • Performs the role of Scrum Master (or equivalent in Lean Agile) across up to two teams.

  • Adopts appropriate Agile frameworks, methods and techniques tailored to the context of the team.

  • Evolves established Agile frameworks, methods and techniques to create new opportunities for agility in PayTech.

  • Recommends, and helps implement, descaling approaches as well as Agile scaling to achieve business Goals, via the simplification of value delivery.

  • Undertakes continuous/regular improvements via retrospective techniques of inspection and adaption, agrees measurements and tracks progress towards improvement.

  • Undertakes Agile Planning techniques focused on incremental delivery of customer value with team, Product Owner, Product Manager and other valued stakeholders.

Core skills

Role Specific

  • Significant experience / knowledge with a variety of Lean and Agile frameworks, and associated methods.

  • Able to communicate “why Agile” as well as “how to do Agile” to a varied audience including both those from software-technical and non-software-technical backgrounds.

  • Experience of adopting Lean Principles (eg: focus on value, waste identification and elimination) with examples of successful changes to behaviour and practice yielding positive impact upon customer value delivered.
