title: Senior Quality Manager, Applied AI
description:
About LILT

AI is changing how the world communicates — and LILT is leading that transformation.

We're on a mission to make the world's information accessible to everyone, regardless of the language they speak. We use cutting-edge AI, machine translation, and human-in-the-loop expertise to translate content faster, more accurately, and more cost-effectively without compromising on brand, voice, or quality.

At LILT, we empower our teammates with leading tools, global collaboration, and growth opportunities to do their best work. Our company virtues—Work together, win together; Find a way or make one; Dance in the customer's shoes; Quicker than they expect; Quality is Job 1—guide everything we do. We are trusted by Intel Corporation, Canva, the United States Department of Defense, the United States Air Force, ASICS, and hundreds of global Enterprises. Backed by Sequoia, Intel Capital, and Redpoint, we’re building a category-defining company in a $50B+ global translation market being redefined by AI.

Key Responsibilities

  • Ensure Workflows Are Built for Quality

    • Outcome: Every Applied AI deliverable ships with measured quality: rater agreement meets agreed thresholds per dimension, rubric scores are reproducible across raters, and reported quality figures hold up under customer audit.

  • Own Technical Tooling & Quality Infrastructure

    • Outcome: Quality metrics for every active program (defect rate, acceptance rate, rework, reviewer reliability, throughput, SLA adherence) are available without manual compilation, and systemic quality issues are detected from workflow data before a customer reports them.

  • Own Operational Quality at Scale

    • Outcome: Concurrent programs meet their quality targets within agreed cost and throughput. Acceptance rates hold at or above target, rework declines over time, and standard QC on standardized workflows is executed and interpreted by Production staff without Quality Manager involvement by the end of the second quarter in role.

  • Delivery sign-off: Every deliverable has a documented go/no-go decision before shipping, based on programmatic QA and a readiness memo with flags. Post-sign-off quality escapes stay below an agreed threshold, and each escape results in a documented process change.

  • Own Customer Quality Remediation

    • Outcome: Customer quality disputes are closed with quantitative analysis, normally at first response. Re-adjudication completes within SLA, recurring defect classes decline release over release, and annotator integrity issues are detected internally before they reach a deliverable.

Qualifications

  • Education: B.S./M.S. in a quantitative field (CS, Statistics, Data Science, Engineering, Linguistics, HCI) or equivalent practical experience.

  • Applied AI / evaluation experience: 6+ years building or operating quality programs for ML/LLM systems (data labeling, benchmark creation, model evaluation, or human-in-the-loop pipelines).

  • Quality systems leadership: Proven ability to design and run end-to-end quality frameworks (rubrics, sampling plans, QC gates, acceptance criteria, escalation paths) across multiple concurrent programs.

  • Measurement & statistics: Strong grasp of reliability and agreement methods (e.g., Krippendorff’s α, Cohen’s κ), power/sample-size intuition, error analysis, and reporting for executive stakeholders.

  • Rater/annotator operations: Experience with calibration, adjudication, targeted retraining, drift monitoring, and integrity/fraud detection in high-throughput human evaluation programs.

  • Tooling & automation: Hands-on with labeling/eval tooling (e.g., Label Studio or similar) and designing deterministic validations; comfort partnering with engineering/research to implement quality instrumentation.

  • Data governance: Strong understanding of dataset/version management, traceability, privacy/compliance constraints, and audit-ready documentation for deliverables.

  • Stakeholder management: Excellent written and verbal communication; able to translate ambiguous research goals into measurable quality targets and negotiate tradeoffs with Applied AI, product, and external partners.

Preferred Skills

  • Fluency in multiple human languages.

  • Proficiency in a programming language and experience working with modern AI frameworks.

Where You’ll Work

This position is based in our Boston office and will be expected to work in the office in a hybrid capacity. LILT is hybrid with hubs in SF, NY, Indianapolis, Boston, London, and Berlin.

Authorization to work in the U.S. is a precondition of employment.

  • Boston (highly preferred)

  • Others: SF Bay Area, New York, Indianapolis, London

Our Story

Our founders, Spence and John met at Google working on Google Translate. As researchers at Stanford and Berkeley, they both worked on language technology to make information accessible to everyone. While together at Google, they were amazed to learn that Google Translate wasn’t used for enterprise products and services inside the company.The quality just wasn’t there. So they set out to build something better. LILT was born.

LILT has been a machine learning company since its founding in 2015. At the time, machine translation didn’t meet the quality standard for enterprise translations, so LILT assembled a cutting-edge research team tasked with closing that gap. While meeting customer demand for translation services, LILT has prioritized investments in Large Language Models, human-in-the-loop systems, and now agentic AI.

With AI innovation accelerating and enterprise demand growing, the next phase of LILT’s journey is just beginning.

Our Tech

What sets our platform apart:

  • Brand-aware AI that learns your voice, tone, and terminology to ensure every translation is accurate and consistent

  • Agentic AI workflows that automate the entire translation process from content ingestion to quality review to publishing

  • 100+ native integrations with systems like Adobe Experience Manager, Webflow, Salesforce, GitHub, and Google Drive to simplify content translation

  • Human-in-the-loop reviews via our global network of professional linguists, for high-impact content that requires expert review


LILT in the News

  • Featured in The Software Report’s Top 100 Software Companies!

  • LILT makes it onto the Inc. 5000 List.

  • LILT’s continues to be an intellectual powerhouse, holding numerous patents that help power the most efficient and sophisticated AI and language models in the industry.

  • Check out all our news on our website.

title: Software Engineer, Motion Planning
description:
About The Company

DiDi's autonomous driving unit was established in 2016 with the mission of developing Level 4 autonomous driving (AD) technology to make transportation safer and more efficient. In August 2019, the unit became an independent company, DiDi Autonomous Driving, dedicated to advanced AD R&D, product application, and business expansion. We believe integrating AD technology into a shared-mobility fleet will generate immense social value. By leveraging DiDi's specialized technology, operational expertise, and integrated ecosystem, we are positioned to build and operate a highly efficient, user-oriented autonomous fleet.

About The Role

We are seeking a Software Engineer /Sr. Software Engineer to join our team and develop the core decision-making and motion planning systems for our autonomous vehicles. In this role, you will be responsible for creating the algorithms that enable smooth, safe, and intelligent navigation in complex environments. You will tackle challenges across the full motion planning stack, from high-level behavioral reasoning to low-level trajectory optimization.

Responsibilities

  • Design and implement the core motion planning logic that determines the vehicle's high-level actions (e.g., lane changes, merges, yields, and interactions with other agents).
  • Develop and optimize the motion planning algorithms that execute behavioral decisions, integrating Geometry Reasoning (path) and Speed Reasoning (velocity) into a cohesive trajectory.
  • Architect and enhance the geometry system for generating geometrically feasible and compliant paths.
  • Architect and refine the velocity system for generating context-aware, comfortable, and safe velocity profiles.
  • Model complex driving scenarios and agent interactions to create a robust world model for the behavioral planner.
  • Design different costs for trajectory ranking to trade off ETAs, comfort and safety of the vehicle behaviors.
  • Conduct in-depth analysis, testing, and debugging of the system's performance in various scenarios, leading root cause investigations.
  • Collaborate with Prediction, Perception, and Control teams to ensure a seamless flow from environmental understanding to physical vehicle motion.

Qualifications

  • B.S./M.S. in Computer Science, Robotics, or a related field.
  • Experience in autonomous systems, robotics, or automotive software development.
  • Strong proficiency in C++ for implementing complex, real-time algorithms.
  • Solid understanding of robotics fundamentals, including decision-making, motion planning, control theory, trajectory ranking, search and optimization algorithms etc.
  • Related experience in one or more of the following: motion planning, trajectory optimization and world environment reasoning, trajectory ranking and cost design.

Preferred Qualifications

  • PhD or internship experience related to robotics planning system designs.
  • Knowledge of vehicle dynamics and longitudinal/lateral control systems.
  • Solid understanding of machine learning principles, reinforcement learning and related algorithms.

The base salary range for the Software Engineer position is $141,463–$235,182 annually, and for the Senior Software Engineer position is $169,783–$282,264 annually, in addition to bonus, equity, and benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by the role, level, and location. title: Design Release Engineer – Execution Team – Safety Restraint Systems
description:
The Restraint Design Release Engineer (DRE) is responsible for the design, development and release of one or more of the following components: the steering wheel, seat belts and/or airbags to support Stellantis vehicle programs.

Assignments include working with suppliers and other cross-functional areas to design, develop and release restraint components and systems. This will include writing change notices and compliance reports, overall management and updates to Stellantis systems and core documentation (e.g., DVPR, DFMEA) to meet program timing and deliverables. The Engineer will follow, track, root cause and manage to resolution issues found during development and serial life (warranty). They will also provide the same support to the plants for build issues found during pre-production, production launch, and serial life builds.

The Restraint DRE is expected to manage the development of the passive safety restraint requirements. The Restraints DRE with steering wheel responsibilities is expected to manage the development of the capacitive hands-on detection and heating (electrical and performance) requirements. The chosen candidate will work with other Stellantis engineering organizations to package and develop the complete restraint system. The Restraints DRE will interface with purchasing, product design office, manufacturing and supply base groups to achieve program objectives.

The Restraint DRE is responsible for the review of testing, parts, data and best practices to meet program requirements, Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standards (FMVSS), ECE and other global certifications.

title: Yourgi Director of Product
description:
Who we are: Yourgi is on a mission to become Earth's most trusted pet care connector, connecting pet parents with a reliable local network of certified professionals, pet resorts, and veterinary centers. Backed by a passionate team, our mission is to make pet care simple, accessible, and joyful for all. Because pets aren't just animals—they're family.

Yourgi grows two ways: pet parents completing bookings on our marketplace, and businesses running their operations on our software. This role owns the product strategy behind both and runs Product day to day. You’ll report to the Chief Product & Technology Officer (CPTO) and lead four product managers across five teams:

Bookings owns the booking flow and everything a pet parent does after booking.

Match owns search, ranking, and the experience before booking.

Pro owns the tools pros use to run their business.

Connect makes a national network of centers bookable online.

Centers runs online booking for Destination Pet locations.

Each team owns a customer journey end to end and pairs with an engineering lead and a designer.

Availability changes by the hour and sits in many center systems. Supply is local, so each market is built one pro and one center at a time. Every booking is a pet parent trusting someone with a family member.

Yourgi is on a mission to become Earth's most trusted pet care connector, connecting pet parents

with a reliable local network of certified professionals, pet resorts, and veterinary centers. Backed

by a passionate team, our mission is to make pet care simple, accessible, and joyful for all.

Because pets aren't just animals—they're family.

We connect pet parents to two kinds of supply. On our marketplace, we match them with independent service pros for grooming, boarding, training, and daycare. Those pros run their business on Yourgi Pro. Through Yourgi Connect, we link pet parents directly into brick-and-mortar centers, including Destination Pet, Four Walls, and a growing national network. There they can check live availability, reserve a spot, and book in real time.

We run on web and native iOS and Android apps, for pet parents on one side and the pros and centers who serve them on the other. We’re live in five markets and adding more.

LOCATION : Remote (US only; must be authorized to work in the US, no visa sponsorship)

REPORTS TO: Chief Product & Technology Officer

PAY: $195,000-$245,000 base +20% bonus

CORE RESPONSIBILITES:


Product strategy - Develop and own the product strategy across the five teams. It covers the problems we solve and the bets we place, and it names what we won’t build. - Ground it in customer evidence, the market, competitors, and unit economics, and revisit it as evidence changes.


Goals and roadmap - Turn the strategy into quarterly goals for each team: one outcome metric plus the input metrics that drive it, defined and baselined before the quarter starts. - Keep one prioritized roadmap across the five teams, each item tied to the goal it moves. - Run product’s weekly business review and the actions that come out of it.


Fast testing with AI - Test bets before scaling them, using the cheapest method that answers the question: prototypes, fake-door tests, concierge pilots, or A/B tests. - Set each bet’s success metric and kill criteria before it starts. Scale, change, or stop it on the results. - Run research synthesis, spec drafts, and experiment analysis with AI by default, and train the team to work this way.


The product team - Hire, coach, and grow the product managers, and set the bar for the craft. - Give each product manager a business number to own, with the data and the authority to move it. - Build a team that pulls in support, sales, marketing, or operations to get a result, and handles the work itself when that is faster.


Product’s voice - Represent product to the leadership team. Bring the current numbers and the risks, and present the plan to hit the goals. - Treat quality as a product outcome. Own defect and reliability metrics for booking alongside conversion. - Partner with the VP of Engineering on scope and capacity, and hold the business goal when the two conflict.

What You Bring


Must-haves - Has rebuilt a product team’s discovery, spec, or analysis workflow around AI tools, and uses AI daily in their own work. - 10+ years in product management, including 3+ years managing product managers. - Has directly owned a conversion, revenue, or retention number, and can name the product choices behind it. - Has built a product strategy from customer and market evidence, set metric-based goals from it, and driven execution. - Has validated bets quickly, from prototypes to A/B tests with sample sizing and guardrail metrics, and scaled or stopped them on the results. - Self-serve analytics: writes SQL or builds analyses in a tool such as Mixpanel or Amplitude without waiting on an analyst. - Experience with a two-sided marketplace or software that service businesses run on, such as tools for salons, clinics, fitness studios, or home services.


Differentiators - Has worked on a consumer marketplace and the business software its supply runs on - Has co-authored a multi-year product vision with a CEO or product executive - Startup or growth-stage experience - Booking, scheduling, or local-services products, where real-time availability shapes conversion - Consumer mobile apps at scale on iOS and Android - Has built a goal and metric system from scratch - Pet care industry experience

What Success Looks Like

In your first 90 days, you’ll deliver a written product strategy and set goals with each team. You’ll also co-author the 2-3 year product vision with the CPTO. Within a year, each product manager owns a business number, teams test before they build, and AI is routine in how product works.


Logistics

  • Remote, US-based, working during regular US business hours. Meetings run on Microsoft Teams.
  • Some travel for leadership offsites and team gatherings.

What We’re Looking For (Top 3)

  • Drives product strategy independently. Shapes strategy from day one and owns it across all five teams. Co-authors the 2-3 year product vision with the CPTO within the first quarter.
  • Builds an AI-first team that tests fast. Prototypes in hours, tests with real users in days, and cuts what the evidence doesn’t support. Brings the product team to the same pace.
  • Makes product managers owners of business outcomes. Each is accountable for a business number. They pull in support, sales, or marketing when they need help. They do the work themselves when that is faster.

PERKS:

  • Health, vision, dental, long & short-term disability, and Life insurance
  • A Startup mentality company with stable funding

  • Flexible Time Off
  • Opportunity to grow your career with a network of like-minded professionals

title: Staff Software Engineer, Data - Experimentation
description:
About the Team

The Decision Systems team helps DoorDash teams make faster, more rigorous, and more trustworthy decisions. We build the analytical systems, statistical methods, and product experiences that power experimentation, causal inference, rollout analysis, metric interpretation, and business impact measurement across DoorDash’s three-sided marketplace. Curie is DoorDash’s experiment analysis product within Decision Systems. It sits at the center of how teams move from hypothesis to analysis to confident action, helping decision makers understand experiments, rollouts, metric movements, and marketplace impact while preserving scientific rigor, velocity, trust, and interpretability. Our work spans experimentation platforms, causal inference, variance reduction, switchback experimentation, metric systems, and AI-assisted analysis workflows. We partner closely with data scientists, engineers, product managers, and operators across DoorDash to translate advanced methods into reliable, scalable systems that improve decision quality and product velocity. Some of the work done in the team was published in articles such as: Design-Aware Variance Reduction for Switchback Experiments: A Comparative Study, Power-Optimal Covariate Adjustment for Switchback Experiments, CUPED on Steroids: Multivariate Covariate Adjustment for Switchback Experiments.

About the Role

We are looking for a Staff Applied Scientist to provide scientific leadership for DoorDash’s Experimentation Platform. In this role, you will define and advance the statistical, causal inference, machine learning, and AI capabilities that power high-quality decision-making across DoorDash. You will work on challenging problems at the intersection of experimentation, marketplace dynamics, machine learning, and product engineering.

Your work will shape how DoorDash teams design experiments, analyze results, interpret noisy marketplace outcomes, and make faster, more trustworthy decisions. This is a high-leverage role for a scientist who enjoys both deep technical work and broad cross-functional influence—partnering with engineers, data scientists, product managers, and operators to translate cutting-edge methods into reliable platform capabilities used across the company.

You're excited about this opportunity because you will...

  • Set the scientific direction for Curie and shape the Decision Systems roadmap with engineering and product partners, identifying where better science, tooling, or automation can materially improve decision quality and velocity.
  • Own the statistical contract for experiment analysis, including how metrics, populations, exposure windows, covariates, ratio metrics, and edge cases are defined.
  • Ensure production systems faithfully implement those contracts by reviewing analytical SQL, validating statistical parity, and raising the bar for correctness across engine migrations.
  • Develop and productionize advanced methods such as CUPED/CUPAC, ratio-metric and delta-method inference, sequential testing, heterogeneous treatment effects, switchback designs, and difference-in-differences for marketplace interference.
  • Build approaches that hold up in high-scale, high-noise, three-sided marketplace data, including power analysis, multiple-testing correction, winsorization, quantile metrics, and other robust measurement techniques.
  • Advance AI-assisted analysis workflows, including trustworthy automated experiment readouts, risk detection, and hypothesis generation, with the same rigor expected of statistical methods.
  • Advise and mentor data scientists, product teams, operators, and engineers on experimental design, metric strategy, causal analysis, and interpretation of results.

We're excited about you because you have…

  • 6+ years of industry experience, or equivalent applied research experience, developing statistical, causal inference, machine learning, or experimentation systems with measurable business impact.
  • Deep expertise in experimentation and causal inference, with production experience in methods such as variance reduction, ratio metrics, sequential testing, heterogeneous treatment effects, marketplace interference, or quasi-experimental designs.
  • Strong coding and data skills, including the ability to reason about production data pipelines and review complex analytical SQL for statistical correctness.
  • Experience translating statistical or machine learning methods into reliable, scalable platform capabilities in close partnership with engineering and product teams.
  • A track record of setting technical direction, influencing cross-functional teams, and mentoring senior technical contributors without relying solely on formal authority.
  • The ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly to scientific, engineering, product, and executive audiences.
  • A bias for impact: you know how to balance methodological rigor, product velocity, engineering constraints, and customer needs.

We expect this position to be filled by 10-17-2026

Compensation

The successful candidate’s starting pay will fall within the pay range listed below and is determined based on job-related factors including, but not limited to, skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions. Base salary is localized according to an employee’s work location. Ranges are market-dependent and may be modified in the future.

In addition to base salary, the compensation for this role includes opportunities for equity grants. Talk to your recruiter for more information.

DoorDash cares about you and your overall well-being. That’s why we offer a comprehensive benefits package to all regular employees, which includes a 401(k) plan with employer matching, 16 weeks of paid parental leave, wellness benefits, commuter benefits match, paid time off and paid sick leave in compliance with applicable laws (e.g. Colorado Healthy Families and Workplaces Act). DoorDash also offers medical, dental, and vision benefits, 11 paid holidays, disability and basic life insurance, family-forming assistance, and a mental health program, among others.

To learn more about our benefits, visit our careers page here.

See below for paid time off details:

  • For salaried roles: flexible paid time off/vacation, plus 80 hours of paid sick time per year.
  • For hourly roles: vacation accrued at about 1 hour for every 25.97 hours worked (e.g. about 6.7 hours/month if working 40 hours/week; about 3.4 hours/month if working 20 hours/week), and paid sick time accrued at 1 hour for every 30 hours worked (e.g. about 5.8 hours/month if working 40 hours/week; about 2.9 hours/month if working 20 hours/week).

About DoorDash

At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.

DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. title: Cybersecurity Engineer
description:
Enterprise Solutions and Management (ESM) is a rapidly growing government contractor that provides strategic IT services that meet mission needs for Defense and Federal customers. We are hiring a Cybersecurity Engineer to support an enterprise-level program within a federal environment.

Job Description and Responsibilities

Performs a variety of routine project tasks applied to specialized cybersecurity problems. Tasks involve integration of electronic processes or methodologies to resolve total system problems, or technology problems as they relate to cybersecurity requirements. Analyzes information security requirements. Applies analytical and systematic approaches in the resolution of problems of workflow, organization, and planning. Provides security engineering support for planning, design, development, testing, demonstration, integration of information systems.


Required Knowledge, Skills and Abilities (KSA)

  • Knowledge of cybersecurity principles and practices to identify, analyze, and address specialized security challenges affecting information systems and technology.
  • Ability to analyze information security requirements and identify appropriate security measures to ensure systems meet established cybersecurity standards and operational needs.
  • Skill in integrating electronic processes, security tools, and technical methodologies to resolve system-level issues and address technology-related cybersecurity problems.
  • Ability to apply analytical and systematic problem-solving techniques to improve workflows, organizational processes, project planning, and operational efficiency.
  • Knowledge of security engineering principles and practices to support the planning, design, development, testing, demonstration, and integration of secure information systems.
  • Ability to evaluate system security and support testing and integration activities to identify potential vulnerabilities, resolve technical issues, and verify compliance with cybersecurity requirements.

Desired KSA

  • Be a positive, self-motivated, and proactive person with the ability to adapt to change and tolerate stressful situations
  • Candidate must communicate effectively with team members, team lead, management, and government customers
  • Must have the ability and desire to research and develop creative solutions to unique problems with minimal supervision




Minimum Training, Education, and Certifications

  • Seven (7) years of relevant IT experience.
  • Computing Environment certification: Forescout, ACAS, AWS, AZURE, F5, Linux, Microsoft, Splunk, Trellix, or etc.

Minimum Clearance

  • Secret

Physical Requirements

  • Required to stand, walk and sit; communicate verbally both in person and by telephone; use hands to finger, handle or feel objects or controls; reach with hands and arms. Regularly required to stoop, kneel, bend, crouch and lift up to 25 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, depth perception, color vision and the ability to adjust focus.
  • Physical demands associated with this position include extensive walking (including stairs) throughout offices and between buildings. May require use of public transportation, personal or Government vehicle to drive to local and/or remote office locations.

Additional Requirements

  • Other duties as assigned

ESM provides equal employment opportunity to all individuals regardless of race, color, creed, religion, gender, age, sexual orientation, national origin or ancestry, disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identification or any other characteristic protected by state, federal or local law.

title: Senior iOS Developer
description:
Job Description

Job Description

At Mercedes-Benz Research & Development North America (MBRDNA), we are committed to delivering world-class automotive technologies that push the boundaries of what is possible. Our teams of highly skilled engineers and designers use cutting-edge software and technology, to enhance the driving experience and reduce environmental impact.


Mercedes-Benz Research & Development North America (MBRDNA) is a place for exceptional people with outstanding ideas and the absolute willingness to bring them to life. In our R&D facilities in the U.S., you will be surrounded by engineers, software developers, and designers pushing technology boundaries to shape the future of our industry. We are not just about cars: we are also about the latest and greatest software, cutting-edge technology, and groundbreaking innovation.

We are looking for a Senior iOS Mobile Developer to help advance the Mercedes app for North America. This role will contribute to the design, development, and maintenance of iOS experiences that enable Connected Car features and integrate the mobile app into Mercedes-Benz’s end-to-end customer experience. The candidate will build on a highly rated application and expand its capabilities to meet business goals, customer expectations, and North American market needs.

The Senior iOS Mobile Developer will work within a fast-paced, cross-functional team alongside mobile engineers, backend developers, product owners, UX designers, QA, and global development partners. The role requires strong technical ownership, collaborative problem solving, sophisticated design judgment, and a commitment to delivering high-quality mobile features across iPhone, Apple Watch, and connected vehicle experiences.

Relocation assistance (domestic or international) is not provided for this position.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Design, build, and maintain iOS features for the Mercedes me connect mobile app serving North American customers.
  • Lead iOS feature implementation architecture and strategy, aligning technical direction with product, UX, QA, backend, and global stakeholders.
  • Develop Connected Car experiences that integrate mobile app functionality with Mercedes-Benz vehicles, backend services, and the broader digital ecosystem.
  • Apply North American market expertise to identify customer needs, propose product improvements, and support changes within infotainment and connected-car domains.
  • Ensure the performance, quality, reliability, security, and responsiveness of the iOS application across supported devices, including mobile phones and wearables.
  • Collaborate with global teams to define, design, implement, and ship new features in alignment with business priorities and release timelines.
  • Take a proactive approach to root-cause analysis, incident resolution, defect prevention, and continuous improvement of engineering practices.
  • Identify and correct bottlenecks, resolve bugs reported by QA, and improve code quality, maintainability, and test coverage.
  • Partner with Product and UX Design to clarify acceptance criteria, technical feasibility, customer experience requirements, and story readiness.
  • Participate actively in Scrum refinement and estimation sessions, accurately sizing work and delivering stories within agreed timelines.
  • Maintain high standards for code quality, pull request quality, documentation, and adherence to Mercedes-Benz development guidelines.
  • Break down pull requests into manageable increments to support efficient review, testing, and merge processes.
  • Review and approve pull requests from other developers, providing constructive feedback and promoting engineering best practices.
  • Support release readiness, app store publication activities, and compliance with Apple Developer guidelines.
  • Contribute to team KPIs and OKRs by focusing on prioritized roadmap items, delivery commitments, and measurable product outcomes.
  • Conduct competitor benchmarking and customer-experience analysis to recommend enhancements for the North American mobile app experience.
  • Mentor junior developers through code reviews, pairing, shadowing, technical guidance, and best-practice documentation.
  • Foster continuous learning, inclusive collaboration, and process improvement within a diverse engineering team.
  • Work effectively in a global environment with peers and partners in Germany, India, China, and other Mercedes-Benz development locations.
  • Utilize diverse opinions, cultural perspectives, and cross-functional expertise to improve product quality and customer value.
  • Up to 25% travel may be required for this position.

Minimum Qualifications:
  • Bachelor of Science in Computer Science or Computer Engineering consider: Electrical Engineering, Mathematics, or related field of study
  • At least 5 years of native iOS development experience.
  • Strong Swift coding skills.
  • Solid understanding of mobile architectures, such as MVP, MVVM, and VIPER.
  • Solid understanding of concurrency using async/await, Dispatch, and Combine.
  • Experience in creating custom, pixel-perfect UIs.
  • Hands-on experience with CI/CD platforms, such as Jenkins.
  • Hands-on experience with unit testing.
  • Hands-on experience with publishing apps to the App Store.
  • Solid understanding of Apple Developer guidelines.
  • Experience in Agile methodologies like Scrum and Kanban.
  • Exceptional time management and ownership for assigned tasked and feature developments.
  • Frequent use of speech, vision, hearing, use of hands for computer use and presentations. Frequent sitting, standing and reaching with hands.
Preferred Qualifications:
  • R&D engineering experience with a focus on vehicles, Mercedes-Benz products, or connected mobility experiences.
  • Working knowledge of infotainment, telematics, digital vehicle services, and Connected Car ecosystems.
  • Experience developing customer-facing mobile features that integrate with backend services, cloud platforms, and vehicle systems.
  • Experience supporting North American market requirements, customer expectations, and regional product enhancements.
  • Backend development experience or strong ability to collaborate with backend engineering teams.
  • Track record of published mobile apps, preferably with high customer ratings or large active user bases.
  • Experience mentoring engineers, improving development practices, and contributing to team-level delivery goals.

title: Network Engineer
description:
Hadrian - Manufacturing the Future

Hadrian is building autonomous factories to reindustrialize America. By combining AI, advanced software, robotics, and full-stack manufacturing, we help aerospace and defense companies build rockets, satellites, aircraft, ships, and other mission-critical systems up to 10x faster and at significantly lower cost.


Following our $1.37B Series D at a $7.87B valuation, Hadrian is rapidly expanding our manufacturing footprint, launching new capabilities across welding, casting, forging, electronics, additive manufacturing, and more, while scaling our Factory-as-a-Service platform to transform how critical products are built.


Backed by leading investors including JPMorgan Chase, Valor Equity Partners, Andreessen Horowitz, Founders Fund, 137 Ventures, Lux Capital, T. Rowe Price, and Morgan Stanley, we’re building the future of American manufacturing—and looking for exceptional people to help make it happen.


If you’re ready to take on the most challenging and rewarding work of your career while helping create American manufacturing jobs for generations to come, you’re exactly who we’re looking for.

The Role

We are looking for a Senior Network Engineer to own the design, architecture, and reliability of network infrastructure across our data center, campus, multi-site, and cloud environments. You’ll define how our networks are built: setting standards, architecting connectivity from the data center fabric to the factory floor and office campus, and leading new site bring-ups from design through production.

You’ll be the technical authority on networking, partnering with infrastructure, IT, security, and operations teams to design scalable topologies, drive automation through Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC), and keep a 24/7 manufacturing environment reliable. The ideal candidate works comfortably across every layer and environment of the network (data center, campus, wired, wireless, WAN, and cloud), pairs deep expertise with strong architectural judgment, and builds systems and standards that scale beyond a single site.

What You’ll Do

  • Own network architecture across data center, campus, multi-site, and cloud, setting standards and reference designs that scale

  • Lead new site bring-ups from topology design and capacity planning through production handoff

  • Architect routing and switching in a scalable fashion, including route policy, redistribution, and segmentation

  • Design and operate BGP for internet edge, multi-homing, and cloud interconnects (peering, filtering, path selection, failover)

  • Build VXLAN/EVPN fabrics: spine-leaf, BGP EVPN control plane, VTEPs, L2/L3 VNIs, and DCI for scalable segmentation and multi-tenancy

  • Design and operate campus networks (access, distribution, core vs clos), wired and wireless, across offices and the factory floor

  • Run cloud-managed wired and wireless with Juniper Mist (Mist AI, Wired Assurance, WAN Assurance) for AI-driven operations and troubleshooting

  • Implement SD-WAN and overlay technologies (GRE/IPsec/SASE) to connect sites, cloud, and remote users

  • Design highly-available connectivity: VPNs (GlobalProtect, IPsec, remote access), first-hop redundancy (HSRP/VRRP), switch clustering

  • Architect cloud networking across AWS and Azure (VPC/VNet, transit, peering, hybrid, BGP over Direct Connect/ExpressRoute)

  • Drive network automation with Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) for provisioning, configuration, and change management

  • Set standards for monitoring, observability, documentation, and operational runbooks

  • Lead root-cause analysis across routing, overlay, wireless, DNS, and performance issues

  • Manage ISP and telecom relationships for circuits, redundancy, and escalations

  • Coordinate low-voltage vendors and structured cabling for facility and data center build-outs

  • Guide connectivity for facility systems (cameras, access control, IoT) and corporate Wi-Fi

  • Mentor IT and infrastructure teammates and review designs and changes

  • Join on-call rotations, incident response, maintenance windows, and help mature escalation processes

  • Support Kubernetes and container networking (CNI, ingress, service networking)

What We’re Looking For

  • 8+ years in network engineering, operations, or infrastructure, including senior design and architecture ownership

  • Deep expertise in TCP/IP, routing, switching, wireless, VLANs, DNS, and DHCP at scale

  • Full-stack network experience: data center, campus, and multi-site, wired and wireless

  • Strong production experience with BGP and OSPF (route policy, redistribution, filtering, path selection)

  • Hands-on with overlay networks, especially VXLAN/EVPN fabrics and spine-leaf

  • Campus LAN and enterprise wireless design, ideally with cloud-managed platforms like Juniper Mist

  • Solid high-availability and redundancy design (BGP/OSPF failover, HSRP/VRRP, path resiliency)

  • Proven multi-site enterprise network experience

  • Strong SD-WAN architecture and implementation experience

  • Hands-on VPN experience (GlobalProtect, IPsec site-to-site, remote access)

  • Cloud networking design (AWS and/or Azure), including hybrid connectivity and routing

  • Proficiency with IaC tools (Git, Terraform, Ansible, Pulumi, CICD, etc.)

  • Track record leading complex network projects to completion

  • Strong operational mindset that balances speed and reliability

What Will Set You Apart

  • CCNP, CCIE, JNCIP/JNCIE, or equivalent advanced certifications

  • Hands-on Juniper Mist (Mist AI, Wired Assurance, WAN Assurance, Marvis) for campus operations and AIOps

  • BGP at scale: route reflectors, communities, traffic engineering, multi-provider edge

  • EVPN/VXLAN fabrics in data center and/or campus (BGP EVPN, symmetric/asymmetric IRB, VRF multi-tenancy, ESI-LAG, DCI)

  • Route and overlay hardening (RPKI, prefix filtering, max-prefix limits, BFD)

  • Multi-vendor fabric platforms and controllers (Juniper Apstra, Arista CloudVision, Cisco NX-OS/ACI)

  • Deep Juniper (EX/QFX, SRX, Mist) and Palo Alto firewall experience

  • AWS/Azure networking depth (VPC, Direct Connect, VPN Gateway, Transit Gateway, ExpressRoute) with BGP-based hybrid routing

  • Kubernetes networking (CNI, ingress, service mesh, BGP load balancing like MetalLB/Calico)

  • ISP relationship and circuit provisioning management at scale

  • Structured cabling and low-voltage program leadership

  • Facility systems experience (cameras, access control, IoT)

  • Experience with designing a high-availability, 24/7 production environment design

  • Mentoring admins, engineers or technical lead experience

Physical & Operational Requirements

  • Ability to lift and move networking equipment (~50 lbs)

  • Comfortable working in data centers and equipment rooms

  • 10-20% travel required for site deployments

  • Participation in on-call rotation and occasional after-hours maintenance

Compensation

For this role, the target salary range is $123,000 - $220,000 (actual range may vary based on experience).

This is the lowest to highest salary we reasonably and in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range, and the range may be modified in the future. An employee's pay position within the salary range will be based on several factors, including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, performance, and business or organizational needs.

Benefits for Full-time Employees

  • Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance plans for employees
    401k

  • Relocation support may be provided for certain situations, based on business need.

  • Flexible vacation policy

  • Equity

ITAR Requirements

To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) you must be a U.S. citizen or national, lawful permanent resident, protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

Use of AI in hiring

Hadrian uses AI-assisted tools in our recruiting and hiring processes to help our team work more efficiently. This may include tools that help organize and analyze recruiting data, as well as an AI-powered notetaker that can record and transcribe interviews and help coordinate feedback. These tools support our team and are not used to make hiring decisions. All candidate evaluations and hiring decisions are performed by humans. If an interview will be recorded, you will be notified in advance and may opt out at any time with no impact on your candidacy. Candidate data processed through these tools is subject to the same protections described in our Privacy Policy.

Consideration of Criminal History

Hadrian will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of all applicable laws. We do not ask about criminal history on our application, and we do not consider criminal history before making a conditional offer of employment.

Hadrian Is An Equal Opportunity Employer

Hadrian does not unlawfully discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, marital status, mental status, physical disability or any other legally protected status. When necessary, the Company also makes reasonable accommodations for disabled candidates and employees, including for candidates or employees who are disabled by pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions.

title: Wiring Systems Engineer
location: Colonia Santa Fe, Ciudad de México, Mexico
description:
General Description:

The Wiring Systems Engineer is responsible for all aspects of wire harness schematics design. This includes wire and fuse sizing, harness architecture layout, implementation of CAN network layouts, product plan assessment, harness complexity creation, harness design optimization (VAVE / VO).

The Systems Engineer will design and validate the electrical systems and released components to ensure we meet all Stellantis electrical specifications in the vehicle and component environments. The systems engineer will support PWB and manufacturing facilities for the entire life cycle, manage the supplier systems engineering support team, manage large amounts of data, and be fluent working in corporate computer systems.

Main Activities:

  • Administer wire harness schematics design and changes for a vehicle lifecycle.
  • Determine wire harness architecture layout and implementation of CAN network layouts, based on Stellantis networking specifications.
  • Determine appropriate wire attributes for all wire harness circuits.
  • Determine appropriate fuse size and types based on electrical characteristics for all electrical components in the vehicle.
  • Create wire harness complexity based on product planning information
  • Generate harness design optimization (VAVE / VO) ideas.
  • Design and validate electrical systems and released components to ensure all Stellantis electrical specifications in the vehicle and component environments are met.
  • Assist wiring systems team with harness developments.
  • Ensure all design processes and specifications are followed.
  • Support wire harness and electrical system troubleshooting at test facilities and dealerships.

title: Regional Service Operations Lead – France & Benelux
description:

title: Product Manager – Notifications | Help Dalux Users Focus on What Matters
description:
**Product Management at Dalux – Turning Information into Attention

**Construction projects generate an enormous amount of information. Files change. Tasks are assigned. Deadlines approach. Comments are added. Reviews require action. Issues are reported. People are mentioned. Workflows progress. But more information does not necessarily make people better informed.

Dalux is looking for a Product Manager to take dedicated ownership of Notifications and help us answer a deceptively difficult product question:

**How do we make sure users know what requires their attention – without overwhelming them with information?

**Notifications exist throughout our products today, across email, mobile, and in-product experiences. As Dalux has grown, so has their complexity. We believe this area deserves dedicated product ownership and a coherent strategy across our products.

**Your responsibilities will include:

**

  • Notification Strategy: Define a coherent product direction for how Dalux communicates important events and required actions to users.
  • Product Discovery: Understand when users need to be informed, when they need to take action, and when a notification simply creates unnecessary noise.
  • Customer Insights: Research how different users manage information and attention across complex projects and busy working days.
  • Cross-product Ownership: Map and improve notification experiences across Dalux products rather than optimizing individual notifications in isolation.
  • Channels & Preferences: Develop experiences spanning in-app notifications, email, mobile push, notification preferences, subscriptions, following, mentions, reminders, and digests.
  • Relevance & Prioritization: Explore grouping, prioritization, timing, and deduplication to ensure important information stands out.
  • Actionability: Make notifications useful by ensuring users understand why they received them, what has changed, and what action they should take.
  • Product Analytics: Use quantitative and qualitative insights to understand which notifications create value and which create noise.
  • Shared Capabilities: Work with Development and other Product Managers to create common notification principles and platform capabilities that can be reused across Dalux.

**About You

**You probably don't currently have "Notifications Product Manager" as your job title – and that's perfectly fine.

We're looking for an experienced Product Manager who finds the underlying problem interesting and has the product and systems thinking required to solve it.

We believe you:

  • Have strong Product Management experience, preferably from B2B SaaS, collaboration, productivity, workflow, communication, or similar software.
  • Have excellent product discovery and UX instincts.
  • Think systematically and can turn many individual use cases into coherent product concepts.
  • Understand the tension between keeping users informed and creating notification fatigue.
  • Are comfortable owning a horizontal capability spanning multiple products and development teams.
  • Can combine user research with product analytics to understand behavior.
  • Care about interaction details and understand how seemingly small product decisions can have a large cumulative impact on user experience.
  • Can simplify complex systems involving events, recipients, relevance, timing, preferences, and communication channels.
  • Communicate fluently in English, written and spoken.

**Construction Technology Experience Is Welcome But Not Required .

**Experience from collaboration, communication, workflow, or productivity software would be particularly relevant.

**What To Expect At Dalux

**At Dalux, you'll join a product-driven company where ideas quickly become reality and where you'll have a direct impact on the products we build.

We offer:

  • A collaborative and informal work environment with flat hierarchies
  • High ownership, trust, and the freedom to drive initiatives
  • Talented and dedicated colleagues in an international team
  • A central Copenhagen office, flexible work hours, and no dress code
  • Monthly social events and an active community
  • Attractive benefits including health insurance, lunch, fitness facilities, and free parking
  • Opportunities for professional growth and development

**Ready for the next step?

**We are reviewing applications on an ongoing basis, so please submit your resume and application as soon as possible.

**About Dalux

**Founded in 2005, Dalux is a Danish Contech company revolutionizing the construction industry with innovative software built on geometric processing and 3D computer graphics.

Over the past years, we’ve grown by 40% annually and now have over 900 employees across 50+ offices in more than 25 countries. All product development takes place in our Østerbro, Copenhagen office, where we focus on building the future of construction technology. We place great value on our strong social community and close collaboration with colleagues, which is why we primarily work from our Copenhagen location.

**Application deadline:

**As soon as possible

title: Senior Propulsion Test Engineer
description:
Divergent is building the new industrial age. Every day, our teams design, manufacture, and assemble advanced systems for some of the world’s most demanding industries. Our integrated engineering and manufacturing platform transforms complex designs into production-ready solutions, helping customers move faster, build smarter, and deliver critical systems when they matter most. Divergent is a qualified Tier 1 supplier to global automotive OEMs and supports leading U.S. aerospace and defense companies.

Join us and help push the boundaries of what can be built.

Purpose

We're seeking a Senior Propulsion Test Engineer to architect, build, and operate world-class propulsion test infrastructure that accelerates the development of next-generation turbo machinery and jet engines. From an empty test bay to first fire, you'll own the end-to-end development of propulsion test capability—designing mechanical structures, integrating high-pressure fluid systems, implementing instrumentation and controls, commissioning the facility, and ultimately leading propulsion test campaigns.

This is a highly hands-on role for an engineer who is equally comfortable designing structural hardware, specifying instrumentation, commissioning fluid systems, and troubleshooting on the test floor. You'll work closely with EH&S, Performance Engineering, Software, and external partners to transform ambitious testing objectives into safe, repeatable, and data-rich test campaigns that generate flight-critical insight.

As our propulsion programs evolve, you'll continuously improve and automate test operations, increasing throughput, data quality, and operational efficiency while fostering a culture of ownership, safety, and technical excellence.

This is an onsite position supporting propulsion development and recurring engine testing.

The Role

  • Deliver fully operational propulsion test stands from concept through commissioning, owning the mechanical, fluid, controls, and instrumentation systems required for safe, repeatable engine testing.
  • Build robust, flight-ready test infrastructure by designing structural hardware, high-pressure fluid systems, and facility equipment that meets demanding propulsion testing requirements.
  • Coordinate test readiness reviews, including, safety, instrumentation, and limits review in preparation for test events
  • Deliver high-fidelity test data by architecting and integrating instrumentation, DAQ, and control systems that provide reliable, flight-critical measurements for propulsion performance evaluation.
  • Commission and operate propulsion test systems by leading assembly, first-flow activation, shakedown testing, operating procedure development, and safe execution of engine test campaigns.
  • Drive propulsion test execution and technical insight by partnering with Performance Engineering to analyze results, benchmark engine performance, and resolve technical issues through root-cause investigation.
  • Continuously improve test capability by automating test operations, increasing reliability and throughput, and evolving infrastructure to accelerate propulsion development in alignment with the DAPS philosophy.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Aerospace, Electrical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
  • Demonstrated experience designing, building, commissioning, and operating complex propulsion or mechanical test systems, including hands-on integration, troubleshooting, and test execution.
  • Excellent ability to collaborate with technical and functional teams in prior to and during test events.
  • Strong technical foundation in high-pressure fluid systems, instrumentation, and high-speed data acquisition, including pressure system design, sensor integration, signal conditioning, and development of reliable, high-fidelity test data systems in accordance with ASME B31.3 or equivalent engineering standards.
  • Ability to lawfully access information and technology subject to U.S. export controls.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Direct experience testing turbo machinery, gas turbines, or jet engines.
  • Strong understanding of propulsion test planning, test execution, data acquisition, and performance analysis.
  • Experience with advanced sensing technologies, including fiber optic instrumentation.
  • Experience with PLCs, industrial controls, automation, or integrated test control systems.
  • Familiarity with vibration, NVH, and propulsion performance characterization.
  • Experience working in fast-paced R&D or first-of-a-kind hardware development environments.
  • A builder's mindset—you naturally envision how to transform an empty space into a safe, efficient, and highly capable propulsion test facility.
  • Collaborative leadership style with a track record of enabling multidisciplinary teams to deliver complex technical systems.

Work Environment

  • This is a hands-on, onsite role supporting propulsion test stand construction, commissioning, and recurring engine testing.
  • Regular exposure to high-pressure fluid systems, aviation fuels and active propulsion testing.
  • Close collaboration with Performance Engineering, Software Engineering, manufacturing teams, and external engineering partners to rapidly develop and improve propulsion test capability.

title: Senior Spacecraft Propulsion Systems Engineer I - Secret Clearance
description:
ABOUT ROCKET LAB

Rocket Lab is the end-to-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity’s reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We move fast, build real hardware for meaningful missions, and make the impossible routine. Come shape the future with us.

SPACE SYSTEMS

At Rocket Lab, we’re not just launching rockets — we're building the future of space. Our Space Systems team builds everything from complete spacecraft, precision payloads to the components and subsystems that allow them to thrive in space, like solar panels, flight software, star trackers, optical systems, separation systems, radios, and more.

Our Space Systems team has enabled more than 1,700 missions, ranging from interplanetary exploration, in-space manufacturing to national security and defense initiatives. The team has built spacecraft, payloads, and components for missions to the Moon and Mars, working with partners including NASA, the Space Development Agency, and the U.S. Space Force. Whether it’s a single high-performance spacecraft, constellation, or the vertically integrated components that help them get to space — our world class Space Systems team is empowering some of the boldest and most ambitious space missions.

SENIOR SPACECRAFT PROPULSION SYSTEMS ENGINEER I - SECRET CLEARANCE

We're seeking a Senior Spacecraft Propulsion Systems Engineer I for our propulsion engineering team based out of Long Beach, CA. As a Senior Propulsion Systems Engineer, you are responsible for system-level and component-level ownership of space systems propulsion and fluidic development. These teams support our Space Systems division, and lead cutting-edge programs for civil, commercial, and defense customers.

WHAT YOU’LL GET TO DO:

  • Owning development of new or existing products or systems, acting as technical lead to guide team through end-to-end development process
  • Conceptual and detailed performance calculations, systems modelling, analysis, and system designs
  • Requirements gathering, definition, and management
  • Systems engineering activities and leadership within the team
  • Test planning, setup, instrumentation, execution, and data analysis
  • Communicating with project stakeholders internal and external to the team
  • Technical risk-based decision making to the right/best solution when faced with an engineering challenge
  • Project management including schedule building and maintenance, identifying top priority items, tasking of other engineers and technicians, and communication of status to leadership and other teams
  • Mentorship and coaching of people within the team on technical and professional development
  • Defining and maintaining standard of excellence for their team through documentation, training, coaching, and review of others’ work
  • Contributing to engineering process development and documentation at Rocket Lab related to areas of experience

YOU’LL BRING THESE QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering (aerospace, mechanical, mechatronics, or other technical discipline)
  • 5+ years of experience in propulsion system development, or other high-performance field
  • Active Secret clearance with TS/SCI eligibility
  • US citizenship is required, due to program requirements
  • Expertise in propulsion system modelling, static and transient analysis, and model validation using test data software such as Amesim, EcosimPro, Simulink, or Simscape
  • Experience with end-to-end development process, including gathering requirements, detailed design, qualification, production, and acceptance testing
  • Experience with all steps in the Systems Engineering V and risk-based decision making
  • Experience working on propulsion systems utilizing different storable propellants, such as electrical and chemical

THESE QUALIFICATIONS WOULD BE NICE TO HAVE:

  • A genuine passion for engineering, curious mindset, and willingness to learn
  • Demonstrated hands-on engineering skills, inside or outside the workplace
  • Comfortable working with high levels of ambiguity
  • Ability to make decisions using basic engineering principles, available literature and standards, technical risk assessments, test data, and physics-based models
  • Practice in identifying the necessary steps to achieve high level technical goals, scheduling them in a plan, and managing delivery against that plan
  • Experience with Jama
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to work well within a team environment
  • Capabilities using Python for data manipulation and post-processing
  • Detailed mechanical design experience using NX (preferred) or equivalent industry standard CAD software
  • Experience with GD&T and engineering drawings
  • Experience using Product Lifecycle Management software such as Teamcenter (preferred), Windchill, or similar
  • Experience using National Instruments data acquisition systems
  • Experience with testing and troubleshooting flight hardware
  • Master's or PhD

This position may require prolonged periods of sitting, standing, walking, computer work, and occasional exposure to moderate levels of noise, dust, and fumes in production areas.

Anticipated annual equity grant value is designed around function, level, experience, and other factors; realized value depends on vesting and stock-price performance.

Join one of the world's fastest-growing space companies and own a piece of it. In addition to competitive base pay, you'll receive company stock as part of your total compensation package, giving you a direct stake in our success. As we expand to new launch sites, groundbreaking missions, and global markets, your ownership has the opportunity to grow alongside the company.

Our comprehensive benefits package includes our industry-leading Employee Stock Purchase Program (with a 15% discount on company stock), top-tier medical plans (HMO, PPO, and a zero cost HDHP option with a significant HSA company contribution), dental and vision coverage, paid vacation and sick time, 11 paid holidays, flexible spending and dependent care accounts, paid parental leave, disability and life insurance, and a 401(k) retirement plan with company match.

Additional perks include subsidized EV charging, onsite fitness centers (where available), discounted gym memberships, complimentary snacks and beverages, 50% employee discount on our popular merch store, and a variety of other employee discounts.

Level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Total Compensation (base and equity)
$135,000—$208,000 USD
Base Salary
$115,000—$173,000 USD

WHAT TO EXPECT

We’re on a mission to unlock the potential of space to improve life on Earth, but that’s not an easy task. It takes hard work, determination, relentless innovation, teamwork, grit, and an unwavering commitment to achieving what others often deem impossible. Our people out-think, out-work, and out-pace. We pride ourselves on having each other’s backs, checking our egos at the door, and rolling up our sleeves on all tasks big and small. We thrive under pressure, work to tight deadlines, and our focus is always on how we can deliver, rather than dwelling on the challenges that stand in the way.

description:

Capacity, Risk & Constraint Management

  • Identify bottlenecks and systemic constraints early; re-sequence work proactively.
  • Actively manage delivery risk, buffer consumption, and emerging execution threats.

  • Experience in multiple project/program delivery methods, Scrum, SAFe, etc.

    • Dependency mapping across parallel workstreams

    • Critical path and critical chain planning

Above and beyond

  • Experience working within a matrixed organization or enterprise PMO/TMO environment.
  • Background in systems modernization, insurance platform implementations, or large-scale operational transformation initiatives.
  • Familiarity with Agile, hybrid, or iterative delivery models in large transformations.
  • Background in insurance operations (underwriting, policy admin, billing, claims, distribution) strongly preferred.

Other things to note

  • This position is open to U.S. remote work. However, team members who reside within 20 miles of the Traverse City headquarters will follow a hybrid schedule, working from the office three days per week.

For SOX compliant roles, responsible for designing, executing, and documenting internal controls where they have been identified as owners to prevent errors in financial reporting, processes, and business operations. title: iOS Tech Lead - Sr. MTS
description:
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

The Team

eBay's Selling Experience Team builds the native iOS and Android experiences that help millions of sellers create and publish listings. We're transforming this critical part of the marketplace through AI-powered listing tools, camera and image-based experiences, and simpler workflows that help both new and experienced sellers succeed.

Our team works closely with product, design, and engineering partners to deliver customer-facing features at scale, with a strong focus on experimentation, quality, and rapid iteration.

The Role

We're looking for a hands-on iOS Tech Lead - Sr. MTS to drive the technical direction of our iOS listing experience. You'll lead architecture and product delivery, write production code, solve complex engineering challenges, and coach a small team of iOS engineers.

This role combines approximately equal parts hands-on engineering and technical/team leadership. We're looking for someone who brings strong independent judgment, challenges assumptions constructively, and enjoys building products as much as leading engineers.

What You Will Accomplish

  • Lead the architecture, development, and delivery of large-scale native iOS experiences used by millions of sellers.
  • Help modernize our listing tools through AI, camera, image/video, and other native device capabilities.
  • Remain hands-on with Swift development, code reviews, debugging, and technical problem-solving.
  • Drive multiple concurrent initiatives while balancing delivery speed, technical quality, and long-term maintainability.
  • Mentor and lead iOS engineers, fostering strong engineering practices and continuous improvement.
  • Collaborate with product, UX, and engineering teams to shape technical direction and deliver impactful customer experiences.
  • Improve application performance, reliability, testing, and development efficiency.

What You Will Bring

  • 12+ years of native iOS development experience, including technical leadership or engineering mentorship.
  • Deep expertise in Swift, iOS frameworks, application architecture, concurrency, and design patterns.
  • Experience building and shipping complex, high-traffic, consumer-facing iOS applications.
  • Strong architectural judgment, problem-solving skills, and experience making technical trade-offs.
  • Experience with backend API integration, application lifecycle management, and production debugging.
  • Ability to lead engineers, influence technical decisions, and communicate effectively across teams.
  • A hands-on, product-focused mindset and comfort operating in a fast-paced environment.

Nice to Have

  • SwiftUI, Combine, or The Composable Architecture (TCA) experience.
  • Experience with on-device AI, camera functionality, or image/video processing.
  • Automated testing, CI/CD, and mobile experimentation experience.
  • Formal people management experience.
  • Consumer internet, marketplace, or other large-scale mobile product experience.

Build at the heart of eBay's marketplace. Listing is where the selling journey begins. The experiences you build will directly influence how easily millions of people can participate in ecommerce.

Shape a major product transformation. We're reimagining the listing experience with AI, native device capabilities, and more intuitive seller workflows. You'll help define and ship these experiences rather than simply maintain an established system.

Own meaningful technical decisions. You'll have significant influence over iOS architecture, engineering practices, and technical direction across the Listing domain.

Lead while staying hands-on. This role offers the opportunity to grow and mentor engineers without stepping away from the technical challenges you enjoy solving.

See your work reach customers. Our teams move quickly, experiment frequently, and deliver improvements to a large global user base. You'll have the opportunity to connect engineering decisions directly to meaningful customer and business outcomes.
