With one of the most experienced management teams in solar, category-leading products, and a fortified technology roadmap, NEXTracker is making a dramatic impact on the power plant of the future


Summary of Role

The Technical Adviser’s goal is to coordinate between the Project Manager and the Customer and assist with the successful construction of NEXTracker products. The TA will facilitate a positive experience with NEXTracker by providing excellent customer service. The TA ensures that NEXTracker’s products and field services out-perform customer expectations and are of the highest quality possible. The TA develops customer loyalty by optimizing the product to the Customer’s needs and providing great onsite technical support services for the NEXTracker product.


Responsibilities

• Responsible for your own safety, and care and shared responsibility for the safety of all co-workers on site. A good understanding of WHS principles and construction site safety is required

• Adherence to all WHS safety regulations and NEXTracker and Customer WHS Policy & Process. Ensures no NEXTracker employee or subcontractor operations proceed without proper safety compliance.

• Provides technical support for NEXTracker customers across Australia, ensuring a best in class customer experience and providing product and systems expertise to the Customer.

• Translate and interpret construction plans, manuals, part number reference lists, technical bulletins, product change notifications and other documents to support construction and installation of NEXTracker products.

Responsible party for participating in, documenting and reporting safety meetings, together with the PM

• Establish and maintain effective communication channels with PM, and Customer PM, Construction Manager, Site Supervisor, Quality team and other customer staff

• Work with Project Manager to develop accurate construction schedule forecasts and to create daily reports to track construction progress, material deliveries, installation issues, tool issues and others site activity.

• Conduct systematic QA inspections of piling and tracker construction in accordance with QA process, tracking, reporting and closing out all deviations via Construction Deviation Report process.

• Liaise between Customer, PM and Quality teams to report and resolve any NEXTracker product quality issues via NCR and RMA processes.

• Work with the Customer to assess readiness for commissioning via Pre-Commissioning processes, and coordinate Commissioning process with the PM and Commissioning Manager

• Provide guidance and technical support to the NEXTracker personnel, temporary labor and subcontractors on issues concerning mechanical, electrical and construction issues

• Provide guidance and advice to Customers on tool operations, maintenance and servicing, and coordinate tool service and training between Customer and our suppliers


Experience, Qualities and Qualifications


Essential

• 5 Years construction industry experience, at least 2 at supervisory level

• A good working understanding of Australian WHS regulations, especially regarding the construction industry

• Construction industry induction (white card)

• Basic First Aid + CPR training (will be provided if not held already – mandatory)

• The physical health, fitness and ability to carry out the responsibilities described above

• Willingness to undergo health and drug/alcohol screening as required for Project site access

• Good understanding of mechanical and electrical systems in a heavy construction context

• Proficient with general construction tools and techniques (laser levels, hand tools, air and pneumatic tools, torqueing, quality assurance etc)

• Detail oriented, with good basic mathematical ability and problem-solving skills

• Self-starter, with ability to work independently, along with strong desire and ability to promote teamwork and achieving team goals

• Excellent customer service skills and ability to build strong customer relationships

• Positive, friendly, enthusiastic attitude – TAs are the face of NEXTracker to our customers in the field and must represent us well

• Experience in and talent for dealing with customer support issues

Understanding of project management techniques and experience in delivering construction-related projects

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills, proficiency in MS Office (Word, Outlook, Excel) and willingness to develop proficiency in NEXTracker systems

• Extensive travel required – this role is up to 100% field based, with the requirement that TAs travel to sometimes remote sites and live away from home for extended periods


Preferred

• Passion for solar or renewable energy

• Strong knowledge of PV technology and its applications

• Hands-on experience with photovoltaic tracking solar systems a plus

• Electrical or mechanical engineering qualifications

At Nextpower, we are driving the global energy transition with an integrated clean energy technology platform that combines intelligent structural, electrical, and digital solutions for utility-scale power plants. Our comprehensive portfolio enables faster project delivery, higher performance, and greater reliability, helping our customers capture the full value of solar power. Our talented worldwide teams are redefining how solar power plants are designed, built, and operated every day with smart technology, data-driven insights, and advanced automation. Together, we’re building the foundation for the world’s next generation of clean energy infrastructure.

We are Nextpower

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Why This Role Matters
Senior Software Engineers are the technical anchors of our teams. You'll be the go-to person for a domain or service, ensuring that what we ship is not only functional but well-designed, tested, and sustainable. Your work will directly impact mission readiness, and your mentorship will shape the next generation of engineers at Bluestaq. You'll balance hands-on delivery with technical leadership, raising the bar for code quality and system design.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own features and modules that span multiple components/services and require coordination with other teams or roles
  • Design and implement non-trivial features with clear tradeoffs (performance, readability, complexity, security)
  • Write solid tests (unit, integration, basic end-to-end) and help improve test coverage and reliability
  • Identify and address code smells, refactoring opportunities, and tech debt in your area
  • Understand core architecture patterns in use (microservices, event-driven, SPA, component-based UI) and work within them effectively
  • Operate independently within your product area: scope work, make reasonable design decisions, and proactively raise risks
  • Act as an escalation point for junior engineers when debugging issues or clarifying designs
  • Mentor others via pairing, feedback, and sharing context, not just fixing things yourself
  • Lead medium-sized features from idea → design → implementation → production → follow-up
  • Debug complex issues that span multiple components or services, including production incidents
  • Make incremental improvements to architecture, patterns, and tooling in your domain

Required Qualifications

  • Strong proficiency in multiple programming languages and frameworks
  • Proven ability to design and deliver complex features across the full stack
  • Deep understanding of software architecture patterns and design principles
  • Experience with automated testing strategies and test-driven development
  • Track record of mentoring junior engineers and improving team practices
  • Strong debugging and problem-solving skills across distributed systems
  • Experience with cloud platforms, containerization, and modern deployment practices
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to explain technical concepts clearly

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with microservices architectures and distributed systems
  • Familiarity with event-driven architectures and asynchronous processing
  • Background in performance optimization and scalability
  • Experience working on government, defense, or mission-critical systems
  • Knowledge of security best practices and secure coding standards
  • Contributions to open-source projects or technical communities
  • Experience with observability tools and practices (logging, metrics, tracing)
  • Familiarity with customer-facing environments, including Technical Exchange Meetings (TEMs) or similar collaborative forums with stakeholders

Required Experience and Education:

  • PhD in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field and 0+ years of software engineering or related experience, OR
  • Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field and 2+ years of software engineering or related experience, OR
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field and 4+ years of software engineering or related experience, OR
  • Associate degree in a related field and 6+ years of software engineering or related experience, OR
  • High School Diploma/GED and 8+ years of software engineering or related experience.

Location Requirement
Colorado Springs, CO · Washington, DC · Dallas, TX · Salt Lake City, UT

  • Colorado Springs is our HQ with an established office — 3–4 days on-site per week.
  • DC, Dallas, and Salt Lake City-based roles will be remote until offices are established there, and then will require 3–4 days on-site.

You use modern AI tools with judgment: integrating them into workflows where they're impactful, reviewing their outputs, and handling proprietary or sensitive data responsibly.

Salary Range (CO)
$100,000—$155,000 USD

Clearance Requirement: This position may require an active TS/SCI Clearance. Current clearance holders are strongly encouraged to apply. If you don't currently hold one, Bluestaq will sponsor eligible candidates through the clearance process based on program needs.

Relocation: Relocation assistance is available for full-time positions.

About Bluestaq
At Bluestaq, we build secure data platforms that matter for space missions, national defense, healthcare systems, and commercial innovation. Founded in 2018, we've become a leader in enterprise software and secure data management by staying focused on what counts: modern architecture, operational excellence, and mission impact.

We're engineers, problem-solvers, and builders who take the mission seriously, but not ourselves. We automate the repeatable, question the status quo, and design systems that are as reliable as they are scalable. Whether we're supporting space, defense systems, or healthcare advancements, we build with the same principles: cloud-native solutions, security by design, and relentless simplicity.

What We Offer:
For full-time positions

  • 100% employer-paid health, dental, and vision for you and your dependents
  • Up to 6% match to 401(k) contributions with additional discretionary 4% profit share on day one. Roth options available; no vesting period.
  • Every role is eligible for an annual performance bonus
  • $200,000 employer-paid life insurance, plus short- and long-term disability coverage
  • $5,000 annual professional development budget per employee
  • 20 days PTO, plus 8 paid holidays
  • Pet insurance, onsite gym, and flexible schedule

Bluestaq is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We prohibit unlawful discrimination against applicants or employees on the basis age 40 and over, color, disability, gender identity, genetic information, military or veteran status, national origin, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, or any other status protected by state or local law.

Bluestaq will make reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with known disabilities and employees whose work requirements interfere with a religious belief unless doing so would result in an undue hardship to Bluestaq or a direct threat. Employees needing such accommodation are instructed to contact Human Resources immediately at contact.us@bluestaq.com.

Applications will be accepted for 60 days beyond the posting date, or until the position is filled, whichever comes first.

title: Lead Digital Transformation Officer - Information Technology
description:
SUMMARY:

The Lead Digital Transformation Officer is responsible for leading and coordinating the execution of the Bank's digital transformation initiatives. This role partners with business line leaders, technology teams, operations, and executive leadership to identify, prioritize, and implement strategic projects that improve efficiency, enhance customer and employee experiences, and support organizational growth. The Digital Transformation Officer manages the enterprise project portfolio, evaluates resource capacity, establishes project priorities, and drives execution to ensure strategic initiatives are completed successfully and deliver measurable business value.

SUPERVISOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

Carries out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the organization’s policies and applicable laws. Responsibilities include interviewing, hiring, and training employees; planning, assigning, and directing work; appraising performance; rewarding and disciplining employees; addressing complaints and resolving problems.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Leads the Bank's digital transformation efforts by coordinating strategic initiatives that improve business processes, customer experiences, employee experiences, and operational effectiveness.

Partners with executive leadership and department leaders to identify, evaluate, and prioritize transformation opportunities aligned with organizational goals.

Establishes and maintains an enterprise project intake, prioritization, and governance process.

Manages the Bank's transformation project portfolio, ensuring alignment with strategic objectives and available resources.

Oversees capacity planning across departments to balance project demand, resource availability, and business priorities.

Works with business units to assess project feasibility, define business requirements, identify dependencies, and establish implementation timelines.

Initiates and facilitates project execution by assembling project teams, developing project plans, assigning responsibilities, and monitoring progress.

Tracks project performance, milestones, risks, issues, and resource utilization, escalating concerns when appropriate.

Facilitates cross-functional collaboration to ensure projects remain aligned and obstacles are addressed effectively.

Identifies opportunities for process improvement, automation, digitization, and operational efficiencies throughout the organization.

Develops and maintains project management standards, reporting frameworks, and governance processes.

Creates executive-level reporting and dashboards that communicate project status, resource capacity, risks, and business outcomes.

Supports organizational change management efforts associated with transformation initiatives, including communication, training, and stakeholder engagement.

Collaborates with technology, operations, risk, compliance, and vendor partners to support successful project delivery.

Monitors industry trends, emerging technologies, and banking best practices to identify opportunities that support strategic objectives.

Ensures projects are implemented in accordance with regulatory requirements, risk management standards, and organizational policies.

OTHER REQUIREMENTS:

Banking is a highly regulated industry and you will be expected to acquire and maintain a proficiency in the Bank's policies and procedures, and adhere to all laws, rules and regulations that are applicable to your conduct and the work you will be performing. You will also be expected to complete all assigned compliance training in a timely manner.

Strong understanding of banking operations, products, services, and regulatory environments.

Demonstrated ability to align strategic objectives with tactical project execution.

Strong project management, organizational, and planning skills.

Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent initiatives and competing priorities.

Experience with project portfolio management, governance, and resource allocation methodologies.

Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities.

Ability to assess organizational capacity and recommend project prioritization strategies.

Excellent verbal, written, presentation, and facilitation skills.

Ability to effectively communicate with executives, department leaders, employees, vendors, and external partners.

Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building skills.

Demonstrated ability to influence without direct authority across all organizational levels.

Experience driving process improvement and change management initiatives.

Proficient in project management, reporting, and collaboration tools.

Ability to work independently while fostering collaboration across teams.

Professional demeanor with a strong customer and employee service orientation.

Team player with a positive outlook and commitment to continuous improvement.

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION:

The wage range for the Lead Digital Transformation Officer position is $75,000 - $90,000 annually. The position includes 22 days of PTO (Paid Time Off) and 5 days of STD (Short Term Disability), 11 annual paid holidays, and 1 annual float holiday.

WesBanco has an excellent benefits package to include medical, dental, and vision, Health Care Flexible Spending, Dependent Care Flexible Spending, Transportation Fringe Benefit Plan, Group Life, Long Term Disability, Optional Life, access to voluntary benefit products such as Cancer, Term & Universal Life, Accident, Short-Term Disability and Critical Illness policies, and other ancillary benefit products. WesBanco also offers 401(k) with employee match.

title: Junior Product Marketer
description:
📍 Antwerp

Help Europe's biggest buildings waste less energy.

Enersee is growing fast. We are ready to scale to the next phase and to help more hospitals, offices, factories, and cities become radically more energy efficient. But to make that happen, we need you!

We're looking for a Junior Product Marketer to sit between our product team and our market — turning everything our engineers build into language that customers, partners and prospects actually understand.

About Enersee

We don't like waste. Waste of time, energy, water, and efficiency. That's why we built an AI-powered tool for energy, sustainability, and facility professionals. It uncovers hidden issues in building data, delivers real-time actionable insights, and helps organizations hit cost and emission targets. In short, we help companies save money while making the planet less wasteful.

Why this role matters

Our product team ships constantly. The problem with shipping constantly is that the outside world doesn't automatically find out — and when a customer, or a partner pitching on our behalf, is working from an outdated picture of what we do, we risk losing momentum.

That's the gap you'd close. You'd be the person who knows what shipped this week, understands it well enough to explain it, and makes sure everyone who needs to know actually knows: our customers, our partners, our prospects, and our own sales team.

This role reports directly to the Head of Marketing.

Requirements

What you'll do

  • Follow every product release. Sit in on product sessions, understand what's been built and why it matters to a customer.

  • Translate it. Turn technical release notes into commercial language — not "we refactored the ingestion layer" but "customers can now connect their meters in a day."

  • Own the product newsletter and overall product-related communication with our customers.

  • Keep our partners current, so nobody ever presents an outdated version of Enersee.

  • Create the materials — feature one-pagers, slides, release notes, and the assets our sales team needs to explain what's new.

  • Maintain our Help Center, so customers can find their own answers.

  • Watch the market. Keep an eye on what competitors are launching and claiming, and feed what you learn back to product and marketing.

Our Ideal hire

  • A degree in Marketing or Engineering - both will serve you well here.

  • A past internship or ~1 year in marketing, comms, product or content. Adjacent experience counts.

  • Available at least three days a week, and open to going full-time in July 2027. Alternatively, this can be an internship that turns into a full-time role upon successful completion.

  • You can explain complicated things simply.

  • You want to understand how the product works, not just describe it.

  • Hands-on with tools like HubSpot, Figma, Webflow or Notion.

  • Fluent English and Dutch — some content you write will be in Dutch.

  • Genuine interest in energy, sustainability and tech. Climatetech experience is a big plus!

  • Proactive and resourceful in a fast-moving startup.

  • Based in or near Antwerp.

What we offer you in return

  • Hands-on experience and real ownership of marketing initiatives.

  • Direct exposure to startup leadership and strategy.

  • The chance to make a visible impact on Enersee’s growth.

  • A collaborative, supportive team culture.

Compensation

  • Competitive compensation

  • Meal vouchers (€8/day).

  • Commuting expenses reimbursed.

  • Company laptop provided.

  • An international team

Don’t check every box?

Smart people don’t always follow straight lines. If you believe in what we’re doing and think you can help us grow, we want to hear from you. 🚀

title: Software Engineer New Grad
description:
About the Company

Valon is the leading AI platform for mortgage servicing, building the AI-native operating system for regulated finance.

Before providing the system of record that powers the entire industry, we built and ran our own mortgage servicer on it. That gave us a real regulated environment to prove our technology could replace the mainframe systems servicers have used for decades. Carrington acquired that servicer and adopted ValonOS as its core platform, allowing us to focus entirely on scaling our SaaS platform.

ValonOS is now on track to power 1 in 6 U.S. mortgages across major mortgage servicers like Newrez, Carrington, and ServiceMac. Every process on the platform is structured and programmable, enabling our AI agents to perform core servicing work, like handling payments, escrow, and homeowner questions, directly within the system's controls.

We recently raised a $150 million Series D at a $2.3 billion valuation by new investor Ribbit Capital, with continued support from existing backer a16z, amongst others.

Engineering at Valon

Our engineering team is here to power the software ecosystem to disrupt one of the most outdated and regulated spaces in the financial sector - the mortgage industry. We’ve built out the foundation of a modern mortgage servicing platform that can accurately handle billions of dollars at scale, but we’re just getting started. At Valon, we want you to do the best work of your life. You'll be surrounded by a tight-knit community of exceptional people from places like Stripe, Jane Street, Meta, and Google who care deeply about their work and each other. Our problem space is complex, but you’ll get a lot of autonomy so that you can learn quickly, execute effectively, and deliver the highest level of business impact. Our tech stack is built on Python, React, Docker, Kubernetes, and Google Cloud Platform.

Our office locations are based in New York City and in San Francisco.

Responsibilities

  • Learn new concepts and technologies quickly and apply them to challenging problems

  • Design and build robust and extensible infrastructure to handle evolving and complex federal, state, and agency regulations

  • Dive deep to understand the inner workings of a highly complex industry

  • Work with Product and Design to define the best experience for our customers

Ideal Background

  • 0-1 year of software engineering experience building quality software applications at scale

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field

  • Strong communicator. Able to work cross-functionally to balance product and technical requirements

  • Great at building scalable systems from scratch with a fast turnaround

  • Experience with one or more of the following: web application development, mobile application development, building large-scale distributed systems, or infrastructure management

  • Time management skills that will maximize efficiency in a fast paced startup environment

Benefits

  • Compensation: competitive salary with a meaningful stake in the company via equity, and 401(k) plan. The base salary range reflects multiple levels. We assess level based on a combination of experience and interview performance.

  • Health & well-being: we’ll invest in your physical and mental well-being with comprehensive medical, dental, & vision benefits.

  • Free Food: daily lunch, and dinner provided through Forkable for in-office team members.

  • Commuter benefits: pre-tax deductions for public transit, rideshares, and parking to simplify your daily commute.

  • Grow together: company wide orientation for you to successfully onboard and other learning & development opportunities including regular review cycles that feature 360-degree feedback.

  • Play together: quarterly budgets for team and company outings. Use it for team swag, cooking classes, or team dinners.

  • Generous time off: flexible paid time off with no annual limit, sick days, and 11 company holidays.

  • Baby bonding time: 12 weeks of fully paid leave for both birthing and non-birthing parents, so you can spend uninterrupted time welcoming and caring for your newest family member.

Throughout the interview process, please remember that emails will only be from email addresses. We will never ask for any personally identifiable information during the interview process itself. Please reach out to talent@valon.com if you have any requests to verify the authenticity of an outreach.

Valon is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws. Valon makes hiring decisions based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs at the time.

title: Assisterende infrastrukturansvarlig
description:
Er du en erfaren ingeniør, trives du med at have ansvar, og har du interesse for letbanetekniske anlæg? Så er det måske dig, vi mangler i vores team.

Vi er netop nu ved at forberede et generationsskifte i vores tekniske systemansvar, og samtidig står vi i de kommende år med en række større opgaver i forbindelse med anskaffelse af nye og længere tog. Du er med dér, hvor tingene sker – tæt på teknikerne og de tekniske installationer – og du er med til at sikre, at Østjylland får en sikker og robust letbaneinfrastruktur. Du vil være garant for, at de nybyggede anlæg efter ibrugtagningen kan driftes og vedligeholdes efter de gældende letbanenormer.

Om jobbet
Du får titlen som assisterende infrastrukturansvarlig – Baneteknik og vil indgå i et professionelt fagligt team i Teknisk Drift-sektionen. På sigt vil du kunne overtage det fulde ansvar som infrastrukturansvarlig – Baneteknik i forbindelse med generationsskiftet i løbet at få år. Her ligger ansvaret for, at vi fortsat har grundlaget for et højt sikkerheds- og vedligeholdelsesniveau for vores infrastruktur, hvor dit ansvarsområde vil være de sikringstekniske anlæg (sikringsanlæg, overkørsler, fjernstyring).

Dit daglige arbejde bliver at sikre, at Letbanen vedligeholdes og fejlrettes efter gældende regler og procedurer, hvor du er en nøgleperson i arbejdet med at føre tilsyn og kvalitetssikre det udførte sikringstekniske arbejde. Du får desuden ansvaret for, at letbanenormer og øvrige tekniske regler inden for eget fagområde er opdaterede i forhold til national og international lovgivning.

Dine opgaver vil derudover være:

  • Løbende opfølgning på fejlregistreringer og tilbagemeldinger på anlæggenes tilstand i tæt samarbejde med sektion Vedligehold
  • Føre tilsyn med vedligeholdelse, installation og test af sikringstekniske anlæg og signaltekniske arbejder
  • Foretage runderinger på steder hvor der skal udføres arbejde – både før, under og efter
  • Kvalitetssikre og dokumentere arbejdet i henhold til gældende normer og standarder
  • Gennemgå projektmateriale for bygbarhed og kvalitet samt afklare tekniske forespørgsler
  • Deltage i sikringstekniske ibrugtagninger, herunder ved kritisk natarbejde, hvor der er krav om åbning af sporet til bestemt tid
  • Behandling af dispensationsansøgninger
  • 3. parts validering af projekter samt faglig sparring og hjælp til interne og eksterne projekter.

Om dig
Vi søger en fagligt stærk kollega med minimum tre års erfaring som ingeniør, sikringstekniker eller anden relevant teknisk baggrund – gerne med erfaring inden for sikringsanlæg, signalteknik eller fra bygge- og anlægsbranchen.

Du kan nikke genkendende til, at du:

  • arbejder struktureret og systematisk
  • har forståelse for tekniske standarder og kan omsætte dem til praksis
  • kommunikerer klart og professionelt, også i perioder med højt tempo
  • trives i et tæt og tværfagligt samarbejde med både kolleger og entreprenører
  • har en høj sikkerhedsbevidsthed og et stærkt ansvar for kvalitet.

Derudover er du god til at skabe stærke relationer internt og eksternt og har en initiativrig tilgang til arbejdet. Erfaring med letbane, jernbane og de nye sikringsanlæg ERTMS eller CBTC er en fordel – men ikke et krav. Vi har fokus på videndeling og udvikling, og vi sørger for at klæde dig fagligt på, uanset hvilken baggrund du kommer med. Det er en forudsætning for varetagelse af stillingen, at du har kørekort til personbil.

Om os
Aarhus Letbane I/S er en mindre organisation, med korte kommandoveje. Aarhus Letbane I/S er en organisation i vækst kendetegnet ved en travl hverdag og en uformel omgangstone i et team af højt engagerede kolleger. Det betyder også, at vi hjælper hinanden med at holde Letbanen kørende. Stillingen er placeret i Aarhus Letbanes Teknisk Drifts-sektion i afdelingen Infrastruktur under ledelse af Martin Moth. Din daglige arbejdsplads bliver på Letbanens Trafik og Servicecenter i banegraven på Thomas Koppels Gade 311.

Vil du med på holdet?
Du kan høre mere om stillingen hos Martin Moth på tlf. 2926 1880. Stillingen ønskes besat hurtigst muligt, og vi arbejder derfor ikke med en ansøgningsfrist. Vi indkalder løbende til samtaler, så tøv ikke med at sende din ansøgning og CV hurtigst muligt til job@aarhusletbane.dk.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

Send din ansøgning til:

  • job@aarhusletbane.dk

title: QA Analyst
description:
BIS Safety Software is a SaaS company on a mission to change how organizations manage safety, learning, and compliance, and the team behind that mission matters just as much as the product. As we continue to grow, we’re expanding our QA team and adding another QA Analyst to help strengthen our testing capabilities.

About the role:

In this role, you'll own manual and exploratory testing for new features and releases on the BIS platform. This isn't a follow-the-script, mark-pass-or-fail role. It's about understanding what a feature is supposed to do, stepping off the expected path, and finding the problems nobody thought to write a test case for. You'll write the test plans, design the cases, run and maintain our existing automated suites, and work side by side with developers to get issues reproduced and fixed. You'll use AI tools as an everyday partner to get more done.

This is an onsite role based out of our Sherwood Park, Alberta office.

In this role, you will be expected to:

  • Test new features and releases manually, with exploratory coverage that goes well beyond the written script
  • Design test cases for new functionality, including the edge cases the requirements didn't mention
  • Document defects clearly enough that developers can reproduce them without coming back to you for more detail
  • Run and maintain our automated test suites, keeping them healthy as the product changes
  • Prepare test data and support regression testing across releases
  • Use AI agents to draft test plans, find edge cases, maintain automated tests, investigate failures, and improve release workflows, verifying everything they produce.
  • Put AI tools to work to speed up test design, documentation, and execution
  • Shape how we test by contributing to QA team discussions on coverage and process improvement

You might be the right fit if you:

  • Hunt for what could break, treating every feature as something to question rather than something to confirm
  • Write defect reports that are precise, complete, and impossible to misread
  • Prioritize under pressure, weighing business priority and risk
  • Treat AI as a partner in your work and keep looking for ways to use it better
  • Speak up when something looks off, even if nobody else has noticed
  • Take ownership of your work and keep it moving without needing direction on every step

Qualifications we are looking for:

  • 2 to 3 years of hands-on QA experience, or formal QA training paired with at least a year of real-world testing
  • A solid grasp of manual test case design, regression testing, and exploratory testing
  • Experience with API testing and API testing tools
  • Comfort with bug tracking tools such as Jira, Redmine, or similar
  • Working knowledge of browser debugging tools
  • An understanding of automation concepts and experience running or maintaining automated test scripts (writing them from scratch isn't required)
  • Practical, everyday use of AI tools

Bonus points if you have:

  • Experience with TestRail or a similar test case management tool
  • Exposure to Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, or Puppeteer
  • Familiarity with Git or other version control
  • Some JavaScript or TypeScript
  • Mobile testing experience, especially iOS edge cases

Compensation and benefits:

  • Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP)
  • Full medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Life insurance and disability insurance
  • Health spending account
  • Flexible working hours
  • On-the-job training and growth opportunities
  • Free on-site parking

About BIS:

BIS Safety Software has been headquartered in Sherwood Park, Alberta, since 2006. We build software that helps organizations manage safety training, learning, and compliance - and we’re growing!

A few things that make us different: we don’t use job titles internally - we value humility and contribution over hierarchy. We move fast, integrate new ideas quickly, and give people real ownership of their work. And through our Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), you have the opportunity to own a piece of the company you’re helping build.

How to apply:

We love hearing from our candidates - please include a cover letter. Visit our Careers Page for more information.
We sincerely thank all applicants for their interest. Only those selected for interviews will be contacted.

title: Spacecraft Propulsion Components Engineer II
description:
ABOUT ROCKET LAB

Rocket Lab is the end-to-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity’s reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We move fast, build real hardware for meaningful missions, and make the impossible routine. Come shape the future with us.

SPACE SYSTEMS

At Rocket Lab, we’re not just launching rockets — we're building the future of space. Our Space Systems team builds everything from complete spacecraft, precision payloads to the components and subsystems that allow them to thrive in space, like solar panels, flight software, star trackers, optical systems, separation systems, radios, and more.

Our Space Systems team has enabled more than 1,700 missions, ranging from interplanetary exploration, in-space manufacturing to national security and defense initiatives. The team has built spacecraft, payloads, and components for missions to the Moon and Mars, working with partners including NASA, the Space Development Agency, and the U.S. Space Force. Whether it’s a single high-performance spacecraft, constellation, or the vertically integrated components that help them get to space — our world class Space Systems team is empowering some of the boldest and most ambitious space missions.

SPACECRAFT PROPULSION COMPONENTS ENGINEER II

We're currently seeking a Spacecraft Propulsion Components Engineer II for our propulsion engineering team based out of Long Beach, CA. As a Propulsion Components Engineer, you're responsible for system-level and component-level ownership of space systems propulsion and fluidic development. This team supports our Space Systems division, and leads cutting-edge programs for civil, commercial, and defense customers.

WHAT YOU’LL GET TO DO:

  • Defining and maintaining standard of excellence for their team through documentation, training, coaching, and review of others’ work.
  • Contributing to engineering process development and documentation at Rocket Lab related to areas of experience.

YOU’LL BRING THESE QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor’s degree in an engineering discipline.
  • 2+ years of experience in propulsion system development or other high-performance field.
  • US citizenship is required, due to program requirements.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a security clearance.

THESE QUALIFICATIONS WOULD BE NICE TO HAVE:

  • A genuine passion for engineering, curious mindset, and willingness to learn.
  • Detailed mechanical design experience using NX (preferred) or equivalent industry standard CAD software and Product Lifecycle Management software such as Teamcenter (preferred), Windchill, or similar.
  • Comfortable working with high levels of ambiguity.
  • Ability to make decisions using basic engineering principles, available literature and standards, technical risk assessments, test data, and physics-based models.
  • Experience working on propulsion systems utilizing different storable propellants, such as electrical and chemical.
  • Track record of design reviews and approving release of flight parts, qual reports and decisions for flight hardware.
  • Practice in identifying the necessary steps to achieve high level technical goals, scheduling them in a plan, and managing delivery against that plan.
  • Experience developing requirement and verification sets, as well as writing test plans, performing testing, and writing test reports.
  • Experience with end-to-end development process including gathering requirements, detailed design, qualification, production, and acceptance testing.
  • Capabilities using Python for data manipulation and post-processing.
  • Demonstrated hands-on engineering skills, inside or outside the workplace.
  • Hands-on integration and testing experience (ideally using NI equipment and software).
  • Experience with GD&T and engineering drawings.
  • Experience using Product Lifecycle Management software such as Teamcenter (preferred), Windchill, or similar.
  • Experience using National Instruments data acquisition systems.
  • Experience with testing and troubleshooting flight hardware.
  • Master's or PhD in engineering.

This position may require prolonged periods of sitting, standing, walking, computer work, and occasional exposure to moderate levels of noise, dust, and fumes in production areas.

Anticipated annual equity grant value is designed around function, level, experience, and other factors; realized value depends on vesting and stock-price performance.

Join one of the world's fastest-growing space companies and own a piece of it. In addition to competitive base pay, you'll receive company stock as part of your total compensation package, giving you a direct stake in our success. As we expand to new launch sites, groundbreaking missions, and global markets, your ownership has the opportunity to grow alongside the company.

Our comprehensive benefits package includes our industry-leading Employee Stock Purchase Program (with a 15% discount on company stock), top-tier medical plans (HMO, PPO, and a zero cost HDHP option with a significant HSA company contribution), dental and vision coverage, paid vacation and sick time, 11 paid holidays, flexible spending and dependent care accounts, paid parental leave, disability and life insurance, and a 401(k) retirement plan with company match.

Operational responsibilities:

General Facility Maintenance – Perform routine building maintenance and repair tasks throughout the golf club. Respond to work orders and maintenance requests in a timely and professional manner. Requires frequent walking, bending, reaching, and lifting up to 50 lbs.

Painting and Cosmetic Repairs – Perform paint touch-ups, drywall patching, and minor surface repairs in guest, member, and employee areas. Requires standing for extended periods, climbing ladders, bending, and light to moderate lifting.

Preventative Maintenance Programs – Follow established preventative maintenance schedules and complete routine inspections. Maintain basic documentation of completed PM activities. Frequent walking, bending, and use of hand tools required.

Ice Machine Preventative Maintenance – Conduct routine cleaning, inspection, and maintenance of commercial ice machines. Ability to bend, reach, and lift equipment components as necessary.

Beverage and Water System Maintenance – Replace and maintain filters and components for:

  • Water softeners
  • Soda systems
  • Coffee and beverage equipment

Requires bending, kneeling, lifting, and use of hand tools.

HVAC Support – Perform basic HVAC troubleshooting, filter replacement, and preventative maintenance. Assist with vendor coordination for larger repairs. Requires climbing ladders, working in mechanical spaces, and lifting materials.

Electrical Maintenance – Replace light bulbs and fixtures. Perform basic electrical troubleshooting and minor repairs consistent with safety guidelines. Requires ladder use, reaching overhead, and working in confined spaces.

Plumbing – Perform basic plumbing tasks including clearing minor clogs, repairing drains, replacing fixtures, and maintaining pipes. Requires bending, kneeling, twisting, and lifting.

Installation and Assembly – Install shelves, wall-mounted equipment, signage, pictures, and fixtures. Requires lifting, positioning, drilling, and use of hand and power tools.

Safety and Compliance – Follow all company safety policies and procedures. Properly use personal protective equipment and report safety concerns to management.

Vendor Coordination – Assist in coordinating with outside contractors and service providers as needed. Monitor vendor work and ensure compliance with property standards.

Property Inspections – Perform routine walk-throughs of the facility to identify repair needs and ensure a safe environment.

Equipment and Tool Maintenance – Maintain tools and equipment in good working order and notify management when repairs or replacements are needed.

Conform with all safety standards and use of all appropriate safety equipment.

Performs all other duties, as assigned.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

What you’ll do:

  • Build and maintain high-throughput backend services using Go.
  • Collaborate with product managers, designers, and frontend developers to ship features that support internal support agents across the globe.
  • Design systems that are scalable, resilient, and easy to maintain.
  • Lead and contribute to architectural discussions and technical decision-making.
  • Write well-tested code and help the team maintain high code quality standards.

Our humble expectations:

  • 7+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a proven track record of building and scaling complex systems.
  • 2+ years of production experience in Golang, with the ability to mentor others and drive best practices across the team.
  • Strong hands-on experience with both SQL and NoSQL databases — especially Cassandra.
  • Solid understanding of designing and operating low-latency, high-throughput distributed systems.

Nice to have

  • Background in Node.js or other backend languages.
  • Familiarity with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP) and event-driven architectures.
  • Previous on-call experience, with a pragmatic approach to reliability and incident management.

What we value

  • A product-oriented mindset — you think beyond the ticket, understand the “why” behind the work, and aim to create real impact for users, having a high level of resposability.
  • Experience leading projects or making key technical decisions, especially in fast-paced environments.
  • Clear and proactive communication skills, with a collaborative spirit — we move fast, but we succeed together.

Next steps:

These positions will be filled as soon as we find the right persons, so make sure to apply as soon as you realize you really, really want to join us!

Are you curious about our hiring process? Check out our careers page for more info.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash .
